leesin-phase-early.text: Lee Sin's level-one attack damage and armor rank among the highest of all champions, making early jungle duels and counter-jungling his strongest phase. After your first two or three camps, look to disrupt the enemy jungler's route; once R becomes available at level 6, an Insec can break open an entire lane.

leesin-phase-late.basis: Lee Sin's damage contribution drops as the game goes on, making solo kills harder. In the late game, use R to separate one enemy so your strong allied carry can fight more easily. In the late game, use R to knock away opponents who dive your backline.
leesin-phase-late.text: As the game goes on, Lee Sin contributes less damage and can no longer reliably kill an opponent alone. Shift toward using R to isolate an enemy or knock away someone diving your backline, creating a favorable fight for your fed allied carry.

leesin-situational-antiheal.basis: Against opponents who sustain through healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items to capitalize on your early dueling advantage. Upgrade Executioner's Calling to Mortal Reminder to reduce the healing of opponents who rely on it to survive.
leesin-situational-antiheal.text: Against champions who survive through healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Lee Sin needs to win duels early, and failing to reduce that healing lets his window of advantage pass.

leesin-skill-e.basis: E's first cast deals area damage around you and provides stealth detection. Use E's first cast to check unwarded brush or reveal a hidden opponent. E's second cast slows opponents. Use E's second cast after the opponent uses their escape ability to chase them.
leesin-skill-e.text: E's first cast, Tempest, deals area damage around Lee Sin and detects stealthed enemies, so it can check unwarded brush or reveal a hidden opponent. Its second cast, Cripple, slows enemies; hold it after landing the first cast, then use it to keep up once the opponent uses an escape ability.

leesin-skill-passive-weave.basis: Flurry increases the attack speed of the next two basic attacks after using an ability and restores energy. When clearing the jungle or fighting, weave two basic attacks between abilities to maintain damage and energy.
leesin-skill-passive-weave.text: After Lee Sin uses an ability, Flurry increases the attack speed of his next two basic attacks and restores energy. Weave those attacks between abilities instead of using abilities back to back to deal more damage and maintain energy; use this ability–attack–attack rhythm when clearing the jungle and fighting.

leesin-skill-q.basis: Q's first cast is a skillshot projectile blocked by minions and jungle monsters. Approach from the side when ganking so the wave does not block Q. Avoid firing Q into empty space to check vision if you want to preserve your engage tool. Q's first cast grants true sight of the target hit, keeping them visible even if they flee into brush.
leesin-skill-q.text: Q's first cast, Sonic Wave, is a skillshot projectile that minions and jungle monsters can block. Gank from the side to avoid the wave, and avoid firing it into empty space to check vision, since that costs you your engage. A hit grants true sight, keeping the target visible even if they flee into brush.

leesin-skill-q2-timing.basis: Q's second cast deals more damage the more health the target is missing. Use allied CC and basic attacks to lower the target's health first, then finish with Q's second cast. When delaying Q's second cast, use it before its short recast window expires.
leesin-skill-q2-timing.text: Q's second cast, Resonating Strike, deals more damage the more health the target is missing. After landing the first cast, let allied crowd control and basic attacks lower their health before using the second cast to finish them, but act before its short recast window expires.

leesin-skill-r.basis: R holds the target in place during its cast. The target knocked back by R knocks up other enemies they collide with. Use R to kick the opponent toward your allies. To knock up multiple enemies, kick R's target through a group of enemies.
leesin-skill-r.text: Direction is everything with R, Dragon's Rage: it holds the target in place during the cast, then knocks up enemies the target hits while flying backward. Kick an opponent toward your allies or through a group for a knockup on multiple enemies; simply kicking someone away can let them escape.

leesin-skill-w.basis: W dashes to allies and your own wards. Place a ward over a wall to create a W path for an engage from an unseen angle. Before placing a ward, decide whether to use it for a W engage or escape.
leesin-skill-w.text: W's first cast, Safeguard, can dash to allies or your own wards, letting Lee Sin create his own engage and escape routes. A ward over a wall can set up an engage from an unseen angle or a retreat when danger comes; decide which route you need before placing it.

leesin-skill-w-recast.basis: W's second cast increases omnivamp. Use W's second cast to sustain your health while clearing jungle camps and heal during skirmishes. Use W's second cast as you start basic attacking immediately after engaging.
leesin-skill-w-recast.text: W's second cast, Iron Will, increases omnivamp, helping Lee Sin sustain through jungle clears and heal during skirmishes. After engaging with the first cast, use it as you begin basic attacking.

leesin-teamfight.basis: Only engage when your allies can follow up immediately. If your allies have not engaged yet, save R to knock away an enemy engager. Lee Sin has limits to how long he can hold the frontline in teamfights. Before entering a teamfight, plan an escape route using W or Q's second cast.
leesin-teamfight.text: In teamfights, Lee Sin's value comes from moving an enemy backliner toward his allies. Engage only when they can follow up immediately; if they have yet to enter the fight, save R to knock away an enemy who engages. Since Lee Sin cannot hold the frontline for long, plan a way out with W or Q's second cast before diving in.

leona-combo-engage.basis: For a basic engage, land E, activate Q, stun with an auto attack, then use W. Prepare E and Q together before engaging to chain their crowd control.
leona-combo-engage.text: For a basic engage, land E Zenith Blade to root the target, activate Q Shield of Daybreak as Leona arrives, stun with an auto attack, then use W Eclipse. Have both E and Q ready so the crowd control lasts continuously; if you engage with only one, the enemy can escape between them.

leona-combo-flash.basis: Q is not consumed on cast; it makes the next auto attack stun. Activate Q first, then Flash in and auto attack to give the enemy less time to react. An activated Q expires if you do not auto attack within a certain time.
leona-combo-flash.text: Q Shield of Daybreak is not consumed when cast; it empowers your next auto attack, so you can activate it before approaching. With Q ready, Flash in to land the stun without giving the enemy time to react to its activation. The effect expires if you do not auto attack within a certain time.

leona-laning-cooldown.basis: If an engage fails, you risk remaining in enemy range with both E and Q unavailable. E functions as an engage ability more than an escape. When looking for a risky engage, at least keep Flash available. Once your engage abilities are down, pull the wave toward your turret to deny a counterattack.
leona-laning-cooldown.text: A failed engage can leave you in enemy range with both E and Q unavailable. Since E is an engage tool rather than an escape, keep Flash available when taking a risky angle. Once your abilities are down, pull the wave toward your turret to deny a counterattack.

leona-laning-timing.basis: Engage as the enemy marksman steps forward to last-hit. Use E during your auto-attack animation to give the enemy less time to react. Before engaging, check that your allied marksman is close enough to follow up. Before engaging, check that your allied marksman's damage abilities are ready. Leona lacks the damage to go in alone and needs her allies' damage.
leona-laning-timing.text: Engage as the enemy marksman steps forward to last-hit, using E Zenith Blade during their auto-attack animation to leave them no time to react. First check that your allied marksman is close enough to follow up and has damage abilities ready; Leona lacks the damage to go in alone.

leona-phase.basis: In early trades, your role is to absorb the enemy's attacks. Look for a kill at levels 2–3, when both Q and E are available. Look for a kill at level 6, when you learn R. After that, your damage falls short, so shift your focus to engaging and crowd control.
leona-phase.text: Leona has one of the highest level 1 armor values of any champion, letting her absorb damage in early trades. Look for kills at levels 2–3, once both Q and E are available, and at level 6, when R becomes available. Her damage falls off afterward, so focus on engaging and applying crowd control.

leona-roaming.basis: You can make your strongest engage before the enemy spots Leona. Look for an E engage from a brush or an area without enemy vision. If the lane stalls, establish vision in the river, then try to roam mid. Leona's long crowd control helps secure kills, making her strong at roaming.
leona-roaming.text: Leona's engage is strongest when it starts before the enemy sees her. Keep looking for E angles from brush or areas without enemy vision; if the lane stalls, establish vision in the river and look to roam mid. She has little damage, but her crowd control can hold a target long enough for a kill, making her a valuable roamer.

leona-skill-e.basis: E travels in a straight line and dashes to the last enemy champion it hits. If another enemy champion is behind your E target, you may dash farther in and become isolated. Before casting E, check how many enemy champions are in its straight path.
leona-skill-e.text: E Zenith Blade travels in a straight line and dashes to the last enemy champion it hits. If another champion stands behind your intended target, it can pull you farther in and leave you isolated, so check how many enemies are in its path before casting.

leona-skill-passive.basis: Leona cannot trigger a Sunlight mark herself; an ally must attack the target. Get in first to apply a Sunlight mark, then have an ally attack that target. Avoid wasting a Sunlight mark on a target your allied damage dealer cannot see.
leona-skill-passive.text: Leona cannot trigger a P Sunlight mark herself; an ally must hit the target. Engage first to apply the mark, then let an ally attack that target. Do not waste it on someone your allied damage dealer cannot see.

leona-skill-r.basis: Remember that R stuns only enemies hit by its center. R only slows enemies hit by its outer area. Use R on a target already caught to land its center. An enemy who can move freely can easily dodge the center of R when you use it on its own. Once you have vision, use R's long range to join an engage from outside the lane.
leona-skill-r.text: R Solar Flare stuns enemies in its center but only slows those in its outer area. Cast it over a target already caught to secure the center hit; a freely moving enemy can easily dodge that area if you use R on its own. Its long range also lets you join an engage from outside the lane when you have vision.

leona-skill-w.basis: W provides damage reduction and increased armor and magic resistance. W explodes when its duration ends. W's bonus defensive stats can only be extended if the explosion hits at least one enemy. Use W just after reaching an enemy, rather than right before going in, so the enemy is nearby when it explodes.
leona-skill-w.text: W Eclipse reduces damage and grants armor and magic resistance, then explodes when its duration ends. The defensive stat increase lasts longer only if the explosion hits at least one enemy, so W is most useful while you are close to them. Activate it just after reaching an enemy, rather than immediately before engaging, to keep them nearby when it explodes.

leona-teamfight-engage.basis: When entering a teamfight first, use E and R to attack the enemy formation. When protecting your carry, stop enemies who jump on them with Q and E. If your team has less damage than the enemy, protect your carry instead of engaging first. After engaging, absorb focused attacks while W lasts and draw out enemy abilities.
leona-teamfight-engage.text: In a teamfight, Leona can open the enemy formation with E and R or stop enemies diving her carry with Q and E. If your team has less damage than the enemy, protect your carry instead of engaging first. After an engage, stay in the fight while W lasts to absorb focused attacks and draw out as many enemy abilities as possible.

leona-teamfight-target.basis: Choose an engage target your allies can reach and attack. An ally must attack to trigger a Sunlight mark. Do not go so far in that your allies cannot attack targets marked with Sunlight.
leona-teamfight-target.text: Choose a target your allies can actually reach and attack, rather than simply one who could be killed. Only allied attacks trigger P Sunlight marks, so diving beyond your allies' reach leaves Leona dealing virtually no damage.

lillia-combo-gank.basis: For ganks, slow the target with E, hit the center of W, then finish with Q. Without E's slow, landing the center of W is difficult.
lillia-combo-gank.text: For a gank, bounce E off a wall or roll it into the target, use the slow to land W's center, then finish with Q. Keep that order: without E's slow, W's center is almost impossible to land.

lillia-combo-r.basis: R puts only enemies marked with dream dust to sleep. Before using R, land at least one ability to apply dream dust. Use R when your allies can wait for drowsiness to become sleep. Don't place a persistent damage area on a sleeping enemy.
lillia-combo-r.text: R Lilting Lullaby puts only enemies marked with dream dust to sleep, so land an ability first and use R only when your allies can wait through the delay from drowsiness to sleep. A sleeping enemy wakes when hit by a single instance of damage, so avoid placing a persistent damage area on them.

lillia-combo-r-setup.basis: It's best to use R before a teamfight breaks out. Apply dream dust to several enemies from afar with Q and E, then use R from outside their vision. If you use R during a head-on fight, sleeping enemies take damage and wake up right away.
lillia-combo-r-setup.text: The best time to use R is before a teamfight begins: mark several enemies from afar with Q and E, then cast R from outside their vision so they cannot react. In a head-on fight, damage is already being exchanged, and they will wake as soon as they fall asleep.

lillia-laning-clear.basis: Catch the monster pack with Q's edge, then hit the large monster with W's center. Early on, use passive healing to clear camps back to back without interrupting your route.
lillia-laning-clear.text: For jungle clears, position so Q's edge catches the monster pack, then hit the large monster with W's center. Passive healing keeps health loss low, so clear camps back to back early without interrupting your route.

lillia-laning-gank.basis: Wait for the enemy to move farther into the lane before lining up an E gank. When ganking, roll E along a wall. Just before a gank, hit a camp or minion with Q to build movement speed stacks. Without Q movement speed stacks, chasing during a gank is difficult.
lillia-laning-gank.text: For the best gank angle, wait until the enemy moves farther into the lane, then roll E along a wall. Just before entering, hit a camp or minion with Q to build movement speed stacks; Lillia's base movement speed is low, making a chase difficult without them.

lillia-phase.basis: Lillia clears the jungle and scales well early. Lillia is weak at solo ganks early. After learning R at level 6, Lillia can gank in coordination with allies. Lillia peaks in the mid to late game when items strengthen her damage over time and movement speed. Early on, clear camps quickly instead of looking for kills.
lillia-phase.text: Lillia clears and scales well early, but her solo ganks are weak, as reflected by high early CS and low kill numbers. Once she learns R at level 6, coordinated ganks with allies become possible; she peaks in the mid to late game when items strengthen her damage over time and movement speed. Early on, focus on clearing camps quickly instead of forcing kills.

lillia-skill-e.basis: E rolls until it hits an enemy or terrain. Roll E down long, straight corridors or along walls to hit enemies outside your vision. Roll E ahead of a fleeing enemy's expected path. E reveals enemies it hits. Use E to check jungle entrances without vision.
lillia-skill-e.text: E Swirlseed rolls until it hits an enemy or terrain. Send it down a long, straight corridor or along a wall to hit enemies outside your vision; its best use is to roll it ahead of a fleeing enemy's expected path. It reveals enemies on hit, so you can also use it to check jungle entrances without vision.

lillia-skill-passive.basis: Applying dream dust to a champion or large jungle monster restores health. When low on health, clear a large camp to heal instead of recalling. Passive healing lets Lillia keep clearing the jungle.
lillia-skill-passive.text: Applying passive dream dust to a champion or large jungle monster restores health. When low, clearing a large camp is better for both healing and time than recalling. That healing lets Lillia keep clearing the jungle despite her low defensive stats.

lillia-skill-q.basis: Q has a short cooldown. Each Q hit stacks movement speed. Lillia's chases and escapes depend on Q's movement speed stacks. During fights, keep using Q and hit anything you can. The true damage at Q's edge is effective even against enemies with high defenses.
lillia-skill-q.text: Q has a short cooldown and stacks movement speed each time it hits. Since those stacks power Lillia's chases and escapes, keep casting Q during fights and hit anything you can. Its edge deals true damage, so it remains effective against enemies with high defenses.

lillia-skill-w.basis: W's windup gives away the cast. W deals much more damage when its center hits. Aim W's center at slowed or sleeping enemies. Aim W's center at stationary jungle monsters. W cannot cross terrain.
lillia-skill-w.text: W Watch Out! Eep! has a visible windup, and its damage rises sharply when the center hits. Aim it at slowed or sleeping enemies, or stationary targets such as jungle monsters. W cannot cross terrain, so it cannot reach an enemy beyond a wall.

lillia-teamfight.basis: In teamfights, use Q from the side to apply passive damage over time to several enemies. Slow enemy divers with E to keep them away from your damage dealers. Avoid getting caught while trying to land W's center from the front.
lillia-teamfight.text: Lillia is not a frontliner: her armor is very low, so cast Q from the side to apply passive damage over time to several enemies, and slow enemy divers with E to keep them away from your damage dealers. Getting caught while trying to land W's center from the front is a common mistake.

lillia-teamfight-r.basis: If you start a teamfight with R, decide the order in which your team should wake the sleeping enemies. Enemies put to sleep by R take extra damage when awakened. Focus sleeping enemies one at a time, waking and finishing each one.
lillia-teamfight-r.text: If you open a teamfight with R, set the order in which your team will wake the sleeping enemies so an area ability does not wake them all at once. Each takes extra damage on waking, making it better to focus and finish them one at a time.

lissandra-combo-engage.basis: Cast E, recast it to engage, then use W, Q, and R in that order. Press W as soon as you arrive with E to stop the enemy from escaping.
lissandra-combo-engage.text: To engage, cast E (Glacial Path) forward and recast it to teleport to the claw, then root the enemy with W (Ring of Frost) before using Q (Ice Shard) and R (Frozen Tomb), in that order. Press W almost as soon as you arrive so the enemy has no chance to escape; waiting to assess the situation until after you arrive is too late.

lissandra-combo-self-r.basis: To use R on yourself, press your self-cast key and R key together for an instant cast. Check your self-cast key setting beforehand.
lissandra-combo-self-r.text: Press your self-cast key and R together to cast R on yourself instantly. Check the key setting beforehand: opening the targeting prompt and trying to click yourself can get you killed.

lissandra-laning.basis: Her short ability ranges make her weak in ranged poke fights. Use Q to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels. Trade only when you can use E and W together. You are most vulnerable to a jungle gank right after using E to poke.
lissandra-laning.text: Lissandra’s movement speed is among the lowest, and her short ability ranges put her at a disadvantage in ranged poke fights. Use Q to last-hit and clear waves while keeping up in levels, and trade only when E and W are both available. Using E to poke leaves you especially vulnerable to a jungle gank immediately afterward.

lissandra-laning-roam.basis: Push the wave with Q, then use E to cross terrain and roam to a side lane. Do not roam if you have used W and R in lane.
lissandra-laning-roam.text: Push the wave with Q, then use E to cross terrain and roam to a side lane. The roam depends on having W and R available, so stay in lane if you have already used them there.

lissandra-phase.basis: From level 6, when both W and R are available, look for a guaranteed engage. Lissandra is strongest in the mid game, once she has one core item. In the late game, her raw damage falls short of other mages. In the late game, focus on stopping engages and applying crowd control.
lissandra-phase.text: Once W and R are both available at level 6, Lissandra can look for a guaranteed engage. She is strongest in the mid game with one core item; later, her raw damage falls short of other mages, so shift from dealing damage to stopping engages and applying crowd control.

lissandra-skill-e.basis: Use E to engage. Use E to escape. Recast E while the claw is traveling to teleport to its position. After casting E, run in the opposite direction to make it harder for the enemy to predict where you're going. If you're immobilized before recasting E, the teleport fails. If the enemy still has crowd control available, don't delay recasting E.
lissandra-skill-e.text: E works for both engaging and escaping: recast it at any point while the claw is traveling to teleport to its position. Casting it and running the other way makes your destination harder to predict, but being immobilized before the recast stops the teleport. If the enemy still has crowd control available, recast promptly.

lissandra-skill-passive.basis: When an enemy champion dies nearby, your passive creates a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and explode after a short delay. After the first kill, account for the Frozen Thrall's slow and area damage when looking for more kills.
lissandra-skill-passive.text: When an enemy champion dies nearby, Lissandra’s passive creates a Frozen Thrall that slows surrounding enemies and explodes after a short delay. After the first kill, factor that slow and area damage into your pursuit of another target.

lissandra-skill-q.basis: Q shatters on the first target it hits and pierces enemies behind it. Q does not shatter if it hits nothing. Against an enemy using minions as a shield, aim Q at a minion first so it reaches the champion behind it.
lissandra-skill-q.text: Q shatters on the first target it hits and pierces enemies behind it; if it hits nothing, it does not shatter. Against an opponent using minions as a shield, aim at a minion so the shattered Q reaches the champion behind it.

lissandra-skill-r-defense.basis: R cast on yourself prevents damage during stasis and restores health. R cast on yourself heals more the more health you are missing. Cast R on yourself late enough to block an enemy finishing ability or delayed damage. You cannot do anything during the stasis from casting R on yourself.
lissandra-skill-r-defense.text: Casting R on yourself makes you invulnerable during stasis and restores health, with a larger heal the more health you are missing. Hold it until an enemy finishing ability or delayed damage is about to hit, but account for the fact that you cannot act during stasis.

lissandra-skill-r-offense.basis: R cast on an enemy stuns the target and leaves an area slow around them. Use R to stop an enemy engager as they come in. If enemies are grouped up, cast R in the middle of them.
lissandra-skill-r-offense.text: Casting R on an enemy stuns them and spreads black ice that slows nearby enemies. It is most valuable for stopping an enemy engager as they come in; when enemies are grouped, target someone in the middle so the ice spreads through them.

lissandra-skill-w.basis: W instantly roots enemies around you, but its range is short. Missing W at low levels leaves you vulnerable during its long cooldown. Do not use W carelessly to clear waves; use it when an engage or jungle follow-up is certain.
lissandra-skill-w.text: W instantly roots enemies around you, but its short range means you have to get close. At low levels, a miss leaves you vulnerable throughout its long cooldown, so avoid using it carelessly to clear waves and save it for a certain engage or jungle follow-up.

lissandra-teamfight.basis: Before a teamfight, decide whether to engage with E and W or counter an enemy engage with R. If you are unsure about engaging, save R for an enemy engager. If you decide to engage in a teamfight, lock enemies down with E and W, then follow up with R.
lissandra-teamfight.text: Before a teamfight, decide whether to engage with E and W to root multiple enemies or answer an enemy engage with R. If you are unsure about going in, reserve R for the enemy engager; if you commit, be ready to follow E and W with R. Standing indecisively at the front is the worst option.

locke-combo-allin.basis: To engage, use Q, E's teleport, the dashing basic attack, then follow-up basic attacks. E's teleport and the next basic attack's dash work as separate steps. Use the dashing basic attack on a target with nails in them to focus your damage.
locke-combo-allin.text: To engage, use Q, teleport with E, then land the dashing basic attack and follow up with more basic attacks. E's teleport and the dash on your next basic attack are separate steps: position yourself first, then dash onto the target while the nails are still embedded to concentrate your damage.

locke-combo-basic.basis: For a basic trade, land Q, then use basic attacks to consume the nails. Nails only detonate from basic attacks. Before throwing Q, work out how many follow-up basic attacks you can land.
locke-combo-basic.text: For a basic trade, land Q and consume the nails with basic attacks. Since only basic attacks detonate them, work out how many follow-up attacks you can land before using Q.

locke-laning.basis: As a melee champion, you have to accept losing some CS against ranged opponents. Use Q to put nails in your opponent rather than clear minions. After landing nails, win trades with basic attacks. If your opponent won't trade, use E's teleport to find an angle to engage.
locke-laning.text: As a melee champion, accept some lost CS against ranged opponents. Use Q to embed nails in your opponent instead of clearing minions, then trade with basic attacks. If they refuse to trade, use E's teleport to find an angle and force the engage.

locke-laning-e-save.basis: E is Locke's only escape tool in lane. Don't use E to engage first when you don't know where the enemy jungler is. A takedown resets E's cooldown. If you can secure the kill, use E to engage, then use it again to escape.
locke-laning-e-save.text: E is Locke's only escape tool in lane, so save it while you do not know where the enemy jungler is. A takedown resets its cooldown, though, allowing you to engage with E and use it again to escape when you can secure the kill.

locke-phase.basis: Locke's melee range and high early mana costs make it hard to use combos back to back at levels 1–2. Locke ranks among the top mid champions for takedowns during the laning phase. Locke builds a lead through kills more than farming. After learning R at level 6, look for executions. As you collect relics, your ability to finish enemies keeps improving into the late game.
locke-phase.text: Locke's melee range and high early mana costs make back-to-back combos difficult at levels 1–2. During the laning phase, he ranks among mid champions with the most takedowns but among those with the least CS, building leads through kills more than farming. Once he learns R at level 6, look for executions; collecting relics keeps improving his ability to finish enemies into the late game.

locke-situational-antiheal.basis: If the enemy has healing, buy Morellonomicon between core items. Locke deals damage over time by consuming nails with basic attacks. If the enemy heals while you're dealing damage, it's hard to bring them below the execution threshold.
locke-situational-antiheal.text: If the enemy has healing, buy Morellonomicon between core items. Locke needs time to deal damage by consuming nails with basic attacks, and healing during that window can keep the target above his execution threshold.

locke-skill-e.basis: E teleports to a target location and damages nearby enemies. After E, your next basic attack dashes to the target and also hits enemies along the path. Use E's teleport to cross terrain. Use the dashing basic attack after E to close in on a target. A takedown resets E's cooldown. Don't save E when a kill is certain.
locke-skill-e.text: E teleports you to a chosen location and damages nearby enemies; your next basic attack then dashes to its target and hits enemies along the path. Use the teleport to cross terrain and the attack to close in. Since a takedown resets E's cooldown, use it when you have a certain kill.

locke-skill-passive.basis: The more health an enemy has lost, the more bonus damage your passive's basic attacks deal. Keep using basic attacks against enemies who have lost health. When finishing a target, don't wait for your abilities to come off cooldown.
locke-skill-passive.text: Your passive adds more damage to basic attacks the more health an enemy has lost. Against a wounded target, keep attacking instead of using more abilities, and do not wait for cooldowns when finishing them off.

locke-skill-q.basis: The more nails embedded, the more damage each basic attack deals. Each nail you fail to consume refunds some of Q's cooldown. If you can't reach a target with nails in them, don't force the chase.
locke-skill-q.text: The more nails embedded in a target, the more damage each basic attack deals. Unconsumed nails refund Q cooldown according to how many remain, so if you cannot reach the target, let them expire rather than forcing a chase.

locke-skill-r.basis: R heavily slows enemies in its area and marks them. An enemy with an R mark is sealed if their health falls below the threshold. Sealing an enemy with R drops a relic on the ground. Picking up a relic permanently raises R's execution threshold. Collect dropped relics after a fight.
locke-skill-r.text: R heavily slows and marks enemies in its area. A marked enemy is sealed if their health falls below the threshold, and a sealing drops a relic on the ground. Picking up relics permanently raises the execution threshold, so collect them after the fight.

locke-skill-w.basis: W increases your attack speed and movement speed while draining your health. When W ends, you recover health based on the damage you took and the health you lost during it. Activate W just before a fight where you need to consume nails quickly. Recasting W to end it early reduces the healing. If you don't need health urgently, let W run its full duration.
locke-skill-w.text: W boosts your attack speed and movement speed while draining your health. When it ends, you recover health based on the damage you took and the health you lost during it. Activate it just before a fight where you need to consume nails quickly, and let it run its full duration unless you urgently need health; recasting it early reduces the healing.

locke-skill-w-cc.basis: You can use W even while under crowd control. Activate W when crowd control keeps you from moving. Activating W during crowd control still gives you healing and increased attack speed afterward.
locke-skill-w-cc.text: You can activate W even while under crowd control. If you use it when you cannot act, you will still receive its healing and attack speed once the control ends, so press W when you get caught.

locke-teamfight.basis: Don't engage first in teamfights. Engage with E after your allies have damaged the enemy. After engaging, focus your passive and nail damage on enemies who have lost health. Use R where several enemies are grouped to spread its marks.
locke-teamfight.text: In teamfights, wait for your allies to damage the enemy before engaging with E and concentrating your missing-health-based passive and nail damage. Aim R at grouped enemies so it marks several of them.

lucian-combo-lane.basis: For lane trades, use Q, a double-shot basic attack, E, a double-shot basic attack, then W. Use E mid-combo to reposition and make up for his short range. Using E mid-combo lets you land one more double-shot basic attack.
lucian-combo-lane.text: For lane trades, use Q (Piercing Light), a double-shot basic attack, E (Relentless Pursuit) to reposition, another double-shot basic attack, then W (Ardent Blaze). Using E mid-combo makes up for Lucian’s short range and gives him another double shot.

lucian-combo-q-minion.basis: Q extends beyond its displayed range. Q cast on a front minion pierces through and hits a champion behind it. Target a front minion with Q to poke a champion behind it.
lucian-combo-q-minion.text: Q (Piercing Light) extends beyond its displayed range and pierces through targets. Cast it on a front minion to hit a champion behind it while appearing to farm.

lucian-combo-r.basis: You can use E while casting R. While firing R, use E to keep your firing angle or move to safety. You cannot change R's aim during the cast. Line up with your target before starting R.
lucian-combo-r.text: Lucian can use E (Relentless Pursuit) during R (The Culling) to maintain his firing angle or move to safety. Since he cannot change R’s aim once it starts, line up directly with the target before casting rather than firing from an angle.

lucian-combo-weave.basis: After Lucian uses an ability, his next basic attack fires twice. To deal full damage, alternate abilities with double-shot basic attacks. Using abilities back to back triggers the double shot only once.
lucian-combo-weave.text: After Lucian uses an ability, his next basic attack fires twice. Alternate abilities and basic attacks to deal full damage; using abilities back to back triggers the double shot only once.

lucian-laning.basis: Push the wave, since his short range makes him easy to poke. Use E to dodge the enemy support's engage. Trade when both Q and your double shot are ready. After trading, retreat behind your minions immediately.
lucian-laning.text: Lucian’s short range makes him easy to poke, so push the wave and use E (Relentless Pursuit) to avoid the enemy support’s engage. Trade only when both Q (Piercing Light) and your double shot are ready, then retreat behind your minions immediately.

lucian-phase-early.basis: Lucian has short range for a marksman. Lucian is strong in early trades thanks to his double shot and E. Build a lead in lane.
lucian-phase-early.text: Lucian has short range for a marksman, but his double shot and E make him strong in early trades. With both kills by 14 minutes and damage per minute ranking near the top, he needs to build a lead in lane.

lucian-phase-late.basis: Lucian excels at short bursts of damage over sustained damage. Other marksmen outperform him in prolonged teamfights. Take repeated short trades: move in, deal damage, then retreat with E.
lucian-phase-late.text: Lucian excels at short bursts of damage rather than sustained damage, and other marksmen outperform him in prolonged teamfights. Look for repeated brief engagements: move in, deal your burst, then retreat with E (Relentless Pursuit).

lucian-skill-e.basis: Each double-shot basic attack reduces E's cooldown. Save E for when you need to dash.
lucian-skill-e.text: Each double-shot basic attack reduces E’s cooldown, but using it early just to cycle it faster can leave Lucian without a dash when he needs one. Prioritize saving it for a moment when that dash could keep him alive.

lucian-skill-r-cancel.basis: You can recast R to stop it. Casting R triggers the passive double shot. If attacked from another angle, stop R and retaliate with a double-shot basic attack.
lucian-skill-r-cancel.text: Lucian can recast R (The Culling) to stop it, and casting it prepares a Lightslinger double shot. If attacked from another angle, cancel R and retaliate with the double-shot basic attack instead of continuing to fire.

lucian-skill-r-usage.basis: While escaping, fire R down a narrow passage to block the enemy's path. When enemies siege an allied turret, use R to clear the minion wave quickly.
lucian-skill-r-usage.text: R (The Culling) has uses beyond dealing damage: while escaping, fire it down a narrow passage to block an enemy’s path, or use it to clear a minion wave quickly when enemies siege an allied turret.

lucian-skill-tower.basis: Lightslinger’s double shot also works on turrets. To attack turrets faster, weave abilities into your attacks.
lucian-skill-tower.text: Lightslinger’s double shot also works on turrets, so weave abilities between basic attacks to damage them faster.

lucian-skill-vigilance.basis: When an ally heals or shields Lucian, his next two shots gain bonus damage. When a nearby enemy is immobilized, Lucian's next two shots gain bonus damage. Time your basic attacks with your support's shields or crowd control.
lucian-skill-vigilance.text: When an ally heals or shields Lucian, or a nearby enemy is immobilized, his next two shots gain bonus damage. Time your basic attacks with your support’s shields or crowd control to deliver a burst of damage.

lucian-skill-w.basis: Hitting an enemy marked by W increases Lucian's movement speed. An ally hitting an enemy marked by W also triggers the movement speed boost. Mark enemies with W just before engaging or chasing.
lucian-skill-w.text: Hitting an enemy marked by W (Ardent Blaze) increases Lucian’s movement speed, even if an ally lands the hit. Apply the mark just before engaging or chasing to help close the gap despite his short range.

lucian-teamfight.basis: In teamfights, come in from the side or follow up to finish targets already under crowd control. Mark your target with W before closing in to gain movement speed. Save E to disengage in teamfights.
lucian-teamfight.text: In teamfights, approach from the side or follow up to finish a target already under crowd control rather than entering head-on. Mark the target with W (Ardent Blaze) before closing in for the movement speed boost, and save E (Relentless Pursuit) to disengage.

lulu-combo-peel.basis: When an ally is caught, protect them with W polymorph, E shield, then Q slow. Use W first as the enemy tries to follow up with another ability right after engaging. Use E for the damage that comes after W to make use of the shield's duration.
lulu-combo-peel.text: When an ally is caught, use W (Whimsy) to polymorph the attacker, then E (Help, Pix!) to shield your ally and Q (Glitterlance) to slow the enemy. W must come first to silence the enemy's follow-up ability immediately after the engage; time E for the damage that follows so its short duration is not wasted.

lulu-combo-q-angle.basis: Q fires bolts from Lulu's and Pix's positions at different angles. Q's two bolts overlap more narrowly when the cursor is close and spread wider when it is far away. Keep the cursor close when using Q to reliably hit a single target. Keep the cursor far away when using Q to clip multiple targets.
lulu-combo-q-angle.text: Q (Glitterlance) fires bolts from Lulu and Pix at different angles. The closer you place the cursor to Lulu, the more narrowly the bolts overlap; the farther away you place it, the wider they spread. Keep it close to reliably hit one target or farther away to clip several.

lulu-combo-ult.basis: R instantly increases the target ally's maximum health. Use R just before an ally dies to help them survive a burst of damage. R knocks up enemies around the target ally. Use R on an allied tank to help them engage.
lulu-combo-ult.text: R (Wild Growth) instantly increases an ally's maximum health, so cast it just before they die to absorb an entire burst of damage. It also knocks up enemies around them: use it on an ally being engaged on to stop the initiation, or on your tank to help initiate.

lulu-laning-bait.basis: Lulu is strongest at responding when enemies commit heavily to an engage. Look to draw out an enemy engage, then counter with W and E. Lulu is vulnerable when she overcommits first because she lacks the damage to finish the fight.
lulu-laning-bait.text: Lulu is strongest when the enemy commits heavily to an engage. Give them an opening to come in, then counter with W (Whimsy) and E (Help, Pix!); if Lulu overcommits first, she lacks the damage to finish the fight and loses out.

lulu-laning-mana.basis: Q and E cost a lot of mana. Avoid pointless Q and E poke so you have mana to protect allies. Save E for its shield rather than poke. When you run out of mana, avoid overcommitting and look for a chance to recall.
lulu-laning-mana.text: Q (Glitterlance) and E (Help, Pix!) cost a lot of mana, and repeated pointless poke can leave you unable to protect an ally when it matters. Save E for its shield rather than using it to poke; when your mana runs low, avoid overcommitting and find a chance to recall.

lulu-phase-early.basis: Lulu is strong early with Q poke and its slow. Maintain your poke advantage in lane. Avoid stepping forward to create the first opening to attack in lane.
lulu-phase-early.text: Lulu’s Q (Glitterlance) poke and slow are strong early, but her health, armor, and attack damage are among the lowest, so she crumples if caught. Keep your poke advantage in lane without stepping forward to force the first opening.

lulu-phase-scaling.basis: Once Lulu gets R at level 6, she can save allies and punish enemies who overcommit to an engage. Lulu scales into the late game as her allied carry grows stronger. Prioritize protecting your allied carry's growth over your own.
lulu-phase-scaling.text: At level 6, R (Wild Growth) lets Lulu reliably save an ally and punish an enemy who overcommits to an engage. She grows stronger into the late game as her allied carry grows stronger, so prioritize protecting the carry's growth over your own.

lulu-situational-cleanse.basis: If the enemy has a lot of lasting crowd control, buy Mikael's Blessing early to cleanse it from allies. W and E cannot cleanse crowd control already affecting an ally.
lulu-situational-cleanse.text: If the enemy has a lot of crowd control that holds allies in place, buy Mikael’s Blessing earlier. Lulu’s W (Whimsy) and E (Help, Pix!) cannot remove crowd control once it has landed, so she needs the item’s cleanse to fully protect her allies.

lulu-skill-e.basis: E shields an ally when cast on them. E moves Pix to an ally when cast on them. Use E on a ranged ally who attacks frequently to add damage with Pix's bolts. E grants true sight of an enemy when cast on them. Use E to reveal an enemy's position in a brush or while stealthed.
lulu-skill-e.text: E (Help, Pix!) shields an ally and moves Pix to them. Cast it on a ranged ally who attacks frequently so Pix's bolts keep adding to their damage. Against an enemy, E grants true sight, letting you reveal their position in brush or while stealthed.

lulu-skill-e-timing.basis: E's shield is short-lived, so using it too early lets it expire before the damage arrives. Watch the enemy's cast animation and time E for when the damage arrives.
lulu-skill-e-timing.text: E (Help, Pix!) has a short-lived shield that can expire before the damage arrives if cast too early. Watch the enemy's cast animation and practice timing E to meet the incoming damage; this is central to mastering Lulu.

lulu-skill-passive.basis: Other units in the path can take Pix's bolts instead and absorb the damage. Harass with a basic attack when the enemy steps beside the minions so they do not block Pix's bolts.
lulu-skill-passive.text: Other units can intercept Pix's bolts. If minions stand between you and the enemy, they absorb the bolts from your basic attack harass, so attack when the enemy steps out beside the minions.

lulu-skill-w-ally.basis: W increases an ally's movement speed when cast on them. W increases an ally's attack speed when cast on them. Use W on an ally when they chase or flee. Use W on an ally when focusing damage on the enemy carry. When you need to stop a reliable enemy engage, save W for the enemy.
lulu-skill-w-ally.text: Casting W (Whimsy) on an ally increases both movement and attack speed, making it useful for chasing, escaping, or focusing damage on the enemy carry. If the enemy has a reliable engage that you need to interrupt, save W for them.

lulu-skill-w-enemy.basis: W silences an enemy when cast on them. W prevents an enemy from attacking when cast on them. W does not stop an enemy from moving. Casting W during a dash does not stop the dash in progress. Use W when an enemy's dash ends and they try to use a follow-up ability to interrupt their combo.
lulu-skill-w-enemy.text: Casting W (Whimsy) on an enemy silences them and prevents them from attacking, but does not stop their movement. A dashing enemy will still reach you if you cast it mid-dash, so time W for when the dash ends and they attempt a follow-up ability to break their combo.

lulu-teamfight.basis: In teamfights, stay close to your most fed ally. In teamfights, focus W, E, and R on your most fed ally. In teamfights, position to respond to whoever the enemy engages on instead of engaging yourself.
lulu-teamfight.text: In teamfights, stay close to your most fed ally and focus W (Whimsy), E (Help, Pix!), and R (Wild Growth) on them. Position to see who the enemy engages on and respond, rather than trying to initiate yourself.

lux-combo-full.basis: Use the kill combo in this order: Q → place E → R → auto attack → detonate E → auto attack. Weave auto-attacks between abilities to keep consuming Illumination marks. Delay detonating E so you can land both auto-attacks.
lux-combo-full.text: For a kill combo, land Q Light Binding, place E Lucent Singularity without detonating it, then use R Final Spark, auto-attack, detonate E, and auto-attack again. Weave auto-attacks between abilities to keep consuming Illumination marks; delaying E’s detonation lets you land both attacks.

lux-combo-poke.basis: In lane, poke by placing and detonating E, then auto-attacking to consume the Illumination mark. Use Q for kill opportunities or to stop enemy engages rather than for poke. Lux loses her means of fighting back when Q is down.
lux-combo-poke.text: In lane, placing and detonating E, then auto-attacking to consume Illumination, is enough for poke. Save Q for kill opportunities and stopping engages, since Lux has no way to fight back while it is down.

lux-laning-safety.basis: Lux has no mobility ability. Lux has almost no way to respond when caught in an ambush. Play at maximum range to prepare for ambushes. Check unwarded brush with E before entering.
lux-laning-safety.text: Lux has some of the lowest armor and health in the game and no mobility ability, leaving her with almost no answer to an ambush. Play at the edge of your range, and check brush without vision by throwing E before entering.

lux-laning-wave.basis: When support Lux hits minions with E, it pushes the lane and increases the risk of exposure to enemy jungle ganks. When you need to let the wave push toward you, use E so it only hits enemy champions. Use E on the wave only when you need to push.
lux-laning-wave.text: As support Lux, hitting minions with E pushes the lane and exposes you to enemy jungle ganks. When you need the wave to push toward you, aim E only at enemy champions; place it over the wave only when you need to push.

lux-phase.basis: Look for kill opportunities as early as level 1 if Q's root lands. Treat level 6 as the first power spike, when R lets you finish enemies beyond your range. Lux deals her strongest damage during her mid-to-late-game burst window, after building up ability power. In the late game, prioritize positioning over damage to prepare for enemy assassins closing in.
lux-phase.text: A landed Q root can create a kill opportunity from level 1. Level 6 is Lux’s first power spike, when R lets her finish enemies beyond her usual range; her strongest burst comes in the mid to late game after she builds ability power. Later, enemy assassins can reach her, so positioning matters more than damage.

lux-situational-antiheal.basis: Choose Morellonomicon to reduce healing when enemy healing becomes a problem. E and R apply Morellonomicon's healing reduction to multiple enemies at once.
lux-situational-antiheal.text: When enemy healing becomes a problem, buy Morellonomicon to reduce it. E and R cover an area, so they can apply its healing reduction to multiple enemies at once.

lux-situational-assassin.basis: Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to prepare for enemy assassins closing in. With no mobility ability, Lux relies on W's shield for her own survival when caught.
lux-situational-assassin.text: Buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier against assassins. Without mobility, Lux has only W’s shield to help her survive once caught.

lux-skill-e-zone.basis: To control an area, place E and delay its detonation. Place E ahead of time on entry or escape routes to hinder enemy movement. Throw E into a brush to check for an ambush. E is Lux's most reliable ability to land. Avoid spamming the mana-heavy E so you do not run out of mana midway through laning.
lux-skill-e-zone.text: Leaving E Lucent Singularity in place before detonating it controls an area: place it ahead of time on enemy entry or escape routes to hinder movement, or throw it into a brush to check for an ambush. Though E is Lux’s most reliable ability to land, it costs a lot of mana; casting it every time it comes off cooldown will leave you short of mana midway through lane.

lux-skill-passive.basis: Illumination marks enemies hit by Lux's damaging abilities. Lux's auto-attacks consume Illumination marks to deal bonus magic damage. R consumes Illumination marks on hit, then reapplies them. After using R, auto-attack to consume the Illumination mark for extra damage. Use auto attacks after landing abilities to deal enough damage.
lux-skill-passive.text: Lux’s damaging abilities apply Illumination, which her auto-attacks consume for bonus magic damage. R consumes the mark on hit and then reapplies it, so follow R with an auto-attack for more damage. Skipping auto-attacks after landing abilities gives up a substantial share of her damage.

lux-skill-q.basis: Q fully roots the first two enemies it hits. Angle Q to root both the tank and the carry standing behind them. Lux relies on landing Q to land follow-up abilities and defend herself. Use Q carefully so a miss does not leave you defenseless.
lux-skill-q.text: Q Light Binding fully roots the first two enemies it hits, so angle it through a tank to catch a carry standing behind them. A miss can leave the rest of Lux’s abilities ineffective and Lux defenseless, so choose your openings carefully.

lux-skill-r.basis: R has a cast time. A red targeting line appears before R fires. R has a relatively short cooldown. As you level up, you can use R once per teamfight.
lux-skill-r.text: Lux’s R, Final Spark, has a cast time, and a red targeting line appears before it fires. When layering it into a combo, account for that delay or the beam will fire after the preceding root wears off. Its cooldown is relatively short, so as you level up, you can use it once per teamfight.

lux-skill-w.basis: W grants a shield on both its outward and return paths. The two shields granted by W stack. Cast W toward grouped allies. While fleeing, cast W in the direction you are running to receive the returning shield sooner.
lux-skill-w.text: W Prismatic Barrier shields on both its outward and return paths, and the two shields stack. Since allies’ movements are harder to predict than enemies’, throw it toward a group of allies instead of aiming at one person. While fleeing, cast it in the direction you are running to receive the returning shield sooner.

lux-teamfight.basis: Position behind your team's frontline in teamfights. Use Q to stop enemy engages. Use E to block enemy movement routes. Use W to protect allies from burst damage. To get value for the mana spent, avoid angles that hit only one enemy and use abilities on multiple enemies.
lux-teamfight.text: In teamfights, stay behind your frontline, use Q to stop engages, E to block routes, and W to shield allies from burst damage. Hitting multiple targets with your abilities is the only way to justify their mana cost, so avoid angles that catch just one.

lux-teamfight-ult.basis: R passes through enemies in a straight line. Prioritize angles that let R pass through multiple grouped enemies in a line. Use R immediately when you can secure a kill or hit multiple enemies in a line.
lux-teamfight-ult.text: R pierces enemies in a straight line, so prioritize angles that catch several grouped enemies. Its relatively short cooldown makes it better to use immediately for a certain finish or a hit on multiple enemies than to hold it, increasing your total damage.

malphite-combo-trade.basis: For short trades against melee opponents, activate W and attack in this order: basic attack → E → basic attack. W empowers your next basic attack and makes each basic attack leave an aftershock for the next few seconds. Use E after the opponent starts a basic attack to reduce their retaliation.
malphite-combo-trade.text: Against melee opponents, activate W, then use a basic attack → E → basic attack for a short trade. W empowers the next attack and adds an aftershock to each attack for the next few seconds, so land both attacks before backing off. Use E after your opponent starts a basic attack to reduce their retaliation.

malphite-combo-ult.basis: Use R → W → basic attack → Q → E for your ultimate burst combo. Q and E are guaranteed to hit while R's knockup lasts. Activate W immediately after R to empower the basic attack you weave between abilities. Aim to kill squishy targets with one full ultimate combo.
malphite-combo-ult.text: For an ultimate burst combo, use R → W → basic attack → Q → E. Q and E are guaranteed to hit during R’s knockup, so you need not worry about them being dodged. Activating W immediately after R empowers the attack between abilities without wasting an attack opportunity, and one full combo can finish off a squishy target.

malphite-laning.basis: During the laning phase, repeatedly poke with Q, then back off to recharge Granite Shield. Q steals the opponent's movement speed, making it harder for them to chase you after you poke. At low Q ranks, time your poke around when you can use a source of mana restoration. Malphite struggles to gain a lead through kills in lane. Extend your lead by pushing the wave and chipping away at turret health.
malphite-laning.text: In lane, poke with Q, then back off long enough to recharge Granite Shield. Q steals your opponent’s movement speed, making it harder for them to follow after the poke, while the restored shield keeps trades in Malphite’s favor. This cycle stops when you run out of mana, so at low Q ranks, time casts around a source of mana restoration instead of using Q on cooldown. Because Malphite struggles to gain a lead through kills in lane, push the wave and chip away at the turret to turn an advantage into lasting gains.

malphite-phase.basis: Malphite is weakest before level 6, when he has no R. Malphite's limited mana restricts how often he can poke early on. Take advantage of the power spike immediately after learning R. Take advantage of your peak strength in the mid game, when you have two or three armor items. Your damage contribution drops late in the game, so focus on starting teamfights with R.
malphite-phase.text: Malphite is weakest before level 6: without R, he has little way to kill an opponent, and limited mana restricts his poke. His power spikes immediately after learning R and peaks again in the mid game with two or three armor items. As his damage contribution falls off late, focus on starting teamfights with R.

malphite-situational-ap.basis: Choose an ability power build to secure kills with R when your team has another frontline tank and the enemy backline is squishy. Choose Rylai's Crystal Scepter to keep enemies from getting away after R. Choose Rabadon's Deathcap and Void Staff to increase R's damage. Choose Zhonya's Hourglass to buy time for your allies to join you after you engage with R. Choose Liandry's Torment to apply damage over time to multiple enemies with R.
malphite-situational-ap.text: Choose an ability power build when your team already has a frontline tank and the enemy backline is squishy. R’s high ability power scaling lets Malphite eliminate the backline in one cast; Rylai’s Crystal Scepter helps keep enemies close afterward, while Rabadon’s Deathcap and Void Staff raise R’s damage further. Zhonya’s Hourglass provides both ability power and armor and buys time for allies to join you after you engage, making it especially well suited to this build. Liandry’s Torment can apply damage over time to multiple enemies through R’s area effect. This build gives up tankiness, so avoid it if your team has no other frontline.

malphite-situational-armor.basis: If the enemy's main damage is physical, focus on armor items that improve both survivability and W and E damage. Against physical damage, buy Glacial Buckler early, then build into Plated Steelcaps, Thornmail, Frozen Heart, and Randuin's Omen. If the enemy has plenty of healing, finish Thornmail first to apply Grievous Wounds.
malphite-situational-armor.text: When the enemy’s main damage is physical, stack armor heavily: it improves survivability and boosts W and E damage, so none of the stat goes to waste. Buy Glacial Buckler early, then build Plated Steelcaps, Thornmail, Frozen Heart, and Randuin’s Omen to make it extremely difficult for physical damage dealers to break through Malphite. If the enemy has plenty of healing, finish Thornmail first to apply Grievous Wounds.

malphite-situational-mr.basis: If the enemy's main damage is magic, choose Hollow Radiance for magic resistance and farming power. Choose Spirit Visage as your magic resistance item if you have allies who provide healing or shields. Choose Force of Nature when taking magic damage from multiple enemies. Keep one armor item for W and E damage even in a magic resistance-focused build.
malphite-situational-mr.text: When the enemy’s main damage is magic, Malphite’s low base magic resistance means an armor-only build will leave him vulnerable. Hollow Radiance provides magic resistance while preserving his ability to farm; choose Spirit Visage if allies provide healing or shields, or Force of Nature if several enemies deal magic damage. Keep at least one armor item, since building only magic resistance sacrifices W and E damage.

malphite-skill-armor-scaling.basis: Both W and E deal damage that scales with armor. W's passive increases Malphite's armor. W's armor bonus increases greatly while Granite Shield is active. Armor items improve both survivability and W and E damage, so avoid leaving them out of your build entirely.
malphite-skill-armor-scaling.text: For Malphite, armor increases damage as well as defense: both W and E scale with it. W’s passive raises his armor, with a much larger bonus while Granite Shield is active. An armor item therefore improves both survivability and damage, making it costly to leave armor out of any build entirely.

malphite-skill-e.basis: E deals area damage to enemies within its range. E reduces the attack speed of enemies it hits. Use E immediately after a basic attack-focused opponent starts attacking. Save E until you have a target to fight instead of using it on cooldown to farm.
malphite-skill-e.text: E Ground Slam deals area damage and reduces the attack speed of enemies it hits, making it especially effective against opponents who rely on basic attacks. Use it just after an enemy marksman or basic attack-focused duelist starts attacking to reduce their damage throughout the fight. Save it for a target you intend to fight instead of spending it on cooldown to farm.

malphite-skill-passive.basis: Granite Shield regenerates only after you take no damage for a certain time. Start trades with Granite Shield charged. Back off and recharge Granite Shield when it breaks. Higher armor reduces the amount of Granite Shield depleted by physical attacks. Approach melee opponents while using Granite Shield to absorb their first basic attack. If ranged poke keeps interrupting your shield’s regeneration, find another way to sustain in lane.
malphite-skill-passive.text: Granite Shield regenerates only after Malphite goes without taking damage for a while, so start trades with it charged and back off to recharge it once it breaks. Higher armor makes physical attacks deplete the shield more slowly, letting the two reinforce each other; against melee opponents, use the shield to absorb their first basic attack as you approach. Ranged poke can repeatedly interrupt its regeneration, so you need another way to sustain in lane.

malphite-skill-r-utility.basis: R makes you unstoppable during the cast, ignoring most crowd control as you dash to the target location. Use R as an escape tool when fleeing a gank. Use R to dodge incoming skillshots by passing through them. Given R's long cooldown, decide in advance whether to use it to escape or save it to engage. Build ability haste to poke with Q and use R more often.
malphite-skill-r-utility.text: R Unstoppable Force makes Malphite unstoppable during the cast, ignoring most crowd control as he dashes to the target location. Alongside engaging, you can use it to escape a gank or pass through an incoming skillshot. Its long cooldown leaves you without a way to start a fight while it is unavailable, so decide in advance whether to spend it on escape or save it for an engage. Ability haste lets you poke with Q and use R more often.

malphite-teamfight.basis: Only engage when R is available. When enemies group up, find an angle to knock up at least two with R. Look for a chance to kill a key damage dealer with R when they step out alone. Coordinate R's timing with your allies so they can follow up with area-of-effect ultimates at the knockup location.
malphite-teamfight.text: Teamfights hinge on where Malphite lands R. Engage only when it is available, looking to knock up at least two grouped enemies or eliminate a key damage dealer who steps out alone. If your allies have area-of-effect ultimates, coordinate their timing with R so they can hit the knockup location instead of chasing a kill on your own.

malzahar-combo-basic.basis: For a basic trade, apply E, summon Voidlings with W, then silence with Q. Hitting a target affected by E with Q resets E's duration. Hitting a target affected by E with R resets E's duration. Using Q before E prevents you from refreshing E, greatly reducing your damage.
malzahar-combo-basic.text: For a basic trade, apply E, summon Voidlings with W, then use Q to silence the target and refresh E. Both Q and R reset E’s duration when they hit an affected target, so following that order keeps E dealing damage as the enemy retreats. If you use Q before applying E, you have no way to refresh it and deal less than half the damage.

malzahar-combo-ult.basis: To secure a kill, apply E, summon Voidlings with W, then suppress with R. R refreshes E, so E keeps dealing damage after the suppression ends. While R suppresses the target, Voidlings attack them. R's zone remains around the target. Use R from a position where you can force the enemy toward your team.
malzahar-combo-ult.text: To secure a kill, apply E, summon Voidlings with W, then suppress the target with R. R refreshes E, so it keeps dealing damage after the suppression ends while the Voidlings attack throughout it. R’s zone remains around the target, so cast it from a position that forces the enemy toward your team.

malzahar-laning.basis: In lane, avoid losing while keeping your opponent tied to the lane. Continually pushing the wave with E and W forces the enemy mid laner to return to farm. After pushing the wave, spend time on objectives or securing vision. Don't step forward to harass with your short range.
malzahar-laning.text: Malzahar’s goal in lane is to avoid losing while keeping his opponent tied to it. Continually pushing with E and W forces the enemy mid laner back to farm and gives you time for objectives or vision. His range is short, so don’t step forward to harass.

malzahar-laning-defense.basis: Malzahar has no mobility ability and has short range. Against ranged poke champions, keep Void Shift active even if it means giving up a few CS. Against melee engage champions, save Q until they engage. Avoid using your abilities first in lane.
malzahar-laning-defense.text: Malzahar has no mobility ability and short range. Against ranged poke champions, keeping Void Shift active is worth giving up a few CS; against melee engage champions, save Q’s silence for the moment they go in. In either matchup, using your abilities first in lane puts you at a disadvantage.

malzahar-phase.basis: Malzahar is weak at levels 1–2. Leveling E makes farming more reliable. At level 6, gaining R sharply increases Malzahar's ability to kill an enemy alone. Malzahar's impact in fights depends heavily on R's cooldown. After using R, don't force a fight.
malzahar-phase.text: Malzahar is weak at levels 1–2, when he has to get by with just one ability. Leveling E makes farming more reliable, and gaining R at level 6 sharply increases his ability to kill an enemy alone. His impact in fights then depends heavily on R’s cooldown, so don’t force a fight after using it.

malzahar-situational-antiheal.basis: Against champions with strong healing, buy Morellonomicon between core items. The sustained damage from E and Voidlings can keep Grievous Wounds applied continuously.
malzahar-situational-antiheal.text: Against champions with strong healing, fit Morellonomicon into your core item order. Malzahar’s sustained damage from E and Voidlings can keep Grievous Wounds applied continuously.

malzahar-situational-zhonya.basis: Buy Zhonya's Hourglass early against an assassin who can engage instantly. Once Void Shift is broken, Malzahar has no way to escape. After Void Shift breaks, Zhonya's Hourglass lets you avoid an engage while waiting for your team.
malzahar-situational-zhonya.text: Buy Zhonya’s Hourglass early against an assassin who can engage instantly. Once Void Shift breaks, Malzahar has no way to escape, so he needs Zhonya’s to avoid the engage while waiting for his team.

malzahar-skill-e.basis: When a target affected by E dies, E spreads to the nearest enemy. When a target affected by E dies, Malzahar restores mana. Early on, apply E to a minion to clear the wave as it spreads. As E spreads between minions, the wave pushes toward the enemy. Without vision, don't push the wave blindly with E.
malzahar-skill-e.text: When a target affected by Malefic Visions (E) dies, E spreads to the nearest enemy and restores mana to Malzahar. Early on, apply it to a minion to clear the wave through successive spreads while recovering mana. The wave pushes toward the enemy as E spreads, though, so pushing blindly without vision leaves you open to a gank.

malzahar-skill-passive.basis: Void Shift returns after you go without taking damage for a while. Void Shift greatly reduces incoming damage while active. Void Shift makes you immune to immobilizing effects and interruptions while active. Check often whether Void Shift is active in lane. Even minor damage from minions or jungle monsters can remove Void Shift.
malzahar-skill-passive.text: Void Shift returns after Malzahar goes without taking damage for a while. While active, it greatly reduces incoming damage and makes him immune to immobilization and interruptions, so avoiding poke is itself a form of defense. Check whether it is active in lane as often as you check your health; even minor damage from minions or jungle monsters can remove it and leave you vulnerable to the next gank.

malzahar-skill-q.basis: Q's hit area is the line segment between the two portals. Place Q across the enemy's path. Q's silence can interrupt an enemy as they begin to cast an ability. Save Q to stop enemies with engage abilities.
malzahar-skill-q.text: Q (Call of the Void) creates two portals, and its hit area is the line segment between them rather than a line from Malzahar to his target. Place it across the enemy’s path to land it. Because its silence can interrupt an ability as the enemy begins to cast it, save Q against champions with engage abilities to stop their entry rather than deal damage.

malzahar-skill-r.basis: A target suppressed by R cannot move, cast abilities, or use basic attacks. Most escape abilities cannot break R's suppression. Immobilizing crowd control on Malzahar interrupts R's suppression. Use R where your teammates can protect Malzahar. Use R after the enemy's follow-up engage ends.
malzahar-skill-r.text: Nether Grasp (R) suppresses its target, preventing movement, abilities, and basic attacks; most escape abilities cannot break free. Malzahar must maintain the cast, however, and immobilizing crowd control on him ends the suppression early. Cast R where your teammates can protect you, after the enemy’s follow-up engage has ended.

malzahar-skill-w.basis: Each time you use another ability, W gains a stack. More W stacks summon more Voidlings. Use W after preparing for the fight. Build stacks with Q and E, then use W when the enemy enters range. Using W early when there are no nearby enemies to attack only wastes the Voidlings' duration.
malzahar-skill-w.text: W gains a stack each time you use another ability, and more stacks summon more Voidlings. Use it once you have prepared for the fight: build stacks with Q and E, then summon the Voidlings as the enemy enters range. Casting W early with nothing nearby to attack only wastes their duration.

malzahar-skill-w-wave.basis: Voidlings deal much more damage to lane minions affected by E. To clear a wave quickly, apply E, then use W. Using E and W together helps secure minion last hits. Push the lane quickly with E and W to make time for roams or objectives.
malzahar-skill-w-wave.text: Voidlings deal much more damage to lane minions affected by E. Apply E to the wave before using W to clear it noticeably faster and secure last hits more reliably. This also gives you time to roam or work on objectives after pushing the lane.

malzahar-teamfight.basis: If you can't target the enemy carry, use R on an engaging champion to stop their engage. Summon Voidlings before a fight. Save Q until the enemy uses an engage ability. You can defend a side lane alone when R is available and you have vision.
malzahar-teamfight.text: In a teamfight, Malzahar’s job is to take one key enemy out of the fight. If the enemy carry is out of reach, use R (Nether Grasp) on an engaging champion to stop the engage instead. Summon Voidlings before the fight and save Q for the moment the enemy casts an engage ability. With R available, you can defend a side lane alone if you have vision, since the enemy will need to send two champions.

maokai-combo-engage.basis: For a basic engage, close in with W, land a Sap Magic-enhanced basic attack, then use Q. Use W to close in and root the enemy. During W's root, restore health with a Sap Magic-enhanced basic attack. Using Q first knocks the enemy back and creates distance.
maokai-combo-engage.text: The basic engage is W → basic attack → Q: close in and root the enemy with W, land a Sap Magic-empowered basic attack during the root to restore health, then finish with Q. Keep that order, since using Q first knocks the enemy back and creates distance.

maokai-combo-q-direction.basis: Q knocks nearby enemies away from Maokai. To knock an enemy toward your team, use W to pass through them, land on the other side, then use Q. To peel an enemy off your carry, stand between them and use Q.
maokai-combo-q-direction.text: Q knocks nearby enemies outward from Maokai. To push an enemy toward your team, use W to pass through them, land on the far side, then cast Q. To peel an enemy off your carry, stand between the two and cast Q instead. That positioning is what lets the same ability serve as either an engage or protection.

maokai-combo-ult.basis: R's root lasts longer the farther the wall travels. For a longer root, cast R from as far away as possible. When R's wall hits an enemy champion, Maokai gains movement speed. After casting R, follow in with W.
maokai-combo-ult.text: R's root lasts longer the farther its wall travels, so casting it right in an enemy's face gives only a brief root; start as far away as possible to let the wall travel. Hitting an enemy champion with the wall also grants Maokai movement speed, letting him follow R immediately with W.

maokai-laning.basis: In bot lane, place saplings in both brushes to make them harder for the enemy to use. Root an enemy with W as they step forward to last-hit. Engage with W only when your ADC is close enough to land basic attacks. Maokai lacks the damage to engage alone in lane. Q costs a lot of mana, so don't waste it clearing minions.
maokai-laning.text: In bot lane, start by controlling the brush: place saplings with E in both bushes to keep the enemy bot lane from using them. When an enemy steps forward to last-hit, root them with W so your ADC can add basic attacks. Maokai lacks the damage to engage alone, so use W only when your ADC is in range to attack. Q costs a lot of mana; wasting it to clear minions can leave it unavailable when you need to counter an enemy engage.

maokai-laning-wave.basis: Don't force the wave to push. The closer the wave is to your side, the easier it is to get out after engaging with W. If you've pushed the wave near the enemy turret, don't engage with W.
maokai-laning-wave.text: Don’t force the wave to push. Maokai’s trades depend on holding enemies in place for an allied damage dealer, and the closer the wave is to your side, the easier it is to get out after engaging with W. If you push near the enemy turret and engage with W, you have no way back once the root ends.

maokai-phase.basis: Level 2, when both Q and W are available, is your first chance to trade. At level 6, R lets you look for forced engages during roams and objective fights. Later, health items increase sapling explosion damage and durability, letting Maokai keep engaging.
maokai-phase.text: Level 2, when both Q and W become available, is your first chance to trade. At level 6, R gives you a way to force engages and take control of roams and objective fights. Later, health items increase both sapling explosion damage and Maokai's durability, so he can keep filling the engage role as the game goes on.

maokai-situational-mikael.basis: If the enemy can immobilize and kill your carry, buy Mikael's Blessing before Locket of the Iron Solari. Maokai has no way to remove crowd control already affecting an ally.
maokai-situational-mikael.text: If the enemy can immobilize and kill your carry, buy Mikael's Blessing before Locket of the Iron Solari. Maokai can stop an engage, but he has no way to remove crowd control once it has affected an ally.

maokai-skill-e-brush.basis: Saplings thrown into brush last longer and explode over a larger area. Place saplings at separate paths, one per path, instead of stacking them in one spot. Place saplings where enemies pass, such as river brush or the tri-brush, to gain vision and block their approach.
maokai-skill-e-brush.text: Saplings thrown into brush last longer and produce much larger explosions. Stacking several in one spot is inefficient, so place them one at a time along separate routes. Even a single sapling where enemies must pass, such as river brush or the tri-brush, provides vision and deters an approach.

maokai-skill-e-cooldown.basis: When a sapling hits an enemy champion or epic monster, Sap Magic's heal cooldown is reduced further. Just before an objective fight, place saplings along the enemy's approach to create more chances to heal.
maokai-skill-e-cooldown.text: When a sapling hits an enemy champion or epic monster, it further reduces Sap Magic’s healing cooldown. Place saplings along the enemy’s approach just before an objective fight: they provide vision, hinder the enemy’s entry, and let Maokai heal more often. Using them only as vision wards misses that value.

maokai-skill-passive.basis: Using an ability or being hit by an enemy champion's ability reduces the cooldown of Sap Magic's heal. The more intense the fight, the more often you can use Sap Magic's heal. In a teamfight, keep using basic attacks whenever you have a target. In lane, use your Sap Magic empowered basic attack even on a minion to restore health.
maokai-skill-passive.text: Using an ability or being hit by an enemy champion's ability reduces the cooldown of Sap Magic's heal, so it becomes available more often as a fight intensifies. That healing helps Maokai withstand focused attacks: in teamfights, keep landing basic attacks whenever a target is available instead of backing away. In lane, it is his only way to regain health without spending mana, so use the empowered attack even on a minion to keep the heal cycling.

maokai-skill-w.basis: Maokai cannot be targeted while casting W. Using W just as an enemy's targeted finishing ability comes in can negate it. Use W to close in while dodging an enemy's key ability.
maokai-skill-w.text: Maokai cannot be targeted while casting W, making it both an engage tool and a way to dodge targeted abilities and basic attacks. Casting it just as an enemy’s targeted finishing ability arrives negates that ability, so save W to close in while dodging a key ability instead of spending it on a blind engage.

maokai-teamfight-peel.basis: When engaging is unfavorable, stay beside your carry and protect them. If an enemy gets onto your carry, knock them away with Q, then root them with W. Maokai deals little damage. Protect the space your carry needs instead of chasing one enemy.
maokai-teamfight-peel.text: When an engage is unfavorable, switch to protecting your carry. Stand beside them; as an enemy reaches them, knock the attacker away with Q, then root them with W to leave them isolated. Maokai deals little damage, so protecting the space your carry needs is always more valuable than chasing one enemy.

maokai-teamfight-ult.basis: If you cast R head-on, the enemy can see it and back away. Cast R from the side or behind. Cast R when the enemy enters a narrow passage with nowhere to dodge.
