vs-diana-r.text: Diana's R Moonfall deals more damage for each champion it pulls in, so standing together in a teamfight lets it catch several of you at once. Use vision to deny her an entry angle from the side, and spread out with her possible angle of entry in mind.

vs-diana-w.basis: Diana's W orbs disappear after a few seconds. Start the fight after Diana's W orbs disappear and her shield wears off.
vs-diana-w.text: Diana’s W Pale Cascade orbs last only a few seconds. Fighting her up close right after she activates W means taking every orb and the full shield, so wait until the orbs disappear and the shield wears off before engaging.

vs-draven-axe-spot.basis: Aim skillshots at Draven's axe landing spot rather than at Draven. Attacking the axe landing spot forces Draven to get hit by the skill or miss the axe.
vs-draven-axe-spot.text: Aim skillshots at Draven’s axe landing spot rather than at Draven. He has to walk there to catch it, forcing him to take the hit or lose the axe; either choice costs him.

vs-draven-disrupt.basis: Draven's damage depends heavily on keeping his axes going. Use knockbacks, slows, and immobilizing crowd control to stop Draven from catching axes.
vs-draven-disrupt.text: Draven's strength comes from keeping his axes going. Knockbacks, slows, and immobilizing crowd control that keep him from reaching an axe's landing spot sharply reduce his damage. Make him drop an axe before trying to kill him.

vs-draven-r.basis: Draven's R returns after passing through, with its damage reduction reset. Even after dodging R once, move completely out of its outbound and return path. If you're low on health, move out of Draven's R range.
vs-draven-r.text: Draven’s R comes back after passing you, with its damage reduction reset. Dodging it once is not enough if you stay in its path: move completely clear of both the outbound and return routes, or get out of range if you are low on health.

vs-draven-safe-farm.basis: If trading is difficult, farm safely without giving Draven a chance to kill you. If farming safely lets the wave push toward you, your jungler gets room to engage on the overextended Draven.
vs-draven-safe-farm.text: If you cannot trade with Draven, farm safely and deny him a chance to kill you. That alone lets the wave push toward you, drawing him forward into a position your jungler can attack.

vs-draven-snowball.basis: Draven uses the gold he earns early to build momentum. Even after the laning phase, look for Draven when he's alone.
vs-draven-snowball.text: Draven uses the gold he earns early to build momentum, but a death costs him half his accumulated stacks. Shutting him down as a team early can erase his late-game damage; keep looking for chances to catch him alone even after the laning phase.

vs-draven-two-axes.basis: Early on, avoid trading damage with Draven when he has two axes. Move in when Draven has only one axe or none.
vs-draven-two-axes.text: Avoid early damage trades with Draven when he has two axes; his auto-attack damage in that state wins any lane trade. Engage when he has only one axe or none.

vs-drmundo-bag.basis: An enemy champion can break a canister Dr. Mundo drops by stepping on it. When backing off after a trade, step on the canister to deny Dr. Mundo its healing and passive cooldown reduction.
vs-drmundo-bag.text: An enemy champion can destroy a canister Dr. Mundo drops by stepping on it. After a trade, retreat through the canister to deny both its healing and the reduction to his passive cooldown.

vs-drmundo-early-mr.basis: If magic damage is your main source of damage, pressure Dr. Mundo hard in the early laning phase while his magic resistance is low. Secure an advantage before Dr. Mundo levels up and gains much more magic resistance.
vs-drmundo-early-mr.text: Dr. Mundo’s early magic resistance is among the lowest of all champions, so you can pressure him hard in lane if magic damage is your main source of damage. Secure an advantage early, because his magic resistance rises substantially with levels and that advantage disappears.

vs-drmundo-passive-bait.basis: Dr. Mundo's passive ignores the first immobilizing effect. Trigger Dr. Mundo's passive with weaker crowd control before using your key engage ability.
vs-drmundo-passive-bait.text: Dr. Mundo’s passive ignores the first immobilizing effect. Trigger it with weaker crowd control before using your key engage ability; reversing that order lets his passive negate your crucial crowd control.

vs-drmundo-q.basis: Dr. Mundo's Q hits only the first target. Keep minions between you and Dr. Mundo to block his Q. Dr. Mundo's Q scales with current health, so it hurts most when your health is full.
vs-drmundo-q.text: Dr. Mundo’s Q (Infected Bonesaw) hits only the first target and deals damage based on current health. Keep minions between you and him to block most casts, and remember that it hurts most when your health is full.

vs-drmundo-r-window.basis: Look for a dive or force an objective while Dr. Mundo's R is down. If Dr. Mundo's R is available, look for an advantage in another lane or at an objective.
vs-drmundo-r-window.text: Treat Dr. Mundo as unkillable while his R is active. Look for a dive or force an objective while it is down; when it is available, spend your time gaining an advantage in another lane or at an objective instead of trying to kill him.

vs-ekko-bait.basis: With both W and R on cooldown, Ekko is an ordinary melee champion. Bait out Ekko's W and R with a decoy fight, then start the main fight.
vs-ekko-bait.text: With both W and R on cooldown, Ekko is an ordinary melee champion. Bait out those abilities with a decoy fight, then start the main fight.

vs-ekko-cc.basis: Ekko is vulnerable to crowd control. Right after Ekko closes in with E, his dash is unavailable. Right after Ekko closes in with E, stun or root him to force out R or stop him.
vs-ekko-cc.text: Ekko is vulnerable to crowd control, especially just after he closes in with E and his dash is unavailable. Stun or root him then to force out R or stop him outright.

vs-ekko-chase.basis: If a low-health Ekko has R ready, place a skillshot in advance at the position of his trailing afterimage. When Ekko uses R, he returns to the position of his trailing afterimage. Ekko often chooses to use R to turn a fight around instead of running away.
vs-ekko-chase.text: If you chase a low-health Ekko whose R is ready, aim a skillshot ahead of time at his trailing afterimage rather than at Ekko himself. That is where he will return, and he often chooses to use R to turn the fight around instead of running away.

vs-ekko-q.basis: Ekko's Q hurts more on its second hit as it returns. Watch the direction of the thrown Q and move out of its return path to reduce the damage you take.
vs-ekko-q.text: Ekko’s Q deals more damage on its second hit as it returns. Watch the direction he throws it and step out of its return path to cut the damage you take in half.

vs-ekko-ult-ready.basis: Ekko is weakest while R is on cooldown after he uses it. If you can see a trailing afterimage behind Ekko, his R is ready. Do not overcommit to chasing Ekko when his R is ready, even if he looks low on health.
vs-ekko-ult-ready.text: Ekko is weakest while R is on cooldown. A trailing afterimage means R is ready, so do not overcommit to chasing him even if he looks low on health.

vs-ekko-w.basis: When Ekko casts W, it leaves a signal the enemy can see. Ekko's W takes time to set up. Remember where the W signal appeared and stay out of its area to deny the stun and shield.
vs-ekko-w.text: Ekko’s W leaves a visible signal when cast and takes time to set up. Remember where the signal appeared and stay out of that area to deny both the stun and the shield.

vs-elise-cocoon.basis: Elise’s gank depends on landing human form Cocoon. The first minion or jungle monster Cocoon hits along its path blocks it. In lane, stand behind your minion wave to avoid Cocoon. When moving near the jungle, stay away from walls and move through areas with clear vision.
vs-elise-cocoon.text: Elise’s gank depends on landing human form Cocoon, which affects only the first unit it hits. Stand behind your minion wave in lane so minions block it, and use minions or jungle monsters as cover elsewhere. Near the jungle, keep away from walls and take routes with clear vision.

vs-elise-cooldown.basis: Rappel has a long cooldown, leaving Elise with few escape options right after she uses it. Attack Elise after confirming that both Rappel and Cocoon are on cooldown.
vs-elise-cooldown.text: Rappel has a long cooldown, leaving Elise without an escape immediately after she uses it. Once both Rappel and Cocoon are on cooldown, turn and attack her; her relatively low magic resistance means she cannot withstand being caught for long.

vs-elise-form.basis: Elise’s human form Q hits hard when its target is at full health. When Elise transforms into Spider Form, use mobility and defensive abilities.
vs-elise-form.text: Elise’s human form Q, Neurotoxin, hits hard against targets at full health. When she transforms into Spider Form, use your mobility and defensive abilities.

vs-elise-phase.basis: Elise is a jungler who tries to end games early with leads from early ganks. Avoid giving Elise kills early and draw out the game. Keep plenty of vision early in lane to prepare for Elise’s ganks. Do not push the lane too far when the enemy jungler’s location is unknown.
vs-elise-phase.text: Elise builds leads through early ganks to end games quickly, while her farming numbers are low. Avoid giving her early kills and draw out the game to improve the matchup. Keep ample vision during early laning, and do not push too far when the enemy jungler’s location is unknown.

vs-elise-rappel.basis: If there are no nearby enemy units, Rappel brings Elise back down where she rose. When chasing Elise, clear nearby minions and jungle monsters to limit how far she can escape with Rappel. Do not use targeted abilities while Elise is airborne with Rappel. Aim skillshots at Elise’s Rappel landing spot in advance.
vs-elise-rappel.text: Rappel can move Elise onto a nearby enemy unit, but without one she lands where she rose. When chasing her, clear nearby minions and jungle monsters or block her route to them to limit her escape. Targeted abilities will miss while she is airborne, so save them and aim skillshots at her landing spot in advance.

vs-evelynn-e.basis: Empowered E after the charm accounts for most of the damage. Position yourself to dodge before the charm lands. Avoid narrow paths along walls and leave room to retreat within your team's vision.
vs-evelynn-e.text: Empowered E after the charm accounts for most of Evelynn’s damage. Once charmed, you cannot break free, so your position beforehand is crucial: avoid narrow paths along walls and move within your team’s vision with room to retreat.

vs-evelynn-early.basis: Before level 6, Evelynn lacks camouflage and needs time for W to become ready, making it hard for her to start fights herself. Evelynn is especially vulnerable to early jungle invades. If you can win the fight, take Evelynn's jungle camps early to delay her level 6.
vs-evelynn-early.text: Before level 6, Evelynn lacks camouflage and needs time for W to mature, leaving her few ways to start a fight herself. She is especially vulnerable to early jungle invades, so if you can win the fight, take her camps early to delay level 6.

vs-evelynn-r.basis: Evelynn's R deals much more damage to targets below a certain health threshold. If your health is in execute range, do not stay somewhere without vision. Do not use targeted abilities on Evelynn while she casts R.
vs-evelynn-r.text: Evelynn’s R deals much more damage below a certain health threshold. After a fight, even a modest amount of health left can put you in range to be finished by one ability, so do not remain in an unwarded area while in execute range. She is untargetable as she casts R; using a targeted ability on her then wastes it.

vs-evelynn-teamfight.basis: Evelynn targets backline damage dealers in teamfights. Backline damage dealers should stay inside areas their team can see. Save immobilizing crowd control for Evelynn.
vs-evelynn-teamfight.text: Evelynn targets backline damage dealers in teamfights, so they should stay within areas their team has vision of and save immobilizing crowd control for her. Her health and defensive stats are low enough that catching her just once immediately after she engages can end the fight for her.

vs-evelynn-w-tell.basis: If you get a W mark, Evelynn is nearby preparing to charm you. Back away before the W mark is ready. When you see a W mark, immediately alert your team with a minimap ping and chat. While marked, use area abilities ahead of time on Evelynn's likely approach path.
vs-evelynn-w-tell.text: A W mark on you means Evelynn is already nearby preparing to charm you. Retreat before it matures, and immediately alert your team with a minimap ping and chat. She has not entered combat yet, so placing an area ability on her likely approach path can damage her while she is still camouflaged.

vs-evelynn-ward.basis: Buy Control Wards when facing Evelynn. A regular ward beside your jungle camp also spots Evelynn when she starts a fight there. Place vision where Evelynn starts fights as well as along her gank paths.
vs-evelynn-ward.text: Control Wards are a basic precaution against Evelynn. Because Demon Shade ends when she enters combat, even a regular ward beside your jungle camp will spot her if she starts a fight there. Place vision where she opens fights as well as along her gank paths.

vs-ezreal-fragile.basis: When fighting Ezreal, establish vision and find an approach angle to close the distance. Avoid trading poke with Ezreal from afar.
vs-ezreal-fragile.text: Ezreal has low health and armor, so he goes down quickly once you reach him. Establish vision and find an angle to close the distance instead of trading poke with him from afar.

vs-ezreal-minions.basis: All of Ezreal's damage comes from skillshots. Minions can block Ezreal's Q for you. Don't turn your back on the wave; move along the inside of it. If you face Ezreal in open ground without minions, you'll take hits without being able to trade back.
vs-ezreal-minions.text: All of Ezreal’s damage comes from skillshots, and minions can block Q Mystic Shot for you. Keep the wave between you and him as you move along its inside edge; facing him in open ground without minions leaves you taking hits without being able to trade back.

vs-ezreal-move-speed.basis: If you have a slow or a movement speed boost, chase Ezreal after he uses E. When ganking Ezreal, approach from an angle that blocks his escape route first.
vs-ezreal-move-speed.text: Ezreal has one of the lowest base movement speeds in the game. If your team has a slow or movement speed boost, you can catch him after forcing out E Arcane Shift, so approach a gank from an angle that blocks his escape route first.

vs-ezreal-r.basis: If you flee at low health along a visible straight path, R can finish you off. When low on health, turn along the terrain as you retreat to avoid R's straight path. Don't retreat in a straight line with your allies, or R may hit you together.
vs-ezreal-r.text: R Trueshot Barrage pierces targets along a straight line, so it can finish you if you flee at low health along a visible straight path. Turn around walls or terrain as you retreat, and avoid lining up with your allies where R could hit you together.

vs-ezreal-w.basis: Ezreal's basic attacks or abilities deal extra damage when they hit a target with a W orb attached. If a W orb attaches to you, briefly move out of Ezreal's range.
vs-ezreal-w.text: When a W Essence Flux orb attaches to you, Ezreal’s next basic attack or ability that hits will detonate it for extra damage. Briefly step out of his range before re-engaging to avoid taking both hits in one trade.

vs-fiddle-ambush.basis: If Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a while, watch for an R ambush from a brush. Place control wards in brushes and along entry paths near objectives. Do not enter an unwarded narrow passage grouped together.
vs-fiddle-ambush.text: If Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a while, watch for an R ambush from a brush. The surest response is to place control wards in brushes and along entry paths near objectives, and avoid entering an unwarded narrow passage while grouped together.

vs-fiddle-cluster.basis: Fiddlesticks' W, E, and R can hit several enemies at once. Spread out from your allies before Fiddlesticks engages. Do not face off against Fiddlesticks in narrow terrain. Fiddlesticks' E silences only enemies in the center of its area. Do not stand in the middle of your team when facing Fiddlesticks.
vs-fiddle-cluster.text: Fiddlesticks’ W, E, and R all hit multiple enemies, so spread out before he engages and avoid facing him in narrow terrain where one entry can catch everyone. E silences only targets in the center of its area, so avoid standing in the middle of your team.

vs-fiddle-punish.basis: Fiddlesticks is fragile and has no mobility abilities. Counterattack as soon as Fiddlesticks lands with R. Save an instant immobilizing ability to counter R. Save a spell defense tool to counter R. Focus your damage on Fiddlesticks' R landing spot.
vs-fiddle-punish.text: Fiddlesticks is fragile and has no mobility ability, making the moment he lands with R your chance to counterattack. Save an instant immobilizing ability or a spell defense tool for R, then focus your damage on his landing spot so he cannot complete a channel.

vs-fiddle-q.basis: During jungle gank windows, keep vision in the brush behind the lane. Do not walk past a motionless effigy until you confirm whether it is the real Fiddlesticks.
vs-fiddle-q.text: An ability hit from Fiddlesticks applies fear when enemies cannot see him, so any area without vision can become a fear threat. During jungle gank windows, keep vision in the brush behind the lane, and do not walk past a motionless effigy until you have confirmed it is not the real Fiddlesticks.

vs-fiddle-r.basis: Fiddlesticks' R channel is visible before the blink follows. If you see R being cast, interrupt it with an immobilizing effect or a slow. If you cannot interrupt R, move out of its range and wait out its duration.
vs-fiddle-r.text: Fiddlesticks’ R (Crowstorm) shows its channel before the blink. If you see him casting it, interrupt him with an immobilizing effect or a slow; if you cannot, leave its area and wait out its duration. Staying there to fight is the worst choice.

vs-fiddle-w.basis: If Fiddlesticks completes W without interruption, its remaining cooldown is greatly reduced. If Fiddlesticks completes W without interruption, it heals a lot. When Fiddlesticks starts channeling W, interrupt it with crowd control you have saved.
vs-fiddle-w.text: Completing W (Bountiful Harvest) without interruption greatly reduces its remaining cooldown and heals Fiddlesticks for a lot. Even a brief immobilizing effect cuts both his ability to cast it again and his sustain, so use saved crowd control as soon as he starts channeling.

vs-fiora-late.basis: Fiora is strong in late-game 1v1s. In the late game, take down Fiora in a side lane with at least two players instead of facing her alone. In the late game, force teamfights instead of dueling Fiora in a side lane. The true damage from vitals is not reduced by stacking armor.
vs-fiora-late.text: Fiora wins late-game 1v1s, so do not face her alone in a side lane. Send at least two players to take her down or force a teamfight. Stacking armor will not reduce the true damage from her vitals.

vs-fiora-riposte.basis: When facing Fiora, bait out W first. Fiora's W blocks all incoming attacks and immobilizing effects during its cast. If Fiora blocks an immobilizing effect with W, her counterthrust stuns. Avoid using immobilizing abilities such as roots or stuns while Fiora's W is available. Sidestep when using key abilities to avoid getting hit by Fiora's W.
vs-fiora-riposte.text: When facing Fiora, first bait out W Riposte. It blocks all attacks and immobilizing effects during its brief cast, then counterthrusts; blocking an immobilizing effect makes the counterthrust stun. While W is available, avoid committing roots or stuns, and sidestep as you use key abilities to avoid the counterthrust.

vs-fiora-riposte-aatrox.basis: Fiora will try to block Aatrox's third Q cast or W pull with W. Use Aatrox's first and second Q casts to bait out Fiora's W. After baiting out Fiora's W, use Aatrox's third Q cast and W. Save Aatrox's W while Fiora's W is available.
vs-fiora-riposte-aatrox.text: Fiora will try to use W Riposte to block Aatrox’s third Q cast or W pull. Bait it out with his first and second Q casts, then use the third Q cast and W. Hold Aatrox’s W while Fiora’s is available.

vs-fiora-ult.basis: When Fiora uses R, hug a wall. Covering one vital with a wall can prevent Fiora from hitting all four R vitals. If Fiora hits all four R vitals, she and her nearby allies heal.
vs-fiora-ult.text: When Fiora uses R Grand Challenge, hug a wall to block access to one vital and keep her from hitting all four. If she hits all four, Fiora and nearby allies heal, which can turn the teamfight.

vs-fiora-vital.basis: The vital marked on your body signals the direction Fiora intends to attack from. Position on the opposite side from the marked vital to narrow Fiora's approach angles. Counterattack the moment Fiora dashes toward the vital. Do not overcommit to chasing Fiora after a short trade.
vs-fiora-vital.text: The vital marked on your body shows which direction Fiora will approach from. Position on the opposite side to narrow her angle, then counterattack as she dashes toward the vital. Do not chase too far after a short trade.

vs-fizz-e-cooldown.basis: The moment Fizz's E goes on cooldown is a clear window to counterattack. Save crowd control and burst damage for the moment Fizz uses E. Early on, Fizz's mana limits him to using E only once or twice in lane.
vs-fizz-e-cooldown.text: As soon as Fizz's E Playful / Trickster goes on cooldown, he loses both an attack and an escape option. This is the clearest window to counterattack, so save crowd control and burst damage for it. Early on, his mana limits him to using E only once or twice in lane.

vs-fizz-entry-read.basis: When Fizz comes in with E, he has to land an auto attack and then wait for W's bleed to trigger. To engage with Q, Fizz has to walk into its range. Counterattack right after Fizz applies W.
vs-fizz-entry-read.text: Fizz has two ways to engage. If he comes in with E Playful / Trickster, he must land an auto attack and wait for W Seastone Trident's bleed to trigger; if he comes in with Q Urchin Strike, he must first walk into its range. Either way, counterattack right after he applies W.

vs-fizz-group.basis: Stay close to your allies, make Fizz use E first, then focus him down. Do not walk alone or chase Fizz alone.
vs-fizz-group.text: Fizz relies on E for both engaging and escaping, making it difficult for him to enter a grouped formation. Stay close to your allies, bait out E, then focus him down while he has no way out. Avoid walking alone, since getting caught leaves you no way to recover, and do not chase him.

vs-fizz-r.basis: If R's fish attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Fizz uses Q to engage as the shark knocks his target up. Place damage or crowd control in Fizz's path as he engages with Q to force him to use E.
vs-fizz-r.text: If the fish from R (Chum the Waters) attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts so they are not knocked back too. Fizz enters with Q as the shark knocks its target up; put damage or crowd control in his path to force out E. Even if you die, your allies can catch him afterward once E is gone.

vs-fizz-w-lasthit.basis: If Fizz misses a last hit with a W empowered attack, W goes on its full cooldown. Trade with Fizz the moment he misses a last hit with W.
vs-fizz-w-lasthit.text: If Fizz misses a last hit with a W empowered attack, W goes on its full cooldown. Watch his last hits in lane and trade the moment he wastes W, when a substantial part of his main damage is unavailable.

vs-galio-armor.basis: Building magic resistance increases both Galio's damage and defense. Include physical damage when attacking Galio. Pressure Galio with physical damage early, when his armor is low.
vs-galio-armor.text: Building magic resistance increases both Galio’s damage and defense, but his base armor is relatively low. Mix in physical damage instead of relying entirely on magic damage, or pressure him with physical damage early while his armor is low.

vs-galio-e.basis: Galio's E stops when it hits terrain. Stand near a wall to shorten the distance Galio can close with E. Dodge when you see E's initial step back.
vs-galio-e.text: Galio’s E Justice Punch stops when it hits terrain. Standing near a wall shortens the distance he can close and makes it harder for him to continue his combo; dodge when you see the initial step back.

vs-galio-lane.basis: Galio is melee, so he is vulnerable to ranged poke, and his mana costs are high. Make Galio use his abilities to clear the wave. When Galio is low on mana, push the lane to leave him less room to use R to help another lane.
vs-galio-lane.text: Galio is vulnerable to ranged poke because he is melee, and his mana costs are high. Make him spend abilities clearing the wave, then push the lane when his mana is low to deny him the chance to use R Hero’s Entrance in another lane.

vs-galio-q.basis: Q's vortex forms only where the two gusts overlap. Avoid the point where Q's gusts overlap to avoid its damage over time. Q's damage over time scales with maximum health, so champions with more health take more damage.
vs-galio-q.text: Q Winds of War’s vortex forms only where its two gusts overlap. Avoid that spot to escape most of its damage over time, which scales with maximum health and therefore hits champions with more health harder.

vs-galio-r.basis: Galio's R has a visible cast animation, and its landing area is marked in advance. When you see R's marker, immediately walk out of its area. While Galio's R is ready, do not start a skirmish with his team in another lane.
vs-galio-r.text: Galio’s R Hero’s Entrance has a visible cast animation and marks its landing area in advance. Walk out of the marked area immediately, and while R is ready, avoid starting a skirmish with Galio’s team in another lane.

vs-galio-w.basis: Galio takes much less damage while charging W. When you see Galio charging W, hold your damage and walk out of taunt range. The longer Galio charges W, the longer its taunt lasts.
vs-galio-w.text: Galio takes much less damage while charging W Shield of Durand. When you see the charge, hold your damage and walk out of taunt range; the longer he charges, the longer the taunt lasts, so trying to stand your ground is the worst choice.

vs-gangplank-barrel.basis: A Powder Keg destroyed by an enemy disappears without exploding. Destroy nearby Powder Kegs yourself from outside their blast radius. The older a Powder Keg is, the greater the risk that one hit will detonate it.
vs-gangplank-barrel.text: A Powder Keg destroyed by an enemy disappears without exploding. Destroy nearby kegs from outside their blast radius, and never step where two kegs overlap. As a keg ages, it becomes easier to detonate with one hit and more dangerous to approach.

vs-gangplank-timing.basis: Gangplank cannot properly execute his Powder Keg combo before the kegs have aged. Close in and trade right after Gangplank places a Powder Keg. Back away if an aged Powder Keg is nearby.
vs-gangplank-timing.text: Gangplank cannot execute his full Powder Keg combo before the kegs have aged. Close in and trade right after he places one, but back away if an aged keg is nearby.

vs-gangplank-ult.basis: Do not cross a wide area alone when low on health. Time objective fights around whether Gangplank has used R.
vs-gangplank-ult.text: From level 6, R (Cannon Barrage) can land anywhere on the map. Don’t cross a wide area alone when low on health, and time objective fights around whether the opposing Gangplank has used R.

vs-gangplank-w.basis: W removes all crowd control effects and heals based on missing health. Save the key crowd control needed to secure a kill until after Gangplank uses W. If the fight looks likely to drag on, get Executioner's Calling or Morellonomicon for Grievous Wounds.
vs-gangplank-w.text: W (Remove Scurvy) clears all crowd control and heals based on missing health. Save the key crowd control you need to secure a kill until after Gangplank uses W; if the fight looks likely to last, get Executioner's Calling or Morellonomicon for Grievous Wounds.

vs-garen-e.basis: Garen's E deals continuous damage while he spins. Garen's E deals bonus damage to the nearest enemy. Avoid extended fights with Garen and keep taking short, hit-and-run trades. If you cannot leave E's range, move among allied minions so a minion becomes the nearest enemy. Avoid approaching Garen in a brush so you do not take the full damage of E's spin.
vs-garen-e.text: Garen’s E Judgment deals continuous damage while he spins and bonus damage to the nearest enemy, so staying close for longer puts you at a disadvantage. Avoid extended fights and repeat short trades where you hit and back away. If you cannot leave the spin’s range, move among allied minions so a minion becomes the nearest enemy; also avoid approaching Garen inside a brush, where you would take the full spin damage.

vs-garen-mobility.basis: Garen has no mobility ability. Garen has limited ability to leave his lane and influence other lanes. Push the wave hard to expose Garen to jungle ganks. After pushing the wave in, create a numbers advantage elsewhere.
vs-garen-mobility.text: Garen has no mobility ability and struggles to leave his lane to influence others. Push the wave hard to expose him to jungle ganks, then, once the wave is pushed in, create a numbers advantage elsewhere.

vs-garen-q-cooldown.basis: Garen's Q-empowered auto attack silences you, preventing retaliation with abilities. Start a trade right after Garen uses Q on a minion or consumes its empowered auto attack. Avoid approaching Garen while his Q is active.
vs-garen-q-cooldown.text: Garen’s Q Decisive Strike empowers an auto attack that silences you and prevents retaliation with abilities. Since Q does not have a short cooldown, start a trade right after he uses it on a minion or spends the empowered attack; do not approach first while Q is active.

vs-garen-r.basis: Garen's R deals true damage proportional to his opponent's missing health. Armor and magic resistance cannot reduce Garen's R damage. Stay outside Garen's R range when your health falls below half. Champions who fight while recovering from low health through life steal must be especially wary of Garen's R execute.
vs-garen-r.text: Garen’s R Demacian Justice deals true damage based on his opponent’s missing health, so armor and magic resistance cannot reduce it. Do not count on tank items to save you: below half health, stay outside his R range. Champions that repeatedly recover from low health through life steal are especially vulnerable to its execute.

vs-garen-silence.basis: Garen's Q silence interrupts abilities with long cast times and channeled ultimates. Use abilities with long cast times or channeled ultimates after Garen has used his Q silence.
vs-garen-silence.text: Garen’s Q Decisive Strike silence interrupts abilities with long cast times and channeled ultimates. Hold those abilities while his empowered auto attack is ready, then use them after he has spent the silence.

vs-garen-w.basis: Right after using W, Garen briefly withstands burst damage and crowd control with a shield and tenacity. When you see Garen activate W, delay your combo slightly.
vs-garen-w.text: Immediately after Garen activates W Courage, its brief shield and tenacity help him withstand burst damage and crowd control. When you see the activation, delay your combo slightly before using it.

vs-gnar-mega.basis: Mega Gnar excels at dealing heavy damage in a short burst. Unlike Mini Gnar's E, Mega Gnar's E does not bounce and travels a shorter distance. Right after Gnar transforms into Mega, avoid fighting him head-on and keep your distance to wait out the transformation. Watch Gnar's appearance and Rage bar to tell when a transformation is near.
vs-gnar-mega.text: Mega Gnar is durable and deals heavy burst damage, but he is slow, and his E Crunch does not bounce or travel as far as Mini Gnar’s E Hop. When he transforms, keep your distance instead of fighting him head-on and wait out the transformation. Watch his appearance and Rage bar for signs that a transformation is near.

vs-gnar-mini.basis: If you have a way to close the gap, fight Gnar up close while he is in Mini form. If you cannot close the gap, farm near your turret and wait for Gnar's transformation cycle.
vs-gnar-mini.text: Mini Gnar can poke from range, but his base health is among the lowest of all champions. If you can close the gap, fight him up close in Mini form; otherwise, farm near your turret and wait for his transformation cycle.

vs-gnar-q.basis: The boomerang from Mini Gnar's Q (Boomerang Throw) can hit enemies both on its way out and on its way back. When Gnar catches his boomerang, Q's cooldown is greatly reduced. Move away from the boomerang's path to make it harder for Gnar to catch it. If Gnar misses his boomerang, there is a longer gap before his next Q poke.
vs-gnar-q.text: Mini Gnar’s Q Boomerang Throw can hit on both the outward and return paths, and catching it greatly reduces its cooldown. Move out of the boomerang’s path to make the catch harder; if Gnar misses it, the gap before his next Q poke is noticeably longer.

vs-gnar-rage.basis: Check Gnar's Rage bar to decide when to fight. Right after returning from Mega to Mini, Gnar cannot gain Rage for a while, so he cannot transform again. Go all-in or start a teamfight with your allies while Gnar is back in Mini form and cannot gain Rage.
vs-gnar-rage.text: Watch Gnar’s Rage bar when deciding when to fight. For a while after he returns from Mega to Mini, he cannot gain Rage or transform again. This is his weakest window: go all-in or start a teamfight with your allies.

vs-gnar-wall.basis: Gnar's R stuns only enemies who hit a wall. Hitting a wall from Gnar's R deals bonus damage to you. Position yourself so you are not between Gnar and a wall. Gnar has an advantage in teamfights in tight spaces.
vs-gnar-wall.text: Gnar’s R GNAR! stuns and deals bonus damage only when it throws you into a wall. Avoid standing with your back to one or positioning yourself between Gnar and a wall. Teamfights in tight spaces favor him.

vs-gragas-e.basis: Gragas's E cooldown is greatly reduced when he collides with an enemy. Only chase a fleeing Gragas when you are certain you can kill him.
vs-gragas-e.text: Gragas's E (Body Slam) cooldown is greatly reduced when he collides with an enemy, letting him use it again soon after. Chase him too far and he can escape with two E casts while your team gets picked off; pursue only when you are certain you can kill him.

vs-gragas-late.basis: Gragas has strong burst damage and formation disruption in the early and mid game, but weak sustained damage in the late game. In early and mid game objective fights, hold your formation and survive to play for the late game.
vs-gragas-late.text: Gragas wins through burst and formation disruption in the early and mid game, but his sustained damage is weak late. Hold your formation and survive early and mid game objective fights, and the matchup improves as time goes on.

vs-gragas-position.basis: Gragas's engage depends on E. Avoid narrow paths and bushes without vision. Do not let your back line stand alone within range of Gragas's E. If E hits you, move out of the barrel's radius to avoid Q's explosion.
vs-gragas-position.text: Gragas’s engage depends on E, so avoid narrow paths and bushes without vision, and keep your back line from standing alone within its range. If E hits you, immediately move out of the barrel’s radius; fighting back in place leaves you exposed to Q’s explosion.

vs-gragas-q.basis: A Q barrel that rolls in does not detonate immediately. If you see a barrel, leave its radius right away. The longer a barrel stays out, the more damage and slow it gains. If E hits you near a barrel, you will also get hit by Q's explosion.
vs-gragas-q.text: A Q barrel does not detonate as soon as it rolls in, so leave its radius immediately when you see one. The longer it stays out, the more damage and slow it gains; avoid standing on it. If E hits you near the barrel, you will take both E and Q’s explosion.

vs-gragas-r.basis: Gragas's R pushes enemies outward from the explosion point. When Gragas has R available, do not stand with your back to an enemy turret or the enemy team. Standing against a wall shortens the distance Gragas's R pushes you.
vs-gragas-r.text: Gragas’s R pushes enemies outward from the explosion point. When he has R available, do not stand with your back to an enemy turret or the enemy team: being pushed toward them can get you killed. Standing against a wall shortens the distance you are pushed and is safer.

vs-gragas-w.basis: Gragas takes reduced damage from the moment he starts drinking with W. When Gragas drinks with W, wait until the damage reduction ends before dealing burst damage.
vs-gragas-w.text: When Gragas starts drinking with W, hold your burst until the damage reduction ends. It applies from the moment he begins drinking, so the same abilities will deal much more damage if you wait briefly.

vs-graves-armor.basis: Graves deals almost entirely physical damage, making him vulnerable to armor. Buy Plated Steelcaps earlier to counter his early to mid game physical damage.
vs-graves-armor.text: Almost all of Graves’s damage is physical, so armor makes a noticeable difference. Buying Plated Steelcaps earlier can change how early to mid game fights play out.

vs-graves-block.basis: Graves's basic attacks are fully blocked by the first unit they hit. In chaotic fights, keep minions or allies between you and Graves to block his basic attacks.
vs-graves-block.text: The first unit hit blocks every pellet of Graves’s basic attack. In a chaotic fight, keep a minion or ally between you and him to block his main source of damage.

vs-graves-q.basis: Q explodes immediately when it touches terrain. Fight in open terrain so you have room to dodge Q's explosion.
vs-graves-q.text: Graves’s Q, End of the Line, explodes immediately when it hits terrain, leaving no room to dodge the blast if you fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow jungle passage. Take fights against Graves in open terrain whenever possible.

vs-graves-reload.basis: After emptying his magazine, Graves cannot basic attack while reloading. Counterattack or create distance right after Graves fires both shells.
vs-graves-reload.text: After firing both shells, Graves must reload and briefly cannot basic attack. Counterattack or create distance immediately after his second shot.

vs-graves-smoke.basis: Vision is limited inside W's smoke. Movement speed is reduced inside W's smoke. Leaving W's area immediately removes its harmful effects. Take the shortest route out of W's smoke, then reengage.
vs-graves-smoke.text: W (Smoke Screen) limits your vision and slows you while you are inside it, but its effects end as soon as you leave. Take the shortest route out, then reengage.

vs-gwen-e.basis: Gwen gets a large cooldown refund when she hits something with E. To catch Gwen, draw her into an area without minions or have immobilizing crowd control ready.
vs-gwen-e.text: Hitting something with E gives Gwen a large cooldown refund, letting her use it repeatedly around minion waves. To catch her, draw her into an area without minions or engage with immobilizing crowd control ready.

vs-gwen-mr.basis: Gwen's maximum health magic damage means stacking health alone makes her hit you harder. Build magic resistance items such as Spectre's Cowl against Gwen's magic damage. Keep your distance to avoid the true damage from the center of Q, which magic resistance cannot reduce.
vs-gwen-mr.text: Gwen’s maximum health magic damage makes stacking health alone hurt you more. Build magic resistance items such as Spectre’s Cowl, but keep your distance as well: magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage at the center of Q.

vs-gwen-passive.basis: Gwen needs to auto attack champions for sustain. Stay out of auto attack range to stop Gwen from healing. Trade at early levels before Gwen builds Q stacks. Do not get close to Gwen when her Q is fully stacked.
vs-gwen-passive.text: Gwen needs to auto attack champions to sustain herself, so stay outside her auto attack range to stop the healing. Trade at early levels before she builds Q stacks, and avoid getting close when Q is fully stacked.

vs-gwen-w.basis: Gwen cannot be targeted from outside the mist while she is inside it. When Gwen's W is active, move inside the mist or wait for it to expire before using targeted abilities or Ignite. Turrets ignore the mist, so push Gwen under the turret.
vs-gwen-w.text: Gwen cannot be targeted from outside W’s mist while she is inside it. Move into the mist or wait for it to expire before using targeted abilities or Ignite; turrets ignore the mist, so pushing her under a turret is effective.

vs-hecarim-e.basis: Hecarim’s E deals more damage based on the distance he runs after activation. Hecarim’s E knocks targets back farther based on the distance he runs after activation. If Hecarim suddenly turns and runs the other way, treat it as an attempt to build up E travel distance. Block vision while Hecarim builds up E travel distance. Move toward your allies so E’s knockback does not leave you isolated.
vs-hecarim-e.text: Hecarim’s E (Devastating Charge) gains damage and knockback distance the farther he runs after activation. If he suddenly turns and runs the other way, he is building travel distance rather than fleeing. Break his line of sight or move toward your allies so the knockback does not leave you isolated.

vs-hecarim-early.basis: Hecarim’s lack of reliable hard crowd control before level 6 is a weakness in his ganks. Hecarim reaches level 6 early thanks to his fast camp clear. Manage the lane early so you do not push it too far.
vs-hecarim-early.text: Hecarim’s ganks are weak before level 6 because he lacks reliable hard crowd control, but his fast camp clear lets him reach level 6 early. Avoid pushing your lane too far early on, and establish river vision once the enemy jungler reaches level 6.

vs-hecarim-r.basis: Hecarim’s R can fear several clustered enemies at once. Keep your teamfight formation spread out so fewer players are hit by R together. R’s fear takes away the target’s control over their movement. Be ready to use a cleanse or mobility ability before R’s fear hits you.
vs-hecarim-r.text: Hecarim’s R (Onslaught of Shadows) can fear several players at once when they are grouped together, so spread out your teamfight formation to limit how many it catches. Fear takes away control of your movement rather than stopping movement entirely; be ready to use a cleanse or mobility ability before it hits.

vs-hecarim-w.basis: Hecarim’s W heals him based on damage nearby enemies take. Hecarim’s W healing also counts damage dealt by his allies. Avoid prolonged fights where several players stay close to Hecarim while his W is active. Kill Hecarim with a short burst of focused damage. Back out of Hecarim’s W range, then approach again.
vs-hecarim-w.text: Hecarim’s W (Spirit of Dread) heals him based on damage nearby enemies take, including damage his allies deal. Having several players stay close and attack him for a long time can keep him alive instead. His durability falls short of a tank’s, so finish him with a short burst of damage or back out of W’s range before reengaging.

vs-heimerdinger-body.basis: Heimerdinger has no mobility ability. Go around his turret position, or withstand it before attacking Heimerdinger himself. Do not repeatedly trade damage head-on in front of his turrets. Change your approach angle from the side or from brush.
vs-heimerdinger-body.text: Heimerdinger's health and armor are among the lowest of all champions, and he has no mobility ability. If you go around his turret position or withstand its fire, a single engage can take him down. Avoid repeated head-on trades in front of his turrets; approach from the side or through brush instead.

vs-heimerdinger-e.basis: The grenade stuns enemies hit by its center; hits outside the center only slow. When the grenade's landing marker appears, move sideways out of its center. A direct grenade hit is Heimerdinger's only guaranteed crowd control and instantly fully charges his turrets.
vs-heimerdinger-e.text: Heimerdinger's grenade stuns only at its center; a hit outside the center merely slows. When its landing marker appears, keep moving sideways to leave the center. That stun is his only guaranteed crowd control and a direct hit instantly fully charges nearby turrets, so avoiding it also greatly reduces the burst that follows.

vs-heimerdinger-melee.basis: Melee champions can get hit by both turrets and rockets while last-hitting inside turret range. As a melee champion, do not force yourself to take the wave; wait outside turret range. Step forward when Heimerdinger uses his grenade or spends all his turret placement charges. If you are not confident you can get close and take him down, give up the lane and put pressure on a side lane.
vs-heimerdinger-melee.text: As a melee champion, last-hitting inside turret range can expose you to both turret fire and rockets. Do not force yourself to take the wave: wait outside turret range and step forward only after Heimerdinger uses E or spends all his turret placement charges. If you cannot confidently close the gap and take him down, give up the lane and pressure a side lane instead.

vs-heimerdinger-r.basis: After level 6, Heimerdinger's ultimate empowers his next ability. The empowered grenade bounces several times and has a much larger stun area. Empowered rockets can finish off a low-health ally with burst damage. When Heimerdinger has his ultimate available, do not group up in narrow passages. When Heimerdinger has his ultimate available, do not group at one spot in front of an objective for a standoff.
vs-heimerdinger-r.text: After level 6, R empowers Heimerdinger's next ability. An empowered grenade bounces several times and has a much larger stun area, while empowered rockets can finish a low-health ally with burst damage. While his ultimate is available, avoid grouping in narrow passages, especially for a standoff at a single spot in front of an objective.

vs-heimerdinger-timing.basis: Turrets charge over time and fire more powerfully when fully charged. Engage when a turret has just been placed or immediately after it fires a powerful shot. When Heimerdinger hits an enemy champion with his grenade, nearby turrets instantly become fully charged. Move out of turret range immediately after the grenade hits you.
vs-heimerdinger-timing.text: Turrets charge over time and fire much harder at full charge, so engage just after one is placed or immediately after it fires a powerful shot. If Heimerdinger hits a champion with E, nearby turrets instantly reach full charge; leave their range immediately if the grenade hits you.

vs-heimerdinger-turret.basis: Turrets far from Heimerdinger stop working after a short time. Push Heimerdinger away instead of destroying his turrets one by one. Turrets prioritize targets Heimerdinger has recently damaged or targets attacking him. When diving, have a durable ally attack Heimerdinger first and draw turret fire before your damage dealers go in.
vs-heimerdinger-turret.text: Turrets shut down shortly after Heimerdinger moves too far away, so pushing him out is faster than destroying them one by one. They prioritize targets he has recently damaged or who are attacking him; when diving, have a durable ally hit Heimerdinger first to draw turret fire before your damage dealers go in.

vs-hwei-dive.basis: Hwei has no mobility, and Subject: Torment is his only way to counterattack when an enemy gets close. Engage right after Hwei uses Subject: Torment to poke or clear a wave. If Subject: Torment is ready, the first champion to engage may be feared or rooted.
vs-hwei-dive.text: Hwei has no mobility and is very fragile, with Subject: Torment his only way to answer an enemy who gets close. Engage just after he uses that subject to poke or clear a wave; if it is ready, the first champion in may be feared or rooted.

vs-hwei-eye.basis: The eye left by Gaze of the Abyss (EW) grants vision and roots the first enemy to enter it. Before ganking, check whether Gaze of the Abyss (EW) has placed an eye. If there’s an eye, take another route or let a minion or something else trigger it first.
vs-hwei-eye.text: The eye left by Gaze of the Abyss (EW) grants vision and roots the first enemy that enters it. Before ganking, check for an eye; if one is present, take another route or let a minion or something else trigger it first.

vs-hwei-lightning.basis: Severing Bolt (QW) deals much more damage if it hits you while you’re immobilized or isolated. Stay close to allies to avoid meeting Severing Bolt’s (QW) isolation condition.
vs-hwei-lightning.text: Severing Bolt (QW) deals much more damage when it hits you while you are immobilized or isolated. If crowd control catches you, use a cleanse or movement ability to escape as quickly as possible, and stay near allies to avoid the isolation condition.

vs-hwei-signature.basis: Hwei’s Signature damage triggers when two different spells hit in quick succession. Move immediately after the first spell hits to dodge the second.
vs-hwei-signature.text: Hwei’s Signature of the Visionary damage is completed when two different spells hit in quick succession. If the first hits you, move immediately instead of holding your ground so the second misses; taking just one hit and backing off prevents the passive explosion.

vs-illaoi-e-fight.basis: If your spirit is pulled and you can fight, fight back. If you only run after your spirit is pulled, it survives intact and you become a Vessel.
vs-illaoi-e-fight.text: If your spirit has been pulled out and you can fight, fight back. If you only run, the spirit survives intact and you become a Vessel.

vs-illaoi-heal.basis: Illaoi’s healing gets stronger as her health gets lower. If you dive Illaoi after bringing her to half health, a few tentacle hits can restore her health. Apply Grievous Wounds with Executioner’s Calling before committing to a dive.
vs-illaoi-heal.text: Illaoi heals more as her health falls, making her much tougher than she looks. Diving her at half health can let a few tentacle hits restore her health, so apply Grievous Wounds with Executioner’s Calling before committing.

vs-illaoi-laning.basis: In lane, Illaoi draws the wave near a wall and sets up tentacles. Keep the wave away from walls and last-hit from outside E range. Illaoi has no guaranteed crowd control, so if you dodge E, she cannot keep you in place.
vs-illaoi-laning.text: In lane, Illaoi draws the wave near a wall to set up tentacles. Keep the wave away from walls and last-hit from outside E range to deny most of her pressure. She has no guaranteed crowd control, so dodging E keeps her from holding you in place.

vs-illaoi-r.basis: R is Illaoi’s peak damage window, but it is short. When Illaoi uses R, spread out so she has no targets to attack. R spawns one tentacle for each enemy champion it damages. Do not group up in front of Illaoi.
vs-illaoi-r.text: R is Illaoi’s peak damage window, but it is short. Spread out during it to leave her no targets to attack and let the ultimate expire. Since R spawns one tentacle for each enemy champion it damages, avoid grouping up in front of her in the first place.

vs-illaoi-tentacle.basis: Illaoi is stronger in fights near tentacles. Destroy tentacles when you can. If you cannot spare the time to destroy tentacles, draw Illaoi into open ground away from walls. Do not take a fight with Illaoi in an area covered by tentacles.
vs-illaoi-tentacle.text: Illaoi’s strength lies near her tentacles. Destroy them when you can; if you cannot spare the time, draw her into open ground away from walls. Taking a fight where tentacles are set up means losing regardless of the item difference.

vs-illaoi-vessel.basis: If you are not fighting, break the spirit tether and dodge the first tentacle after becoming a Vessel. After dodging the first tentacle, wait beside it until the mark expires. If you stay beside that tentacle without destroying it, you will not be hit by another slam, and Illaoi will not gain more tentacles.
vs-illaoi-vessel.text: If you do not intend to fight, break the spirit tether, become a Vessel, and dodge the first tentacle slam. Then stand beside that tentacle until the mark expires. Leaving it intact and staying close prevents further slams from hitting you while keeping Illaoi from gaining more tentacles.

vs-irelia-early.basis: Irelia is weak in level 1–2 trades. Gain control before Irelia has all her abilities. Use that early control to disrupt Irelia's farming and slow her growth.
vs-irelia-early.text: Irelia is weak in level 1–2 trades. Take control before she has all her abilities, then use that advantage to disrupt her farming and slow her growth.

vs-irelia-q-minion.basis: Irelia approaches by chaining Q dashes through low-health minions. Do not leave a half-health minion between you and Irelia that she can use to approach with Q. Step back and keep your distance from Irelia when minions are about to die.
vs-irelia-q-minion.text: Irelia can close the gap by chaining Q dashes through low-health minions. Do not leave a half-health minion between you and her, and step back to keep your distance as minions are about to die.

vs-irelia-r.basis: If you are trapped in Irelia's R blade wall, wait until the blades disappear. Crossing Irelia's R blade wall deals additional damage and heavily slows you.
vs-irelia-r.text: If you are trapped in Irelia’s R blade wall, it is better to wait for the blades to disappear. Crossing the wall deals additional damage and applies a heavy slow, which can stop you from escaping.

vs-irelia-teamfight.basis: When a teamfight starts, focus Irelia first. Irelia's R splits formations in teamfights. Irelia's E can stun multiple targets at once.
vs-irelia-teamfight.text: Focus Irelia first when a teamfight starts. Her R can split your formation and her E can stun several champions at once, allowing her to control the fight if left alive.

vs-irelia-w.basis: Abilities that deal true damage ignore the damage reduction from Irelia's W. If Irelia uses W to withstand damage, use Ignite's true damage. Use Ignite's healing reduction to limit Irelia's Q healing.
vs-irelia-w.text: True damage ignores the damage reduction from Irelia’s W. Ignite combines true damage with healing reduction, disrupting her ability to withstand damage with W and recover with Q.

vs-ivern-brush.basis: Brush Ivern creates appears where there was none and lasts a long time. If Ivern's team loses vision inside the brush, it disappears. Deny vision inside Ivern's brush to remove the ambush spot. Do not walk carelessly past brush that suddenly appears.
vs-ivern-brush.text: Ivern’s brush can appear where there was none and remain for quite a while, but it disappears if his team loses vision inside it. Deny that vision to remove the ambush spot, and do not walk carelessly past brush that suddenly appears.

vs-ivern-daisy.basis: While Daisy! is alive, Ivern's team has one more frontline unit. Daisy! can absorb skillshots. Do not fire non-targeted abilities at an enemy behind Daisy!. Daisy!'s third consecutive hit on the same target knocks them up. If Daisy! starts attacking you, move to break the chain of consecutive attacks.
vs-ivern-daisy.text: While Daisy! is alive, Ivern’s team effectively has another frontline unit. She can absorb skillshots, so avoid firing non-targeted abilities at an enemy behind her. Her third consecutive hit on one target knocks them up; if she starts attacking you, move to break the chain.

vs-ivern-e.basis: Ivern's E explodes shortly after being applied and leaves a slow. If you engage on a shielded target, the slow that follows makes it hard to back away. Engage on a shielded target after E explodes.
vs-ivern-e.text: Ivern’s E explodes shortly after it is applied and leaves a slow. Engaging on an already shielded target can leave you struggling to retreat when the slow follows, so wait for the shield to explode before going in.

vs-ivern-jungle.basis: Ivern plants seeds at camps and waits for them to grow, so you can predict his harvest route. Place vision in Ivern's jungle early to track when he will harvest camps. As the enemy jungler, ambush Ivern when he comes to a camp; he is weak in a 1v1.
vs-ivern-jungle.text: Ivern plants seeds at camps and waits for them to grow, making his harvest route predictable. Place vision in his jungle early to see which camps he will return to and when; as the enemy jungler, ambush him there, since he is weak in a 1v1.

vs-ivern-q.basis: When you are hit by Ivern's Q, his allies automatically dash into attack range. Take a favorable position before Ivern fires Q, rather than after it hits you. Stand with minions or terrain between you and Ivern to limit his Q angles.
vs-ivern-q.text: Ivern’s threat begins with Q. His allies automatically dash into range of a target it roots, so win the positioning battle before he fires rather than trying to react after it hits. Keep minions or terrain between you and Ivern to limit his Q angles.

vs-ivern-solo.basis: Ivern himself deals almost no damage. Instead of spending time trying to kill Ivern, stop the ally receiving his shield first. If only Ivern is left, you have already won the fight. Ivern escapes well with his mobility and brush, so do not chase him too far.
vs-ivern-solo.text: Ivern himself deals almost no damage, so focus on stopping the ally he shields before spending time trying to kill him. If only Ivern remains, you have already won the fight. His mobility and brush help him escape, so do not chase too far.

vs-janna-e.basis: A target with E absorbs damage and gains attack damage. Engage after E's shield is gone, or target someone else. Each time Janna disrupts an enemy with an ability, E comes back sooner.
vs-janna-e.text: A target shielded by E absorbs damage and gains attack damage, making their counterattack stronger. Avoid wasting burst damage into the shield: engage after it expires or target someone else. Account for E returning sooner each time Janna hinders an enemy with an ability.

vs-janna-lane.basis: Keep poking the ally Janna protects to make her use E. Make Janna waste Q and W to drain her mana.
vs-janna-lane.text: Janna is strongest just after she buffs an ally with E. Keep pressuring the ally she protects to force her to spend the shield; this is more effective than poking Janna herself. Her abilities cost a lot of mana, so making her waste Q and W a few times can give you control of the lane.

vs-janna-q.basis: Q's tornado makes a sound while charging. If you hear Q charging from a bush or outside your vision, avoid the tornado's path. A fully charged Q has much greater range and knockup duration. When Janna has just disappeared from vision, watch for a fully charged Q as you engage.
vs-janna-q.text: Q’s tornado makes a sound while charging. If you hear it from a bush or outside your vision, stay out of its path. A fully charged tornado has much greater range and knockup duration, making an engage especially risky just after Janna disappears from vision.

vs-janna-r.basis: Janna's R pushes nearby enemies away and stops their engage. If you have an interrupt, save it for when Janna uses R. Engage with your back to a wall to shorten the distance R pushes you.
vs-janna-r.text: Janna’s R pushes nearby enemies away and can stop an engage entirely, so save an interrupt for the moment she uses it. Its knockback cannot push you through a wall; engaging with your back to one shortens how far you are pushed and makes it easier to close in again.

vs-janna-target.basis: Establish vision and look for a moment when Janna is isolated. If Janna keeps stopping engages from behind her allied carry, look to pick off Janna first.
vs-janna-target.text: Janna has among the lowest health, armor, and magic resistance, so getting caught can kill her outright. While she stays behind her allied carry, she can keep pushing back engages; establish vision and look for a moment when she is isolated, or set up a pick on Janna first.

vs-janna-w.basis: W's ghosting lets Janna pass through minions. To catch Janna, use immobilizing crowd control or an engage ability that closes the distance at once.
vs-janna-w.text: W (Zephyr) gives Janna ghosting, letting her pass straight through minions. Minion walls and allied bodies will not block her or narrow her escape route, so catching her requires immobilizing crowd control or an engage ability that closes the distance at once.

vs-jarvan-early.basis: Jarvan IV can gank from level 2, once he has EQ. Early on, establish vision first in bushes that give Jarvan IV an EQ angle. Do not push the lane too far early on. Jarvan IV is most dangerous through the mid game, as his items come together. In the late game, Jarvan IV's ability to trap a target with R is more threatening than his damage.
vs-jarvan-early.text: Jarvan IV can gank as soon as he has EQ at level 2, so establish early vision in bushes that give him an EQ angle and avoid pushing the lane too far. He is most dangerous through the mid game as his items come together; late in the game, being isolated by R is a greater threat than his damage.

vs-jarvan-eq.basis: When you see the flag, immediately move away from it to dodge the Q dash that may follow. Q without a flag is a short poke.
vs-jarvan-eq.text: Jarvan IV’s main threat is EQ. When E Demacian Standard lands at your feet or nearby, a Q Dragon Strike dash can follow, so move away from the flag immediately. Without a flag, Q is only a short jab and poses little threat.

vs-jarvan-flag-wall.basis: Jarvan IV can dash to a flag thrown over a thin wall to cross it. When Jarvan IV disappears from vision, position with possible approaches over walls in mind.
vs-jarvan-flag-wall.text: Jarvan IV can throw a flag over a thin wall and dash to it to cross the terrain, so fleeing along a wall does not guarantee safety. When he disappears from vision, position with possible approaches over walls in mind.

vs-jarvan-passive.basis: Jarvan IV's first auto attack deals bonus damage based on current health. Martial Cadence's bonus damage can trigger on the same target only once every set period. Right after taking Jarvan IV's first auto attack is a window to trade back.
vs-jarvan-passive.text: Jarvan IV's first auto attack deals bonus damage based on current health, and Martial Cadence can trigger on the same target only once every set period. It hurts most at full health, making the moment just after you take that first hit a reasonable window to trade back.

vs-jarvan-r.basis: Jarvan IV can recast R to remove the wall himself. If trapped by R, escape with a movement ability that crosses walls. If trapped by R, do not circle indecisively along the wall.
vs-jarvan-r.text: Jarvan IV can recast R to remove Cataclysm's wall himself, so do not count on waiting for an opening. If trapped, commit to escaping with a movement ability that crosses walls or to killing Jarvan IV inside the wall; circling it indecisively is the worst choice.

vs-jarvan-w.basis: Jarvan IV's W shield grows stronger with more enemy champions nearby. If Jarvan IV uses W among several enemies, wait until the shield is gone before dealing finishing damage.
vs-jarvan-w.text: Jarvan IV’s W Golden Aegis grants a stronger shield when more enemy champions are nearby. If he jumps into several enemies and uses it, a burst of damage will mostly be absorbed by the shield, so wait until it is gone before dealing finishing damage.

vs-jax-bait.basis: Jax can activate E, feint an approach, then retreat to bait out the opponent's mobility ability or ultimate. Do not spend your escape or defensive ability just because Jax activates E. After Jax's E ends, use its cooldown window to trade. Pressure Jax with your jungler while his E is unavailable.
vs-jax-bait.text: Jax may activate E Counter Strike, feint an approach, then retreat to bait out your mobility ability or ultimate. Do not spend an escape or defensive ability just because he activates E; trade during its cooldown after it ends. With little defensive ability while E is unavailable, Jax is especially vulnerable to pressure from you and your jungler.

vs-jax-e.basis: Do not use basic attacks while Jax's E is active. Jax's E also dodges bonus damage and crowd control carried by basic attacks. Jax's E deals more recast damage for each attack it dodges. When Jax activates E, back out of its stun range and wait for its duration to end. Save your mobility ability to get out of Jax's E range. Since Jax's E does not block ability damage itself, plan your trades around abilities.
vs-jax-e.text: Do not basic attack while Jax’s E Counter Strike is active: it dodges basic attacks along with their bonus damage and crowd control, then deals more recast damage for each attack dodged. Back out of its stun range without attacking and wait for the duration to end, saving your mobility ability for that moment. E does not block ability damage itself, so plan your trades around abilities.

vs-jax-early.basis: Jax has a weak laning phase because he lacks poke, farming abilities, and healing. Avoid forcing melee trades at level 1, when Jax has the advantage. From level 2 onward, build a CS and level lead over Jax. Secure an advantage before Jax gets stronger by learning R at level 6 and completing his first core item.
vs-jax-early.text: Jax’s laning phase is weak because he lacks poke, a farming ability, and healing, but he has the advantage in level 1 melee trades. Avoid forcing a fight while each player has only one ability, then build a CS and level lead from level 2 onward. Make use of that lead before his fighting power rises sharply when he unlocks R at level 6 and completes his first core item.

vs-jax-ranged.basis: When playing a ranged champion against Jax, whittle down his health with auto attack poke. Even when poking with a ranged champion, stop auto attacking while Jax's E is active. Jax gains attack speed with successive basic attacks, increasing his damage. Repeat short trades instead of prolonged fights to disrupt Jax's basic attack rhythm. Jax can use minions or wards as stepping stones to engage with Q. Avoid standing next to minion groups so Jax cannot use Q to close in. Watch how many allied minions remain in front of Jax while staying outside his Q range.
vs-jax-ranged.text: As a ranged champion, whittle down Jax’s health with basic attack poke, but stop attacking while E Counter Strike is active. Successive basic attacks increase his attack speed and damage, so repeat short trades instead of prolonged fights to break his attack rhythm. Q Leap Strike can target units, making minions and wards ways for him to close in; avoid standing beside a minion wave, watch how many allied minions remain in front of him, and stay outside Q range.

vs-jax-teamfight.basis: When Jax engages, avoid grouping up nearby so his E's area stun does not hit you together. If Jax engages with E active, use your abilities after E's duration ends. Immediately after Jax's E stun ends, focus crowd control on him to kill him. If Jax pushes a side-lane turret, split your team to pressure his team's territory and trade objectives instead of forcing a duel.
vs-jax-teamfight.text: When Jax jumps into a teamfight, spread out so the area stun from E Counter Strike cannot hit several of you together. If he enters with E active, wait out its duration before using abilities, then focus crowd control on him immediately after the stun ends to kill him. If he is pushing a side-lane turret, split your team to pressure his side of the map and trade objectives instead of forcing a one-on-one fight.

vs-jayce-early.basis: Jayce is strongest early. If you fall behind early, farm defensively and stall until your power spike.
vs-jayce-early.text: Jayce is strongest early. If you fall behind, farm defensively instead of forcing a comeback, and stall until your own power spike.

vs-jayce-gate.basis: When Jayce places Acceleration Gate, he may soon fire Shock Blast. As soon as you see Acceleration Gate, sidestep out of the line to dodge the empowered Q.
vs-jayce-gate.text: When Jayce places Acceleration Gate, Shock Blast is about to follow. Sidestep out of its line as soon as you see the gate to dodge the empowered Q.

vs-jayce-poke.basis: Jayce's Cannon Q is a straight-line skillshot. Move side to side while farming, keeping Jayce's Cannon Q in mind. If your health gets low, don't force yourself to stay in lane. Clear the wave, then go back.
vs-jayce-poke.text: Cannon Q is a straight-line skillshot, so move side to side while farming. If your health gets low, clear the wave and return rather than forcing yourself to stay in lane.

vs-jayce-squishy.basis: Use the moment after Jayce leaps with To the Skies! (hammer Q) and has no mobility as an opening to engage. Bait out Jayce’s hammer Q leap, then close in.
vs-jayce-squishy.text: Jayce’s health and armor are among the lowest. Bait out his Q To the Skies! leap, then engage while it is on cooldown and he has no way to close the distance or escape.

vs-jayce-stance.basis: Adjust your response based on Jayce’s weapon form. If Jayce holds his cannon, he’s preparing ranged poke; if he holds his hammer, he’s preparing to leap in and knock you back.
vs-jayce-stance.text: Adjust your response to Jayce’s weapon form: a cannon signals ranged poke, while a hammer signals a leap in and knockback.

vs-jhin-q-bounce.basis: Each target Q kills while bouncing strengthens its next hit. Stay away from low-health allies and minions so an empowered Q cannot bounce to you.
vs-jhin-q-bounce.text: Each target Q kills as it bounces strengthens the next hit. When laning against Jhin, stand a step away from the wave and avoid standing beside low-health allies or minions: Q can kill them and bounce to you with increased damage.

vs-jhin-r.basis: R deals more damage the less health its target has. R's final shot deals more damage than its other shots. When low on health, prioritize dodging R shots. If an ally must block an R shot, the ally with the highest current health percentage should take it.
vs-jhin-r.text: R deals more damage as its target loses health, and its final shot hits especially hard. If you are below full health, focus on dodging; if someone must block a shot, the ally with the highest current health percentage should take it rather than automatically sending the frontline.

vs-jhin-reload.basis: After firing his set number of shots, Jhin cannot basic attack while reloading. Engage when Jhin is reloading or has fired his first one or two shots. Back off if Jhin still has his final shot. Count Jhin's remaining shots when facing him.
vs-jhin-reload.text: After firing his set number of bullets, Jhin cannot basic attack while reloading. Engage during the reload or just after he has fired his first one or two shots; back off when his final bullet remains, because it can deal a sudden burst of damage. Count his remaining shots whenever you face him.

vs-jhin-tank-lead.basis: Jhin struggles to kill enemies who build a lot of health. When advancing on Jhin, have your frontline go first and block W and R shots. The frontline should step on traps first so the damage dealers behind them can approach safely.
vs-jhin-tank-lead.text: Jhin picks off fragile targets with burst damage and struggles against enemies who build a lot of health. When advancing on him, send the frontline in first to absorb W and R shots and trigger traps, allowing the damage dealers behind them to enter range unharmed.

vs-jhin-traps.basis: Jhin places traps that are invisible on the map. E traps explode after a delay, not immediately when stepped on. With enough movement speed, you can pass through a trap before it explodes. Before deliberately stepping on a trap to remove it, check whether Jhin is using it as bait.
vs-jhin-traps.text: Jhin places invisible E, Captive Audience, traps around the map. Stepping on one slows you, but the explosion takes time, so a champion with enough movement speed can keep moving through before it detonates. Even if you know where a trap is, Jhin may be waiting for you to step on it to remove it; avoid getting rooted by W while standing on the trap.

vs-jhin-w-root.basis: W roots only targets recently hit by Jhin's basic attack, his trap, or an attack from one of his allies. Right after Jhin's basic attack hits you or you step on a trap, move out of W's straight path. When the enemy's crowd control lands, check Jhin's position for a follow-up W.
vs-jhin-w-root.text: W, Deadly Flourish, roots only enemies recently hit by Jhin’s basic attack or trap, or attacked by one of his allies. If his basic attack has just hit you or you have stepped on a trap, move out of its straight path; W is very narrow and can be dodged once you know its angle. Jhin often fires it after an ally’s immobilizing effect, so account for his position as soon as that crowd control lands.

vs-jinx-minigun.basis: Jinx's minigun needs time to build attack speed stacks. Use the moment Jinx pokes with rockets as an opening to engage while she has no minigun stacks. When Jinx pokes with rockets, close in and kill her with burst damage.
vs-jinx-minigun.text: Jinx’s minigun takes time to build attack speed stacks. When she is poking with rockets, she has no minigun stacks; use that opening to close in and burst her down.

vs-jinx-mobility.basis: Jinx has no dash. Save your engage ability until Jinx has used her defensive tools. Engage as soon as Jinx misses her W slow. Bait out Jinx's E, then engage.
vs-jinx-mobility.text: Jinx has no dash and is among the slowest champions. Save your engage ability until she misses her W slow or uses E; then she has no way to respond.

vs-jinx-passive.basis: Jinx gains a large movement speed boost right after a takedown or destroying a structure. Jinx gains a large attack speed boost right after a takedown or destroying a structure. Avoid fighting right after an ally dies or a turret is destroyed and triggers Jinx's Get Excited!.
vs-jinx-passive.text: Get Excited! gives Jinx large movement speed and attack speed boosts after a takedown or a structure is destroyed. She can catch you even if you run after an ally dies or a turret falls, so avoid starting a fight during that window.

vs-jinx-r.basis: Jinx's R deals less damage the closer you are to her. If Jinx tries to finish you with R, move out of its attack area or close in on her.
vs-jinx-r.text: Jinx’s R, Super Mega Death Rocket!, deals less damage the closer you are to her. If she tries to finish you with it, either move out of its finishing range or close in on her.

vs-jinx-rocket-splash.basis: Jinx's rocket basic attacks also deal full damage to enemies near the target. When Jinx uses rockets to take CS, keep your distance from the minions.
vs-jinx-rocket-splash.text: Jinx’s rocket basic attacks deal full damage to enemies near their target. When she uses them to take CS, stand away from the minions so you do not take the splash damage.

vs-kaisa-burst.basis: Immediately after Kai'Sa enters with R, immobilize and kill her before her shield wears off. If you fail to stop Kai'Sa's R engage, she deals sustained damage with basic attacks.
vs-kaisa-burst.text: Even a fed Kai'Sa is fragile because her armor and magic resistance scale poorly. Immobilize and kill her just after she dashes in with R, before her shield wears off; if you let the engage go unanswered, she can keep dealing damage with basic attacks.

vs-kaisa-e-vision.basis: Evolved E gives Kai'Sa brief stealth. Before a fight, place Control Wards in side brush and along approach routes to prepare for a flank from Kai'Sa. Draw Kai'Sa near a turret to reveal her while she is stealthed.
vs-kaisa-e-vision.text: Evolved E briefly conceals Kai'Sa. Before a fight, place Control Wards in side brush and along approach routes to guard against her appearing from the flank, and draw her near a turret to reveal her while she is stealthed.

vs-kaisa-early.basis: Kai'Sa is weakest at levels 1–2. At levels 1–2, push the lane to make it harder for Kai'Sa to farm CS. At levels 1–2, lower Kai'Sa's health to delay her item progression.
vs-kaisa-early.text: Kai'Sa is weakest at levels 1–2 because her range is short and her armor is low. Push the lane during this window to deny her CS and chip away at her health, delaying the item gains she needs to grow stronger.

vs-kaisa-plasma.basis: Plasma's detonation damage increases as the target's health decreases. If you have Plasma stacks and about half your health remains, the next one or two basic attacks could deal heavy damage. When you have Plasma stacks, stay out of range until they disappear.
vs-kaisa-plasma.text: Kai'Sa's passive Plasma detonation hits harder the less health you have. If you have stacks and are at about half health, the next one or two basic attacks may hurt far more than expected, so move out of range and wait for the stacks to expire.

vs-kaisa-q-minions.basis: Kai'Sa's Q missiles split among nearby enemies. Kai'Sa's Q missiles deal less damage with each additional hit on the same target. If Kai'Sa looks ready to use Q, stay near allied minions to split the missiles.
vs-kaisa-q-minions.text: Kai'Sa's Q (Icathian Rain) missiles split among nearby enemies, and each additional missile that hits the same target deals less damage. Stand near allied minions to spread out the missiles, and do not step away from the wave alone when Kai'Sa looks ready to use Q.

vs-kaisa-r-mark.basis: Kai'Sa's R can dash only to targets with a Plasma mark. Right after Kai'Sa's W hits is the most dangerous time for her to engage with R. If W hits you, retreat toward your allies until the Plasma mark disappears to deny Kai'Sa an R angle.
vs-kaisa-r-mark.text: Kai'Sa’s R can dash only to a target with a Plasma mark. The moment after her W hits is the most dangerous; if it hits you, retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears to deny her an R angle.

vs-kalista-catch.basis: Kalista relies on hopping for mobility, so she has trouble escaping once caught. When you have an opening to engage, catch Kalista immediately with forced movement or immobilization.
vs-kalista-catch.text: Kalista relies on hopping for mobility, so she has little way to escape once caught. Use forced movement or immobilization as soon as you have an opening to engage; she is among the most prone to early deaths of any marksman.

vs-kalista-poise.basis: Push Kalista out of attack range to stop her from hopping. Lower Kalista's attack speed to reduce the distance she travels by hopping.
vs-kalista-poise.text: Martial Poise depends on Kalista’s basic attacks: push her out of attack range and she cannot hop, or reduce her attack speed and she covers less distance in the same amount of time. Displacement and attack speed reduction can therefore shut down her mobility.
