vs-kalista-r.basis: If Kalista's Oathsworn support stays close beside her, prepare for them to be thrown with R. Prepare crowd control where Kalista's thrown Oathsworn is expected to land. Spread out in advance to prepare for Kalista's R.
vs-kalista-r.text: R Fate’s Call pulls in and throws Kalista’s Oathsworn support to start a fight. If the support stays close beside her, be ready for the throw: prepare crowd control at the expected landing spot or spread out in advance.

vs-kalista-rend.basis: If you're low on health with several spears stuck in you, you can be executed even while in lane. If spear stacks have built up, manage your health more cautiously than usual. If spear stacks have built up, leave lane until the spears disappear.
vs-kalista-rend.text: At low health, several spears stuck in you can leave you vulnerable to execution even while standing in lane. Once stacks build up, manage your health more cautiously or leave lane until the spears disappear.

vs-kalista-vision.basis: If Kalista loses vision of you, even an auto attack already in flight will miss. Move into brush or behind a wall to reduce the damage from Kalista's auto attacks.
vs-kalista-vision.text: If Kalista loses vision of you, even an auto attack already in flight will miss and fall to the ground. Entering brush or moving behind a wall can therefore reduce the damage you take from her auto attacks.

vs-kalista-windup.basis: Kalista cannot cancel her auto attack windup. Predict when Kalista will start an auto attack to hop, then use a skillshot.
vs-kalista-windup.text: Kalista cannot cancel her basic attack windup, and she must start that attack to hop. Watch for that moment to land a skillshot reliably: predict when the hop will begin instead of waiting to see it.

vs-karma-mantra-e.basis: Mantra E shields all nearby allies. Engage after Mantra E's shield expires.
vs-karma-mantra-e.text: Mantra E shields all nearby allies, making burst damage largely ineffective while the shields are active. Wait for them to expire before engaging.

vs-karma-mantra-q.basis: The burning zone left by Mantra Q detonates in place after a short delay. If Mantra Q hits you, immediately walk out of the zone.
vs-karma-mantra-q.text: The burning zone left by Mantra Q detonates in place after a short delay. If the initial blast hits you, immediately walk out of its circle to avoid the heavy follow-up damage.

vs-karma-mantra-w.basis: Mantra W roots only after the tether has been connected for a while. Karma restores missing health while Mantra W is connected. If Mantra W catches you, burst Karma down before the root takes hold. If Mantra W catches you, create distance to break the tether before the root takes hold.
vs-karma-mantra-w.text: Mantra W restores Karma’s missing health while its tether is connected, then roots you after a delay. If it catches you, burst Karma down or move far enough to break the tether before the root takes hold.

vs-karma-passive.basis: Karma reduces Mantra's cooldown each time she lands an ability. Move behind minions or out of range to avoid Karma's abilities.
vs-karma-passive.text: Every ability Karma lands reduces Mantra’s cooldown, so taking free poke helps recharge it. Move behind minions or out of range to make her abilities less likely to hit.

vs-karma-w-disengage.basis: Karma's W can catch an engaging champion and stop their advance. Keep your distance to draw out Karma's W, then engage.
vs-karma-w-disengage.text: Karma’s W, Focused Resolve, can stop an engage by catching the champion who goes in. Keep your distance and draw out W before engaging.

vs-karthus-early.basis: Before level 6, Karthus has no mobility ability or immobilizing effect. Disrupt Karthus's growth with jungle invades or early ganks. Karthus clears camps among the fastest, so he grows quickly if left undisturbed early.
vs-karthus-early.text: Before level 6, Karthus has no mobility ability or immobilizing effect. Disrupt his growth with jungle invades or early ganks; he clears camps among the fastest and can catch up quickly if left undisturbed.

vs-karthus-passive.basis: Karthus can use all his abilities without mana for a short time after dying. Immediately after killing Karthus, move away from his body to avoid Q and E in spirit form. Do not start healing or attacking an objective where you killed Karthus.
vs-karthus-passive.text: Karthus can use all his abilities without mana for a short time after dying. Move away from his body immediately after killing him to avoid Q and E in spirit form, and do not stop there to heal or attack an objective.

vs-karthus-q.basis: Karthus's Q deals much more damage when it hits only one enemy. Stand with minions or allies to avoid Q's single-target damage. Walk out of Q's warning area when it appears. When Karthus misses Q while farming, he loses that mana.
vs-karthus-q.text: Karthus’s Q deals much more damage when it hits only one enemy, so stand with minions or allies to reduce the damage and walk out of its warning area when it appears. If he misses Q while farming, he loses the mana spent on it.

vs-karthus-r.basis: Karthus's R damages all enemy champions regardless of distance. After a fight or when returning to lane, keep enough health to survive R. If you are unsure whether you can survive R, recall again.
vs-karthus-r.text: Karthus’s R damages every enemy champion regardless of distance. After a fight or when returning to lane, keep enough health to survive it; if you are unsure, recall again.

vs-karthus-teamfight.basis: Karthus keeps dealing damage in teamfights after dying. If you kill Karthus, reposition immediately. Clear the frontline before Karthus gets within E range.
vs-karthus-teamfight.text: Karthus keeps dealing damage in teamfights after dying, so reposition immediately if you kill him. Plan the fight around clearing the frontline before he gets within E range.

vs-karthus-w.basis: Passing through Karthus's W reduces your magic resistance and heavily slows you. After passing through W, you take more damage from Karthus's Q and R. When W is placed, change your escape route to go around it.
vs-karthus-w.text: Passing through Karthus’s W heavily slows you and reduces your magic resistance, making the following Q and R hurt more. When he places the wall, change your escape route to go around it.

vs-kassadin-e.basis: Each spell cast near Kassadin reduces E's cooldown. Avoid unnecessary spell casts near Kassadin so E does not come back sooner. Clear waves from outside Kassadin's range when possible.
vs-kassadin-e.text: Each spell cast near Kassadin reduces E, Force Pulse’s, cooldown, so casting freely in lane helps him get it back sooner. Avoid unnecessary spells near him, and clear waves from outside his range when possible.

vs-kassadin-early.basis: Before level 6, Kassadin has few ways to reach an enemy. Build a level and CS lead before Kassadin reaches level 6. Push the wave to keep Kassadin under his turret. Pressure Kassadin with your jungler early.
vs-kassadin-early.text: Before level 6, Kassadin is a melee mage with no way to close the gap. Win the lane during this window: push waves to keep him under his turret and pressure him with your jungler to build a level and CS lead. If you fail to do so, he becomes increasingly hard to handle as the game goes on.

vs-kassadin-late.basis: Late-game Kassadin attacks the backline with R, then uses R again to escape. Backline champions should build magic resistance against Kassadin. Backline champions should have instant immobilization to respond to Kassadin. Choose Banshee's Veil or Quicksilver Sash to neutralize the first step of Kassadin's entry combo. Do not stand alone within Kassadin's R range.
vs-kassadin-late.text: Late in the game, Kassadin uses R, Riftwalk, to reach and eliminate the backline, then casts it again to escape. Backline champions need magic resistance and an instantly available immobilizing ability; Banshee’s Veil or Quicksilver Sash is the most reliable way to neutralize the first step of his entry combo. Above all, do not stand alone within his R range.

vs-kassadin-passive.basis: Kassadin ignores unit collision, so a wall of minions cannot stop his chase. In a magic-damage-heavy composition, have an ally with immobilization and physical damage lock down Kassadin first.
vs-kassadin-passive.text: Kassadin takes less magic damage and ignores unit collision, so a wall of minions will not stop his chase and magic damage alone is unlikely to bring him down. If your team relies heavily on magic damage, have an ally with physical damage and an immobilizing ability lock him down first.

vs-kassadin-q.basis: Kassadin's Q interrupts channels. Kassadin's Q shield absorbs magic damage. Poke with magic damage while Kassadin's Q is on cooldown. Start channeling spells after confirming Kassadin has used Q.
vs-kassadin-q.text: Kassadin’s Q, Null Sphere, interrupts channels and grants a shield that absorbs magic damage. Use magic poke while Q is on cooldown so the shield cannot absorb it, and wait until he has used Q before starting a channeled ability.

vs-kassadin-r.basis: Kassadin's mana cost doubles as he uses R repeatedly. While chasing, watch Kassadin's mana to calculate how many R casts he has left. Counterattack when Kassadin runs out of mana and cannot use R.
vs-kassadin-r.text: Kassadin’s R, Riftwalk, costs twice as much mana with repeated casts. When chasing him, watch his mana bar and count how many more times he can use it. Once he runs out, he loses that mobility entirely; that is your moment to counterattack.

vs-kata-dagger.basis: Katarina relies on daggers on the ground to link her damage and movement. Stay away from daggers on the ground to limit Katarina's attack angles. In teamfights, have your whole team stay clear of dagger locations to discourage Katarina from engaging.
vs-kata-dagger.text: Katarina needs to pick up daggers for both damage and movement. Watch where they land and stand clear of those areas to take away her path in and her attack angles. In a teamfight, keeping your whole team away from dagger locations can effectively shut her out.

vs-kata-e-cd.basis: E has its full cooldown when used on a target other than a dagger. Punish Katarina during E's cooldown after she uses it on a target other than a dagger. Picking up a dagger after using E still reduces E's cooldown. Occupy or block the remaining dagger locations to prevent Katarina from reducing E's cooldown.
vs-kata-e-cd.text: When Katarina uses E on something other than a dagger, it goes on its full cooldown. That is your window to punish her, but picking up a dagger during it will still reduce the cooldown. Occupy or block the remaining dagger locations as you pressure her.

vs-kata-mr.basis: Katarina deals most of her damage as magic damage. Even if Katarina builds attack damage items, prioritize magic resistance because most of her damage is magic. R also includes physical damage, so magic resistance alone cannot negate all of its damage.
vs-kata-mr.text: Most of Katarina’s damage is magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance even if she builds attack damage items. R also includes physical damage, however, so magic resistance alone will not negate all of it.

vs-kata-q.basis: If Q hits you, its dagger lands behind you. After Q hits you, move toward Katarina to put distance between yourself and the dagger. After Q hits you, avoid retreating in a direction that puts you on the dagger.
vs-kata-q.text: If Q hits you, its dagger lands behind you. Move toward Katarina to put distance between yourself and the dagger and delay her next engage; retreating instead may put you directly on it.

vs-kata-r.basis: Keep an immobilizing crowd control skill available to interrupt R's rapid burst of damage. When Katarina starts casting R, interrupt it with crowd control to block most of its damage. When judging whether you can survive R with healing, account for its healing reduction.
vs-kata-r.text: Save an immobilizing crowd control skill for R, a channel that deals heavy damage quickly. Interrupting it after it starts can prevent most of that damage. Account for its healing reduction when judging whether healing will keep you alive through it.

vs-kata-reset.basis: When Katarina gets a kill, her skill cooldowns decrease and she can immediately engage again. Pull back or protect low-health allies to deny Katarina her first kill.
vs-kata-reset.text: A kill reduces Katarina’s skill cooldowns and lets her engage again immediately. Pull back or protect low-health allies to deny her the first kill and break the chain.

vs-kayle-dive.basis: Kayle is vulnerable to surprise attacks. Call your jungler repeatedly to attempt ganks and dives from outside Kayle's vision. Kayle uses W's movement speed boost to escape. Apply immobilizing crowd control before dealing damage so Kayle cannot escape with W.
vs-kayle-dive.text: Kayle has no dash or defensive skill, making her vulnerable to surprise ganks and dives from outside her vision. Call your jungler repeatedly, and land immobilizing crowd control before dealing damage so she cannot escape with W (Celestial Blessing)’s movement speed.

vs-kayle-early.basis: Kayle is very weak at levels 1–5, when she fights at melee range. Take lane control while Kayle is level 1–5. Keep denying Kayle CS and experience early. Kayle gains the advantage over time, so use the early game to build a lead.
vs-kayle-early.text: Kayle is at her weakest at levels 1–5, with melee range and the lowest magic resistance of any champion. Take control of the lane and keep denying her CS and experience to build an early lead. If you fail to open a gap then, time favors Kayle.

vs-kayle-late.basis: Avoid a direct teamfight against Kayle after level 16. Secure objectives and turrets and try to end the game before Kayle reaches level 16. Force fights with a numbers advantage on the side of the map away from Kayle.
vs-kayle-late.text: Kayle gains area fire waves at level 11 and permanent maximum range at level 16. Avoid direct teamfights against her after level 16: secure objectives and turrets to end the game before then, or force a fight with a numbers advantage on the side of the map away from her.

vs-kayle-level6.basis: Carry out plans to gain a laning advantage against Kayle before she reaches level 6. Once Kayle reaches level 6, reassess the melee trades you took before. After Kayle reaches level 6, engage with your jungler.
vs-kayle-level6.text: Gain your laning advantage before Kayle reaches level 6. She gains ranged basic attacks at that point, so the melee trades you could win earlier no longer work the same way; afterward, engage with your jungler.

vs-kayle-r.basis: Kayle's R blocks damage but still allows crowd control to affect its target. When Kayle uses R, use crowd control to hold the target in place and run out its duration instead of focusing damage. Resume attacking after Kayle's R damage immunity ends. Start a full fight after Kayle has already used R.
vs-kayle-r.text: Kayle’s R (Divine Judgment) blocks damage, but its target can still be affected by crowd control. When she casts it, hold the target in place instead of committing damage, then resume attacking after the immunity ends. Start a full fight once Kayle has already used R.

vs-kayle-teamfight.basis: Kayle stands at the back in teamfights and deals damage with basic attacks. Find a route to reach Kayle directly from the flank or outside her vision. Coordinate when allied crowd control will land before engaging to account for Kayle's R.
vs-kayle-teamfight.text: Kayle stays at the back in teamfights and deals damage with basic attacks, so find a route to reach her directly from a flank or outside her vision instead of spending time fighting through the frontline. Coordinate allied crowd control to land as you engage, accounting for the immunity she can gain from R (Divine Judgment).

vs-kayn-e.basis: Damaging Kayn while he uses E reduces its duration. Immobilizing Kayn while he uses E ends it immediately. Interrupt Kayn's E while he is inside the wall instead of waiting for him to come out.
vs-kayn-e.text: Damaging Kayn during E (Shadow Step) shortens its duration, while immobilizing him ends it immediately. Interrupt him inside the wall instead of waiting for him to emerge.

vs-kayn-early.basis: Kayn is noticeably weak in fights before transforming. Pressure Kayn's jungle route early to delay his transformation. Force early objective fights to delay Kayn's transformation. Don't give Kayn early kills that could speed up his transformation.
vs-kayn-early.text: Kayn is noticeably weak before transforming. Pressure his jungle route and force objective fights early to delay his transformation and power spike; giving him early kills brings that transformation forward.

vs-kayn-r-condition.basis: Kayn's R can only be cast on a target he has damaged first. Dodge W's straight-line hitbox to stop Kayn from enabling R at range.
vs-kayn-r-condition.text: Kayn can cast R (Umbral Trespass) only on a target he has damaged first. Dodge the straight-line hitbox of W (Blade's Reach) to keep him from enabling R at range.

vs-kayn-r-exit.basis: When Kayn uses R on an ally, prepare crowd control around the target. Apply crowd control the moment Kayn exits R.
vs-kayn-r-exit.text: An ally caught in Kayn’s R (Umbral Trespass) cannot help for its duration. Kayn exits near the target, so prepare crowd control there when he goes in and use it the moment he comes out.

vs-kayn-wall-warning.basis: If Kayn is inside nearby terrain, a warning indicator appears along its edge. When you see the warning indicator along a wall, stop trading damage and retreat toward your turret.
vs-kayn-wall-warning.text: When Kayn is inside nearby terrain, a warning indicator appears along that wall's edge. If you see it, he already has a gank angle, so stop trading damage and retreat toward your turret.

vs-kennen-cleanse.basis: Use a cleanse to remove the stun so you can avoid Kennen's follow-up damage. Physical damage dealers should consider Mercurial Scimitar to remove Kennen's stun. Ability power champions should consider Quicksilver Sash to remove Kennen's stun. If you cannot remove the stun, avoid standing together with allies in Kennen's entry path.
vs-kennen-cleanse.text: Kennen’s decisive damage follows his area stun, so use a cleanse to remove it if you have one. Physical damage dealers should consider Mercurial Scimitar, and ability power champions should consider Quicksilver Sash. If you cannot remove the stun, avoid standing together with allies in his entry path.

vs-kennen-e.basis: Kennen relies on E as his only escape. Counterattack when Kennen uses E to enter recklessly. Even if you take some poke, bait out Kennen's E before approaching.
vs-kennen-e.text: Kennen has some of the lowest health among champions, and E is his only escape. Counterattack when he uses it to enter recklessly: once E is down, he has no way out. Even if you take some poke, it is better to draw out E before approaching.

vs-kennen-marks.basis: Three stacks of Kennen's marks cause a stun. When you have two marks, move out of Kennen's range to prevent the third. Back off briefly and wait for the mark stacks to expire.
vs-kennen-marks.text: Three stacks of Kennen’s marks stun you. Once you have two, move out of his range or put minions between you to stop the third. The stacks expire over time, so backing off briefly resets them and denies his finishing blow.

vs-kennen-q.basis: Kennen's Q hits only the first target it strikes. Stand behind minions to block Kennen's Q poke. Move so you are exposed to Q only briefly when stepping up for a last hit.
vs-kennen-q.text: Kennen’s Q hits only the first target in its path. Standing behind minions blocks his lane poke and prevents the first mark that leads to a stun. Plan your movement so you are exposed only briefly when stepping up for a last hit.

vs-kennen-r.basis: Kennen gains resistances during R. Anticipate Kennen's entry angle and spread out so you do not get caught together in R's area stun. Keep vision on Kennen's likely entry points to stop him from starting a teamfight with R.
vs-kennen-r.text: R is most effective when Kennen enters the middle of your team, and its resistances help him survive briefly. Anticipate his entry angle and spread out to avoid a shared area stun. Keep vision on his likely entry points to deny him the chance to start a teamfight with R.

vs-khazix-e.basis: E’s Leap is Kha'Zix’s only mobility ability. Right after Kha'Zix engages with E is your chance to counterattack. Save crowd control and Flash for the moment Kha'Zix engages with E.
vs-khazix-e.text: E (Leap) is Kha'Zix's only mobility ability, so save crowd control and Flash for the moment after he uses it to engage—that is your chance to counterattack. If he has evolved E, though, its cooldown resets when he participates in a takedown; once an ally has been picked off, assume that counterattack window is gone.

vs-khazix-isolation.basis: Stay near allied champions or minions to reduce isolated Q damage. Spend less time moving alone through side lanes. Keep Kha'Zix from reading where you clear jungle camps alone.
vs-khazix-isolation.text: Kha’Zix’s damage can vary by nearly double depending on isolation, so stay near allied champions or minions to cut his Q damage to roughly half. Spend less time moving alone through side lanes, and keep him from predicting where you clear jungle camps alone.

vs-khazix-passive-vision.basis: When Kha'Zix is out of sight, his next basic attack deals bonus magic damage and slows. Keep vision in brushes to prevent Kha'Zix’s empowered basic attack and slow. Prioritize vision in brushes by the river and jungle entrances.
vs-khazix-passive-vision.text: When Kha’Zix is out of sight, his next basic attack deals bonus magic damage and slows. Maintain vision in brushes to deny that empowered attack and slow, prioritizing brushes by the river and jungle entrances.

vs-khazix-phase.basis: Pressure Kha'Zix before level 6, when he gets his first evolution. Pressure Kha'Zix’s jungle early or take objectives first to delay his evolution timing. Avoid acting alone from the mid game onward once Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions.
vs-khazix-phase.text: Before level 6 and his first evolution, Kha’Zix is an ordinary jungler. Pressure his jungle early or take objectives first to delay his evolution timing and gain the advantage; once he has two or more evolutions in the mid game, stop acting alone.

vs-khazix-r.basis: Control Wards do not reveal Kha'Zix during R’s invisibility. When Kha'Zix disappears, use area-of-effect abilities ahead of time on his expected approach path. When Kha'Zix disappears, stay close to allies and apply crowd control as soon as he appears. The brief moment when Kha'Zix becomes visible after stealth ends is a chance to counterattack.
vs-khazix-r.text: Control Wards do not reveal Kha’Zix during Void Assault (R). When he disappears, cast area-of-effect abilities along his expected approach path or stay close to allies and apply crowd control as soon as he appears. The brief moment when stealth ends and he becomes visible is your chance to counterattack.

vs-khazix-teamfight.basis: Group up and start teamfights in narrow areas where you have vision. Keep backline damage dealers beside tanks to prevent isolation. When contesting an objective, do not go out of vision one at a time.
vs-khazix-teamfight.text: Group up and start teamfights in narrow areas where you have vision. Keeping backline damage dealers beside tanks prevents isolation and denies Kha’Zix an opening to engage. When contesting an objective, avoid sending teammates out of vision one at a time.

vs-kindred-e.basis: Much of Kindred's damage comes from Wolf's pounce, which triggers after consecutive hits on a target marked by E. If E marks you, create distance or break line of sight to avoid triggering the pounce. The lower your health, the more dangerous E's Wolf's pounce is.
vs-kindred-e.text: Kindred's major burst comes from Wolf's pounce after consecutive hits on a target marked by E. If you are marked, create distance or break line of sight to prevent it from triggering. Its damage scales with your missing health, making it especially dangerous when you are already low.

vs-kindred-early.basis: Kindred is fragile and slow, making them vulnerable to early pressure. Ward Kindred's jungle and disrupt their route to slow their mark progress. When you encounter Kindred, close in before they place W.
vs-kindred-early.text: Kindred's fragility and low movement speed make them vulnerable to early pressure. Ward their jungle and repeatedly disrupt their route to force cautious farming and delay their marks. If you encounter Kindred, close in before they place W.

vs-kindred-mark.basis: Kindred's growth depends heavily on marks. When a jungle monster is marked, clear that camp first. Delaying Kindred's marks several times reduces their mid-to-late-game damage and range.
vs-kindred-mark.text: Kindred's growth depends on marks. When a jungle monster is marked, clear its camp first or ward nearby to keep Kindred from claiming it. Delaying several marks noticeably reduces Kindred's damage and range in the mid to late game.

vs-kindred-r-displace.basis: If you have a displacement ability, push or pull Kindred out of R's zone. If you have a displacement ability, push or pull the ally Kindred is trying to save out of R's zone. R's zone stays in place, so moving a target outside it removes the effect that prevents death.
vs-kindred-r-displace.text: If you have a displacement ability, push or pull Kindred—or the ally they are trying to save—out of R's zone. The zone stays in place, so leaving it removes the protection from death.

vs-kindred-r-inside.basis: When Kindred activates R, enter its zone. Inside R's zone, allies at near-zero health survive too. Allies inside R's zone are also healed when it ends.
vs-kindred-r-inside.text: When Kindred activates R (Lamb's Respite), move into its zone: no one can die inside it, so even allies at near-zero health survive and receive healing when it ends. Waiting outside only to get caught after the zone expires is the worst outcome.

vs-kindred-w.basis: Inside W's zone, Kindred has a shorter Q cooldown and can keep repositioning. Pushing Kindred out of W's zone removes Wolf's damage. Use a knockback or movement impairment to keep Kindred out of W's zone.
vs-kindred-w.text: Inside W's zone, Kindred can reposition repeatedly with Q's shorter cooldown while Wolf also deals damage. Push Kindred outside it to interrupt those Q rotations and remove Wolf's damage; a knockback or movement impairment can keep them there.

vs-kled-courage.basis: Check Kled's Courage bar when facing him dismounted. When Courage fills, Skaarl returns with restored health and Kled remounts. If you can reliably kill dismounted Kled, do it before he remounts. If you struggle to kill dismounted Kled, keep your distance so he can't build Courage.
vs-kled-courage.text: Watch Kled’s Courage bar when he is dismounted: once it fills, Skaarl returns with restored health and Kled remounts, effectively gaining a second health bar. If you can reliably kill him, do it before he remounts; otherwise, keep your distance so he cannot build Courage.

vs-kled-courage-source.basis: Kled also builds Courage by killing minions and attacking structures or epic monsters. After forcing Kled off Skaarl, push him out of lane to deny him farm.
vs-kled-courage-source.text: Kled gains Courage not only by hitting champions, but also by killing minions and attacking structures or epic monsters. If left alone in lane while dismounted, he can remount by farming minions and attacking the turret, so after knocking him off Skaarl, zone him out of lane and deny him farm to keep your advantage.

vs-kled-late.basis: After laning and the mid game, Kled becomes weaker because he deals less damage to champions while dismounted. Avoid giving Kled an early lead and extend the game.
vs-kled-late.text: Kled has very low health while dismounted and deals less damage to champions. He weakens sharply after the laning phase and mid game, so avoid giving him an early lead and extend the game.

vs-kled-q.basis: Even if Q catches you, Kled must stay close for a short time to trigger the pull. Right after Q catches you is your chance to escape before the pull. Save your mobility ability and Flash for right after Q catches you. If Q catches you and you have no way to escape, move toward your minion wave or allies.
vs-kled-q.text: Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) does not pull you immediately; Kled must stay close for a short time after it catches you. Save your mobility ability or Flash for that moment and escape before the pull. If you have no way out, move toward your minion wave or allies to make it harder for him to follow.

vs-kled-r.basis: Kled can engage with R from far away and out of vision. Keep vision on the flanks to spot Kled's R engage early. R charges only the first enemy champion along its path.
vs-kled-r.text: Kled can engage with R (Chaaaaaaaarge!!!) from far outside vision, so keep vision on the flanks to spot him early. If you cannot stop the engage, remember that Skaarl charges only the first enemy champion along the path. With a tank in front, the backline will not be hit directly; hold your formation.

vs-kled-w.basis: Kled is more dangerous when W is ready. W's fourth basic attack deals maximum-health damage, so it deals more damage the more health you have. When Kled activates W, back off before he lands all four basic attacks, then move in again.
vs-kled-w.text: Kled is much more dangerous when W (Violent Tendencies) is ready: its fourth landed basic attack deals damage based on your maximum health, making that hit especially costly for high-health champions. When he activates W, back off before he lands all four attacks, then move in again.

vs-kogmaw-late.basis: Kog'Maw is a hypercarry who grows stronger over time. Secure objectives and turrets in the early to mid game to end the game quickly. Keep pressuring Kog'Maw in lane to disrupt his farming.
vs-kogmaw-late.text: Kog’Maw is a hypercarry who grows stronger over time. Take objectives and turrets in the early to mid game to finish quickly, and keep pressuring him in lane to disrupt his farming.

vs-kogmaw-mobility.basis: Kog'Maw has no mobility ability and low movement speed, making him vulnerable to immobilizing crowd control. Prioritize Kog'Maw in jungle ganks and roams. If your team has an engage composition, target Kog'Maw first in teamfights.
vs-kogmaw-mobility.text: With low movement speed and no mobility ability, Kog’Maw can be caught by a single immobilizing crowd control effect. Make him your first target for jungle ganks and roams, and focus him first in teamfights if your team has an engage composition.

vs-kogmaw-passive.basis: Immediately after killing Kog'Maw, walk backward away from his body. Even after dying, Kog'Maw can follow you through units and deal damage that defensive stats cannot reduce.
vs-kogmaw-passive.text: Walk away from Kog’Maw’s body immediately after killing him. His delayed explosion deals true damage that defensive stats cannot reduce, and he can move through units to follow you even after death.

vs-kogmaw-q.basis: Getting hit by Q increases the damage from Kog'Maw's subsequent auto-attacks and his allies. Block Q's projectile with a minion or dodge it sideways. If Q hits you, stay away from Kog'Maw during the brief resistance reduction.
vs-kogmaw-q.text: Q reduces both armor and magic resistance, increasing the damage from Kog’Maw’s follow-up auto-attacks and his allies. Block its projectile with a minion or dodge sideways; if it hits, keep your distance until the brief resistance reduction ends.

vs-kogmaw-r.basis: R can come from off-screen and deals heavy damage to low-health targets. If your health is low, leave Kog'Maw's vision to heal. Getting hit by R reveals your position and exposes you to a follow-up gank.
vs-kogmaw-r.text: R can arrive from off-screen and deals sharply increased damage to low-health targets. If your health is low, leave Kog’Maw’s vision before healing; a hit also reveals your position and can set up a follow-up gank.

vs-kogmaw-w.basis: Kog'Maw's range increases only while W is active. Wait for W to expire, then close in on Kog'Maw. When Kog'Maw approaches with W active, wait out its duration.
vs-kogmaw-w.text: Kog’Maw’s extra range lasts only while W is active; without it, he has ordinary ranged attack range. Wait for W to expire before closing in, and if he approaches with it active, let its duration run out to win the trade.

vs-ksante-early.basis: K'Sante is weakest at levels 1–2, when he only has Q. Chip away at K'Sante's health during his weak levels 1–2. K'Sante's Q deals more damage as he builds defensive items. K'Sante's Q cooldown decreases as he builds defensive items.
vs-ksante-early.text: K'Sante is weakest at levels 1–2, when he has only Q, so chip away at his health then. If you do not, the lane becomes harder to turn around as defensive items increase Q's damage and shorten its cooldown.

vs-ksante-omnivamp.basis: In All Out, K'Sante heals from all damage he deals. If you expect a long close-range fight with K'Sante, make sure at least one teammate has a way to reduce healing. Do not let K'Sante keep attacking while surrounded by multiple allies in All Out.
vs-ksante-omnivamp.text: In All Out, K'Sante heals from all damage he deals. If you expect a prolonged close-range fight, make sure at least one teammate has healing reduction, and do not let him keep attacking while surrounded by multiple allies.

vs-ksante-q.basis: Once K'Sante has enough Q hit stacks, his next Q becomes a shockwave that pulls in and stuns enemies. If you have been hit by consecutive Qs, move out of range of the next Q or save a mobility ability to dodge it. K'Sante can also build Q stacks by hitting minions. Watch the Q stack indicator on K'Sante.
vs-ksante-q.text: After enough Q hits, K'Sante's next Q becomes a shockwave that pulls in and stuns enemies. If consecutive Qs have hit you, move out of the next one's range or keep a mobility ability ready to dodge it. He can also build stacks on minions, so watch the stack indicator on K'Sante.

vs-ksante-r-wall.basis: K'Sante's R hurts most when it hits you with your back to a wall. If K'Sante's R slams you into a wall, you're pushed through the terrain. If K'Sante's R slams you into a wall, you take an extra hit. When facing K'Sante, don't keep terrain behind you.
vs-ksante-r-wall.text: K'Sante's R hurts most when you have a wall behind you: hitting the wall pushes you through the terrain and deals an extra hit. When facing him, keep terrain away from your back to greatly reduce the value of his ultimate.

vs-ksante-r-window.basis: When K'Sante activates All Out, his maximum health and bonus armor and magic resistance drop significantly. Focus your damage on K'Sante the moment he activates All Out. K'Sante deals more damage in All Out. K'Sante gains more lifesteal in All Out. Do not face K'Sante alone in All Out.
vs-ksante-r-window.text: When K'Sante activates R All Out, his maximum health, bonus armor, and magic resistance drop sharply, leaving him vulnerable for a while. Focus your damage on him as soon as he activates it instead of retreating, but do not face him alone: his damage and lifesteal also increase in this form.

vs-ksante-w.basis: K'Sante is unstoppable while charging W. K'Sante takes reduced damage while charging W. When you see K'Sante charging W, hold off on using crowd control and focusing your damage. Watch the direction of W's dash and sidestep it. The longer K'Sante charges W, the longer the knockback and stun last.
vs-ksante-w.text: While charging W, K'Sante is unstoppable and takes reduced damage. When you see the charge, hold your crowd control and burst damage, watch the direction of his dash, and sidestep it. The longer he charges, the longer the knockback and stun last.

vs-leblanc-clone.basis: The clone created by P cannot deal damage. If a low-health LeBlanc splits into two, hold your abilities until you can tell which is real. When the clone appears, track the one that actually attacks.
vs-leblanc-clone.text: The clone created by P (Mirror Image) cannot deal damage. If a low-health LeBlanc suddenly splits into two, do not waste an ability on either one at random; follow the one that actually attacks.

vs-leblanc-e.basis: The E root activates after the chain remains attached, rather than on impact. If E hits you, move out of chain range before the root activates. Use Flash or a movement ability right after E hits you to avoid the root.
vs-leblanc-e.text: E (Ethereal Chains) roots only after the chain has remained attached, not on impact. If it hits you, get out of chain range before the root activates; use Flash or a movement ability immediately to escape it.

vs-leblanc-mark.basis: If the Q mark remains, the next ability hit deals double damage. If Q marks you, back away to give the mark time to disappear.
vs-leblanc-mark.text: If the Q (Sigil of Malice) mark remains on you, the next ability to hit you deals double damage. Back away instead of moving forward and give the mark time to disappear.

vs-leblanc-roam.basis: LeBlanc tries to roam after pushing the lane. If LeBlanc disappears from mid vision, alert your team immediately. In a side lane, secure vision of the river before moving forward.
vs-leblanc-roam.text: LeBlanc roams after pushing the lane. Alert your team immediately if she disappears from mid vision, and secure river vision before moving forward in a side lane.

vs-leblanc-w.basis: After LeBlanc dashes in with W, she can return to her original position only for a short time. Approach and fight after LeBlanc's W return expires or is used.
vs-leblanc-w.text: After LeBlanc dashes in with W (Distortion), she can return to her original position only for a short time. Instead of immediately counterattacking and letting her slip away, close in and fight after that return expires or has been used.

vs-leesin-early-duel.basis: Lee Sin is strong in early duels and falls off in the late game. If you encounter Lee Sin in the jungle early, avoid dueling him and retreat. Use objective and lane advantages to buy time until the late game, when Lee Sin falls off.
vs-leesin-early-duel.text: Lee Sin's level-one attack damage and armor are among the highest of all champions, so accepting an early duel puts you at a disadvantage. Retreat if you meet him in the jungle early, then use objective and lane advantages to buy time until his strength fades in the late game.

vs-leesin-q-block.basis: Most of Lee Sin's engages depend on landing Q's first cast. Lee Sin's first Q cast is a projectile blocked by minions and jungle monsters. If you expect a Lee Sin gank, keep the wave between you and him to block Q's straight path.
vs-leesin-q-block.text: Most of Lee Sin's engages start with Q's first cast, Sonic Wave, a projectile blocked by minions and jungle monsters. If you expect a gank, keep the wave between you and him to deny a straight shot; when Q misses, he has virtually no way to reach you.

vs-leesin-q2.basis: Lee Sin's second Q cast deals more damage the more health the target is missing. If Q's first cast hits you while you are below half health, move toward an allied turret or your team during the short window for Q's second cast.
vs-leesin-q2.text: Lee Sin's Q second cast, Resonating Strike, hurts more the more health you have lost. If its first cast has hit you and your health drops below half, treat your remaining health as much lower than it looks and move toward an allied turret or your team during the short recast window.

vs-leesin-r-position.basis: If Lee Sin has room to get behind you, watch for the risk of being kicked by R. Position with your back to a wall or your team's frontline so that even if R kicks you, you move toward your allies. If an ally knocked back by Lee Sin's R collides with you, you will also be knocked up. Spread out from your allies just before a teamfight so R cannot knock up multiple teammates together.
vs-leesin-r-position.text: Lee Sin's R, Dragon's Rage, is most threatening when he has room to get behind you. Stand with a wall or your frontline at your back so a kick sends you toward your team, and spread out before a teamfight: allies struck by the knocked-back target will also be knocked up.

vs-leesin-w-sustain.basis: Lee Sin heals during skirmishes through the omnivamp from W's second cast. Apply healing reduction if Lee Sin survives longer than expected in extended fights through W's omnivamp. Focus your damage on Lee Sin immediately after he uses W to engage.
vs-leesin-w-sustain.text: Lee Sin can recover health in skirmishes through the omnivamp from W's second cast, Iron Will. If he survives longer than expected in an extended fight, apply healing reduction. Focus your damage immediately after he uses W to engage, when he has neither its shield nor its omnivamp available.

vs-leesin-ward-jump.basis: Lee Sin can cross walls by using W on his own wards. Watch for Lee Sin engaging with a ward and W from beyond walls where you lack vision. Use Control Wards to clear wards beyond walls and prevent Lee Sin from engaging with a ward and W. Position one space away from the wall to prepare for Lee Sin's ward-W engage.
vs-leesin-ward-jump.text: Lee Sin can use W, Safeguard, on his own wards to cross walls. Treat an unwarded area beyond a wall as a possible engage route: clear his wards there with a Control Ward or stand a step away from the wall.

vs-leona-armor.basis: Avoid taking early trades against Leona with physical damage. Wear down Leona's health beforehand with magic damage or ranged poke. Counterattack after Leona's engage abilities are down.
vs-leona-armor.text: Leona has one of the highest level 1 armor values of any champion, so early physical damage trades against her are usually unfavorable. Wear her down with magic damage or ranged poke, then counterattack once her engage abilities are down.

vs-leona-e.basis: Leona's E passes through targets in a straight line and dashes to the last champion hit. The marksman and support should avoid lining up along E's path so Leona cannot reach the target behind them.
vs-leona-e.text: Leona's E Zenith Blade passes through targets in a straight line and dashes to the last champion it hits. In lane, the marksman and support should avoid standing in line with its path, or Leona can dash past the first target to reach the one behind.

vs-leona-passive.basis: An ally of Leona must attack to trigger a Sunlight mark. If you see a Sunlight mark on you, retreat immediately to prepare for the enemy's follow-up attack.
vs-leona-passive.text: An ally of Leona must hit you to trigger a P Sunlight mark. Treat the mark as a warning that enemy damage is coming: retreat immediately instead of moving forward.

vs-leona-q.basis: Leona can approach with Q already activated. Even if you do not see the Q animation, do not let Leona get close enough to reach you.
vs-leona-q.text: Leona can approach with Q Shield of Daybreak already activated. Even if she has not used a skill, do not assume you are safe; keep her out of range to reach you.

vs-leona-r.basis: Remember that Leona's R stuns only enemies in its center. Leona's R only slows enemies in its outer area. Move sideways as soon as R's indicator appears to dodge the stun at its center.
vs-leona-r.text: Leona's R Solar Flare stuns only enemies in its center; its outer area merely slows. Move sideways as soon as the indicator appears to avoid the stun.

vs-leona-w.basis: Use the time between Leona activating W and its explosion to create distance. Move out of W's area before it explodes to avoid its damage. If W's explosion hits no enemies, Leona's bonus defensive stats will not be extended.
vs-leona-w.text: Leona's W Eclipse takes time to explode after activation. Move out of its area before then to avoid the damage and prevent her bonus defensive stats from lasting longer; staying close lets her survive much longer.

vs-lillia-e.basis: Lillia's E rolls until it hits an enemy or a wall. In narrow corridors, it's nearly impossible to dodge E. If you don't know where Lillia is, don't walk straight through jungle entrances or river passages.
vs-lillia-e.text: Lillia's E Swirlseed rolls until it hits an enemy or a wall, making it nearly impossible to dodge in narrow corridors. If you do not know where she is, avoid walking straight through jungle entrances or river passages.

vs-lillia-r-condition.basis: Lillia's R puts only enemies marked with dream dust to sleep. Even at high health, dodge Q and E so Lillia cannot meet R's condition.
vs-lillia-r-condition.text: Lillia's R Lilting Lullaby puts only enemies marked with dream dust by her abilities to sleep. Her Q and E poke therefore sets up R, so dodge both even when you have plenty of health.

vs-lillia-r-drowsy.basis: Even if Lillia's R hits you, you won't fall asleep immediately. You can still move while drowsy. Move to safety while drowsy. Use a way to remove movement-impairing effects while drowsy. If you miss the drowsy window, you'll be stuck asleep.
vs-lillia-r-drowsy.text: Lillia's R does not put you to sleep immediately. You can still move while drowsy, so use that time to reach safety or remove the movement-impairing effect; miss that window and you will be stuck asleep.

vs-lillia-speed.basis: Lillia becomes hard to catch when ability hits build her movement speed stacks. You have a chance to chase Lillia when she has no movement speed stacks. Keep dodging Lillia's abilities, then close in.
vs-lillia-speed.text: Each ability hit gives Lillia a movement speed stack, and she becomes impossible to catch once they build up. With no stacks, her base movement speed is low; keep dodging her abilities, then close in to chase her.

vs-lillia-squishy.basis: Lillia needs to deal sustained damage at close range. In teamfights, save crowd control that prevents movement for Lillia when she comes in from the side.
vs-lillia-squishy.text: Lillia has very low armor and must get close to deal sustained damage. In teamfights, save an immobilizing crowd control ability for her: catching her once as she comes in from the side can bring her down quickly.

vs-lillia-w.basis: Lillia's W has a visible windup. W deals much more damage when its center hits. When you see W's windup, move slightly sideways to avoid the center. Keep a wall between you and Lillia so W cannot reach you.
vs-lillia-w.text: Lillia's W Watch Out! Eep! has a visible windup and deals much more damage only when its center hits. When the windup starts, a small step sideways is more likely to avoid the center than backing away. Lillia cannot cross terrain with W, so it cannot reach you through a wall.

vs-lissandra-e.basis: Lissandra throws E, then recasts it to teleport to the claw's position. Immobilize Lissandra while the claw is traveling to stop her E teleport.
vs-lissandra-e.text: Lissandra throws E and can recast it to teleport to the claw. Immobilize her while it is traveling, before she recasts, to stop the teleport.

vs-lissandra-mobility.basis: Lissandra has no escape besides E. Check whether Lissandra has used E before deciding to engage.
vs-lissandra-mobility.text: Lissandra has one of the lowest movement speeds and no escape besides E (Glacial Path). Once she has used it, she is simply a slow mage, so check whether E is spent before deciding to engage.

vs-lissandra-q.basis: Lissandra's Q must hit the first target to shatter and pierce through behind it. Farm from an angle that keeps you out of Q's path through your allied minions.
vs-lissandra-q.text: Lissandra’s Q must hit a first target to shatter and pierce through enemies behind it. If you stand in line with your allied minions, you are in its path; farm from an offset angle instead.

vs-lissandra-r.basis: Lissandra's R stuns when cast on an enemy and prevents damage during stasis when cast on herself. If Lissandra still has R, spread out your attacks so you can deal damage after her stasis ends.
vs-lissandra-r.text: Lissandra’s R stuns an enemy when cast on them and makes her invulnerable during stasis when cast on herself. If she still has R, a single burst can be wasted on that stasis, so space out your damage to hit her when it ends.

vs-lissandra-w.basis: Lissandra's W has a long cooldown at low levels. Move in and trade right after Lissandra uses W on the wave or misses it.
vs-lissandra-w.text: Lissandra’s W has a long cooldown at low levels. Move in and trade right after she uses it on the wave or misses.

vs-locke-e.basis: After Locke teleports with E, his next basic attack dashes to the target. Locke's dashing basic attack after E also hits enemies along its path. After Locke teleports with E, stand so your allies aren't lined up along his dash path.
vs-locke-e.text: Locke's E does not end with the teleport: his next basic attack dashes to its target and hits enemies along the path. Once he teleports, position yourself so your allies are not lined up along his dash path.

vs-locke-e-reset.basis: A takedown resets Locke's E cooldown, letting him dive in repeatedly. The moment just after an ally is picked off is the most dangerous time for Locke's repeated engages. As soon as the first ally dies, retreat and regroup.
vs-locke-e-reset.text: When Locke participates in a takedown, his E cooldown resets, allowing him to dive in again. The moment after an ally is picked off is especially dangerous, so retreat immediately and regroup as soon as the first ally dies.

vs-locke-q.basis: Locke's basic attacks deal rapidly increasing damage if you keep taking them while nails are stuck in you. If you're hit by nails, get out of Locke's basic attack range first.
vs-locke-q.text: Locke's basic attacks deal rapidly increasing damage if you keep taking them while nails are embedded in you. If you are hit by nails, prioritize getting out of his basic attack range over dodging further abilities.

vs-locke-r.basis: If your health falls below the threshold while marked by R, you are sealed. When you see an R mark, retreat with more health remaining than usual. The more relics Locke collects, the higher R's sealing threshold rises.
vs-locke-r.text: If your health falls below the threshold while marked by R, you are sealed. Retreat with more health remaining than usual when you see the mark, and account for the threshold rising as Locke collects relics.

vs-locke-w.basis: With W active, Locke gains a large attack speed and movement speed boost while draining his own health. When W ends, Locke recovers a substantial portion of the health he lost. If you can't finish Locke while W is active, retreat before his healing triggers.
vs-locke-w.text: With W active, Locke gains a large boost to attack speed and movement speed while draining his own health, then recovers a substantial portion of that lost health when it ends. If you cannot finish him during W, retreat before the healing triggers.

vs-lucian-e.basis: Lucian reduces E's cooldown with each double-shot basic attack. To catch Lucian, engage during the brief window right after he uses E.
vs-lucian-e.text: Each double-shot basic attack reduces the cooldown of Lucian’s E, Relentless Pursuit. The longer you let him trade basic attacks, the sooner E returns, so engage in the brief window right after he uses it to catch him.

vs-lucian-extended.basis: Weather Lucian's first combo, then extend the fight. Counterattack after Lucian has used all his abilities.
vs-lucian-extended.text: Lucian relies on burst damage rather than sustained damage. Weather his first combo and extend the fight; his damage drops sharply once his abilities are spent, giving you a window to counterattack.

vs-lucian-q.basis: Lucian's Q extends beyond its displayed range and pierces through targets. When Lucian farms with Q, move out of the line behind his target minion.
vs-lucian-q.text: Lucian’s Q (Piercing Light) extends beyond its displayed range and pierces through targets. When he uses it to farm, step out of the line behind his target minion to avoid the poke.

vs-lucian-r.basis: Lucian cannot change R's aim during the cast. When Lucian uses R, sidestep out of its firing path.
vs-lucian-r.text: Lucian cannot change the aim of R (The Culling) during its cast. Sidestep out of its firing path instead of running straight back.

vs-lucian-vigilance.basis: When the enemy support shields or heals Lucian, his next two shots are empowered. When an ally is immobilized, Lucian's next two shots are empowered. Avoid trading and back off while Lucian's next two shots are empowered.
vs-lucian-vigilance.text: When the enemy support shields or heals Lucian, or one of your allies is immobilized, Lucian’s next two shots are empowered. Back off briefly and avoid trading into those shots.

vs-lulu-commit.basis: Lulu responds well when enemies commit heavily all at once. Use steady poke instead of a single committed engage to push Lulu and her lane partner out of lane.
vs-lulu-commit.text: Lulu excels when enemies commit heavily all at once. Use steady poke to push her and her lane partner out of lane instead of forcing a committed engage.

vs-lulu-passive.basis: Other units in the path can take Pix's bolts instead and absorb the damage. Stand behind minions to reduce damage from Pix's bolts that accompany Lulu's basic attacks.
vs-lulu-passive.text: Other units can intercept Pix's bolts. Stand behind minions to avoid much of the extra damage that accompanies Lulu's basic attacks.

vs-lulu-r.basis: Lulu's R instantly increases the target's health. Lulu's R knocks up enemies around the target. When Lulu's R is available, target Lulu herself or someone else instead of the ally she would protect.
vs-lulu-r.text: Lulu's R (Wild Growth) instantly increases its target's health and knocks up nearby enemies. Someone who looks certain to die can survive with a single R, so while it is available, target Lulu herself or someone other than the ally she would protect.

vs-lulu-squishy.basis: Lulu has no dash to escape. Target Lulu herself while her shield and Pix are on her allied carry.
vs-lulu-squishy.text: Lulu has some of the lowest health, armor, and attack damage in the game, with no dash to escape. Look to catch her when her shield and Pix are on an allied carry.

vs-lulu-w.basis: An enemy affected by Lulu's W is silenced. An enemy affected by Lulu's W cannot attack. Before engaging with a dash, bait Lulu into using W on another ally.
vs-lulu-w.text: Lulu's W (Whimsy) silences its target and prevents them from attacking. A dash engage is shut down while W is available, so bait her into using it on another ally before going in.

vs-lux-e.basis: E hinders access to a specific area. Spread out and approach from different directions so E does not block you all.
vs-lux-e.text: Lux’s E, Lucent Singularity, controls an area. If you group up and approach from one spot, it can block you all at once, so spread out and approach from different directions to keep Lux from locking down a single area.

vs-lux-passive.basis: Getting hit by Lux's abilities applies an Illumination mark. Lux's auto-attacks consume Illumination marks to deal bonus damage. Move out of Lux's auto-attack range immediately after an ability hits you to avoid Illumination's bonus damage.
vs-lux-passive.text: Lux’s abilities apply Illumination, which her auto-attacks consume for bonus damage. Leaving her auto-attack range immediately after an ability hits you noticeably reduces the damage you take.

vs-lux-q.basis: Lux relies on Q's root to guarantee that her remaining abilities land. Treat the moment after Lux misses Q as an opportunity to engage while she is defenseless. Bait out Lux's Q, dodge it, then engage.
vs-lux-q.text: Lux relies on Q Light Binding: a hit guarantees her remaining abilities, while a miss leaves her defenseless. Bait out Q, dodge it, and then engage.

vs-lux-q-line.basis: Q roots the first two enemies it hits. Avoid lining up with allies and leave space to the side so Q does not root you together.
vs-lux-q-line.text: Q Light Binding roots the first two enemies it hits, so an ally standing in front will not block it for you. Avoid lining up with teammates; spread sideways instead.

vs-lux-r.basis: R displays a red targeting line before firing its main beam. When retreating at low health, avoid fleeing in a straight line to prepare for R. Prepare to dodge sideways as soon as R's red targeting line appears.
vs-lux-r.text: R Final Spark shows a red targeting line before the beam fires. When retreating at low health, avoid running in a straight line and be ready to dodge sideways as soon as the line appears.

vs-lux-squishy.basis: Lux has no mobility ability. Lux struggles to survive when an enemy manages to get close. Find an approach angle from a brush or the flank to get close to Lux.
vs-lux-squishy.text: Lux has some of the lowest armor and health in the game and no mobility ability. Getting into range is the hard part; once you reach her, you can take her out quickly, so focus on finding an approach through a brush or from the flank.

vs-malphite-e.basis: E's attack speed reduction lowers the damage output of basic attack-focused champions. As a basic attack-focused champion, stay behind your allies and maintain your range while keeping outside E's range. Move in and attack after Malphite uses E.
vs-malphite-e.text: E Ground Slam cuts the damage output of champions who rely on basic attacks by reducing their attack speed. If you play one of those champions, stay behind your allies and keep your distance outside E’s range when fighting Malphite, then move in and deal damage after he uses it.

vs-malphite-early.basis: Gain lane control before Malphite reaches level 6, while he has no R and is short on mana. Arrange a jungle gank before Malphite reaches level 6 to delay his scaling. Keep in mind that Malphite becomes harder to beat one-on-one once he has R and armor items.
vs-malphite-early.text: Take lane control and arrange a jungle gank before Malphite reaches level 6, while he has no R, little way to kill an opponent, and limited mana. Delaying his scaling during this window is most effective; once he has R and armor items, he becomes harder to beat one-on-one.

vs-malphite-grouping.basis: Malphite’s R knocks up multiple enemies around where his dash ends. Before a teamfight, spread out so Malphite’s R can hit only one person. The opposing team is weakest right after Malphite uses his R. Counterattack hard right after Malphite uses his R.
vs-malphite-grouping.text: Malphite’s R knocks up multiple enemies around the end of his dash. Spread out before a teamfight so even a well-placed R catches only one person, then counterattack hard immediately after he uses it, when his team is weakest.

vs-malphite-passive.basis: Break Malphite's Granite Shield before starting your combo. Prevent Granite Shield from regenerating with damage over time or frequent poke. Avoid starting a trade immediately after Q hits you, since it steals your movement speed.
vs-malphite-passive.text: Malphite can swing trades in his favor by keeping Granite Shield ready. Break it before starting your combo so you damage his health, then use damage over time or frequent poke to prevent it from regenerating and sharply reduce his lane sustain. If his Q hits you, it steals your movement speed, making it hard to engage or retreat, so avoid starting a trade immediately afterward. Q is targeted, so hiding behind minions will not stop it; avoid lingering within its range.

vs-malphite-r.basis: Malphite's R is an unstoppable dash that cannot be interrupted by crowd control. If you don’t know where Malphite is, avoid standing close to allies near lanes or objectives.
vs-malphite-r.text: Malphite’s R is an unstoppable dash that crowd control cannot interrupt, so avoid giving him an opening. It can come from an unwarded bush or behind a wall; while you do not know where he is, avoid standing close to allies near lanes or objectives.

vs-malzahar-e.basis: Don't stand near a minion affected by E. When Malzahar applies E to the wave, back off and wait for the minions to be cleared.
vs-malzahar-e.text: Don’t stand near a minion affected by E (Malefic Visions): when it dies, E moves to the nearest enemy, so trying to last hit beside the wave can leave you taking unwanted damage repeatedly. If Malzahar applies E to the wave, step back and wait for the minions to be cleared.

vs-malzahar-gank.basis: Call for a gank while Malzahar is pushing the lane. Before going in for a gank, remove Void Shift. In lane, look to kill Malzahar with your jungler.
vs-malzahar-gank.text: Malzahar pushes the lane quickly, but he has no mobility ability and a short range. Call for a gank while he is pushing; Void Shift is his only response, so going in after removing it makes the gank highly likely to succeed. It is much easier to kill him with your jungler than to try to beat him in lane.

vs-malzahar-q.basis: To dodge Q, move outside the line between the two portals. If you see Q being cast, delay your engage ability.
vs-malzahar-q.text: Q (Call of the Void) hits along the line segment between Malzahar’s two portals. Sidestepping can keep you inside that line, so move toward the outside of a portal to escape quickly. Since the silence prevents you from using your engage ability, delay its cast when you see Q being cast.

vs-malzahar-r.basis: Mobility abilities and shields cannot break R's suppression. Use Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to remove R's suppression. Without a cleanse item, an ally must immobilize Malzahar to interrupt R's cast. When Malzahar has R available, don't walk alone through areas without vision.
vs-malzahar-r.text: Mobility abilities and shields cannot break R’s suppression. Remove it with Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar; without either item, your only option is for an ally to immobilize Malzahar and interrupt his cast. When his R is available, don’t walk alone through areas without vision.

vs-malzahar-w.basis: Close in on Malzahar when the Voidlings have disappeared or have not been summoned yet. If Voidlings have already been summoned, clear them first with an area ability.
vs-malzahar-w.text: Malzahar is much more dangerous while his Voidlings are active. Close in when they have disappeared or have yet to be summoned; if they are already out, clear them with an area ability before engaging.

vs-maokai-cooldown.basis: Maokai's threat in fights comes from W and R. Right after making Maokai use W without effect, step forward and trade. If Maokai's W is ready, stay out of its range near brush.
vs-maokai-cooldown.text: Maokai's threat comes from W and R. Once you make him use W without effect, he has no way to close in or force a play in lane; step forward and trade immediately. When W is ready, stay out of its range near brush.

vs-maokai-passive.basis: The more abilities you hit Maokai with, the faster Sap Magic's heal cooldown decreases. Use poke abilities on the enemy carry instead of Maokai. Ignore Maokai or deal with him using basic attacks.
vs-maokai-passive.text: The more abilities you hit Maokai with, the sooner Sap Magic's heal comes back, so repeatedly poking him can help him heal more often. Use your abilities on the enemy carry instead; ignore Maokai or deal with him using basic attacks.

vs-maokai-sapling.basis: A sapling chases the first enemy that comes close and explodes after some time or when it hits another enemy. A sapling placed in brush explodes over a larger area. If a sapling is chasing you, lead it toward minions or monsters to make it explode, away from your team.
vs-maokai-sapling.text: A sapling chases the first enemy that comes close, then explodes after a few seconds or when it collides with another enemy. Saplings planted in brush have much larger explosions, so take care when entering brush. If one is chasing you, lead it away from your team toward minions or monsters to make it explode.

vs-maokai-ult.basis: The farther R's wall travels, the longer its root lasts. When you see R's wall, dodge perpendicular to its path. If you must cross R's wall, do it while it has traveled only a short distance. Fight Maokai's team in open areas with room to dodge.
vs-maokai-ult.text: The farther R's wall travels, the longer its root lasts, so taking a wall from long range head-on results in the longest root. When you see it, move perpendicular to its path or cross it while it has traveled only a short distance. Narrow passages leave no room to dodge, so fight Maokai's team in open terrain.

vs-maokai-w.basis: Maokai cannot be targeted while dashing with W. Use targeted abilities after Maokai finishes his W dash and lands. Trade after Maokai has used W.
vs-maokai-w.text: Maokai cannot be targeted while dashing with W, so targeted abilities and basic attacks used during the dash are wasted. Use those abilities after he lands, or wait until W is down to trade.

vs-masteryi-early.basis: Early on, Master Yi is weak in the jungle and has very little gank potential. Early on, you can meet Master Yi in his jungle and fight him. Secure early objectives quickly to slow Master Yi's growth. Master Yi grows stronger the longer the game lasts.
vs-masteryi-early.text: Early on, Master Yi is weak in the jungle and has very little gank potential, so you can fight him if you meet him in his jungle. Secure early objectives quickly to slow his growth, and press your early advantage rather than delaying it: he grows stronger as the game goes on.

vs-masteryi-q.basis: Master Yi cannot be targeted while casting Q. Use targeted crowd control or a finishing blow right after Q ends and Master Yi lands.
vs-masteryi-q.text: Master Yi cannot be targeted during Q (Alpha Strike), so targeted crowd control or a finishing blow used then is wasted. Wait until Q ends and he lands before using it; reflexively pressing an ability as soon as he engages is the biggest mistake.

vs-masteryi-r.basis: Slows do not work on Master Yi while R is active. If Master Yi gets no takedown, R's duration is not extended and it ends.
vs-masteryi-r.text: Slows do not affect Master Yi during R (Highlander), making kiting to create distance with slows useless while it lasts. Stop him with immobilizing crowd control or a movement ability, or escape around terrain. Only a takedown extends R, so it expires on its own if nobody dies.

vs-masteryi-reset.basis: A takedown greatly reduces Master Yi's basic ability cooldowns, letting him reach the next target. Do not let Master Yi catch an ally alone in a teamfight. Stay grouped and layer crowd control to catch Master Yi on his first engage.
vs-masteryi-reset.text: A takedown greatly reduces Master Yi’s basic ability cooldowns, letting him reach the next target immediately. Above all, avoid leaving an ally isolated in a teamfight. Stay grouped and layer crowd control to catch him on his first engage.

vs-masteryi-truedamage.basis: Master Yi's basic attacks deal some true damage while E is active. To counter E's true damage, build health and bring crowd control and ways to keep him from closing in.
vs-masteryi-truedamage.text: Master Yi’s basic attacks deal some true damage while E (Wuju Style) is active, making armor alone less effective than you might expect. Build health alongside crowd control and ways to keep him from closing in.

vs-masteryi-w.basis: Immobilizing crowd control can interrupt W Meditate. When Master Yi activates W, interrupt it with a stun, root, or knockup. Save one of your team's crowd control abilities to interrupt Master Yi's W.
vs-masteryi-w.text: W (Meditate) is a channel that immobilizing crowd control can interrupt. Save one of your team’s crowd control abilities for the moment Master Yi activates it: a stun, root, or knockup will stop both its healing and damage reduction.

vs-mel-e.basis: Mel's E roots at the center of its orb and only slows at the edges. When Mel's E comes toward you, sidestep its center. Save a movement ability or cleanse for the Q barrage after Mel's E root.
vs-mel-e.text: Mel's E roots at the center of its orb but only slows at the edges, so sidestep the center instead of moving straight back. A root sets up an immediate Q barrage; save a movement ability or cleanse for that moment.

vs-mel-early.basis: Mel has no movement ability. If you are melee or have a dash, close the distance to Mel during lane. Pressure Mel before she completes her core items to delay her build.
vs-mel-early.text: Mel has armor among the lowest and no movement ability, so a melee champion or one with a dash can gain an advantage by closing the distance in lane. Her win rate is low before she completes her core items; pressure her early to delay that point.

vs-mel-passive.basis: Each hit from Mel adds Overwhelm stacks. If the stored damage exceeds your remaining health plus shields, her next attack executes you. If you have taken several hits from Mel's harass, back off based on how many times she has hit you, rather than your current health.
vs-mel-passive.text: Every hit from Mel adds Overwhelm stacks. If their stored damage exceeds your remaining health plus shields, her next attack executes you, so having more than half your health is no guarantee of safety after repeated hits. If you have taken several hits of harass, back off based on how many times she has hit you rather than the number on your health bar.

vs-mel-r.basis: Mel's R has no range limit and can hit enemies with Overwhelm from far away. Even after leaving a fight, wait somewhere safe until your Overwhelm stacks expire.
vs-mel-r.text: Mel's R has no range limit: if Overwhelm stacks remain on you, she can finish you from across the map. After leaving a fight, wait somewhere safe until the stacks expire, and avoid walking near an objective while low on health.

vs-mel-w-reflect.basis: Mel's W reflects projectiles for a brief moment. If Mel looks ready to use W, bait it out with a low-value ability or auto before using your main skillshot. If you have a dash, targeted ability, or an area effect already on the ground, use it against Mel's W first.
vs-mel-w-reflect.text: Mel's W reflects projectiles for a brief moment. If she looks ready to use it, bait it out with a low-value ability or auto before casting your main skillshot, or it may be reflected back at you. Dashes, targeted abilities, and area effects already on the ground cannot be reflected, so use those first if you have them.

vs-milio-early.basis: Milio's team composition gets stronger over time. During the early laning phase, wear down Milio's mana through poke and take control of the wave. When Milio's healing starts to become a problem, get healing reduction earlier.
vs-milio-early.text: Milio’s composition grows stronger over time. During the early laning phase, the most reliable response is to drain his mana through poke and take control of the wave. If his healing starts to become a problem, get healing reduction sooner.

vs-milio-q.basis: Q knocks back the first enemy it hits and is Milio's only escape tool. Check whether Milio's Q is down before deciding to engage.
vs-milio-q.text: Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy it hits and is Milio’s only escape tool. Once he has used it, you can close in on him, so check whether Q is down before deciding to engage.

vs-milio-r.basis: Milio's R cleanses immobilizing effects but cannot cleanse knockups. When engaging with a knockup, you can still look for an opening even if Milio has R available.
vs-milio-r.text: R, Breath of Life, cleanses immobilizing effects but cannot remove airborne effects. If your composition has airborne crowd control, you can still find an opening to engage even while Milio has R available.

vs-milio-w.basis: W increases the attack range of Milio's allies. When the enemy marksman's range increases, delay the frontline fight until W ends.
vs-milio-w.text: W, Cozy Campfire, increases allies’ attack range. If the enemy marksman suddenly starts attacking from farther away, W is active; delay the frontline fight and let its duration run out.

vs-missfortune-e.basis: Avoid starting a fight where E has been placed. E's slow delays both engaging and disengaging. If R overlaps E, you risk taking heavy damage. When E is placed, delay your engage. Lure the enemy out of E's area.
vs-missfortune-e.text: Avoid starting a fight inside E Make It Rain. Its slow delays both engaging and disengaging, and R Bullet Time layered over it can deal heavy damage. When E is placed, delay your engage and lure the enemy out of its area.

vs-missfortune-mobility.basis: Miss Fortune has no mobility ability. If your champion has an engage ability, get onto Miss Fortune after level 6 and try to kill her. If you cannot get onto her, use vision to deny Miss Fortune an angle to attack instead of fighting over range.
vs-missfortune-mobility.text: Miss Fortune has no mobility ability, and her base movement speed is among the lowest of all champions. If your champion has an engage ability, get onto her after level 6 and try to kill her; if you cannot reach her, use vision to deny her an attack angle instead of fighting over range.

vs-missfortune-q.basis: Q hits the front target, then bounces to a target behind it. Standing directly behind a lane minion exposes you to Q's bounce. To avoid Q harass, stand to the side so you are not in line with a minion.
vs-missfortune-q.text: Q Double Up hits a front target, then bounces to one behind it, so standing directly behind a lane minion exposes you to free harass. Stand to the side, out of line with the minion, to avoid the bounce.

vs-missfortune-r.basis: R is a channeled ability, so if crowd control interrupts it, all remaining waves are lost. If you have no crowd control, use a wall or brush to block vision. R's cone direction is fixed when you cast it. To dodge R, move out through the side of the cone rather than retreating straight back.
vs-missfortune-r.text: R Bullet Time is channeled, and a single crowd control effect can interrupt it and cancel all remaining waves. If you have no crowd control, use a wall or brush to break vision or move out through the side of the cone. Its direction locks when cast, making a sideways escape better than retreating straight back.

vs-missfortune-w.basis: When Miss Fortune takes damage, W's movement speed bonus resets. Damage a fleeing Miss Fortune to remove W's movement speed bonus. Save damage-over-time or long-range abilities to use when chasing Miss Fortune.
vs-missfortune-w.text: Taking damage resets Miss Fortune’s W Strut movement speed bonus, so a single hit can slow her enough to catch her as she flees. Save damage-over-time or long-range abilities for the chase.

vs-mordekaiser-e.basis: E pulls all enemies within its area at once. In narrow passages or tight formations, multiple players can be pulled by E and hit by both Q and the passive aura. Spread out from your allies when standing in front of Mordekaiser.
vs-mordekaiser-e.text: E Death's Grasp pulls every enemy in its area at once. Standing in a narrow passage or clustered with allies in front of Mordekaiser lets him pull several of you into both Q and his passive aura, so spread out.

vs-mordekaiser-mobility.basis: Mordekaiser has low mobility because he has no mobility ability. Use slows and maintain distance to fight outside Mordekaiser's E range. Once Mordekaiser backs off, he struggles to close the distance again. Prioritize a position where Mordekaiser cannot catch you over dealing more damage.
vs-mordekaiser-mobility.text: Mordekaiser has no mobility ability and struggles to close gaps. Slows and good spacing let you fight outside E range, and if you force him to back off, he cannot easily get close again. Prioritize staying where he cannot catch you over dealing more damage.

vs-mordekaiser-passive.basis: Mordekaiser's passive aura activates after landing three abilities or basic attacks. Keep trades short, exchanging only one or two hits before backing off to prevent the passive aura from activating. Once the passive aura activates, limit the time you spend fighting up close.
vs-mordekaiser-passive.text: Mordekaiser's passive aura requires three ability or basic attack hits to activate. Trade only one or two hits before backing off to avoid both its sustained damage and movement speed boost; once it activates, every moment spent close to him works against you.

vs-mordekaiser-r.basis: If you are caught in R, your allies cannot help you for its duration. R steals some of your stats, so you can lose a duel you would win outside it. Do not enter Mordekaiser's ultimate range alone while his R is available.
vs-mordekaiser-r.text: If Mordekaiser catches you in R Realm of Death, your allies cannot help for its duration. He also steals some of your stats, so you may lose a duel you would win outside it. Do not enter his R range alone while it is available.

vs-mordekaiser-w.basis: The more damage Mordekaiser deals and takes, the larger the shield he gains from W. Mordekaiser can convert his remaining W shield into healing. Focus your damage after his W shield wears down or is converted into healing.
vs-mordekaiser-w.text: The more damage Mordekaiser deals and takes, the larger his W Indestructible shield becomes, and he can convert the remaining shield into health. Pouring damage into him immediately after he activates it can leave him with more shield to turn into healing, so focus your damage after the shield wears down or he converts it.

vs-morgana-e.basis: Don't waste crowd control on a target while E is active. Track E's cooldown and engage while it's unavailable.
vs-morgana-e.text: Don’t waste crowd control on a target protected by Morgana’s E Black Shield. Track its cooldown and engage while it’s unavailable; that’s the most reliable way to break through a Morgana composition.

vs-morgana-phase.basis: Morgana relies on landing Q to threaten opponents in lane. Getting hit by Q leaves you exposed to W and a follow-up combo. In lane, prioritize positioning to dodge Q over calculating damage.
vs-morgana-phase.text: Morgana poses little threat unless Q (Dark Binding) lands, but one hit sets up W (Tormented Shadow) and the rest of her combo. In lane, prioritize positioning to dodge Q over calculating damage.

vs-morgana-q.basis: Morgana's Q roots only the first target it hits. Keep a minion between you and Morgana to block Q.
vs-morgana-q.text: Morgana’s Q Dark Binding roots only the first target it hits, so keep the minion wave between you and her; moving along a line that overlaps the wave will block it most of the time.

vs-morgana-r.basis: R's stun triggers after a delay, not as soon as the chains connect. When you see R's chains, use a movement ability to leave its range before the stun triggers. If you can't leave R's range, kill Morgana before the stun triggers.
vs-morgana-r.text: R (Soul Shackles) stuns after a delay, rather than when the chains first connect. If you see the chains, use a movement ability or Cleanse to get out of range before the stun. If you cannot escape, kill Morgana first to prevent it from triggering.

vs-morgana-w.basis: Morgana's W deals more damage to targets with more missing health. When retreating on low health, don't cross Morgana's W.
vs-morgana-w.text: Morgana’s W Tormented Shadow hurts much more when you’re missing a lot of health. If you’re low, getting caught in it can kill you on its own, so avoid crossing an area she has placed while retreating.

vs-naafiri-late.basis: In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area damage hurts the pack and reduces Naafiri's damage. In the late game, fight together to deny Naafiri an opening to reach the backline. Keep broad vision during Naafiri's mid-game roaming phase.
