vs-naafiri-late.text: In late-game front-to-back teamfights, area damage can wipe out Naafiri’s pack and reduce her damage. Stay together rather than getting picked off alone to deny her a route to your backline, and maintain broad vision during her more dangerous mid-game roaming phase.

vs-naafiri-pack.basis: Removing the pack greatly reduces Naafiri's damage. Clear the pack first with area damage. Naafiri can fully restore the pack's health with E. Counterattack right after Naafiri uses E. Save area damage while the pack is recalled.
vs-naafiri-pack.text: Clearing the pack sharply reduces Naafiri’s damage, so use area damage to remove it first. Because E can fully restore the pack’s health, counterattack right after Naafiri uses E, and save your area damage while the pack is recalled.

vs-naafiri-q.basis: If the second Q hits while the first Q's bleed is active, the damage rises sharply. If the first Q hits you, keep your distance until the bleed ends. If you get close to Naafiri while bleeding, you will take the second Q and the pack's attacks together.
vs-naafiri-q.text: The second Q deals sharply increased damage if it hits while the first Q’s bleed is active. If the first hits you, keep your distance until the bleed ends; closing in while bleeding lets Naafiri land the second Q and the pack’s attacks together.

vs-naafiri-r.basis: R is a targeted dash to a champion, so you cannot dodge it. Do not go alone when Naafiri has R available. Immediately back away after an ally dies so Naafiri cannot take you out next with her second R.
vs-naafiri-r.text: R is a targeted dash to a champion and cannot be dodged, so do not travel alone while Naafiri has it available. If an ally has just died, retreat immediately: Naafiri may have a second R and can take you out next.

vs-naafiri-range.basis: As a melee champion, Naafiri is outranged by ranged champions. Harass Naafiri and farm from behind minions. Do not give Naafiri an opening to close in with E. The pack clears waves, making it hard to fully freeze the lane against Naafiri.
vs-naafiri-range.text: Ranged champions outrange Naafiri, who must fight in melee. Harass and farm from behind your minions while denying her an opening to close in with E, and you can maintain an advantage throughout lane. Her pack helps clear waves, though, so fully freezing the lane against her is difficult.

vs-naafiri-w.basis: Naafiri is untargetable for a short time while W is active. Use targeted crowd control or finishing abilities after W ends.
vs-naafiri-w.text: Naafiri is untargetable for a short time while W is active, so wait until it ends before using targeted crowd control or a finishing ability; using either during W wastes it.

vs-nami-e.basis: Do not fight an enemy affected by E head-on. Back off until E's short duration ends, then fight again. If an attack empowered by E slows you, you may be caught while escaping.
vs-nami-e.text: Do not fight an enemy affected by E head-on. Its duration is short, so back off, let it expire, then fight again; trying to escape while its slow is active can get you caught.

vs-nami-heal.basis: Nami relies on W's healing for lane sustain, making her vulnerable to healing reduction. Apply healing reduction with Executioner's Calling or Morellonomicon to weaken her W sustain.
vs-nami-heal.text: Nami relies entirely on W's healing for lane sustain. Apply healing reduction with Executioner's Calling or Morellonomicon to undermine her ability to hold the lane.

vs-nami-q.basis: Q falls slowly. Q has a long cooldown. When you see Q's warning indicator, walk sideways to dodge it. Target Nami and the enemy ADC right after she misses Q.
vs-nami-q.text: Q falls slowly and has a long cooldown. When its warning indicator appears, a step sideways can dodge it; immediately after it misses is the best time to target Nami and her ADC.

vs-nami-r.basis: R has very long range. R travels slowly. When you see R, move sideways to dodge it. Save your mobility ability to dodge the Q that follows R. If R hits you, you are at high risk of being hit by the follow-up combo.
vs-nami-r.text: R has very long range but travels slowly, so move sideways as soon as you see it and save your mobility ability for the Q that follows. The danger of getting hit by R is being caught by the rest of the combo, not R's damage itself.

vs-nami-squishy.basis: Nami has no mobility ability. Secure vision to find an angle to target Nami. In lane, prioritize targeting Nami over the enemy ADC.
vs-nami-squishy.text: Nami has some of the lowest health among all champions and no mobility ability. Secure vision and find an angle onto her to disrupt the lane; targeting Nami is better than targeting her ADC.

vs-nasus-early-allin.basis: Attempt an all-in at levels 2–3, when Nasus is weaker than most bruisers. Go beyond poking and bring Nasus down to half health with your first all-in. Once your cooldowns are back after the first all-in, go all-in again and aim for the kill. Take Ignite for the level 2–3 all-in strategy. Avoid picking champions with weak early games that struggle to exploit Nasus's early weakness.
vs-nasus-early-allin.text: Go all-in at levels 2–3, when Nasus is weaker than most bruisers. Poking alone is insufficient: bring him to half health with the first all-in, then go in again for the kill when your cooldowns return. Ignite suits this strategy. Champions with weak early games cannot create this opening, so avoid picking them into Nasus.

vs-nasus-kite.basis: Nasus is vulnerable to kiting. Even at full health, keep your distance and attack instead of fighting Nasus head-on. Nasus relies on W to close in on enemies who keep their distance.
vs-nasus-kite.text: Nasus is vulnerable to kiting. Even at full health, keep your distance and attack instead of taking him head-on; with only W Wither to close the gap, he will lose most opportunities to engage.

vs-nasus-r.basis: Nasus gains health and defensive stats while R is active. Nasus is stronger than most champions while R is active. Unless you have a clear advantage in numbers or damage, delay the fight until Nasus's R ends.
vs-nasus-r.text: While R Fury of the Sands is active, Nasus gains health and defensive stats and becomes stronger than most champions. Unless you have a clear advantage in numbers or damage, avoid starting a fight until R ends.

vs-nasus-w.basis: With more ranks, W cripples champions who rely on basic attacks by reducing their movement speed and attack speed. Avoid moving alone within Nasus's range so you do not get caught by W on your own.
vs-nasus-w.text: With more ranks, W Wither reduces both movement and attack speed enough to largely shut down champions who rely on basic attacks. Getting caught alone leaves you unable to escape, so avoid moving alone within Nasus’s range.

vs-nasus-wave.basis: Do not push the wave toward Nasus. Nasus can easily build stacks by last-hitting with Q under his own turret. Let the wave push toward your side and ask for a jungle gank. Nasus relies on Flash to escape. Even one successful gank against Nasus can turn the entire laning phase around.
vs-nasus-wave.text: Do not push the wave toward Nasus: under his turret, he can build Q Siphoning Strike stacks most easily. Let the wave push toward your side and call for a jungle gank. With no escape besides Flash, even one successful gank can turn the entire laning phase around.

vs-nautilus-e.basis: If Nautilus uses E right next to you, stay in place until its waves end. If you run away before E's waves end, you will enter later explosions and take extra damage and a slow.
vs-nautilus-e.text: If Nautilus uses E right next to you, stay in place until all its waves have ended. Running too soon takes you into later explosions, dealing extra damage and slowing you.

vs-nautilus-mobility.basis: Apart from using Q on terrain, Nautilus has no way to move quickly. Save your own engage ability to create distance after Nautilus uses Q.
vs-nautilus-mobility.text: Nautilus is among the slowest champions and has no mobility apart from using Q on terrain. Save your engage ability to create distance after he uses Q; once it is spent, he cannot easily catch up.

vs-nautilus-passive.basis: Nautilus's first auto attack roots its target. After a trade, immediately leave Nautilus's auto attack range so you do not get rooted and hit by follow-up abilities.
vs-nautilus-passive.text: Nautilus’s first auto attack roots its target. After a trade, leave his auto attack range promptly: even one hit can hold you in place for his follow-up abilities.

vs-nautilus-q.basis: Nautilus relies on Q for direct engages and most kill opportunities. Keep minions between you and Nautilus to block Q. If Nautilus misses Q, trade safely while it is on its long cooldown.
vs-nautilus-q.text: Q (Dredge Line) is Nautilus’s only direct engage tool and creates most of his kill opportunities. Keep minions between you and him to block it; if he misses, trade safely during its long cooldown.

vs-nautilus-r.basis: R follows its targeted enemy, so it cannot be dodged. R also knocks up allies standing along its path. While Nautilus has R available, avoid standing in line with allies along his engage path.
vs-nautilus-r.text: R (Depth Charge) follows its targeted enemy, so it cannot be dodged, and also knocks up allies standing along its path. While Nautilus has R available, avoid lining up with allies along his engage path.

vs-nautilus-w.basis: With W active, Nautilus deals area damage around his auto attack target. If you have time, stay close to Nautilus and break his W shield before continuing the fight.
vs-nautilus-w.text: With W active, Nautilus’s auto attacks deal area damage around their target. If you have time, stay close enough to break his W shield before continuing the fight.

vs-neeko-clone.basis: Shapesplitter's clone is easy to identify. Shapesplitter's clone doesn't attack. If you turn to chase the clone, the real Neeko can find an angle in the meantime. If you think it's a clone, ignore it. If you think it's a clone, keep your eyes on your original target.
vs-neeko-clone.text: Shapesplitter’s clone is easy to identify because it never attacks. Chasing it gives the real Neeko time to find an angle, so if you judge it to be the clone, ignore it and keep watching your original target.

vs-neeko-disguise.basis: If you encounter an enemy champion somewhere unexpected, check whether they were already seen elsewhere. Check whether a suspicious enemy champion has a reason to be there. If Neeko disappears from vision and a lone enemy champion approaches, watch for a disguised engage.
vs-neeko-disguise.text: An enemy champion appearing somewhere unexpected may be Neeko. Check whether that champion was already visible elsewhere and whether they have a reason to be there; a lone enemy approaching after Neeko disappears from vision is a common sign of a disguised engage.

vs-neeko-e.basis: If E hits something first, it grows larger and faster, making it easier to hit someone standing behind it. Spread out from your allies so E cannot root several of you together.
vs-neeko-e.text: E is most powerful when it roots several people at once. It grows larger and faster after its first hit, making someone behind the first target easier to catch, so spread out from your allies and limit each cast to one target.

vs-neeko-early.basis: Before level 6, Neeko has no way to turn a fight around. If you play a melee champion who dives in, close the gap and force a trade right after Neeko uses E.
vs-neeko-early.text: Neeko’s armor is among the lowest, and before level 6 she has no way to turn a fight around. If you play a melee champion who dives in, close the gap and force a trade immediately after she uses E.

vs-neeko-r.basis: R only goes off after Neeko enters herself and finishes its preparation animation. Use a sturdy frontline and reliable crowd control held in reserve to stop Neeko's engage. If you see R's preparation animation, move out of the area. A disguised Neeko's R preparation animation is hidden, so spread out as soon as a suspicious opponent gets close.
vs-neeko-r.text: R only goes off after Neeko walks in and completes its preparation animation. A sturdy frontline with reliable crowd control held in reserve can stop her from entering, and moving out of the area when you see the animation can avoid it. Because the preparation is hidden while she is disguised, spread out early when a suspicious opponent gets close.

vs-nidalee-hunt.basis: Only Javelin Toss and Bushwhack apply the Hunted mark. Dodge Javelin Toss and Bushwhack to prevent her cougar abilities from being empowered. If you dodge both Javelin Toss and Bushwhack, you won't be marked for true sight by Hunted.
vs-nidalee-hunt.text: Only Javelin Toss and Bushwhack apply Hunted. Dodge both to prevent her cougar abilities from being empowered and avoid the true sight that makes her pursuit easier.

vs-nidalee-nocc.basis: Nidalee has no crowd control. When Nidalee is caught, Pounce is her only escape tool. Catch Nidalee by applying an immobilizing effect. Remember where Nidalee came out to throw a spear and look for an angle to attack her.
vs-nidalee-nocc.text: Nidalee has no crowd control and is fragile; once caught, Pounce is her only escape. Immobilize her to secure the catch, and remember where she emerged to throw a spear so you can find an angle to attack.

vs-nidalee-pounce.basis: If Nidalee uses Pounce to engage after marking you, Takedown follows. Use crowd control or defensive abilities the moment Nidalee closes in with Pounce. Right after a spear hits you, have a defensive ability ready for Nidalee's engage.
vs-nidalee-pounce.text: Once Nidalee has marked you, Takedown follows when she closes in with Pounce. Save crowd control or defensive abilities for that moment, and have a defensive ability ready as soon as a spear hits you.

vs-nidalee-spear.basis: Javelin Toss deals more damage when thrown from farther away. Dodge spears Nidalee throws from a distance. Keep minions or your allied frontline between you and Nidalee to block Javelin Toss.
vs-nidalee-spear.text: Javelin Toss hurts more when it travels farther, so be especially careful to dodge spears thrown from long range. Keep minions or your allied frontline between you and Nidalee to block them.

vs-nidalee-trap.basis: Move through jungle entrances and the river assuming Nidalee has placed Bushwhack traps there. Before entering, clear Bushwhack traps with a Control Ward or an area-of-effect ability.
vs-nidalee-trap.text: Assume Nidalee has placed Bushwhack traps at jungle entrances and along the river. Clear them with a Control Ward or an area-of-effect ability before entering so you do not start a fight marked by Hunted.

vs-nilah-cc.basis: Nilah has low health and is highly vulnerable to immobilizing crowd control. Nilah is vulnerable when both E and W are down. Use targeted crowd control after Nilah enters and uses W.
vs-nilah-cc.text: Nilah has low health and is highly vulnerable to immobilizing crowd control. Her real opening comes when both E and W are down, so use targeted crowd control after she enters and spends W.

vs-nilah-heal.basis: Nilah amplifies healing and shields provided by allies and shares those effects with them. If Nilah's support provides healing, buy a Grievous Wounds item early. Choose Executioner's Calling or Morellonomicon based on your own scaling.
vs-nilah-heal.text: Nilah amplifies healing and shields from allies and shares the effect with the ally who provided them. If her support provides healing, a Grievous Wounds item is especially valuable: buy Executioner’s Calling or Morellonomicon early, whichever suits your scaling.

vs-nilah-q.basis: Right after Q hits, Nilah briefly gains attack range and attacks in a cone. While Nilah's Q buff is active, back away farther than usual.
vs-nilah-q.text: After Q hits, Nilah briefly gains attack range and attacks in a cone. Do not assume you are safe at the edge of her usual range; take another step back while the Q buff is active.

vs-nilah-r.basis: If Nilah's R catches several champions, her team gains both damage and healing. Spread out from your allies when Nilah has R available. If R has already pulled you in, attack Nilah immediately to stop her from maintaining the cast.
vs-nilah-r.text: If Nilah catches several champions with R, her team gains both damage and healing. Spread out while it is available; if it has already pulled you in, attack Nilah immediately to stop her from maintaining the cast rather than trying to scatter.

vs-noct-e.basis: Nocturne's E does not trigger fear if the tether breaks. Save a mobility ability or Flash for when Nocturne applies E.
vs-noct-e.text: Nocturne’s E only triggers fear if the tether stays connected; moving far enough away breaks it. Save a mobility ability or Flash for the moment he applies E, and getting out of range will leave you taking only the damage, without the fear.

vs-noct-q.basis: Targets hit by Nocturne's Q also leave a trail. Nocturne quickly chases along the trail left by a target hit by Q. If Nocturne's Q hits you, angle toward your allies or a turret until the trail disappears.
vs-noct-q.text: If Nocturne’s Q hits you, you leave a trail that lets him chase quickly. Running straight away lays a path for him, so angle toward your allies or a turret until the trail disappears.

vs-noct-r-group.basis: Nocturne uses R to target isolated enemies. While R cuts off shared vision, do not scatter and flee separately.
vs-noct-r-group.text: When Nocturne activates R and the screen darkens, immediately move toward your teammates. He looks for isolated targets, so grouping up makes his engage costly. Scattering and fleeing separately while shared vision is cut off is the worst choice.

vs-noct-vision.basis: Nocturne is strong in areas without vision. Maintain vision around the river and jungle entrances.
vs-noct-vision.text: Nocturne thrives where there is no vision. Keep the river and jungle entrances warded and position yourself before he activates R, so you can judge where to retreat even after darkness falls.

vs-noct-w.basis: Nocturne's W blocks one ability. If Nocturne blocks an ability with W, his attack speed doubles.
vs-noct-w.text: Nocturne’s W blocks one ability completely and doubles his attack speed if it does. Use a low value ability to remove the shield before applying your key crowd control.

vs-nunu-e.basis: If an E snowball hits and slows you, the root triggers after a delay. If E hits you, leave the area immediately. If you have a mobility ability, use it after E hits you and before the root triggers.
vs-nunu-e.text: If E (Snowball Barrage) hits and slows you, its root follows after a delay. Leave the area immediately, using a mobility ability during that window if you have one. Simply trying to run from the same spot can leave you caught by R’s slow and then rooted.

vs-nunu-gank.basis: Nunu & Willump can gank with the snowball from level 3. Early on, secure river vision before positioning in lane. Nunu can roll around the Rift Scuttler and come back immediately after a gank.
vs-nunu-gank.text: Nunu & Willump can gank with a snowball from level 3. If you push the lane and stand too far forward, a snowball rolled in from outside your vision can hit you, so secure river vision before choosing your lane position early on. They can also roll around the Rift Scuttler and return immediately after a gank.

vs-nunu-heal.basis: Nunu can keep healing by using Q on minions and monsters. Nunu's Q heals more when his health is below half. Get Executioner's Calling or Morellonomicon early to reduce Nunu's Q healing.
vs-nunu-heal.text: Nunu can repeatedly heal with Q (Consume) on minions and monsters, with even more healing below half health. Without healing reduction, you may win a damage trade but fail to finish him off, so get Executioner’s Calling or Morellonomicon early.

vs-nunu-magic.basis: Virtually all of Nunu & Willump's damage is magic damage. Nunu & Willump's main threat comes from the snowball's crowd control more than its damage. Against Nunu, options that increase both magic resistance and tenacity are effective.
vs-nunu-magic.text: Virtually all of Nunu & Willump’s damage is magic damage, while most of their threat comes from the snowball’s crowd control. Options that provide both magic resistance and tenacity are especially effective.

vs-nunu-r.basis: Nunu's R is a channeled ability. Use immobilizing crowd control to interrupt Nunu's R channel. Interrupting Nunu's R channel prevents its explosion damage. If you can't interrupt Nunu's R, walk out of its range. The longer you stay within Nunu's R, the stronger its slow becomes, up to 95%. A Nunu who only builds health won't be taken down while channeling R. When a Nunu who only builds health uses R, leave the area instead of forcing an attack.
vs-nunu-r.text: R (Absolute Zero) is channeled, and interrupting it with immobilizing crowd control prevents the explosion damage. If you cannot interrupt it, walk out of range, though its slow grows stronger the longer you remain inside, reaching up to 95%. A Nunu who has built only health will not be taken down during the channel, so leave the area instead of forcing an attack.

vs-nunu-w-dodge.basis: The W snowball moves forward much faster than it turns sideways. When the snowball comes toward you, walk toward it and escape through the spot Nunu just left. The snowball has very long range, making it hard to outrun.
vs-nunu-w-dodge.text: The W (Biggest Snowball Ever!) snowball travels forward much faster than it turns sideways, so running away will let it catch you. Instead, walk toward it and escape through the spot Nunu just left. Its range is very long, making a straight sprint away unlikely to work.

vs-olaf-axe.basis: During lane, move to prevent Olaf from picking up his Q axe. Move away from where the axe lands to hinder Olaf's poke and approach.
vs-olaf-axe.text: In lane, focus on keeping Olaf from retrieving his Q axe. Moving away from where it lands denies him both a quicker poke cooldown and his approach path.

vs-olaf-e.basis: Armor and magic resistance cannot reduce Olaf's E true damage. When low on health, counter Olaf's E with shields, healing, or distance.
vs-olaf-e.text: Armor and magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Olaf’s E, Reckless Swing. When low on health, rely on shields, healing, or distance instead of defensive stats.

vs-olaf-lowhp.basis: Olaf gains attack speed and lifesteal as his health gets lower. Closing in on a half health Olaf can get you killed instead. Save crowd control that can reliably stop Olaf for the finishing stage.
vs-olaf-lowhp.text: Olaf gains attack speed and lifesteal as his health gets lower, so closing in on him at half health can get you killed. Save crowd control that can reliably stop him for the finishing stage.

vs-olaf-scaling.basis: Olaf is strongest early and becomes relatively weaker as the game goes on. Avoid giving Olaf early kills and stall until the matchup turns in your favor. If you have a range advantage, fight Olaf without getting close.
vs-olaf-scaling.text: Olaf is strongest early and becomes relatively weaker as the game goes on. Avoid giving him early kills and stall until the matchup turns in your favor; if you have a range advantage, simply keeping your distance is enough to win.

vs-olaf-ult.basis: Movement impairing effects like stuns and roots do not work on Olaf while his R is active. When Olaf activates R, create distance behind a wall or your allies and wait out its duration. Apply crowd control right after Olaf's R ends. Getting hit by Olaf's basic attacks or E during R extends its duration.
vs-olaf-ult.text: Stuns, roots, and other movement impairing effects do not work on Olaf while R is active. Its duration is short, so create distance behind a wall or your allies, wait it out, and apply crowd control as soon as it ends. Avoid taking basic attacks or E hits during R, since each one extends its duration.

vs-orianna-auto.basis: Orianna's P adds magic damage to basic attacks. Orianna's P bonus damage increases with consecutive attacks on the same target. If you play an ability power champion, avoid basic attack trades early. If you play an ability power champion, trade damage only with abilities early on.
vs-orianna-auto.text: Orianna’s P adds magic damage to basic attacks, increasing with consecutive hits on the same target. If you play an ability power champion, avoid early basic attack trades and trade damage only with abilities.

vs-orianna-ball.basis: Judge Orianna's threat by the ball's position. If the ball is not nearby, R cannot pull you from your current position. When you stand near the ball, R can pull you at any time. Position yourself based on the ball's location.
vs-orianna-ball.text: Judge Orianna’s threat by the ball’s position. If it is not nearby, R cannot pull you from where you stand; if you stand near it, you can be pulled at any time. Watch the ball, rather than Orianna herself, when positioning.

vs-orianna-no-ball.basis: When the ball is away from Orianna, she loses the armor and magic resistance from E's passive. Try to trade damage right after Orianna casts Q.
vs-orianna-no-ball.text: Orianna loses the armor and magic resistance from E’s passive while the ball is away from her, so trade damage right after she casts Q.

vs-ornn-brittle.basis: If Ornn's final W flame hits you, you become Brittle. While you're Brittle, immobilizing crowd control from Ornn's team lasts longer and deals bonus damage. Keep your distance and don't move forward until Brittle wears off. If Ornn auto attacks you while you're Brittle, the knockback can separate you from your allies.
vs-ornn-brittle.text: Ornn’s final W flame applies Brittle. While it lasts, immobilizing crowd control from Ornn’s team lasts longer and deals bonus damage, so keep your distance and don’t move forward until it wears off. An auto attack from Ornn can also knock you back and separate you from your allies during this time.

vs-ornn-early.basis: Ornn's early damage is very low. Pressure Ornn as much as possible in early laning to get ahead. Keep up the pressure to end the game before Ornn's items and his allies' Masterwork upgrades stack up.
vs-ornn-early.text: Ornn’s early damage is very low, so you should rarely lose lane to him. Press your advantage as much as possible early, then keep up the pressure to end the game before his items and his allies’ Masterwork upgrades accumulate.

vs-ornn-forge.basis: Move close and attack when Ornn tries to craft an item in lane. Interrupting his crafting denies Ornn the laning advantage of finishing an item without recalling.
vs-ornn-forge.text: When Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, close in and attack him. Interrupting the craft eventually forces him to recall, removing his only laning advantage: finishing an item without going back.

vs-ornn-pillar.basis: Ornn's Q pillar acts like a wall, letting him knock enemies up with E even in open terrain. When a Q pillar appears, move away from it.
vs-ornn-pillar.text: Ornn’s Q pillar also counts as a wall for him, so standing near it leaves you open to an E knockup even in otherwise open terrain. Once it appears, move clear of the entire area around it.

vs-ornn-ult.basis: The first R spirit approaches slowly, so sidestep it. Ornn can headbutt the R spirit back, so don't stand on a straight line between him and the spirit. After the spirit passes, account for where Ornn could headbutt it back from the other side.
vs-ornn-ult.text: The spirit summoned by R approaches slowly at first, so you can sidestep it. The danger comes after Ornn recasts R to headbutt it: stay off the straight line between him and the spirit, and even after it passes, position with its possible return from the other side in mind.

vs-ornn-wall.basis: To avoid Ornn's E shockwave, stand away from walls. If Ornn's E doesn't hit terrain, it only deals damage as he passes through. When Ornn prepares E, retreat toward the open area away from the wall.
vs-ornn-wall.text: Stand away from walls: Ornn’s E knocks enemies up with its shockwave only if he hits terrain, and otherwise merely deals damage as he passes through. When you see him prepare E, retreat toward open ground away from the wall.

vs-pantheon-e.basis: Pantheon's E only blocks damage coming from the direction he faces. Pantheon's E does not block turret damage. When Pantheon uses E, move to his side or behind him to attack. If you must attack from the front, wait until E ends.
vs-pantheon-e.text: Pantheon's E (Aegis Assault) blocks damage only from the direction he faces; attacks from his side or behind still hit, and it cannot block turret damage. Move around him to attack, or wait until E ends before attacking from the front.

vs-pantheon-phase.basis: Pantheon is very strong in early trades. Pantheon's impact falls sharply as the game goes late. Buy time without giving Pantheon kills early.
vs-pantheon-phase.text: Pantheon’s base stats are among the best in the game at levels 1–2, so trading blows with him early is almost always a losing proposition. His impact drops sharply as the game goes on, though, and simply buying time without giving him early kills can turn the matchup in your favor.

vs-pantheon-q.basis: Pantheon's held Q deals reduced damage to enemies behind the first target hit. Keep minions between you and Pantheon when he pokes with held Q.
vs-pantheon-q.text: Pantheon's held Q deals reduced damage to enemies behind the first target it hits, so keep minions between you and him when he pokes to reduce your losses in lane.

vs-pantheon-r.basis: Pantheon needs vision of an area to aim R's landing spot accurately. Step into brush to make it harder for Pantheon to aim R's landing spot. When R's landing warning appears, walk out of the landing area.
vs-pantheon-r.text: Pantheon needs vision of an area to aim R's landing accurately, so stepping into brush makes his aim harder. When the landing warning appears, you can avoid most of the attack simply by walking out of its area.

vs-pantheon-w.basis: Pantheon's W is a targeted stun, so it cannot be dodged. Stay out of Pantheon's W range. Stand farther back if Pantheon has an ally with crowd control beside him.
vs-pantheon-w.text: Pantheon's W is a targeted stun that cannot be dodged, so stay out of its range. Stand even farther back when an ally with crowd control is beside him, since they can keep you in place for his combo.

vs-poppy-e.basis: Poppy's E must knock you into terrain to stun you and deal bonus damage. Avoid standing with your back to a wall or narrow passage; stay in open space to avoid the E stun.
vs-poppy-e.text: Poppy’s E only stuns and deals bonus damage if it knocks you into terrain. Keep your back away from walls and narrow passages and position in open space, where E will only push you. In lane, what is behind you can determine the outcome of a trade.

vs-poppy-lowhp.basis: As Poppy's health gets lower, W's passive Armor and Magic Resist increase. When finishing off a low-health Poppy, check that you have enough guaranteed damage.
vs-poppy-lowhp.text: As Poppy’s health falls, the Armor and Magic Resist from W’s passive increase. A low health Poppy can turn an attempted finish into a counterattack, so go for the kill only when you are sure your guaranteed damage is enough.

vs-poppy-passive.basis: Poppy's thrown shield lands on the ground and is destroyed if an enemy steps on it. Step on the fallen shield first to stop Poppy from gaining a shield.
vs-poppy-passive.text: Poppy’s thrown shield lands on the ground and is destroyed if an enemy steps on it. Denying the pickup prevents her from gaining a shield, which can greatly change the outcome of a lane trade. It tends to land near walls, so anticipate the path Poppy will take to retrieve it and step on it first.

vs-poppy-q.basis: Poppy's Q leaves a zone where it hits that detonates again shortly afterward. Q deals damage based on maximum health, so it hurts champions who build health more. If Q's first hit lands, immediately walk out of the lingering zone.
vs-poppy-q.text: Poppy’s Q leaves a zone where it hits that detonates again shortly afterward. Its damage scales with maximum health, so it hurts champions who build health more; if the first hit lands, walk out of the zone immediately.

vs-poppy-r.basis: When Poppy starts spinning her hammer, she is charging R. The longer Poppy charges R, the longer the fissure becomes and the farther it knocks enemies away. When you see Poppy charging R, move sideways out of the line directly in front of her. Poppy also slows down while charging R, making it easier to create distance.
vs-poppy-r.text: When Poppy starts spinning her hammer, she is charging R. A longer charge extends the fissure and knocks enemies farther away, so move sideways out of the line directly in front of her when you see it. Poppy also slows down while charging, making it easier to create distance.

vs-poppy-w.basis: When Poppy activates W, it stops movement abilities that dash into the area around her. If W stops a dash, you briefly cannot use movement abilities. If you need to engage with a dash, wait for W to end or walk up to her.
vs-poppy-w.text: When Poppy activates W, it stops dashes into the area around her, and enemies it stops briefly cannot use movement abilities. If your champion engages with a dash, wait until W ends or approach on foot instead of dashing in while it is active. W lasts only a short time, so waiting is almost always worthwhile.

vs-pyke-antiheal.basis: Pyke's sustain depends on P's healing. With Grievous Wounds applied, Pyke has a harder time repeatedly engaging and disengaging. If you deal physical damage, buy Executioner's Calling earlier than usual to reduce Pyke's healing.
vs-pyke-antiheal.text: Pyke’s sustain comes entirely from P’s healing, and he builds little in the way of defensive stats. Grievous Wounds disrupts his repeated engage and disengage cycle, so if you deal physical damage, buy Executioner’s Calling earlier than usual.

vs-pyke-e.basis: Against Pyke, prioritize dodging E. E's stun occurs along the line between Pyke's starting and ending points. Move sideways from Pyke's path to dodge the E phantom. If you dodge E, Pyke is left in a position where engaging or escaping is difficult.
vs-pyke-e.text: Prioritize dodging E: its phantom stuns along the line between Pyke’s starting and ending points, so move sideways off his path to avoid it. If E misses, Pyke is left where he cannot easily continue the engage or escape.

vs-pyke-late.basis: Pyke struggles to bring high health targets below his execution threshold. Late game champions with health items will not die to a single Pyke R. Late in the game, keep squishy allies Pyke might target behind the frontline and move together.
vs-pyke-late.text: Pyke struggles to bring high health targets below his execution threshold, and a champion with health items will not die to a single R late in the game. Keep squishy allies he might target behind the frontline and move together.

vs-pyke-passive.basis: Pyke must leave vision to heal his stored health. After a trade, place a ward toward Pyke as he retreats to prevent his healing. Keep retreating Pyke in sight as you follow him to prevent his healing.
vs-pyke-passive.text: Pyke heals his stored health only after leaving vision. After a trade, ward toward him as he retreats or follow while keeping him in sight to prevent the healing from starting.

vs-pyke-r.basis: Do not stand next to a low health ally. If Pyke executes an ally with R, others in the X shaped area also take damage. If Pyke executes someone with R, he can use R again immediately. In teamfights, wounded allies should spread out to stop a chain of R executions.
vs-pyke-r.text: Do not stand next to a low health ally. If Pyke executes them with R, anyone else in the X shaped area takes damage, and he can use R again immediately. Wounded allies should spread out in teamfights to break the chain of executions.

vs-pyke-w-vision.basis: When Pyke uses W nearby, a shark shadow circles beneath your feet. If you see the shark shadow, Pyke is already in range. If you see the shark shadow, retreat toward your allies or under your turret. Use control wards to cover brush entrances and limit Pyke's W approach angles.
vs-pyke-w-vision.text: When Pyke uses W nearby, a shark shadow circles beneath your feet. Seeing it means he is already in range, so move toward your allies or retreat under your turret. Cover brush entrances with control wards to limit his W approach angles.

vs-qiyana-cooldown.basis: Try to fight back right after Qiyana uses W and E to engage. In lane, trade with Qiyana if she stays forward after using all her abilities.
vs-qiyana-cooldown.text: Qiyana is a fragile melee assassin, and once she has used W and E to engage, she is highly vulnerable to a counterattack. If you avoid her combo, strike back immediately afterward. In lane, trade with her if she remains forward after using all her abilities.

vs-qiyana-element.basis: If Qiyana approaches with the river element, back out of Q's root range first. If Qiyana disappears while holding the brush element, move into your allies' vision. If you are below half health and Qiyana has the rock element, create distance before she gets close.
vs-qiyana-element.text: Watch Qiyana’s current element to anticipate her next move. If she approaches with the river element, back out of Q’s root range; if she disappears while holding the brush element, move into your allies’ vision. When you are below half health, keep your distance from a Qiyana holding the rock element before she can get close enough to finish you.

vs-qiyana-lategame.basis: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game and becomes relatively weaker as the game goes late. Avoid giving up a lead in the early and mid game, then build defensive stats and move together. When moving together, stand away from terrain so Qiyana has no angle for R.
vs-qiyana-lategame.text: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game and becomes relatively weaker later. Avoid giving her an advantage in the early and mid game, then build defensive stats and move together so she struggles to dive in and burst someone down alone. When grouped, prioritize standing away from terrain to deny her an R angle.

vs-qiyana-r.basis: Qiyana's R shockwave explodes when it hits terrain, and its stun duration is proportional to the distance it travels. When facing Qiyana, do not stand with your back to a wall. If Qiyana's R hits you, use a movement ability away from the terrain because the explosion spreads along its edge.
vs-qiyana-r.text: Qiyana’s R explodes when its knockback shockwave reaches terrain, and its stun lasts longer the farther the shockwave travels. Do not face her with your back to a wall. If R hits you, use a movement ability away from the terrain, since the explosion spreads along its entire edge.

vs-qiyana-terrain.basis: Qiyana depends on terrain to take elements and trigger R's terrain explosion. Against Qiyana, stand in open ground away from walls, brush, and the river. Move to a wide area to avoid facing Qiyana by the river or in a narrow passage.
vs-qiyana-terrain.text: Qiyana relies on terrain to take elements with W and trigger R’s explosion. Against her, stay in open ground away from walls, brush, and the river, where both are harder for her to use. Take routes through wide areas to avoid meeting her by the river or in a narrow passage.

vs-quinn-e.basis: Quinn backs away as soon as she reaches you with E, making it hard to retaliate. Quinn has no escape when E is down. Engage Quinn right after she uses E; do not force an engage before then.
vs-quinn-e.text: Quinn backs away as soon as E reaches you, making an immediate counterattack difficult, but she has no escape while E is down. Engage right after she uses it; until then, do not force your way in.

vs-quinn-harrier.basis: Quinn's poke is strong when a Harrier mark is on the target. When you are marked, move outside Quinn's auto range and let the mark expire. Farm or start a trade while Harrier's mark is unavailable.
vs-quinn-harrier.text: Quinn's poke hurts most when you have a Harrier mark. If you are marked, step outside her auto range and let it expire, then farm or start a trade while the mark is unavailable.

vs-quinn-melee.basis: Quinn has a range advantage in lane against melee champions. When playing a melee champion against her, collect CS and preserve your health early. When playing a melee champion against her, do not try to engage alone without jungle help. Melee champions should start a trade only when Quinn's E is down or their jungler arrives.
vs-quinn-melee.text: Quinn outranges melee champions throughout lane, so focus on collecting CS and preserving health early. Do not try to engage her alone without jungle help; start a trade only after her E is down or your jungler arrives.

vs-quinn-q.basis: If Quinn’s Q hits a minion first, it won’t reduce a champion’s vision. Stand behind the minion wave to block Quinn’s Q. Don’t throw skillshots while your vision is reduced by Quinn’s Q. While your vision is reduced by Quinn’s Q, focus only on whether to move in or back off.
vs-quinn-q.text: If Quinn's Q hits a minion first, it will not reduce a champion's vision, so stand behind the minion wave to block it. If your vision is reduced, hold your skillshots and focus on deciding whether to move in or back off.

vs-quinn-r.basis: Damaging Quinn while she travels with R ends her movement speed bonus. If you lose track of Quinn, establish vision in the side lanes or along jungle routes. Warn your team early when you spot Quinn roaming. After level 6, Quinn excels at creating numbers advantages in other lanes.
vs-quinn-r.text: Damaging Quinn while she travels with R ends her movement speed bonus. If you lose track of her, place vision along side lanes or jungle routes and warn your team early when you spot a roam. After level 6, she excels at creating numbers advantages away from her own lane.

vs-quinn-teamfight.basis: Quinn lacks staying power in front-to-back teamfights. Force teamfights instead of fighting Quinn one-on-one in a side lane. If Quinn enters a teamfight from the flank, catch her with crowd control.
vs-quinn-teamfight.text: Quinn has very low health and lacks staying power in front-to-back teamfights. Force fights as a team instead of taking her on one-on-one in a side lane; if she comes in from the flank, catch her with crowd control.

vs-rakan-cc.basis: Rakan is very vulnerable to crowd control that applies immediately. Right after W lands, use a stun or root that does not require aiming to stop Rakan's mobility. It is hard to catch Rakan with skillshots alone.
vs-rakan-cc.text: Rakan relies on going in and getting back out, making him very vulnerable to immediate crowd control. Use a stun or root that does not require aiming right after W Grand Entrance lands to stop his mobility; skillshots alone have a harder time catching him.

vs-rakan-e.basis: Rakan can only use E on allied champions. Away from allies, Rakan is effectively a melee champion with no mobility ability. Look for moments when Rakan is alone while roaming or setting up vision.
vs-rakan-e.text: Rakan can use E Battle Dance only on allied champions. Away from allies, he is effectively a melee champion without a mobility ability, so look to catch him alone while he roams or sets up vision.

vs-rakan-passive.basis: Rakan's passive shield returns periodically. Each time Rakan lands poke, his passive shield returns sooner. Trading while Rakan's shield is up puts you at a disadvantage. Rakan is most vulnerable right after his shield breaks.
vs-rakan-passive.text: Rakan’s P Fey Feathers shield returns periodically, and each time he lands poke, it returns sooner. Trading while the shield is up puts you at a disadvantage; he is most vulnerable immediately after it breaks.

vs-rakan-r.basis: With R active, Rakan charms enemies he touches as he passes. It is hard to escape an R active Rakan on foot. Put terrain between you and Rakan when dodging his R. Crowd control Rakan before he touches you with R active. If you stand in a line, Rakan's R can charm several of you at once.
vs-rakan-r.text: With R The Quickness active, Rakan charms enemies he touches as he passes. His movement speed makes escaping on foot impossible, so put terrain between you and him or apply crowd control before he touches you. Standing in a line lets him charm several of you at once.

vs-rakan-w.basis: Rakan's W dashes, then leaps to land, and its landing spot is visible beforehand. When Rakan starts moving with W, step sideways to dodge the knockup. The farther away Rakan starts W, the easier it is to dodge.
vs-rakan-w.text: Rakan’s W Grand Entrance dashes and then leaps to a landing spot that is visible beforehand. Step sideways as he starts moving to dodge the knockup; the farther away he starts, the easier it is to avoid.

vs-rammus-armor.basis: Rammus stacks armor to extreme levels, and that armor converts into attack damage. Have allies with magic damage, true damage, or damage based on maximum health deal with Rammus.
vs-rammus-armor.text: Rammus stacks armor to extreme levels and converts it into attack damage, so trying to bring him down with physical damage wastes time. Let allies with magic damage, true damage, or damage based on maximum health handle him.

vs-rammus-autoattack.basis: Auto-attacking Rammus while W is active deals reflected damage to the attacker. The faster a champion attacks, the more they suffer from Rammus's W reflected damage. While W is active, attack another target instead of auto-attacking Rammus. Unless you must kill Rammus, wait for W to end.
vs-rammus-autoattack.text: Auto-attacking Rammus while W is active deals reflected damage to the attacker, and faster attackers suffer more. Attack another target while W is up; unless you must kill Rammus, it is better to wait for it to end.

vs-rammus-r-range.basis: R's area grows with Rammus's movement speed, so using it from Q at maximum speed covers more area than expected. If you see Rammus rolling toward you, allow plenty of room for R's expected area and back away. After R lands, aftershocks continue in the same spot, stacking slows. Leave the spot where R lands immediately.
vs-rammus-r-range.text: R (Soaring Slam)’s area grows with Rammus’s movement speed, so an R cast from Q (Powerball) at maximum speed reaches much farther than it may appear. If you see him rolling toward you, give the expected area plenty of room and back away; after he lands, leave that spot immediately because repeated aftershocks stack slows there.

vs-rammus-taunt.basis: E is a targeted taunt that cannot be dodged; while affected, you cannot issue movement commands or use abilities. Fight outside Rammus's E range. Time Flash or a mobility ability so you can use it as soon as the taunt ends. Do not start channeling an ability while Rammus is close.
vs-rammus-taunt.text: E (Frenzying Taunt) is targeted and cannot be dodged; once it lands, you cannot issue movement commands or use abilities. Fight outside its range, and plan to use Flash or a mobility ability immediately after the taunt ends rather than before it lands. Do not begin channeling an ability while Rammus is close.

vs-rammus-w-window.basis: Rammus's defensive stats are extremely high while W is active. With W down, Rammus is slightly less durable than a typical tank. When W activates, back off briefly, then focus your damage as soon as it ends.
vs-rammus-w-window.text: Rammus’s defensive stats become exceptionally high while W (Defensive Ball Curl) is active, but without it he is slightly less durable than a typical tank. Back off briefly when he activates W, then focus your damage the moment it ends.

vs-reksai-phase.basis: Rek'Sai tries to build an advantage through early and mid-game ganks and end the game early. Avoid giving Rek'Sai kills early and stall the game to make her easier to deal with. Do not push your lane too far against Rek'Sai early on. Do not travel alone through areas without vision early on.
vs-reksai-phase.text: Rek'Sai aims to build a lead through early- and mid-game ganks and end the game quickly. Her farming and sustained-damage numbers are low, so denying her early kills and extending the game makes her easier to deal with. Early on, avoid pushing your lane too far or traveling alone through areas without vision.

vs-reksai-r.basis: Rek'Sai's R only leaps to enemies she has recently damaged. If burrowed Q hits you, stay near your allies for the next few seconds. Do not use targeted abilities while Rek'Sai is leaping with R. Place untargeted crowd control at Rek'Sai's R landing spot in advance.
vs-reksai-r.text: Rek'Sai's R can leap only to an enemy she has recently damaged. If her burrowed Q hits you, stay near your allies for the next few seconds, when she may leap in. She cannot be targeted during the leap, so save targeted abilities and place untargeted crowd control at her landing spot in advance.

vs-reksai-tunnel.basis: Rek'Sai's tunnel entrances are visible and break when enemies step on them. If you find a Rek'Sai tunnel near a lane or in your jungle, step on it to destroy it. Destroying a Rek'Sai tunnel removes her gank route and escape route through it.
vs-reksai-tunnel.text: Rek'Sai's tunnel entrances are visible and break when an enemy steps on them. If you spot one near a lane or in your jungle, step on it as you pass. Destroying a tunnel removes both the gank route and the escape route it provides.

vs-rell-e.basis: If Rell and one ally suddenly speed up together, E is active and an engage is coming. If Rell runs toward you, E's movement speed increase doubles. If Rell activates E and runs toward you, stop trading and retreat beyond W's Crash Down range.
vs-rell-e.text: If Rell and an ally suddenly speed up together, E Full Tilt is active and an engage is coming. The speed increase doubles when Rell runs toward you, so stop trading at that moment and retreat beyond W Ferromancy: Crash Down range.

vs-rell-early.basis: Rell has no way to heal in lane. If you can poke with magic damage, keep lowering Rell's health from outside her engage range.
vs-rell-early.text: Rell has one of the lowest early magic resistance values of any champion and no way to heal in lane. If your team can poke with magic damage, keep wearing her down from outside her engage range until she has to recall first.

vs-rell-q.basis: If Rell's Q hits you, it destroys all your shields. Apply shields after Rell uses Q. Sidestep Q's straight-line thrust.
vs-rell-q.text: Rell’s Q, Shattering Strike, destroys every shield it hits, so wait until after she uses it to shield yourself; you can also dodge its straight-line thrust by stepping to the side.

vs-rell-r.basis: Rell's R is effective when it pulls several nearby enemies together. Spread out from your allies before a teamfight engage so R cannot pull several of you together. If R has already pulled you in, use a movement ability or cleanse while it keeps pulling.
vs-rell-r.text: R Magnet Storm is most effective when it pulls several nearby enemies together, so spread out from your allies before a teamfight engage to limit it to one target. If you have already been pulled in, do not try to walk out against the continuing pull; use a movement ability or cleanse while it lasts.

vs-rell-w.basis: Rell's forced engage depends on W's Crash Down, which has very short range. When Rell is mounted, she is looking to engage. When Rell dismounts into armored form, her movement speed becomes one of the slowest in the game. Stay outside W's Crash Down range, then create distance right after Rell uses W.
vs-rell-w.text: Rell’s only forced engage is W Ferromancy: Crash Down, which has very short range. When mounted, she is looking to engage; after dismounting into armored form, her movement speed is among the slowest in the game. Stay outside Crash Down range, then create distance as soon as she uses W to leave her isolated.

vs-renata-body.basis: Renata Glasc has no mobility ability of her own. If your composition can reach Renata Glasc, kill her first. In lane, pressure Renata Glasc herself to give her less room to use her engage abilities.
vs-renata-body.text: Renata Glasc has among the lowest level-one health and attack damage of any champion and no mobility ability of her own. If your composition can reach her, killing her first is the surest answer. Pressuring Renata Glasc directly in lane also leaves her less room to use her engage abilities.

vs-renata-e.basis: Renata Glasc's E shields allies and damages and slows enemies. Dodge Renata Glasc's straight-line E by moving sideways. Rather than focusing only on dodging Renata Glasc's E, target Renata Glasc herself, who deals little damage.
vs-renata-e.text: Renata Glasc’s E (Loyalty Program) shields allies while damaging and slowing enemies. It travels in a straight line, so dodging sideways can also spoil its shielding angle. Since Renata Glasc herself deals little damage, targeting her is quicker than focusing only on dodging E.

vs-renata-q.basis: Renata Glasc's Q roots only the first target it hits. Stand behind minions or your frontline so they take Renata Glasc's Q instead. If Renata Glasc's Q roots you, decide immediately whether to escape with Flash or a mobility ability. After you're thrown by Renata Glasc's Q, your allies can be stunned too.
vs-renata-q.text: Renata Glasc’s Q (Handshake) roots only the first target it hits, so stand behind minions or your frontline to let them take it. If you are rooted, decide immediately whether to escape with Flash or a mobility ability, since Renata Glasc chooses where to throw you. The throw can stun your allies too.

vs-renata-r.basis: If Renata Glasc's R hits you, you briefly lose control and attack nearby allies. If you have a way to cleanse crowd control, remove Renata Glasc's R immediately. If you have no way to cleanse it, move away from your allies immediately after Renata Glasc's R hits you. If you have Cleanse or Quicksilver Sash, save it while within range of Renata Glasc's R.
vs-renata-r.text: If Renata Glasc’s R (Hostile Takeover) hits you, you briefly lose control and attack nearby allies. Cleanse it immediately if you can; otherwise, move away from your allies as soon as it hits to reduce the damage. Save Cleanse or Quicksilver Sash while you are within R’s range.

vs-renata-r-spacing.basis: Enemies affected by Renata Glasc's R prioritize attacking their own allies, so grouping up makes the damage worse. While Renata Glasc's R is available, space yourselves out as you engage. When Renata Glasc's R is available, don't engage with all five players lined up together.
vs-renata-r-spacing.text: Enemies affected by Renata Glasc’s R (Hostile Takeover) prioritize attacking their own allies, so grouping up makes it more damaging. While R is available, leave space between teammates as you engage and avoid charging in with all five players lined up together.

vs-renata-w.basis: An enemy with Renata Glasc's W briefly revives and keeps fighting after dying. An enemy revived by W stays alive if they get a takedown during that time. Right after killing an enemy affected by W, back away so your allies don't die.
vs-renata-w.text: An enemy affected by Renata Glasc’s W (Bailout) briefly revives and keeps fighting after dying; a takedown during that time lets them survive. After killing a W target, back away to keep your allies from dying nearby. Overcommitting to kill the revived enemy again can give them the takedown they need to live.

vs-renekton-deny-fury.basis: Poke him consistently to prevent fights and limit his Fury generation. Renekton's Fury decreases while he is out of combat. Poke Renekton when he steps up to hit minions for Fury.
vs-renekton-deny-fury.text: Renekton needs to fight to build Fury. Keep poking without giving him a target to engage on, and he will rarely get to use empowered abilities while his Fury drains out of combat. When he steps forward to hit minions for Fury, use that opening to poke him.

vs-renekton-e.basis: Renekton's E allows a second dash only if the first dash hits a unit. Avoid standing in or behind your minion wave so allied minions cannot serve as Renekton's way in. After taking his combo, retreat in a direction where Renekton has no target to hit with E.
vs-renekton-e.text: Renekton gets a second E dash only when the first hits a unit. Avoid standing in or behind your minion wave: those minions can let him engage from farther away. If you are the only target, he can instead hit you to unlock his escape. After taking his combo, retreat in a direction with no unit for his E to hit.

vs-renekton-fury.basis: Check Renekton's Fury bar to judge how threatening he is. If his Fury is over half full, stay out of range to avoid empowered W's long stun. Stay alert even if his Fury is just under half full: one basic attack or Q may make an empowered ability available. Force a trade when his Fury is empty and his damage is reduced.
vs-renekton-fury.text: Watch Renekton’s Fury bar to judge his threat. Above half, stay out of range of empowered W’s long stun; just below half can be even more dangerous, since one basic attack or Q may give him enough Fury for an empowered ability. Force a trade when the bar is empty and his damage is much lower.

vs-renekton-post-combo.basis: Renekton is vulnerable after his first combo because he lacks sustained damage and has long cooldowns. Survive the first combo, then counterattack while Q, W, and E are all on cooldown. Focus on Renekton immediately after he uses E to disengage.
vs-renekton-post-combo.text: Renekton has no sustained damage abilities and his cooldowns are long. If you survive his first combo, counterattack while Q, W, and E are on cooldown and he has only basic attacks left. He is especially vulnerable just after using E to disengage.

vs-renekton-scaling.basis: Renekton becomes much more threatening at levels 3 and 6. While R is active and granting bonus health and Fury, avoid fighting him one-on-one and wait for it to end. Farm without giving Renekton kills until his value drops after the mid game.
vs-renekton-scaling.text: Renekton becomes much more threatening at levels 3 and 6. While R is active, its bonus health and Fury generation make a one-on-one fight dangerous, so wait out its duration. Farm without giving him kills through the mid game, and the matchup improves as his value falls.

vs-renekton-shield.basis: Empowered W destroys the target's shield. If Renekton’s Fury is full, avoid trying to absorb his combo with a shield. Use shields for sustain after taking Renekton's combo and backing away.
vs-renekton-shield.text: Renekton’s empowered W Ruthless Predator breaks the target’s shield before dealing damage. When he has Fury built up, a shield cannot absorb his combo; use shields for sustain after taking the combo and backing away.

vs-rengar-ferocity.basis: When Rengar's resource bar is full, his next ability is empowered. Trade with Rengar when his resource bar is empty.
vs-rengar-ferocity.text: When Rengar’s resource bar is full, his next ability is empowered: Q deals more damage, E roots, and W removes crowd control. He is a very different threat with a full bar, so trade with him only when it is empty.

vs-rengar-punish.basis: E is Rengar's only way to immobilize enemies. Counter Rengar's engage, then hold him in place with an immobilizing ability.
vs-rengar-punish.text: E is Rengar’s only immobilizing ability, and he has low health. Counter his engage, then hold him in place with an immobilizing ability; W’s healing alone will not keep him alive. Backline champions should stay behind their frontline and within allied vision so that the frontline becomes the target of his leap.

vs-rengar-r.basis: Do not travel alone while injured. Stay close to allies so your detection ranges overlap and can reveal Rengar before he leaps.
vs-rengar-r.text: R, Thrill of the Hunt, gives Rengar camouflage and a large movement speed boost, so do not travel alone while injured. His camouflage ends when he enters an enemy champion’s detection range; stay close to allies and overlap your detection ranges to reveal him before he leaps. R also ends with a leap toward the nearest enemy, so keep the backline behind the frontline to divert him from his intended target.

vs-riven-cc.basis: Riven's combo relies on tightly chaining abilities and basic attacks. Riven is vulnerable to roots or silences during her combo that interrupt her remaining Q and W casts. Use crowd control right after Riven reaches you.
vs-riven-cc.text: Riven’s combo depends on chaining abilities and basic attacks closely together. A root or silence after the combo begins interrupts her remaining Q and W casts and greatly reduces her damage, so save crowd control until just after she reaches you.

vs-riven-channel.basis: Riven's Q3 and W interrupt channeled ultimates. Avoid starting a channel while Riven is close to you. Start channeling after you see Riven use up Q or use W.
vs-riven-channel.text: Riven’s Q3 and W can interrupt channeled ultimates. Avoid starting one while she is close; wait until you have seen her use up Q or spend W.

vs-riven-mobility.basis: Riven can cover a long distance by chaining three Q dashes and one E dash. If you have pushed too far beyond vision, check whether all of Riven's dash abilities are available. Each of Riven's dashes travels a short distance. When you see Riven's first dash, immediately back away to create distance.
vs-riven-mobility.text: Riven can travel a long distance by chaining three Q dashes and one E dash, so if you have pushed too far beyond vision, first check whether all her dash abilities are available. Each dash is short, though; if you back away as soon as you see the first one, the remaining dashes are unlikely to reach you.

vs-riven-physical.basis: Riven deals all her damage as physical damage. If Riven starts getting ahead, buy armor items sooner to reduce her physical damage.
vs-riven-physical.text: All of Riven’s damage is physical, so building armor alone can change the outcome of a trade. If she starts getting ahead, buy armor items earlier.

vs-riven-ult.basis: Riven gains attack damage while R is active. Expect Riven to land abilities from farther away than usual while R is active. If Wind Slash is still available, being low on health is dangerous even near your turret. When Riven activates R, keep your distance until it expires.
vs-riven-ult.text: While R is active, Riven gains attack damage and range, allowing her abilities to reach you from farther away. She is especially dangerous while Wind Slash is available because it deals more damage the more health you have lost, leaving you unsafe even near your turret when your health is low. Keep your distance until R expires.

vs-riven-wave.basis: Counterattack when Riven uses Q to clear minions. After using Q on the wave, Riven loses her main damage and escape tools. Before Riven gets ability haste items, make use of the long window while Q is on cooldown.
vs-riven-wave.text: Counterattack when Riven uses Q to clear minions: spending it on the wave removes both her main damage source and an escape tool. Before she gets ability haste items, its long cooldown leaves a substantial opening, so take advantage of that moment, especially early on.

vs-rumble-e.basis: Getting hit by both E shots in succession greatly amplifies the slow, making it hard to walk away. As soon as the first E hits, immediately make the call to create distance. If you have a mobility ability, use it before the second E arrives.
vs-rumble-e.text: Getting hit by both E shots in succession greatly amplifies the slow, making it impossible to walk away, and reduces your magic resistance, increasing the damage that follows. Decide what to do as soon as the first shot lands: create distance immediately instead of holding your ground, or use a mobility ability before the second shot arrives.

vs-rumble-hp.basis: Q deals damage based on the target's maximum health. To counter Q's max health damage, choose items with magic resistance over defensive items that only provide health. Rumble is prone to giving up an early advantage in lane against magic damage champions.
vs-rumble-hp.text: Q deals damage based on the target’s maximum health, so building only health works against you when facing Rumble; choose defensive items with magic resistance instead. His magic resistance is also among the lowest of all champions, giving magic damage champions an early laning advantage.

vs-rumble-range.basis: Q deals damage in a close-range cone. Rumble has no mobility ability. Limit the time Rumble stays close to you to reduce the damage you take. Create situations where Rumble has to walk forward to trade.
vs-rumble-range.text: Q deals damage in a close-range cone, and Rumble has no mobility ability. Whether you play a ranged or melee champion, limiting how long he stays close removes most of his damage. Set up trades that force him to walk forward.

vs-rumble-w.basis: W provides both a shield and a brief movement speed boost. Focus your burst damage after Rumble's W shield expires. Once Rumble has used W as well, treat his escape tools as spent.
vs-rumble-w.text: W grants Rumble a shield and a brief movement speed boost. Bursting him immediately after he activates it wastes much of your damage on the shield, so let its short duration pass before going in. Once he has used W, his means of escape is also spent.

vs-ryze-early.basis: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so his kill stats rank near the bottom. Pressure Ryze in lane before he completes his items to slow his growth.
vs-ryze-early.text: Early on, Ryze lacks both mana and damage, leaving his kill stats near the bottom. The most reliable response is to pressure him in lane before he completes his items and slow his growth.

vs-ryze-flux.basis: Q deals increased damage to an E-marked target and bounces to nearby targets. If E hits you, keep your distance from allies until the mark expires.
vs-ryze-flux.text: Ryze’s damage starts with E’s mark: Q deals increased damage to a marked target and bounces to nearby enemies. If E hits you, move away from allies and keep your distance until the mark expires.

vs-ryze-noescape.basis: Use a gap closer or strong crowd control to reach Ryze first and deny him time to use his combo. If you give Ryze space and take sustained damage, his marks keep refreshing and put you at a disadvantage.
vs-ryze-noescape.text: Ryze has no mobility ability, and his armor ranks among the lowest. Reach him first with a gap closer or strong crowd control to deny him time for a combo. Giving him space to deal sustained damage lets his marks keep refreshing and puts you at a disadvantage.

vs-ryze-root.basis: Ryze's W roots a target marked by E. W only slows a target that has not been hit by E. Against Ryze, prioritize dodging E.
vs-ryze-root.text: Ryze’s W roots only a target already marked by E; otherwise, it merely slows. Prioritize dodging E.

vs-ryze-ult.basis: Ryze's R takes time to activate after he casts it. Immobilizing Ryze or preventing him from using abilities before R activates cancels it. When you see Realm Warp, anticipate what may arrive at its destination. When you see Realm Warp, interrupt Ryze's cast.
vs-ryze-ult.text: R Realm Warp takes time to activate, and immobilizing Ryze or preventing him from using abilities during that delay cancels it. When you see it, anticipate what may arrive at its destination or interrupt Ryze.

vs-samira-cc-dash.basis: If Samira basic attacks an immobilized ally, she dashes to that ally. Prioritize dodging engage crowd control from enemies near Samira. When an ally is immobilized, expect Samira to dash to them and respond accordingly.
vs-samira-cc-dash.text: Basic attacking an immobilized enemy makes Samira dash to them, so getting caught by the enemy support’s crowd control signals her engage. Prioritize dodging engage abilities from enemies near her; if an ally is immobilized, expect Samira to dash to them and respond.

vs-samira-e-reset.basis: E resets immediately if an enemy Samira damaged dies shortly afterward. When retreating from a teamfight, do not leave a low-health ally behind. If Samira engages with E and no one dies, take her down then.
vs-samira-e-reset.text: Wild Rush (E) resets immediately if an enemy Samira damaged dies shortly afterward. Once someone starts to fall in a teamfight, she can keep dashing to the next target, so do not leave a low-health ally behind as you retreat. If she uses E to engage and no one dies, that is your chance to take her down.

vs-samira-grade.basis: Samira can only use R at the highest Style rank. Take one type of attack, then disengage or move out of range to stop Samira from raising her Style rank. Limit the time Samira can stay close to prevent her from using her ultimate.
vs-samira-grade.text: Samira can use Inferno Trigger (R) only at the highest Style rank. Because she gains ranks by landing different types of attacks in succession, taking one hit and disengaging or moving out of range stops her progress. Keep her time within close range short to prevent the ultimate.

vs-samira-r-interrupt.basis: Samira’s Inferno Trigger lasts 2 seconds. Samira heals through life steal during Inferno Trigger. Interrupting Inferno Trigger with immobilizing crowd control or a knockback cancels the remaining shots. When Inferno Trigger is interrupted, Samira’s grade has already reset, so it takes time for her to become strong again. When you see Samira’s Inferno Trigger, interrupt it instead of running away.
vs-samira-r-interrupt.text: Inferno Trigger fires for 2 seconds, during which Samira heals through life steal. Interrupt it with immobilizing crowd control or a knockback to cancel the remaining shots; her Style has already reset, so rebuilding her strength takes time. When you see the ultimate, interrupt it instead of running away.

vs-samira-range.basis: Samira has short range for a marksman and deals most of her damage at melee range. If you outrange her, keep poking without stepping forward to limit Samira's chances to build Style. In lane, watch for openings that let Samira walk into range.
vs-samira-range.text: Samira has short range for a marksman and deals her real damage only within melee range. If you outrange her, keep poking without stepping forward to deny her chances to build Style. In lane, watch for openings that would let her walk into range.

vs-samira-w.basis: Projectiles are destroyed while Samira's W is spinning. Use projectile abilities and basic attacks after W stops spinning. Instant abilities and area abilities that are not projectiles can still hit while W is spinning.
vs-samira-w.text: Blade Whirl (W) destroys projectiles while Samira is spinning. When you see her swing her blades, wait until the spin ends before using projectile abilities or basic attacks; instant and area abilities that are not projectiles can still hit her during it.

vs-sejuani-e.basis: Stacks cannot build again for a while on a target stunned by E. Once the E stun has been used, there is a brief safe window when stacks cannot build. When the stun ends, create distance immediately to avoid Sejuani's first auto-attack.
vs-sejuani-e.text: Stacks cannot build on a target for a while after E stuns them, creating a brief safe window once the stun has been used. Sejuani's first auto-attack after stunning you deals bonus damage based on your maximum health, though, so create distance as soon as the stun ends to avoid that hit.

vs-sejuani-frost.basis: When Sejuani is nearby, watch for stun stacks if you are close to one of her melee allies. Create distance immediately when the Permafrost stack indicator fills up.
vs-sejuani-frost.text: Permafrost stacks come from Sejuani’s W and auto-attacks as well as the auto-attacks of her melee allies. A stun may be building even when Sejuani is not hitting you herself, so being close to one of her melee allies while she is nearby is dangerous. Move away immediately when the stack indicator fills.

vs-sejuani-passive.basis: Sejuani is immune to slows and has increased defensive stats while Frost Armor is active. When escaping, damage Sejuani first to remove her slow immunity, then use your escape ability.
vs-sejuani-passive.text: With Frost Armor active, Sejuani is immune to slows and has increased defensive stats. Taking damage removes the armor shortly afterward, so if you need to escape, hit her first, even with a low-value ability, to remove her slow immunity before using your escape tool.

vs-sejuani-q-r.basis: Q stops when it hits an allied champion in front, so it cannot reach those behind them. R stuns longer when it travels farther before hitting. If R is going to hit you, close the distance so it hits at short range. When you see Q or R wind up, move sideways to dodge.
vs-sejuani-q-r.text: Dodging Q and R is central to fighting Sejuani. Q stops when it hits a champion, so if an ally in front takes the hit, those behind them are safe. R stuns longer the farther it travels, so if it is going to hit you, closing the distance reduces the stun. Both abilities have visible windups and can be dodged by moving sideways.

vs-sejuani-scaling.basis: Sejuani's damage and defenses scale with her health and defensive stats. Sejuani ranks near the bottom in early kills and damage. Take early jungle control and objectives to delay Sejuani's item completion.
vs-sejuani-scaling.text: Sejuani’s damage and defenses scale with her health and defensive stats. Given time, she can become hard to kill while repeatedly locking down your allies, so take early jungle control and objectives to delay her item completion. Her early kills and damage rank near the bottom, leaving plenty of opportunity to take those resources.

vs-sejuani-w.basis: Most of W's damage and its slow are on the second hit. If W's first hit lands, move out of range before the second hit.
vs-sejuani-w.text: W swings twice, with most of its damage and the slow on the second hit. If the first hit lands, moving out of range before the second can negate more than half of the damage trade.

vs-senna-e.basis: When you see Senna's mist, back away to an area where you have vision. Use area abilities on Senna's mist to block her approach.
vs-senna-e.text: When Senna activates E (Curse of the Black Mist), allies inside it can also approach while camouflaged. If you see the mist, don’t hold your position against it: immediately retreat to an area where you have vision, or cast an area ability into the mist to deny the approach.

vs-senna-early.basis: Senna is vulnerable to early pressure. Pressure Senna hard in lane to prevent her from collecting Mist. If you leave Senna alone early, her range and attack damage will keep growing.
vs-senna-early.text: Senna has the lowest level-one health of any champion and very low attack damage. Pressure her hard in lane to stop her collecting Mist and limit her late-game growth; if left alone early, her range and attack damage will keep increasing.

vs-senna-mist-stacks.basis: If Senna hits you twice with attacks or abilities, she gains Mist. If Senna hits you once, retreat immediately to avoid the second hit.
vs-senna-mist-stacks.text: If Senna hits you twice with attacks or abilities, she gains Mist and deals damage. After the first hit, retreat immediately to a position where she cannot land the second.

vs-senna-q.basis: Senna's Q extends in a straight line through a targeted ally or minion. Do not stand in a straight line with Senna and an allied champion of hers. Do not stand in a straight line with Senna and a minion in front of you.
vs-senna-q.text: Senna's Q, Piercing Darkness, extends in a straight line through a targeted ally or minion. Avoid lining up with Senna and one of her allied champions, or with Senna and a minion in front of you, to avoid much of her poke.

vs-senna-souls.basis: Senna's growth depends on collecting souls. When a soul appears, watch for Senna to step forward. Check where the soul is, wait nearby, then harass Senna. Pressure Senna into giving up souls.
vs-senna-souls.text: Senna's growth depends on collecting souls, which forces her to step forward when one appears. Watch where a soul lands, wait nearby, and harass her as she approaches. Forcing her to give up one soul matters more than denying a few CS.

vs-senna-w.basis: Senna's W has a delay between hitting and rooting. When Senna's W attaches to you, its mark is visible until the root triggers. If W marks you, move away from your allies immediately. In lane, stand behind minions to block Senna's W.
vs-senna-w.text: Senna's W, Last Embrace, shows a mark during the delay between impact and the root. If it marks you, move away from your allies immediately so they are not rooted with you. In lane, standing behind minions can block W.

vs-seraphine-e.basis: Seraphine's E roots enemies who are already slowed. Seraphine's E stuns enemies who are immobilized. As soon as you're slowed, move out of the line directly in front of Seraphine.
vs-seraphine-e.text: Seraphine’s E Beat Drop roots enemies who are already slowed and stuns those who are immobilized. If you are slowed while standing directly in front of her, it can root you, so move out of its path as soon as the slow lands.

vs-seraphine-fragile.basis: Seraphine has no mobility ability. After Seraphine uses E, she has virtually no way to defend herself. Engage right after Seraphine misses E.
vs-seraphine-fragile.text: Seraphine has very low health and movement speed, with no mobility ability. Once her E is down, she has virtually no way to defend herself, so engage immediately after she misses it.

vs-seraphine-passive.basis: Seraphine needs nearby allies to stack Notes, increasing her basic attack range and damage. Trade when Seraphine is standing alone, away from her marksman.
vs-seraphine-passive.text: Seraphine needs nearby allies to stack Notes, which increase her basic attack range and damage. Engage and trade when she is standing alone, away from her marksman.

vs-seraphine-ult.basis: Seraphine's R extends its range each time it hits an allied champion. In teamfights, spread out sideways so Seraphine's R can't pass through you in a line.
vs-seraphine-ult.text: Seraphine’s R Encore extends its range each time it hits one of her allies. If your team stands in a line, its charm can reach players farther back, so spread out sideways in teamfights.

vs-sett-mobility.basis: Sett relies on R to close the gap on opponents. Maintain your range and repeatedly poke Sett. When Sett starts walking toward you, retreat before his movement speed increases. Account for the fact that poke damage turns into Sett's W shield.
vs-sett-mobility.text: Sett has no way to close the gap apart from R (The Show Stopper), so keep your distance and repeatedly poke him in lane. When he starts walking toward you, retreat before his movement speed increases, and account for the poke damage becoming his W (Haymaker) shield.

vs-sett-mr.basis: As a magic damage champion, look for aggressive trades around Sett's level 3. Build an early health advantage to give Sett fewer chances to build Grit.
vs-sett-mr.text: Sett’s early magic resistance is among the lowest of all champions. As a magic damage champion, you can trade aggressively around level 3; building a health advantage then also gives him fewer chances to build Grit.

vs-sett-r.basis: If Sett grabs you with R, Flash and Cleanse cannot remove the suppression. Items that remove crowd control, such as Mercurial Scimitar, can remove Sett's R suppression. Sett's R damage scales with the grabbed target's bonus health. While Sett has R available, stack with your allies to leave no room to be thrown.
