vs-sett-r.text: Being grabbed by Sett’s R (The Show Stopper) suppresses you; Flash and Cleanse cannot remove it, but a removal item such as Mercurial Scimitar can. R’s damage scales with the grabbed target’s bonus health, making frontline champions who build health particularly vulnerable. While Sett has R available, stand together with your allies to leave him no space to throw you.

vs-sett-w.basis: Sett's W grows stronger the more damage he takes. Treat the moment right after using major abilities on Sett as when his W is most dangerous. After damaging Sett, back away and approach again once his Grit has fallen. If you cannot dodge all of W, move sideways to avoid the center line's true damage.
vs-sett-w.text: Sett’s W (Haymaker) grows stronger with the damage he takes, making the moment after you use major abilities on him especially dangerous. Once you have dealt damage, back away briefly to let his Grit decay before approaching again. If you cannot avoid W entirely, at least step sideways out of its center line to avoid the true damage.

vs-shaco-backstab.basis: Shaco deals much more damage when attacking a target from behind. If Shaco is nearby, put your back to a wall or face toward your allies to make it harder for him to get behind you.
vs-shaco-backstab.text: Shaco deals much more damage when he attacks from behind, and his first basic attack after Q Deceive’s stealth critically strikes from that position. If he is nearby, put your back to a wall or face your allies to make it harder for him to get behind you.

vs-shaco-box.basis: Assume W is in unwarded bushes and around objectives. W becomes invisible shortly after placement. Clear W in advance with Control Wards and Oracle Lens. If you cannot clear W, start the objective from a position where you have room to retreat even if feared. Starting an objective fight while feared by W disrupts Smite timing.
vs-shaco-box.text: Assume W Jack In The Box is waiting in bushes without vision and around objectives. It becomes invisible shortly after placement, so clear boxes in advance with Control Wards and Oracle Lens. If you cannot clear them, start the objective only from a position that gives you room to retreat if feared; fighting while feared can disrupt your Smite timing.

vs-shaco-clone.basis: The R clone takes increased damage and dies faster than Shaco. The R clone explodes when it dies and leaves three small boxes that trigger immediately. After killing the R clone, back away to avoid the explosion and fear. Watch how the health bars react to tell the R clone from Shaco.
vs-shaco-clone.text: The R Hallucinate clone takes increased damage and dies faster than Shaco, then explodes and leaves three small boxes that trigger immediately. Step back as soon as you kill it to avoid the explosion and fear. Watch how the health bars react to distinguish the clone from Shaco instead of pouring your damage into it.

vs-shaco-early.basis: Shaco is a jungler who gains advantages through early ganks and invades. Early on, avoid giving Shaco kills, take objectives, and buy time. Shaco's ability to win solo fights falls off late game. Keep vision at entrances to your jungle to stop Shaco's early ganks and invades.
vs-shaco-early.text: Shaco gains advantages through early ganks and invades rather than farming. Avoid giving him kills early, take objectives, and buy time: his ability to win solo fights falls off late game. Keeping vision at entrances to your jungle also disrupts much of his early plan.

vs-shaco-execute.basis: E deals much more damage when the target is low on health. If you have little health left after a fight, avoid unwarded jungle areas and bushes.
vs-shaco-execute.text: E Two-Shiv Poison deals much more damage to targets on low health, so a dagger from outside your vision can finish you after a fight. If you have little health left, avoid jungle areas and bushes without vision.

vs-shaco-q-commit.basis: Right after Shaco engages with Q, he cannot immediately use it again to escape. When Shaco appears after Q, focus him immediately with your allies. If you miss the opening right after Shaco engages with Q, he may recover and disappear out of vision again.
vs-shaco-q-commit.text: After Shaco engages with Q Deceive, he cannot immediately use it again to escape. Focus him with your allies as soon as he appears; that is the window to catch him before he recovers and disappears out of vision again.

vs-shen-e.basis: E is Shen's main tool for forcing control over opponents and moving during fights. Counterattack right after Shen misses E.
vs-shen-e.text: Shadow Dash (E) is Shen’s only mobility ability and his only hard crowd control. If you dodge it, he can neither close the gap nor escape, so counterattack as soon as it misses. If E taunts you, you’ll take his empowered basic attacks for the duration.

vs-shen-lane.basis: Shen ranks near the bottom in top lane laning stats, so he is likely to lose early trades. Against Shen, prioritize lane control over kills. Push the wave to keep Shen occupied with CS and make him lose out when he uses R to help another lane.
vs-shen-lane.text: Shen ranks near the bottom in top lane laning stats, making early trades favorable against him. Prioritize lane control over kills: push the wave to keep him occupied with CS, so using R to help another lane costs him his own. That creates a greater advantage for your team.

vs-shen-q.basis: Most of Shen's damage comes from basic attacks empowered by Q. How much Q empowers them depends on whether the returning spirit blade hits a champion. Step out of the spirit blade's path as it returns to Shen. Because Q's damage scales with maximum health, defensive items that only add health are less effective.
vs-shen-q.text: Most of Shen’s damage comes from basic attacks empowered by Twilight Assault (Q), and their strength depends on whether the returning spirit blade hits a champion. Step out of its path as it returns to Shen to greatly reduce Q’s damage. Because that damage scales with maximum health, defensive items that only add health are less effective against him.

vs-shen-r.basis: From level 6, Shen can join an ally anywhere on the map. If Shen disappears from lane or starts channeling R, alert your team immediately. Start a dive or fight only if you can finish it before Shen arrives. When Shen leaves with R, gain an advantage in his lane.
vs-shen-r.text: From level 6, Shen can join an ally anywhere on the map. If he disappears from lane or starts channeling R, alert your team immediately; finish a dive or fight before he arrives, or do not start it. When he uses R, his lane is completely empty, so take advantage there.

vs-shen-w.basis: Shen's W blocks basic attacks but does not block ability damage. As a marksman, keep your distance while W is active and attack again after the zone ends. Champions who rely on ability damage should keep using their abilities even when W is active.
vs-shen-w.text: Spirit’s Refuge (W) blocks basic attacks, but ability damage passes through. As a marksman, keep your distance while the zone is active and resume attacking when it ends; basic attacks during that time are wasted. Champions who deal damage with abilities can keep using them through the zone.

vs-shyvana-early.basis: At level 5 or below, Shyvana has no immobilizing crowd control, making it hard for her to secure kills with ganks. Early on, Shyvana quickly clears camps and takes objectives while building P stacks. Early on, steal Shyvana's jungle camps and take objectives first to prevent her from gaining P stacks.
vs-shyvana-early.text: At level 5 or below, Shyvana has no immobilizing crowd control, making gank kills difficult; instead, she quickly takes camps and objectives to build P Scalemail stacks. Invade early to steal her camps and take objectives first, denying those permanent stacks and exposing her low late-game health growth.

vs-shyvana-fury.basis: Shyvana's Fury gauge shows whether she can transform. Pressure Shyvana or start an objective when her Fury gauge is empty. If Shyvana's Fury gauge is full, do not start attacking an objective in front of her.
vs-shyvana-fury.text: Shyvana's Fury gauge shows whether she can transform. Pressure her or start an objective when the gauge is empty, her weakest moment; when it is full, do not start attacking an objective in front of her.

vs-shyvana-r-unstoppable.basis: Shyvana is unstoppable while flying with R, so crowd control cannot interrupt her entry. Apply crowd control after Shyvana lands with R. Fight back when her transformation ends and she loses the bonus health and empowered abilities.
vs-shyvana-r-unstoppable.text: Shyvana is unstoppable while flying with R Dragon's Descent, so crowd control cannot interrupt her entry. Apply it after she lands to hold her in place, then fight back when the transformation ends and she loses her bonus health and empowered abilities.

vs-shyvana-spread.basis: In dragon form, Shyvana can hit several enemies at once with R's path, W's explosion, and her piercing E. Spread out in teamfights to reduce Shyvana's area damage and healing.
vs-shyvana-spread.text: In dragon form, all of Shyvana’s abilities can hit multiple enemies at once. If two or more players stand where R’s path, W’s explosion, and her piercing E overlap, they give Shyvana both damage and healing. Spreading out in teamfights alone cuts her damage in half.

vs-singed-cc.basis: Attack Singed's teammates while Singed is tied down. Don't chase Singed all the way.
vs-singed-cc.text: Singed gets value by running close to the enemy team. Instead of committing several players to catch him, hold him in place with crowd control and attack his teammates while he is tied down. Chasing him all the way is exactly what he wants.

vs-singed-chase.basis: Don't chase Singed just because he looks low on health if you lack the damage to kill him for sure. Chasing Singed means stepping in the Q poison he leaves behind. If Singed has R active, Q's poison also reduces healing.
vs-singed-chase.text: Do not chase Singed just because he looks low on health. He leaves Q Poison Trail behind as he runs, and if R Insanity Potion is active, that poison also reduces healing. The pursuer is the one stepping in it, so let him go unless you have enough damage ready to kill him for certain.

vs-singed-early.basis: Take down Singed's health at levels 1–2, when his damage and mana are limited. Pressure Singed early to force him to recall. Once Singed has his core items, he becomes hard to kill and can keep pushing the lane.
vs-singed-early.text: Pressure Singed at levels 1–2, when his damage is weak and his mana runs out quickly. Lower his health and force him to recall early; if you fail to do so, his core items will make him extremely hard to kill, and he can keep pushing the lane.

vs-singed-glue.basis: You cannot use movement abilities while standing on W's adhesive. Before trying to dash away, check whether W is under your feet. Getting hit by E while on W roots you. Go around W instead of stepping on it.
vs-singed-glue.text: You cannot use movement abilities while standing on W Mega Adhesive. Before trying to dash away, check whether it is under your feet; getting hit by E Fling while on it also roots you, leaving you caught in the full combo. Go around the adhesive rather than stepping on it.

vs-singed-proxy.basis: Don't chase Singed behind the turret and fight him one-on-one in the jungle. If Singed is behind the turret, push the empty lane to pressure the turret. If Singed is behind the turret, move to another lane with your jungler to gain a numbers advantage.
vs-singed-proxy.text: If Singed disappears behind your turret, he is clearing the wave with Q Poison Trail. Chasing him into a one-on-one fight in the jungle favors him. Instead, push the empty lane to pressure the turret or move to another lane with your jungler to create a numbers advantage; Singed cannot create any pressure while he remains behind the turret.

vs-sion-passive.basis: After dying, Sion revives shortly afterward, attacks quickly, and deals damage based on maximum health. When Sion falls, reposition until his revival ends instead of continuing to fight there. Healing reduction is especially effective against Sion's increased life steal during his revival.
vs-sion-passive.text: Sion revives shortly after dying, attacks very quickly, and deals damage based on maximum health. When he falls, reposition until the revival ends instead of continuing to fight where he died. His life steal rises sharply during the revival, making healing reduction especially valuable then.

vs-sion-q.basis: Forcing Sion to release Q early removes its knockup and stun. Move sideways out of Q while Sion charges it. If you cannot dodge Q, get close to Sion and force him to stop charging.
vs-sion-q.text: Forcing Sion to release Q early denies its knockup and stun. His movement slows while he charges, so move sideways rather than backward to dodge most casts; if you cannot escape, get close and pressure him into releasing early to greatly reduce the damage.

vs-sion-r.basis: Sion's R travels almost straight and has limited steering. Sidestep Sion's R. Choose a route that avoids meeting Sion's R in narrow passages or along walls. Sion's R deals less damage and stuns for less time when he travels a shorter distance. If you must block Sion's R, intercept him right after he starts charging.
vs-sion-r.text: Sion's R travels almost straight and has limited steering, so sidestep it rather than running forward or backward, and avoid meeting him in narrow passages or along walls. Its damage and stun duration increase with distance; if you must block him, intercept him just after he starts charging.

vs-sion-scaling.basis: Sion permanently gains maximum health each time he kills a unit. Even if you cannot kill Sion, push the lane to disrupt his farming. While Sion farms, gain an advantage in another lane. Do not ignore Sion and let the game drag on.
vs-sion-scaling.text: Sion permanently gains maximum health whenever he kills a unit, so letting him keep farming makes him harder to face over time even if you cannot kill him. Push the lane to disrupt his farming or use that time to gain an advantage in another lane; ignoring him and letting the game drag on is the worst choice.

vs-sion-w.basis: Sion must wait a short time after activating W's shield before he can detonate it. Breaking W's shield first prevents the explosion. Focus damage on Sion right after he activates W to break the shield.
vs-sion-w.text: Sion must wait a short time after activating W's shield before he can detonate it. Breaking the shield first prevents the explosion, so focus your damage on him as soon as he activates W.

vs-sivir-e.basis: Sivir's E blocks one entire ability. Feint an engage to draw out E, then apply guaranteed crowd control. Do not immediately use a targeted engage ability while Sivir's E is ready.
vs-sivir-e.text: Sivir’s E Spell Shield completely blocks one ability. Repeatedly feint an engage and pull back to draw it out, then apply guaranteed crowd control. A targeted engage ability used without preparation while E is ready will simply be blocked.

vs-sivir-mobility.basis: Sivir has no teleporting mobility ability, only her passive movement speed. Prioritize diving Sivir when her E is down.
vs-sivir-mobility.text: Sivir has no teleporting mobility ability and relies only on the movement speed from her passive. When E Spell Shield is down, she is among the easiest marksmen to catch, so prioritize diving her.

vs-sivir-push.basis: Sivir clears waves quickly and will damage your turret if left alone in lane. Before leaving lane, push the wave or have another teammate ready to catch it. Keep Sivir in lane and create a numbers advantage elsewhere.
vs-sivir-push.text: Sivir’s wave clear is among the best, and leaving her alone in lane lets her damage your turret. Before leaving, push the wave or arrange for another teammate to catch it. Keeping Sivir tied to lane also lets you create a numbers advantage elsewhere.

vs-sivir-q.basis: Sivir's Q costs a lot of mana, so dodging it puts her at a disadvantage. If Q hits you on the way out, anticipate its return path and step aside.
vs-sivir-q.text: Sivir’s Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so dodging it puts her at a disadvantage. If it hits you on the way out, anticipate its return path and step off that line; she wants to hit you both ways.

vs-sivir-r.basis: When Sivir activates R, her entire team speeds up. Do not chase or retreat slowly while Sivir's R is active. While Sivir's R is active, take only short fights that use terrain and vision. Wait for Sivir's R to end.
vs-sivir-r.text: When Sivir activates R On The Hunt, her entire team speeds up, making a chase or slow retreat likely to end badly. While R is active, take only short fights that use terrain and vision, and wait for it to end.

vs-skarner-e.basis: Skarner's E passes through terrain, but it only stuns a caught target if he slams them into a wall. To avoid Skarner's E stun, do not stand with your back to a wall. If Skarner catches you with E in an open area, you are pushed but not stunned. If Skarner slams you into a wall with E, back away in anticipation of his next charge.
vs-skarner-e.text: Skarner's E charges through terrain but stuns a caught target only if he slams them into a wall. Avoid standing with your back to one: in open ground, E pushes you without stunning you. If he does land the wall hit, its cooldown drops sharply, so retreat with his next charge in mind.

vs-skarner-r-cleanse.basis: Skarner's R is not a channel, so stuns and silences cannot interrupt it. Carries facing Skarner should decide in advance whether to buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to remove R.
vs-skarner-r-cleanse.text: Skarner’s R suppresses its target, so movement abilities and most cleanses cannot break free. It is not a channel, either, and cannot be interrupted by stuns or silences. Quicksilver Sash and Mercurial Scimitar are effectively the only ways to remove it, so carries facing Skarner should decide in advance whether to include one in their build.

vs-skarner-range.basis: Skarner deals most of his damage when he stays close and stacks Quaking with Q empowered basic attacks. Stay outside melee range to avoid Skarner's Q empowered basic attacks.
vs-skarner-range.text: Skarner deals his damage by staying close and stacking Quaking with Q-empowered basic attacks. Outside melee range, only the recast rock throw can hit you. Positioning where he cannot catch you can cut the damage you take by at least half.

vs-skarner-scaling.basis: Because Skarner has abilities that use health and defensive stats, tank items increase both his damage and survivability. Take early jungle control and objectives to delay Skarner's item completions.
vs-skarner-scaling.text: Skarner's abilities scale with his health and defensive stats, so tank items increase both his damage and survivability. Given time, he becomes hard to kill while repeatedly locking targets down. Take early jungle control and objectives to delay his item completions.

vs-smolder-e.basis: E is Smolder's only escape that lets him cross terrain. Right after Smolder uses E is your chance to catch him. Save immobilizing crowd control and Flash until Smolder uses E. Smolder's E attacks focus on the enemy with the lowest health.
vs-smolder-e.text: E is Smolder's only escape over terrain, so the moment after he uses it is practically your only chance to catch him. Save immobilizing crowd control and Flash for that window. E also automatically attacks the enemy with the lowest health, so a low-health ally in front will draw its damage.

vs-smolder-early.basis: E is Smolder's only escape tool. Keep pressuring Smolder in the early and mid game so he cannot stay in lane. Make Smolder a priority target for jungle ganks.
vs-smolder-early.text: Smolder's level-one health and armor are among the lowest of any champion, and E is his only escape. Keep up the pressure in the early and mid game so he cannot stay in lane, and make him a top priority for jungle ganks.

vs-smolder-late.basis: The longer the game goes, the more it favors Smolder. Secure objectives and towers quickly to end the game in the mid game. If the game looks likely to go late, have a way to engage and kill Smolder as soon as a teamfight starts.
vs-smolder-late.text: The longer the game goes, the more it favors Smolder. Take objectives and towers quickly to end the game in the mid game; if it looks likely to go late, have a way to engage and kill him as soon as a teamfight starts.

vs-smolder-r.basis: Smolder's R deals much more damage at its center. Smolder heals when R's flames reach him. Move out of the R area beneath Smolder, then approach again.
vs-smolder-r.text: Smolder's R covers a wide area and deals much more damage at its center. Its flames also heal him when they reach him, so chasing into an R cast beneath his feet helps him recover. Move out of its area, then approach again.

vs-smolder-stacks.basis: Smolder grows permanently stronger each time he hits a champion with an ability or kills an enemy with Q. In lane, avoid Smolder's poke and deny him CS.
vs-smolder-stacks.text: Smolder grows permanently stronger whenever he hits a champion with an ability or kills an enemy with Q (Super Scorcher Breath). Avoiding his poke and denying him CS is the only way to weaken his late game, so disrupting his farming in lane is often more important than getting a kill.

vs-smolder-w.basis: Smolder's W explodes only when it hits a champion. Smolder gains the W stack only when he hits a champion with it. Stand behind minions or move sideways to dodge Smolder's W. If Smolder's W hits you, its slow leaves you open to a follow-up Q and basic attacks.
vs-smolder-w.text: Smolder's W explodes and grants a stack only when it hits a champion. Stand behind minions or move sideways to dodge it, denying him both damage and growth. Prioritize avoiding W: its slow leaves you exposed to a follow-up Q and basic attacks.

vs-sona-aura.basis: Sona's healing, shielding, and movement speed effects reach nearby allies through her auras. Separate Sona from her allies or push her back so her auras cannot reach them.
vs-sona-aura.text: Sona delivers healing, shields, and movement speed to nearby allies through her auras. Separate her from the group or push her back so those effects reach no one. Even if she survives, disrupting her position removes much of her team’s staying power.

vs-sona-e.basis: If Sona takes no damage, E's movement speed boost lasts longer. When targeting Sona, apply immobilizing crowd control first. Decide whether to chase the enemy team before Sona activates E.
vs-sona-e.text: E helps Sona escape, and its movement speed boost lasts longer if she takes no damage. When targeting her, apply immobilizing crowd control first; a slow alone is insufficient. If her team retreats, decide whether to chase before she activates E, which can cut off the pursuit.

vs-sona-heal.basis: Late game, Sona's auras keep healing her team, making them strong in long teamfights. Against Sona, make sure your team has at least one anti-heal item. Physical damage dealers can choose Executioner's Calling for anti-heal. Magic damage dealers can choose Morellonomicon for anti-heal.
vs-sona-heal.text: Late game, Sona can keep cycling auras to heal her team, making prolonged teamfights harder to turn around. Have at least one anti-heal item on your team: physical damage dealers can buy Executioner’s Calling, while magic damage dealers can buy Morellonomicon.

vs-sona-lane.basis: During laning, keep forcing trades so Sona has to spend mana on W. Look for the moment Sona steps forward to deliver an aura.
vs-sona-lane.text: Sona’s health and attack damage are among the lowest of all champions, and her abilities cost a lot of mana. Keep forcing trades in lane: using W (Aria of Perseverance) to heal through them will drain her mana first. The best time to catch her is when she steps forward to bring an aura to her allies.

vs-sona-powerchord.basis: After Sona uses basic abilities several times, her next basic attack is empowered. If Sona suddenly moves into basic attack range, watch for an empowered attack.
vs-sona-powerchord.text: After Sona uses basic abilities several times, her next basic attack is empowered. If she suddenly enters basic attack range, assume she has it ready and create distance before she attacks: depending on the ability she used immediately beforehand, the hit can deal bonus damage or slow you.

vs-sona-r.basis: Sona's R stuns every enemy in its line. When Sona is visible, spread out sideways instead of lining up with allies. Treat Sona stepping forward as a warning that she's about to cast R.
vs-sona-r.text: Sona’s R, Crescendo, travels in a straight line and stuns everyone it hits. When she is visible, spread sideways instead of lining up with allies. Its range is limited, so treat her stepping forward as a warning that she may cast it.

vs-soraka-e.basis: Soraka's E has a long cooldown. Engage when you see Soraka use E first. Use your engage ability before stepping into Soraka's E.
vs-soraka-e.text: Soraka's E has a long cooldown. If she uses it first to poke or push the wave, she has no way to stop an engage until it returns, so go in as soon as you see it used. Its area silences you, so use your engage ability before stepping into it.

vs-soraka-r.basis: Account for Soraka's R cooldown even when trying to get a kill in another lane. Damage dealt over time can be healed by a single cast of Soraka's R. Against a team with Soraka, deal your damage in a short burst.
vs-soraka-r.text: R heals all allies regardless of distance, so account for its cooldown even when looking for a kill in another lane. One cast can erase damage dealt gradually, but a short burst is harder to undo. Against a team with Soraka, do not split a kill attempt into smaller bursts.

vs-soraka-w.basis: During laning, pressure Soraka's marksman to force her to use W. Keep Soraka from landing Q to maintain pressure on her health.
vs-soraka-w.text: W heals by consuming Soraka's own health. In lane, keep pressuring her marksman to force heals; her health will fall, and below a certain threshold she cannot heal at all. Preventing her from landing Q is what keeps that pressure going.

vs-swain-e.basis: E's wave travels forward and then returns. Even if you dodge the first wave, stay out of its path until it disappears completely. If E roots you, its recast pulls you in and leaves you open to follow-up attacks.
vs-swain-e.text: E’s wave travels forward and then returns. Dodging the first pass is not enough: stay out of its path until it disappears completely, or the returning wave can root you. Swain can then recast E to pull you in and land the rest of his combo.

vs-swain-melee.basis: Melee champions without a ranged last-hit option lose a lot of CS to Swain's E pressure. As a melee champion without a ranged last-hit option, check summoner spell cooldowns and ward positions to create gank opportunities for your jungler.
vs-swain-melee.text: Melee champions without a ranged way to last-hit lose substantial CS to Swain’s E pressure. Instead of trying to win trades, check summoner spell cooldowns and ward positions to create a gank opportunity for your jungler.

vs-swain-mobility.basis: Swain has no dash or escape ability and has low movement speed. Gank or force a fight right after Swain uses E.
vs-swain-mobility.text: Swain has no mobility or escape ability and moves slowly. If you dodge his E root, he cannot get away, so gank or force a fight right after he uses E.

vs-swain-q.basis: Q hits with more overlapping bolts up close and fewer from farther away. In lane, stay near Q's maximum range while last-hitting.
vs-swain-q.text: Q fires several bolts that overlap up close, while only one hits from far away. Keeping your distance sharply reduces Swain’s poke damage, so last-hit near the edge of Q’s range in lane.

vs-swain-r.basis: R stays active only while it drains nearby enemies, and Swain keeps healing during that time. When Swain activates R, leave its range and fight again after his ultimate ends.
vs-swain-r.text: R stays active by draining nearby enemies, healing Swain as it does. When he transforms, leave its range rather than continuing to fight beside him; wait for his ultimate to end before reengaging.

vs-swain-sustain.basis: Swain permanently increases his maximum health by hitting champions with abilities and keeps healing with R. Take lane priority early to slow Swain's growth. Late in the game, apply Grievous Wounds to Swain before fighting him.
vs-swain-sustain.text: Swain permanently increases his maximum health by hitting champions with abilities and heals continually with R. He grows tougher over time, so take lane priority early to limit his growth, then apply Grievous Wounds before engaging him in late-game fights.

vs-sylas-e.basis: Sylas's E has two stages: a dash followed by a thrown chain. E's first dash deals no damage. If E's second chain hits you, Sylas pulls himself to you, knocks you up, and hits you with a combo. Use mobility abilities and Flash to avoid E's second chain, not its first dash.
vs-sylas-e.text: Sylas's E has two stages: a dash that deals no damage, followed by a thrown chain. If the chain hits you, Sylas pulls himself to you, knocks you up, and lands his full combo, so time mobility abilities and Flash to dodge the second-stage chain rather than the initial dash.

vs-sylas-early.basis: Before level 6, Sylas is weak because of his short range and tight mana supply. Take lane control and push before level 6 to disrupt Sylas's farming.
vs-sylas-early.text: Before level 6, Sylas is weak because of his short range and tight mana supply. Take control of the lane and push during this window to severely disrupt his farming.

vs-sylas-q.basis: Sylas's Q explodes after a short delay where the chains cross. Even if the first chain clips you, move out of the crossing point immediately to avoid the explosion.
vs-sylas-q.text: Sylas's Q explodes after a short delay where the chains cross. Even if the first chain clips you, leave the crossing point immediately to avoid most of the damage.

vs-sylas-teamfight.basis: Sylas is fragile and most vulnerable just after diving in with E. When Sylas engages with E, crowd control and attack him before he can heal with W.
vs-sylas-teamfight.text: Sylas is fragile and most vulnerable just after diving in with E. Crowd control and attack him as he engages so he goes down before he can heal with W.

vs-sylas-ult.basis: Sylas uses R to copy an enemy's ultimate. If you have a fight-turning ultimate, use it before Sylas uses R. If you have a fight-turning ultimate, keep your distance so Sylas cannot get in range to steal it.
vs-sylas-ult.text: Sylas uses R to copy an enemy's ultimate. If yours can turn a fight, use it before Sylas activates R or keep your distance so he cannot get in range to steal it.

vs-sylas-w.basis: The more health Sylas is missing, the more W heals him. If you have a way to reduce healing, use it just before Sylas lands W.
vs-sylas-w.text: The more health Sylas is missing, the more W heals him. If you bring him down to half health but delay finishing him, a single W can bring him back; apply healing reduction just before it lands if you have it.

vs-syndra-boots.basis: Syndra's Q, W, and E are untargeted abilities placed on or thrown at the ground. Buying boots early for movement speed lets you dodge many of Syndra's Q, W, and E abilities by walking.
vs-syndra-boots.text: Syndra's Q, W, and E are untargeted abilities placed on or thrown at the ground. Buying boots early gives you the movement speed to dodge many of them by walking.

vs-syndra-dive.basis: Syndra has no mobility ability. If your champion can close the gap, check whether Syndra's E is on cooldown before engaging.
vs-syndra-dive.text: Syndra has some of the lowest health and armor and no mobility ability. If your champion can close the gap, engaging when her E is on cooldown can be enough to win the lane.

vs-syndra-e.basis: E has a long cooldown. Syndra relies on E to defend herself. Syndra is most vulnerable immediately after using E. Close in immediately after Syndra uses E.
vs-syndra-e.text: E has a long cooldown and is Syndra's only defensive ability, leaving her most vulnerable immediately after she uses it. Close in at that moment.

vs-syndra-maxrank.basis: Syndra's abilities gain additional effects when maxed. Syndra's ability effects change when they reach max rank. When an ability's visual effect changes, adjust your spacing to account for a change in its power or range.
vs-syndra-maxrank.text: Syndra's abilities gain additional effects and change visually when they reach max rank. When an ability's visual effect changes, reassess your spacing to account for its different power or range.

vs-syndra-orb-stun.basis: Syndra's stun comes from a Dark Sphere pushed by E. If a sphere is near you or between you and Syndra, you risk being stunned. When you see a sphere, move out of the path it will be pushed along.
vs-syndra-orb-stun.text: Syndra's stun comes from a Dark Sphere pushed by E, rather than E alone. If a sphere is near you or between you and Syndra, she has an angle to stun you, so move out of the path it would take when pushed.

vs-syndra-orbs-ult.basis: R also fires spheres on the field. R becomes more dangerous when many spheres are on the field. If several Q spheres are in an area, either engage and accept the risk of R or move elsewhere.
vs-syndra-orbs-ult.text: R also fires spheres on the field, making areas with many spheres especially dangerous. If Syndra has placed several Q spheres in an area, either enter prepared to take her ultimate or move elsewhere.

vs-tahmkench-e.basis: Some damage dealt to Tahm Kench is stored as gray health and returns as a shield or healing. Instead of trading small hits and backing off, engage when you can focus him down and kill him in one go. Grievous Wounds reduces how much stored gray health returns as healing. Buy Executioner’s Calling or Morellonomicon early, depending on your scaling.
vs-tahmkench-e.text: Some damage dealt to Tahm Kench is stored as gray health and comes back as a shield or healing, making small trades followed by a retreat largely pointless. Engage only when you can focus him down and kill him in one go. Grievous Wounds reduces how much stored gray health returns as healing, so buy Executioner’s Calling or Morellonomicon early, whichever suits your scaling.

vs-tahmkench-r-ally.basis: An enemy swallowed by Tahm Kench cannot be targeted and gains a shield after being spat out. Before using a targeted finishing ability, check whether Tahm Kench still has R. When an enemy is swallowed, keep up pressure with untargeted area abilities. When an enemy is swallowed, also look for a chance to stop Tahm Kench himself.
vs-tahmkench-r-ally.text: An enemy swallowed by Tahm Kench cannot be targeted while inside him and gains a shield after being spat out. Before committing targeted finishing abilities, check whether his R (Devour) is available. If he swallows your target, keep up pressure with untargeted area abilities or stop Tahm Kench himself first.

vs-tahmkench-r-enemy.basis: While an ally is swallowed, Tahm Kench is rooted in place and heavily slowed. If an ally is swallowed, stay together and focus Tahm Kench to interrupt the swallow.
vs-tahmkench-r-enemy.text: While your ally is swallowed, Tahm Kench is rooted and heavily slowed. Stay together and focus your damage on him to interrupt the swallow as quickly as possible.

vs-tahmkench-stacks.basis: After three hits from Tahm Kench’s basic attacks and Q, you are in range of both a stun and a swallow. If you have two stacks, move out of range and wait for them to expire. Tahm Kench poses little threat without stacks.
vs-tahmkench-stacks.text: Three hits from Tahm Kench’s basic attacks and Q (Tongue Lash) open up both a stun and a swallow. If you have two stacks, move out of range and wait for them to expire; he poses little threat without stacks.

vs-tahmkench-target.basis: Focus untargeted damage on the carry Tahm Kench is protecting. When attacking the carry, account for Tahm Kench’s R giving them another chance to survive if it is available.
vs-tahmkench-target.text: Trying to kill Tahm Kench first is usually a losing trade: he has high health and defensive stats, along with several ways to heal. It is better to ignore him and focus untargeted damage on the carry he protects, while accounting for the extra chance to survive that his R gives the carry when it is available.

vs-tahmkench-w.basis: When Tahm Kench dives, his landing spot is briefly hidden. When you see the dive animation, spread out so W cannot knock up several of you. Without W, Tahm Kench has trouble both engaging and escaping.
vs-tahmkench-w.text: When Tahm Kench uses W (Abyssal Dive), his landing spot is briefly hidden. As soon as you see the dive animation, spread out so the area knockup cannot catch several of you. Without W, he has trouble both engaging and escaping.

vs-taliyah-dash.basis: Before dashing at Taliyah, check whether E's rocks are on the ground. Dashing across E's rocks stuns you. If E is placed, walk in or go around the rocks to engage.
vs-taliyah-dash.text: Before dashing at Taliyah, check for E’s rocks on the ground. Dashing across them stuns you and leaves you exposed to her full combo. If the rocks are there, walk in or approach from an angle that goes around them.

vs-taliyah-e-w.basis: If Taliyah places E nearby, W may follow soon. If W pushes you across E's rocks, you are stunned. When E is placed, move away from the rocks. The space between the rocks and Taliyah is the most dangerous place to be pushed into them by W.
vs-taliyah-e-w.text: If Taliyah places E (Unraveled Earth) nearby, expect W (Seismic Shove) immediately afterward. Move away from the rocks as soon as E appears: W will stun you if it pushes you across them, and standing between the rocks and Taliyah is the most dangerous position.

vs-taliyah-q-dodge.basis: Taliyah's Q only flies in the cast direction and cannot change direction midflight. To dodge Q, sidestep instead of moving in a straight line.
vs-taliyah-q-dodge.text: Taliyah’s Q flies only in its cast direction and cannot turn midflight. Approaching or fleeing from her in a straight line lets the shards hit you, while a step to the side makes most of them miss.

vs-taliyah-r.basis: Taliyah cannot use R if she recently took damage from a champion or structure. Keep dealing damage to stop Taliyah from escaping with R. If you have not damaged Taliyah yet, chase with the possibility that she may escape using R's wall in mind.
vs-taliyah-r.text: Taliyah cannot use R if she recently took damage from a champion or structure. Keep dealing damage to stop her from escaping with it. If you have not damaged her yet, pursue with the possibility that she could put up a wall and escape at any moment.

vs-taliyah-roam.basis: Taliyah can quickly reach distant fights with Rock Surfing's speed near walls and her R. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, back off early in case she is heading to another lane.
vs-taliyah-roam.text: Rock Surfing’s speed near walls and R let Taliyah reach fights across the map quickly. If she disappears from the jungle, consider that she may be heading to another lane rather than a nearby camp, and back off early.

vs-taliyah-squishy.basis: Taliyah has no healing or shielding ability of her own. Taliyah is easily killed when affected by crowd control that prevents movement. Against Taliyah, spend your resources creating an opening to close in on her instead of absorbing her combo.
vs-taliyah-squishy.text: Taliyah’s health and armor are among the lowest in the game, and she has no healing or shielding ability of her own. A single movement disabling crowd control effect can leave her easy to kill, so spend your resources creating an opening to close in on her rather than absorbing her combo.

vs-talon-armor.basis: All of Talon's damage is physical. To reduce Talon's burst damage, buy an inexpensive armor item such as Cloth Armor early. Against Talon, prioritize armor over magic resistance or health.
vs-talon-armor.text: All of Talon's damage is physical, so even one inexpensive armor item such as Cloth Armor noticeably reduces his burst early on. Prioritize armor over magic resistance or health when facing him.

vs-talon-early.basis: Around level 2, Talon deals enough damage to get first blood in a single trade. Around level 2, stay back and farm safely behind your minions. Push the wave first so Talon does not level up before you.
vs-talon-early.text: Around level 2, Talon can deal enough damage in one trade to secure first blood. Stay back and farm safely behind your minions during that window, and push the wave first so he does not level up before you.

vs-talon-late.basis: Talon's impact falls off in the late game. In the late game, Talon can easily die where he engages even if he kills one backline target. Group up for late-game teamfights. Layer crowd control as soon as Talon engages.
vs-talon-late.text: Talon's impact falls off as the game goes on. In late-game fights, group up and layer crowd control as soon as he engages: even if he kills a backline target, he can easily die on the spot, making the trade favorable. The longer the game goes, the less it favors Talon.

vs-talon-r.basis: Talon relies heavily on R's invisibility to leave a fight. Look to counterattack after Talon has used R. Do not chase Talon too far while he has R, as he can use invisibility to evade pursuit and counterattack.
vs-talon-r.text: Talon relies heavily on R's invisibility to escape fights, so counterattack once you confirm he has used it. Avoid chasing too far while R is available: he can disappear, evade pursuit, and kill you instead.

vs-talon-roam.basis: Talon roams very quickly because he can cross terrain. Keep your allies informed of Talon's location. Establish vision along jungle routes to prevent Talon's ambushes. Push the lane to make Talon return to farm. Clear enemy vision with a Control Ward to gather information for a counterattack on Talon.
vs-talon-roam.text: Talon roams exceptionally quickly by crossing terrain. Keep your allies informed of his location and establish vision along jungle routes to prevent ambushes. Pushing the lane can force him back to farm, while clearing enemy vision with a Control Ward can give you the information to catch him instead.

vs-talon-w.basis: Talon must land both hits of W to complete his Blade's End stacks. Dodging W's return hit prevents substantial damage and the Blade's End bleed from triggering. If W's first hit lands, make leaving its return path your top priority.
vs-talon-w.text: Talon needs both the outgoing and returning hits of W to complete his Blade's End stacks. Dodging the return prevents a substantial share of the damage and the bleed, so if the first hit lands, make getting out of the blades' return path your top priority.

vs-taric-bravado.basis: Taric reduces his ability cooldowns with Bravado basic attacks. Kite Taric or knock him away with an airborne effect so he cannot reach a target to basic attack. Manage the wave to keep Taric away from minions and slow down his ability rotation.
vs-taric-bravado.text: Bravado basic attacks reduce all of Taric’s ability cooldowns. Kite him or displace him with a knock-up so he cannot reach anything to attack; denying those two attacks noticeably slows his ability rotation and delays his next E and Q. Managing the wave to keep him away from minions has the same effect.

vs-taric-e.basis: Taric's E activates after a delay and has a clear warning. When Taric's E is telegraphed, move sideways to dodge it. Bait out Taric's E, then poke and trade from range.
vs-taric-e.text: Taric’s E has a clear warning before its delayed stun activates, and a step sideways can dodge it. Once E is down, he has no way to reach you and is exposed to ranged poke. Bait it out, then poke and trade during that window.

vs-taric-r-cc.basis: Taric's R damage immunity does not prevent crowd control. Use crowd control to hold enemies in place while their damage immunity wears down. While they are immune to damage, manage your positioning and crowd control, then attack again as soon as it ends.
vs-taric-r-cc.text: Taric’s R blocks damage but not crowd control. If an enemy becomes invulnerable, hold them with crowd control while its duration runs out. Manage positioning and crowd control instead of dealing damage during the invulnerability, then attack as soon as it ends.

vs-taric-w.basis: Taric's abilities also activate from the position of the ally linked by W. Treat the area around an enemy linked by W as a place where E may activate. If an enemy linked by W dashes in, be ready for E to activate from their position.
vs-taric-w.text: Taric’s abilities also activate from the position of the ally linked by W, so judging distance from Taric alone can leave you in range of a stun from that ally. Treat the area around the linked champion as dangerous, especially if they dash in: E may activate from their position as they reach you.

vs-teemo-brush.basis: Teemo remains stealthed even while moving within brush. Teemo gains attack speed the moment his stealth breaks, giving him an edge at the start of trades. Go around unwarded brush instead of carelessly walking past it. Wait for Teemo to leave the brush, then retaliate.
vs-teemo-brush.text: Teemo can stay stealthed while moving inside brush, then gain attack speed as soon as stealth breaks, giving him an early edge in a trade. Avoid walking past brush without vision: use a control ward or take another route, and wait until he comes out before retaliating.

vs-teemo-e.basis: Teemo's E keeps dealing poison damage even if you back off after taking a single auto. Stay outside Teemo's auto attack range until you are ready to fully commit. Once you decide to engage Teemo, close the distance in one go and commit to the fight.
vs-teemo-e.text: A single Teemo auto leaves E Toxic Shot’s poison ticking even if you back away, so brief hit and retreat trades favor him. Stay outside his auto range until you are ready to commit; once you engage, close the distance in one move and stay on him.

vs-teemo-mobility.basis: Teemo relies on W to escape. Push the lane, then engage Teemo with your jungler. Build an early lead to limit Teemo's time to place mushrooms.
vs-teemo-mobility.text: Teemo has low defensive stats and movement speed, and W Move Quick is his only way to escape. Push the lane and engage him with your jungler; an early lead can deny him the time to place mushrooms. Give him that time, and half the map becomes his territory.

vs-teemo-q.basis: Teemo's Q only blocks basic attacks and does not prevent ability use. When blinded by Q, deal damage with abilities instead of autos or retreat until the blind ends. Auto attack-focused champions should trade right after Teemo uses Q.
vs-teemo-q.text: Teemo’s Q Blinding Dart stops basic attacks but leaves abilities usable. If blinded, deal damage with abilities or retreat until it ends instead of trying to auto. Champions that rely on autos should trade immediately after Teemo uses Q; engaging while it is available lets him use its cooldown to deny their damage.

vs-teemo-r.basis: Use Oracle Lens to clear mushrooms from key routes. Move as though there are mushrooms in front of objectives and in narrow passages. When retreating, be wary of mushrooms and avoid running through familiar shortcuts. Teemo's mushrooms persist for a long time, even those placed long ago.
vs-teemo-r.text: Use Oracle Lens to clear mushrooms from key routes. Assume they are planted around objectives and in narrow passages, and avoid familiar shortcuts when retreating. Mushrooms last a long time, so even ones placed well before the fight may still be there.

vs-tf-cancel.basis: Twisted Fate's R teleport is canceled by interrupting effects. If you see Twisted Fate activate R and he is in range, interrupt his teleport with crowd control. If you can predict where R will land, secure vision there in advance and wait.
vs-tf-cancel.text: Interrupting effects cancel Twisted Fate’s R (Destiny) teleport. If you see him activate R while he is in range, use crowd control to stop the move; if you can predict his landing spot, secure vision there in advance and wait.

vs-tf-card.basis: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card, stay out of his auto-attack range. You can approach more safely when he is holding a blue or red card.
vs-tf-card.text: Watch the color of the card in Twisted Fate’s hand. If he has locked in gold, stay out of auto-attack range or one hit will stun you; you can approach more safely when he holds blue or red.

vs-tf-q.basis: Only one card from Twisted Fate's Q can hit a single target. Stand behind minions to reduce Q poke damage.
vs-tf-q.text: Only one card from Twisted Fate’s Q (Wild Cards) can hit a single target. Stand behind minions so they catch the card first and greatly reduce his poke damage.

vs-tf-ult.basis: After level 6, watch for an R roam if Twisted Fate disappears from lane or pushes it quickly. Tell your team immediately when Twisted Fate activates R. When Twisted Fate activates R, retreat under the turret in any lane at risk.
vs-tf-ult.text: After level 6, Twisted Fate disappearing from lane or pushing it quickly signals an R (Destiny) roam. When he activates R, he gains vision of the entire map, so tell your team immediately and have any lane at risk retreat under its turret.

vs-thresh-e.basis: Thresh's E pushes or pulls enemies in the direction he sweeps. Avoid the line connecting Thresh and his allies so E cannot pull you in.
vs-thresh-e.text: Flay (E) pushes or pulls enemies in the direction Thresh sweeps. Stay off the line between him and his allies to avoid being pulled in.

vs-thresh-lantern.basis: Thresh's W is used to rescue allies in danger or bring in reinforcements. When Thresh throws W, immediately use a finishing ability or disengage.
vs-thresh-lantern.text: Thresh can use Dark Passage (W) to rescue an ally in danger or bring in reinforcements, so when he throws its lantern, immediately use a finishing ability or disengage.

vs-thresh-mobility.basis: Thresh has limited ways to escape a fight on his own. Close the gap and engage right after Thresh uses Q.
vs-thresh-mobility.text: Thresh has limited ways to escape on his own, so close the gap and engage immediately after he uses Death Sentence (Q).

vs-thresh-q.basis: Thresh's Q has a long windup. Move sideways immediately when you see Thresh raise his scythe during Q's windup. When facing Thresh, change direction from side to side to dodge Q. When stepping forward to last-hit, change direction once more in anticipation of Q.
vs-thresh-q.text: Thresh's Death Sentence (Q) has a long windup, so move sideways as soon as you see him raise his scythe. Keep changing direction while facing him, and turn once more when stepping forward to last-hit in anticipation of Q.

vs-thresh-r.basis: Once one R wall breaks, the remaining walls deal no damage. Once one R wall breaks, the slow duration of the remaining walls is halved. If trapped in R, immediately decide which way to escape. The tankiest ally deliberately breaks through one R wall.
vs-thresh-r.text: Once one wall of The Box (R) breaks, the others deal no damage and their slow duration is halved. If trapped, immediately choose an escape route and have the tankiest ally deliberately break through one wall.

vs-thresh-souls.basis: Much of Thresh's armor and damage depends on collecting souls. Trade with Thresh when he steps forward to collect souls.
vs-thresh-souls.text: Much of Thresh's armor and damage depends on collected souls, so trade with him when he steps forward to pick them up.

vs-tristana-late.basis: Aim to end the game before Tristana completes her build. Ambush Tristana when she pushes the lane and moves up to pressure the turret. When Tristana disappears from vision, first check whether she might be pushing a turret elsewhere.
vs-tristana-late.text: Tristana is difficult to handle with a completed build, so aim to end the game before she reaches it. Ambush her when she pushes the lane and moves up to pressure a turret; if she disappears from vision, first consider whether she is pushing a turret elsewhere.

vs-tristana-w-cc.basis: Interrupt Tristana with crowd control while she is airborne during W. If Tristana has both W and R ready, engage only when you have crowd control that can hold her.
vs-tristana-w-cc.text: W Rocket Jump is a slow dash that crowd control can interrupt while Tristana is airborne. If she has both W and R Buster Shot ready, engage only when you have crowd control available to hold her in place.

vs-tristana-w-reset.basis: If an ally falls and your team is losing a teamfight, retreat immediately. When retreating, do not leave a squishy ally in front.
vs-tristana-w-reset.text: Tristana’s W Rocket Jump resets on every takedown, allowing her to keep jumping in. If an ally falls in a teamfight, staying put can lead to more teammates being picked off, so retreat as soon as your team starts losing ground. Do not leave a squishy ally at the front as you withdraw.

vs-trundle-duel.basis: Trundle is very strong in one on one fights after getting R. Do not face Trundle alone in a side lane. Against Trundle, who lacks area damage, steer the game toward five on five fights at objectives.
vs-trundle-duel.text: Trundle has strong base attack damage from level one and becomes very powerful in one on one fights after getting R. Facing him alone in a side lane is a common way to lose; because his lack of area damage limits his teamfight contribution, steer the game toward five on five fights at objectives.

vs-trundle-e.basis: Fight Trundle in open terrain, away from the river and jungle entrances. When Trundle places E, move sideways immediately before its slow makes escape difficult.
vs-trundle-e.text: E creates impassable terrain that can cut off your retreat completely in a narrow path. Fight Trundle in open ground rather than at river or jungle entrances. When the pillar appears, move sideways immediately; its surrounding slow makes escape harder the longer you wait.

vs-trundle-q.basis: Trundle's Q raises his attack damage and lowers the target's attack damage. If you fight with physical damage, back off right after Q hits you and reengage when its effect ends.
vs-trundle-q.text: Trundle's Q raises his attack damage while reducing the target's. For a champion who relies on physical damage, the few seconds immediately after being hit are the worst time to trade, so back off and reengage once the effect ends.

vs-trundle-r.basis: The more health and defensive stats a champion has, the worse they fare against Trundle's R. Frontliners should not face Trundle alone. While Trundle's R is active, attack another target or create distance.
vs-trundle-r.text: R deals damage based on the target’s maximum health while stealing armor and magic resistance, so champions with more health and defensive stats are especially vulnerable to it. Frontliners should not face Trundle alone. He is toughest while R is active; attack another target or create distance until it ends.

vs-trundle-sustain.basis: Trundle heals whenever an enemy unit dies nearby. If you have lowered Trundle's health, capitalize on it immediately or push the lane to force him to recall.
vs-trundle-sustain.text: Trundle heals whenever an enemy unit dies nearby. A large clashing wave gives him so much sustain that poking him down and extending the lane will not work. Once you lower his health, capitalize immediately or push the lane to force a recall.

vs-trundle-w.basis: Do not fight Trundle inside his W area. Back out of W's area and reengage after it expires.
vs-trundle-w.text: Trundle is strongest inside W, where he gains attack speed, movement speed, and increased healing received. Do not fight him there: back out, let W expire, then reengage.

vs-tryndamere-armor.basis: Most of Tryndamere's damage is physical and relies on critical strikes. Building armor can greatly change how a duel with Tryndamere plays out. Thornmail exploits Tryndamere's reliance on basic attacks. If you build no armor at all, you will lose to Tryndamere regardless of the item difference.
vs-tryndamere-armor.text: Most of Tryndamere’s damage is physical and depends on critical strikes, so building armor can greatly change the duel. Thornmail directly counters his reliance on basic attacks; with no armor at all, you lose to him regardless of the item difference.

vs-tryndamere-e.basis: To take down Tryndamere, draw him into terrain without minions. Land immobilizing crowd control right after Tryndamere uses E.
vs-tryndamere-e.text: Each critical strike reduces E’s cooldown, so Tryndamere can use it almost continuously in a minion wave. Trying to catch him among many minions means he’ll keep slipping away; draw him into terrain without minions, or land immobilizing crowd control right after he uses E.

vs-tryndamere-early.basis: Early on, deny Tryndamere last hits to reduce his Fury and Q healing. If Tryndamere builds Fury by hitting minions, create distance before he closes in.
vs-tryndamere-early.text: Deny Tryndamere last hits early to limit his Fury, which also reduces his critical strike chance and Q healing. If you see him hitting minions to build Fury, create distance before he engages.

vs-tryndamere-r.basis: While Tryndamere's R is active, he cannot die until it expires. When Tryndamere activates R, stall with immobilizing crowd control or create distance. Tryndamere can use R even while under crowd control.
vs-tryndamere-r.text: Tryndamere cannot die while R is active, so pouring more damage into him during its duration is a waste. Stall with immobilizing crowd control or create distance instead, but remember that he can activate R even while under crowd control.

vs-tryndamere-splitpush.basis: If Tryndamere has R available, sending one person to stop him in a side lane can easily cost you that player. Check Tryndamere's R cooldown before going to take him down. If Tryndamere has R available, trade for an objective or send more players to stop him.
vs-tryndamere-splitpush.text: Sending one player to stop Tryndamere in a side lane while his R is available will only cost you that player. Check his R cooldown before trying to take him down; if it’s available, trade for an objective or send enough players to stop him.

vs-tryndamere-w.basis: W only slows enemies whose backs are turned to Tryndamere. When retreating, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid W's slow. W reduces attack damage regardless of which way the enemy is facing. Do not take a basic attack fight right after W hits you.
vs-tryndamere-w.text: W only slows enemies whose backs are turned to Tryndamere, so walk backward while facing him when you retreat. Its attack damage reduction applies regardless of direction, so avoid a basic attack fight immediately after W hits you.

vs-twitch-fragile.basis: Attack Twitch when his camouflage ends or while he positions with R active. Focus your team's attacks on Twitch at the same time.
vs-twitch-fragile.text: Twitch has low health and armor. Save targeted crowd control for the moment his camouflage ends or he positions with R active, then coordinate with your team to focus him all at once.

vs-twitch-poison.basis: Building armor does not reduce Deadly Venom's true damage. A spell shield does not block Deadly Venom's damage over time itself. A spell shield only blocks effects triggered through Deadly Venom. Take fewer basic attacks from Twitch to limit Deadly Venom.
vs-twitch-poison.text: Armor does not reduce Deadly Venom’s true damage, and a spell shield does not stop its damage over time; it only blocks effects triggered through Deadly Venom. Even with Banshee’s Veil, limit how many basic attacks Twitch lands.

vs-twitch-r-line.basis: With R active, Twitch's basic attacks pierce enemies in front and hit damage dealers behind them. Spread out sideways relative to the direction Twitch is firing with R. Twitch's range increases during R, so he can hit you from distances that are normally safe.
vs-twitch-r-line.text: With R (Spray and Pray) active, Twitch’s basic attacks pierce enemies, hitting damage dealers behind the front line if you stand in a row. Spread sideways relative to his firing direction, and account for the extra range: distances that are normally safe may no longer be safe.

vs-twitch-w.basis: W's poison cloud slows enemies and applies Deadly Venom stacks. Leave W's poison cloud immediately if it lands beneath you. The longer you stay in W's poison cloud, the more Deadly Venom stacks you gain and the greater the risk of E finishing you.
vs-twitch-w.text: W (Venom Cask) leaves a poison cloud that slows you and adds Deadly Venom stacks. If it lands beneath you, leave immediately instead of staying to deal a little more damage. The longer you remain in it, the more stacks you gain and the easier it becomes for E (Contaminate) to finish you.

vs-twitch-ward.basis: Use a Control Ward to reveal Twitch's camouflage. Camouflaged Twitch is also revealed if you get very close to him. Go around brush or narrow paths without vision, or reveal them first. Tell other lanes when Twitch disappears from lane.
vs-twitch-ward.text: Use a Control Ward to reveal Twitch’s camouflage, and remember that getting very close also reveals him. Avoid walking blindly through brush or narrow paths: go around or establish vision first. If Twitch disappears from lane, assume he may already be moving behind another lane and alert your teammates.

vs-udyr-e-stun.basis: E’s stun triggers only on the first attack against each target after activating the stance and cannot stun the same target again for a while. After taking one E stun, counterattack or disengage. Udyr’s stun is ready immediately after he activates E stance again.
vs-udyr-e-stun.text: E (Blazing Stampede) stuns each target only on its first hit after the stance is activated and cannot stun the same target again for a while. Once you have taken the stun, use that window to counterattack or disengage. Expect the stun to be ready whenever Udyr activates E again.

vs-udyr-mobility.basis: Udyr’s high movement speed and E’s speed boost make him hard to outrun on foot. Save a mobility ability or immobilizing crowd control when facing Udyr. Apply immobilizing crowd control after Awakened E ends.
vs-udyr-mobility.text: Udyr has one of the highest movement speeds among champions, and E (Blazing Stampede) makes him faster, so you cannot escape by simply running. Save a mobility ability or immobilizing crowd control, and apply the crowd control after Awakened E ends, since immobilizing effects do not work during it.

vs-udyr-range.basis: Udyr must get close to enemies to deal damage. Ranged champions should wear Udyr down before he approaches. When harassing Udyr, save a way to disengage if he gets close.
vs-udyr-range.text: Udyr must get close to deal damage. As a ranged champion, your only advantage is to wear him down before he reaches you, while always keeping a way to disengage if he closes the gap.

vs-udyr-tank.basis: Udyr becomes very durable when he builds defensive items and adds his W shield. Against a durable Udyr, take out his vulnerable teammates behind him first, then use your numbers advantage to kill him.
vs-udyr-tank.text: Defensive items combined with W (Iron Mantle) make Udyr very durable. Against such a build, take out the vulnerable teammates behind him first, then use your numbers advantage to kill him.

vs-udyr-tracking.basis: Place vision at key routes and jungle entrances to track Udyr’s path. Do not step forward in lane while Udyr is out of sight.
vs-udyr-tracking.text: Udyr starts in the jungle and shows himself only when ganking. Place vision along key routes and at jungle entrances to track his path, and do not move forward in lane while he is out of sight.

vs-udyr-w.basis: Pressure Udyr when his W shield breaks to force him to switch stances. After breaking the W shield, give Udyr no time to heal.
vs-udyr-w.text: Udyr is noticeably weaker after his W (Iron Mantle) shield breaks. Press the attack instead of backing away, forcing him to switch stances without giving him time to heal.

vs-urgot-e.basis: Urgot's E cannot cross terrain and stops at the first champion it hits. Urgot's E pushes minions aside as he passes through them. Have your frontline stand in front of your damage dealers to block Urgot's E. Stand near walls to limit Urgot's E engage angles.
vs-urgot-e.text: Urgot’s E cannot cross terrain and stops at the first champion it hits. It pushes through minions, but a frontline champion standing ahead of a damage dealer prevents E from reaching the dealer. Standing near a wall also greatly limits his engage angles.

vs-urgot-legs.basis: Leg cannons, which account for most of Urgot's damage, deal damage based on maximum health. Each leg cannon has its own cooldown. Stay outside Urgot's short range to avoid prolonged exposure to his leg cannons.
vs-urgot-legs.text: Most of Urgot’s damage comes from his leg cannons, which deal damage based on maximum health and hurt durable champions too. Each cannon has its own cooldown, so the longer you stay near him, the more damage adds up. Stay outside his short range instead of repeatedly moving in and out.

vs-urgot-q.basis: Urgot's Q applies such a strong slow that it is hard to escape on foot. When you see Q coming, decide immediately whether to use a mobility ability. If Q has already hit you, judge whether standing your ground and fighting back is better than fleeing. If Urgot's Q hits you, you become W's priority target.
vs-urgot-q.text: Urgot’s Q slows so strongly that you cannot escape on foot after it hits. Decide immediately whether to use a mobility ability when you see it coming; if it has already hit, fighting back where you stand is often better than trying to flee. Q also marks you as W’s priority target, focusing its fire on you.

vs-urgot-r.basis: If your health falls below the execution threshold after R hits you, you are automatically pulled in and executed. If you have the R mark, get completely out of Urgot's range before your health reaches the execution threshold. If you have the R mark, immediately use an option such as Zhonya's Hourglass or Quicksilver Sash. R's slow grows stronger the more health the target has lost.
vs-urgot-r.text: Once Urgot’s R hits, falling below its execution threshold triggers the pull and kills you. If marked, get completely out of Urgot’s range before your health reaches that threshold, or immediately use an option such as Zhonya’s Hourglass or Quicksilver Sash. The slow strengthens as you lose health, so waiting longer makes escape harder.

vs-urgot-range.basis: Urgot is classified as ranged, but his range is close to that of a melee champion. Long-range champions can keep their distance against Urgot. Melee champions should avoid fighting Urgot head-on and either take him down with their jungler or farm for the late game. E is Urgot's only way to enter a teamfight. In teamfights, group up to block Urgot's E engage angles.
vs-urgot-range.text: Urgot is classified as ranged, but his range is nearly melee. True ranged champions can beat him through their range, while melee champions should avoid fighting him head on in lane and either take him down with their jungler or farm for the late game. E is his only teamfight engage tool, so grouping up leaves him no opening.

vs-urgot-w.basis: Urgot's movement speed drops sharply while W is active. If Urgot approaches with W active, walk out of its firing range. Urgot gains slow resistance during W, making it hard to keep him away with slows.
vs-urgot-w.text: Urgot’s movement speed drops sharply while W is active, so if he approaches with it on, walking away can take you out of firing range. His slow resistance also rises, however, making slows a poor way to keep him off you.

vs-varus-e-ground.basis: Healing and regeneration are reduced on the contaminated ground left by Varus’s E. If you rely on healing, leave E’s contaminated ground before fighting again.
vs-varus-e-ground.text: The contaminated ground left by Varus’s E Hail of Arrows reduces healing and regeneration while you stand on it. If your champion relies on healing to stay in a fight, step off the ground to recover your sustain before going back in.

vs-varus-mobility.basis: Varus has no dash and relatively low movement speed. If Varus’s Flash is down, look for a chance to reach and catch him with an engage ability or crowd control. Prepare a way past the opposing frontline so you can reach Varus.
vs-varus-mobility.text: Varus has no mobility ability and relatively low movement speed. Once you reach him with an engage ability or crowd control, Flash is his only way out, so you can catch him if it is down. Prepare a way past the opposing frontline to make the matchup favorable.

vs-varus-passive.basis: A kill or assist briefly gives Varus a large boost to attack speed and attack damage. For a few seconds after an ally is killed, avoid fighting Varus and wait for the boost to pass.
vs-varus-passive.text: A kill or assist briefly gives Varus a large boost to attack speed and attack damage. If he gets one when an ally dies in a teamfight, stay away for those few seconds, then reengage after the boost passes.

vs-varus-q-charge.basis: Varus slows himself while aiming Q. When you see Varus aiming Q, sidestep the arrow’s path and close in on him. When Varus starts aiming Q, hide behind minions to avoid the long range, fully charged arrow.
vs-varus-q-charge.text: Varus slows himself and stays in place while aiming Q Piercing Arrow. When you see him begin to aim, sidestep the arrow’s path and use that moment to close in. A fully charged arrow has very long range, so hiding behind minions when he starts aiming is also effective.

vs-varus-r.basis: Varus’s R spreads from the first champion it hits to nearby champions, rooting those it reaches. If an ally is rooted by R, move far enough away that the tendrils cannot reach you. The tendrils from R disappear if you move far enough away. Spread out your teamfight formation to keep R from spreading to multiple people.
vs-varus-r.text: R Chain of Corruption sends tendrils from the first champion hit, rooting everyone they reach. If an ally is rooted, keep far enough away that the tendrils cannot reach you instead of moving in to help; they disappear once you get far enough away. Spread out in teamfights so R roots only one person.

vs-vayne-fragile.basis: Pressure Vayne early to force her back. Push the lane to disrupt Vayne's farming and delay her scaling.
vs-vayne-fragile.text: Vayne’s early health and armor are both among the lowest, so early pressure forces her to back off. Push the lane to disrupt her farming and delay her scaling; with her early game statistics also among the lowest, do not let her get through this stage uncontested.

vs-vayne-late.basis: Once Vayne has attack speed and penetration items, defensive stats alone struggle to stop her. Vayne becomes harder to deal with as the game goes on. Secure objectives and turrets in the early and mid game, working toward ending the game.
vs-vayne-late.text: Once Vayne has attack speed and penetration items, defensive stats alone struggle to stop her. She becomes harder to face as the game goes on, so use objectives and turrets in the early and mid game to work toward ending it.

vs-vayne-r.basis: Q's cooldown is shorter while R is active. While R is active, Vayne briefly becomes invisible each time she uses Q. Use targeted abilities the moment Vayne's invisibility ends. R's duration extends when Vayne scores a takedown. Keep low-health allies away from Vayne to prevent her from extending R's duration.
vs-vayne-r.text: While R is active, Q has a shorter cooldown and briefly makes Vayne invisible each time she uses it. Time targeted abilities for the moment she reappears. Because takedowns extend R’s duration, keep low-health allies away from her to help it end sooner.

vs-vayne-w.basis: W deals true damage based on the target's maximum health. Building armor does not reduce W's true damage. Do not rely solely on defensive items and keep taking Vayne's attacks. W requires a set number of attacks to hit the same target before it triggers. Count the hits you take and move out of range just before W triggers.
vs-vayne-w.text: W deals true damage based on the target’s maximum health, so armor does not reduce it and high-health frontline champions take more damage from each trigger. Do not simply stack defensive items and keep absorbing attacks. Instead, count the hits on you: W triggers only after a set number hit the same target, and stepping out of range just before it triggers can avoid most of that damage.

vs-vayne-wall.basis: Vayne relies heavily on E's wall stun to secure kills. When facing Vayne, avoid fighting with your back to a wall. During the laning phase, position within the minion line or toward the open river. In teamfights, fight Vayne in open areas instead of narrow passages.
vs-vayne-wall.text: Vayne secures many kills through E’s wall stun, so avoid fighting her with your back to a wall. In lane, position within the minion line or toward the open river; in teamfights, face her in open areas instead of narrow passages.

vs-veigar-e.basis: E stuns only when you cross its edge. If trapped inside E, move or attack within it instead of running into the edge. If you must cross E's edge, save a mobility ability or Flash until then.
vs-veigar-e.text: E stuns only when you cross its edge. If you are trapped inside, you can still move and attack, so stay within the cage until it disappears or move toward Veigar rather than rushing into the edge. Save a mobility ability or Flash for crossing the edge without being stunned.

vs-veigar-early.basis: Keep pressuring Veigar during his weak levels 1–5. Use early pressure to disrupt Veigar's farming and poke. Coordinate your engage order with your allies, bait out E, then gank.
vs-veigar-early.text: Veigar has the lowest armor and no mobility ability at levels 1–5. Keep pressuring him then to disrupt both his farming and his poke. A gank after E is used is almost guaranteed to work, so coordinate which ally will engage first to draw it out.

vs-veigar-late.basis: Veigar's stacks have no cap, so he grows stronger in the late game. Before starting a late-game objective fight, check Veigar's position and whether he has used E.
vs-veigar-late.text: Veigar’s stacks have no cap, so he grows stronger as the game goes on. Late in the game, anyone without magic resistance who stands within range of his combo can be eliminated in one burst. Before starting an objective fight, check Veigar’s position and whether he has used E (Event Horizon).

vs-veigar-passive.basis: Dodge Veigar's Q poke so he cannot gain permanent stacks from you. Veigar's Q passes through only the first two units it hits. Stand behind minions to block Veigar's Q poke.
vs-veigar-passive.text: Veigar grows permanently stronger whenever his abilities hit, so taking needless Q poke increases his late game damage. Q passes through only the first two units it hits; standing behind minions can block many casts.

vs-veigar-r.basis: Veigar's R deals more damage the more health its target has lost. If your health falls below half, move out of Veigar's R range. At full health, you can survive Veigar's R.
vs-veigar-r.text: Veigar’s R deals more damage as its target loses health, making it especially dangerous to remain in range while low. If your health falls below half, move out of R range; at full health, you can survive it without retreating out of fear.

vs-veigar-w.basis: W deals heavy damage, but its landing spot and timing are visible in advance. When you hear W and see its ground indicator, move sideways to dodge it. When trading with Veigar, keep moving instead of standing still to attack.
vs-veigar-w.text: W deals heavy damage, but its landing spot and timing are visible in advance. Move sideways when you hear it and see the ground indicator to dodge it; when trading with Veigar, keep moving instead of standing still to attack.

vs-velkoz-e.basis: E is Vel'Koz's only reliable crowd control ability, and he has no mobility ability. Approach Vel'Koz after his E misses. E pushes away enemies who get very close instead of knocking them up. When engaging on Vel'Koz, have a way to finish him after E pushes you back.
vs-velkoz-e.text: E is Vel'Koz's only reliable crowd control ability, and he has no mobility ability, so bait out E and close in after it misses; he has little left to fight back with. Be ready for E to push you away instead of knocking you up if you get very close, and have a way to finish him after the pushback.

vs-velkoz-passive.basis: Taking consecutive hits from Vel'Koz's abilities completes Organic Deconstruction stacks and triggers true damage that resistances cannot block. Even if you build magic resistance, avoid taking repeated poke from Vel'Koz. When you have Organic Deconstruction stacks, leave vision or retreat behind minions to let the stacks expire.
vs-velkoz-passive.text: Consecutive hits from Vel'Koz's abilities complete Organic Deconstruction stacks and trigger true damage that resistances cannot block, so do not keep taking his poke just because you have built magic resistance. If you have stacks on you, leave vision or retreat behind minions to let them expire.

vs-velkoz-position.basis: Vel'Koz has no way to escape, so he struggles to survive if caught. Clear vision around the river and tri-brush to create a route to approach from the side. Once you have a route to engage from the side, Vel'Koz has a harder time stepping forward to poke.
vs-velkoz-position.text: Vel'Koz has very low health and armor and no way to escape, so getting caught can be fatal. Clear vision around the river and tri-brush to open a route from the side; that threat alone can keep him from stepping forward to poke and remove the opposing bot lane's damage.

vs-velkoz-q.basis: Q splits to either side when it reaches maximum range or is recast. Do not dodge Q by moving only sideways. When Q splits, move toward Vel'Koz or behind the beams after they pass.
vs-velkoz-q.text: Dodging the initial Q (Plasma Fission) projectile is not enough: at maximum range or when Vel'Koz recasts it, the projectile splits into two beams that travel to either side of its original path. Moving only sideways can put you in a split beam's path, so move toward Vel'Koz or slip behind the beams once they have passed.

vs-velkoz-r.basis: Vel'Koz channels R while standing still. When R's beam starts, prioritize interrupting it with crowd control or by blocking vision. If you cannot interrupt R, move behind a wall or past minions to break vision.
vs-velkoz-r.text: Vel'Koz must stand still to channel R. Crowd control or blocked vision can cut off all its remaining damage, so interrupt the beam as soon as it starts. If you cannot interrupt it, move behind a wall or past minions to break vision.

vs-vex-dash.basis: When Vex's Doom is ready, one basic ability interrupts dashes and fears enemies. Delay your dash while Vex's Doom indicator is showing. Go in right after Vex spends Doom on the wave or on poke.
vs-vex-dash.text: Do not use a dash carelessly near Vex: when Doom is ready, one basic ability can interrupt the dash and apply fear. Wait while her Doom indicator is showing, then go in right after she spends Doom on the wave or on poke.
