vs-vex-dive.basis: Vex's only survival tool is her W shield. Get close when both Vex's Doom and W are down.
vs-vex-dive.text: Vex has low armor and magic resistance, and her W (Personal Space) shield is her only survival tool. She is vulnerable once W is spent, so look to close in when both Doom and W are unavailable.

vs-vex-e.basis: Vex's E grows larger the farther it travels. If you're already within E's range, dodge by moving toward Vex or taking a short step sideways.
vs-vex-e.text: Vex’s E (Looming Darkness) grows wider as it travels and is narrow near her, so running straight back makes it easier to hit you. If you are already in range, move toward Vex or take a short step sideways to improve your chance of dodging it.

vs-vex-r.basis: If Vex's R projectile hits you, it marks you and she can dash to you. If R marks you, move toward your allies immediately so Vex has to dash into their midst. Look for the moment just after Vex dashes with R, when she has no movement ability to escape.
vs-vex-r.text: Vex’s R projectile marks you on hit, allowing her to dash to you. Move toward your allies as soon as the mark appears so she has to dash into their midst, then look for a chance to catch her after she lands, when she has no movement ability to escape.

vs-vex-reset.basis: If a marked target damaged by R dies soon after, Vex gets R back. Before starting a teamfight, move low-health allies out of Vex's range.
vs-vex-reset.text: If an ally marked by Vex takes damage from R (Shadow Surge) and dies soon afterward, Vex gets R back. Giving her the first kill can start a chain of takedowns, so move low-health allies out of her range before starting a teamfight.

vs-vi-position.basis: While Vi has R available, backline damage dealers should not go alone into areas without vision. While Vi has R available, backline damage dealers should stay within range of their allies' protective abilities.
vs-vi-position.text: R targets one enemy and chases them to the end, so Flash cannot dodge it. While Vi has R available, backline damage dealers should avoid going alone into areas without vision and stay within range of their allies’ protective abilities.

vs-vi-q-charge.basis: When Vi charges Q, move back or sideways to dodge it. Even if you interrupt Q's charge, Vi can use it again soon, so prioritize dodging.
vs-vi-q-charge.text: A fully charged Q deals much more damage, so move back or sideways when you see Vi begin charging to dodge it. Interrupting the charge lets her use Q again after a short wait, making dodging the priority.

vs-viego-corpse.basis: If an ally dies near Viego, a wraith remains where they fell. Viego begins possession when he basic attacks a wraith. Do not keep fighting near where an ally fell. Knock Viego away from the wraith or immobilize him so he cannot attack it.
vs-viego-corpse.text: If an ally dies near Viego, they leave a wraith where they fell, which he can basic attack to begin possession. Do not keep fighting near that spot; if possible, knock Viego away or immobilize him so he cannot reach the wraith.

vs-viego-fog.basis: If you see black mist along terrain, Viego is camouflaged inside it. When you see the mist, place a Control Ward. When you see the mist, take another route around it. Do not push the lane toward the mist.
vs-viego-fog.text: Black mist along terrain means Viego is camouflaged inside it. When you see it, place a Control Ward or take another route, and do not push the lane toward the mist.

vs-viego-possession.basis: While possessing someone, Viego takes the fallen ally's appearance and uses their basic abilities. Do not mistake a possessing Viego for an ally and turn your back on him. Counterattack when Viego finishes possessing someone and returns to his own body. Keep your distance and hold out until possession ends.
vs-viego-possession.text: During possession, Viego takes the fallen ally’s appearance and uses their basic abilities. Do not mistake him for an ally and turn your back. Keep your distance and hold out until possession ends, then counterattack as he returns to his own body.

vs-viego-r.basis: Viego's R targets the nearby champion with the lowest percentage of remaining health. If you are low on health and separated from your team, you are more likely to be targeted by Viego's R. If you are low on health, fall back. If you are low on health, stay close to your allies to make it harder for Viego's R to pick you out.
vs-viego-r.text: Viego’s R, Heartbreaker, targets the nearby champion with the lowest percentage of remaining health. If you are low on health and separated from your team, you become a likely target, so fall back or stay close to allies to make it harder for R to pick you out.

vs-viego-sustain.basis: If Viego fails to get a kill, he has almost no way to heal. Do not start a small fight you cannot win. Retreat without giving Viego a kill to slow his growth.
vs-viego-sustain.text: Without a kill, Viego has almost no way to heal. Do not start a small fight you cannot win; even retreating without giving him a kill keeps him from snowballing.

vs-viego-w.basis: The longer Viego charges W, the longer its stun lasts. Viego slows down while charging W. Interrupting Viego while he charges W cancels the charge. When you see Viego charging W, dodge to the side. If you have crowd control, use it to interrupt Viego's W charge.
vs-viego-w.text: The longer Viego charges W, Spectral Maw, the longer its stun lasts, but he slows while charging and an interruption cancels it. When you see him charge, dodge to the side and, if you have crowd control, use it to interrupt him.

vs-viktor-augment-read.basis: You can tell how many augments Viktor has by the color of his staff's light. When the color of Viktor's staff light changes, reassess your trades.
vs-viktor-augment-read.text: The color of Viktor’s staff light shows how many augments he has. Trades can play out differently as augments accumulate, so reassess your damage calculations when the color changes.

vs-viktor-dive.basis: Viktor has no dash to escape on his own. When an enemy closes in, Viktor's defenses are his Q shield and W stun. Avoid W's area when closing in to attack Viktor.
vs-viktor-dive.text: Viktor has low health and armor and no dash to escape on his own. Once you close in, his defenses are his Q shield and W stun, so avoid W’s area as you attack him.

vs-viktor-e.basis: E hits in a straight line. Dodge E by stepping to the side. Do not stand in line with the wave, so E cannot poke you as easily.
vs-viktor-e.text: E travels in a straight line, so you can dodge it by stepping sideways. Viktor’s angle for clearing a wave is easy to predict; stay out of line with the wave to avoid most of his poke.

vs-viktor-r-interrupt.basis: R interrupts channels when it appears. Wait until Viktor has used R before casting a channeled ultimate.
vs-viktor-r-interrupt.text: R interrupts channels when it appears. If your champion has a channeled ultimate, wait until Viktor has used R before casting it.

vs-viktor-w.basis: W stuns only if the target stays in its area. Leave W's area immediately to take only the slow and avoid the stun. Do not keep trading inside W's area.
vs-viktor-w.text: W stuns only if you remain in its area. Leave as soon as it appears to take only the slow and avoid the stun; do not keep trading inside it.

vs-vladimir-e.basis: Vladimir moves more slowly while charging E. Enemy units in front can block Vladimir's E. When you see E charging, keep minions between you and Vladimir or move out of range before the charge ends. You can close the distance on Vladimir while charging E slows his movement.
vs-vladimir-e.text: Vladimir moves more slowly while charging E, and enemy units in front can block its wave. When you see the charge, keep minions between you and Vladimir or leave its range before it finishes. His reduced movement speed also gives you an opening to close the distance.

vs-vladimir-early.basis: Vladimir is weakest at levels 1–5. Focus lane pressure and ganks at levels 1–5 to slow Vladimir's growth. As time passes, his health and ability power rise together, making him harder to face.
vs-vladimir-early.text: Vladimir is weakest at levels 1–5, when his low defensive stats and lack of an escape make him vulnerable to lane pressure and ganks. Exploit that window to slow his growth: as time passes, his health and ability power increase each other, making him harder to face.

vs-vladimir-items.basis: Items that deal damage based on maximum health are effective against Vladimir. For magic damage, you can choose Liandry's Torment. For physical damage, you can choose Blade of the Ruined King. Adding Grievous Wounds makes it harder for Vladimir to survive through healing.
vs-vladimir-items.text: Items that deal damage based on maximum health are especially effective against Vladimir because building health also increases his damage. Liandry’s Torment is a magic damage option, while Blade of the Ruined King is a physical damage option. Adding Grievous Wounds makes it harder for him to survive through healing.

vs-vladimir-r.basis: While infected by Vladimir's R, you take increased damage from all sources. If infected by R, back away and rejoin the fight after its effect ends. Avoid grouping multiple players inside R's area so Vladimir doesn't heal more.
vs-vladimir-r.text: While infected by Vladimir’s R, you take increased damage from all sources. Back away as soon as it lands and rejoin the fight after its effect ends. Avoid grouping inside R’s area: hitting more champions increases Vladimir’s healing.

vs-vladimir-w.basis: Vladimir's W breaks targeting and destroys incoming projectiles. Draw out W with a low-cost ability, then use your decisive ability when the pool ends. Without W, Vladimir has no way to escape if caught.
vs-vladimir-w.text: Vladimir’s W breaks targeting and destroys incoming projectiles, so important crowd control can disappear if used carelessly. Draw out W with a low-cost ability early in the fight, then use your decisive ability as the pool ends. Once W is down, Vladimir has no way to escape if caught.

vs-volibear-e.basis: Volibear's E lightning strikes after a delay once its indicator appears. When E's indicator appears, walk sideways out of it to avoid the damage and slow. Volibear must be inside E's marked area to gain its shield.
vs-volibear-e.text: E's lightning strikes after a delay. When its indicator appears, step sideways out of the marked area to avoid both the damage and slow. Volibear must stand inside that area to gain the shield, which can also reveal the direction of his next engage.

vs-volibear-lane.basis: Ranged champions should poke while Volibear's Q is on cooldown. Wait out Volibear's Q, then keep poking to take control of the lane.
vs-volibear-lane.text: As a ranged champion, poke while Volibear's Q is on cooldown. Without Q, E's slow is his only way to close the gap, so make him spend Q, then keep poking to take control of the lane.

vs-volibear-q.basis: Volibear's Q movement speed bonus increases toward enemy champions and decreases when he flees. When Volibear chases you with Q active, use mobility or terrain to break vision, or move toward your allies. Stay outside Volibear's empowered basic attack range to avoid Q's stun.
vs-volibear-q.text: Volibear gains much more movement speed from Q while moving toward an enemy champion than while fleeing, so running straight away while he chases with Q will usually let him catch you. Use mobility or terrain to break vision, or move toward your allies. Since the stun comes from an empowered basic attack, staying outside attack range can let Q's duration expire.

vs-volibear-r.basis: Volibear's R briefly disables turrets near its landing point. If you are low on health and Volibear's R is ready, retreat deeper behind your turret. When Volibear's R leap is telegraphed, use a mobility ability to leave its landing point.
vs-volibear-r.text: Volibear's R briefly disables turrets near its landing point, so if you are low on health while R is available, retreat deeper behind your turret instead of relying on it to stop a dive. The leap is telegraphed, giving you time to use a mobility ability to leave the landing area.

vs-volibear-stacks.basis: Volibear's damage depends on his passive attack speed stacks. At maximum passive stacks, Volibear's basic attacks also hit nearby enemies. Avoid fighting when Volibear approaches while building stacks on minions or monsters. Fight just after Volibear's passive stacks expire.
vs-volibear-stacks.text: Volibear's damage depends on his passive attack speed stacks, and at maximum stacks his basic attacks also hit nearby enemies. If he approaches while hitting minions or monsters to build stacks, avoid the fight and engage just after the stacks expire.

vs-volibear-w.basis: Volibear's W heals more when he has more missing health. If you cannot finish Volibear when he is around half health, back off and wait out W's cooldown. Use healing reduction items to weaken Volibear's W healing.
vs-volibear-w.text: Volibear's sustain comes from W, which heals more the more health he is missing. If he is around half health and you cannot reliably finish him, back off and wait out W's cooldown instead of continuing to hit him. Healing reduction items can turn that situation around.

vs-warwick-e.basis: Warwick takes less damage while E is active and fears enemies when it ends. If Warwick activates E, back off and reengage after the fear triggers. Warwick can recast E to trigger the fear early.
vs-warwick-e.text: Warwick takes much less damage while E is active and fears enemies when it ends, so unloading your burst during that window puts you at a double disadvantage. Back off and reengage after the fear triggers, but remember that he can recast E to trigger it early; do not stay close while counting down its full duration.

vs-warwick-passive.basis: Don't decide to dive Warwick based only on his current health. Apply Grievous Wounds with Executioner's Calling when finishing off Warwick.
vs-warwick-passive.text: Warwick heals more as his health falls, making him deceptively durable at half health; diving based on his health alone can let him refill it with a few basic attacks. Apply Grievous Wounds with Executioner’s Calling before calculating whether you can finish him off.

vs-warwick-r.basis: While suppressed by Warwick's R, you cannot do anything. Use Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to immediately remove Warwick's R suppression. If you cannot remove the suppression, focus on keeping the ally caught by R alive. Counterattack while Warwick is locked in place immediately after using R.
vs-warwick-r.text: Warwick’s R suppresses its target, preventing them from doing anything for its duration. Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar removes the suppression immediately; without either, focus on keeping the caught ally alive. Warwick is locked in place immediately after using R, making that a good time to focus a counterattack on him.

vs-warwick-r-range.basis: Warwick's R leap distance increases with movement speed. If Warwick has a movement speed buff, don't assume you are safe just because you are across a wall or in a bush without vision. During an objective standoff, don't leave the far side of the pit open for Warwick to engage from.
vs-warwick-r-range.text: Warwick’s R (Infinite Duress) leap distance increases with his movement speed. With a movement speed buff, he can reach much farther than expected, so don’t treat a wall or an unwarded bush as a safe distance. During an objective standoff, take particular care not to leave the far side of the pit open.

vs-wukong-clone.basis: The real Wukong uses W to turn invisible and retreat in another direction. Avoid mistaking the W clone for the real Wukong and unloading your abilities on it. When a W clone appears, first check the directions the real Wukong is likely to move. Identify the W clone by the fact that it stays in place.
vs-wukong-clone.text: W (Warrior Trickster) leaves a clone in place while the real Wukong turns invisible and retreats in another direction. When the clone appears, check where Wukong is likely to go instead of mistaking it for him and spending your abilities on it; the clone stays in place, which helps you identify it.

vs-wukong-e.basis: E is a targeted dash, so it cannot be dodged. Stay outside E range to prevent Wukong from engaging. If Wukong closes in and reduces your armor with Q, subsequent trades become unfavorable.
vs-wukong-e.text: E (Nimbus Strike) is a targeted dash, so it cannot be dodged; staying outside its range is the way to prevent Wukong from engaging. Once he closes in, Q (Crushing Blow) reduces your armor and makes subsequent trades unfavorable.

vs-wukong-mr.basis: Champions focused on magic damage can come out far ahead in early trades against Wukong. If your champion focuses on magic damage, fight back aggressively when Wukong closes in during the early game.
vs-wukong-mr.text: Wukong’s base magic resistance is among the lowest of all champions. If you play a champion that deals primarily magic damage, you can gain a substantial lead in early trades, so fight back aggressively when he closes in.

vs-wukong-passive.basis: Wukong gains more armor through P as he attacks champions or jungle monsters. Wukong gains more healing through P as he attacks champions or jungle monsters. P stacks give Wukong a greater advantage the longer he stays in close combat. Against Wukong, repeatedly go in for short trades and disengage instead of taking extended duels.
vs-wukong-passive.text: Each hit on a champion or jungle monster builds Wukong’s P (Stone Skin) stacks, increasing his armor and healing. He gains the advantage the longer a close fight lasts, so take repeated short trades and disengage instead of committing to an extended duel.

vs-wukong-r.basis: R knocks up multiple enemies at once. R deals damage based on maximum health. Spread out when Wukong's R is available. Account for R's second cast when deciding how far to retreat. Account for the clone copying R when deciding how far to retreat.
vs-wukong-r.text: R (Cyclone) knocks up multiple enemies at once and deals damage based on maximum health. Spread out while Wukong’s R is available, and leave enough room to retreat from both its second cast and the clone that copies it.

vs-wukong-r-window.basis: Wukong has a harder time engaging and disengaging without R. Force an objective or a fight immediately after Wukong uses R. If Wukong disappears from vision with R available, first break up your grouped formation.
vs-wukong-r-window.text: Wukong has a harder time engaging and disengaging without R (Cyclone), so force an objective or a fight immediately after he uses it. If he disappears from vision while R is available, spread out your grouped formation first.

vs-xayah-e-line.basis: When Xayah uses E, her feathers return to her in straight lines. Instead of moving straight away from Xayah, sidestep out of the line between the feathers and her.
vs-xayah-e-line.text: When Xayah uses E, her feathers return to her in straight lines. Sidestep out of the line between the feathers and Xayah to avoid their path; moving sideways around her position is better than running straight back.

vs-xayah-feather-count.basis: Xayah's root triggers only when at least three returning feathers hit. If three or more feathers lie on the line between you and Xayah, move off it immediately.
vs-xayah-feather-count.text: Xayah roots a target only when at least three returning feathers hit it. Count the feathers on the ground, and if three or more lie along the line between you and Xayah, move off that line immediately.

vs-xayah-mobility.basis: Xayah has low movement speed and no mobility ability besides R. Pressure Xayah with ganks and forced engages when her R is down or she has not reached level 6.
vs-xayah-mobility.text: Xayah has relatively low movement speed and no mobility ability besides R. Pressure her with ganks and forced engages before level 6 or while R is down.

vs-xayah-move.basis: If you fight Xayah from the same spot for too long, feathers pile up under your feet. Keep trades short and reposition so the feathers do not line up along their recall path.
vs-xayah-move.text: The longer you fight Xayah from the same spot, the more feathers pile up under your feet. Keep trades short and reposition often so the feathers do not line up along their recall paths.

vs-xayah-r.basis: When Xayah becomes untargetable with R, she can avoid engage abilities and crowd control. Engage after confirming Xayah has used R.
vs-xayah-r.text: Don’t engage on Xayah first unless the opening is certain. If she becomes untargetable with R, your engage ability and crowd control can go to waste, leaving her with the advantage; it’s much safer to wait until you’ve confirmed her R is down.

vs-xerath-close.basis: Xerath has no movement ability. Most champions can trade damage favorably with Xerath if they close the gap. Close the gap right after Xerath uses E and W.
vs-xerath-close.text: Xerath’s range is threatening, but most champions can trade favorably once they close the gap. He has no movement ability, so move in right after he uses E and W.

vs-xerath-laning.basis: Xerath uses a lot of mana during the laning phase. When Xerath runs out of mana, push the lane and call your jungler.
vs-xerath-laning.text: Xerath uses a great deal of mana in lane. Instead of trying to dodge every bit of poke, avoid the heavy damage and keep farming; Xerath will eventually run low on mana first. When that happens, push the lane and call your jungler.

vs-xerath-q.basis: Xerath's Q travels in a straight line through minions and can hit targets behind them. When Xerath starts charging Q, change direction and dodge well to the side. Close the gap while Xerath is slowed as he charges Q.
vs-xerath-q.text: Xerath’s Q Arcanopulse travels through minions in a straight line, so standing behind them will not protect you. When he starts charging, change direction and move well to the side, then close the gap while the charge slows him.

vs-xerath-ult.basis: Xerath's R has a long cast animation, and he cannot move while casting it. As soon as you see Xerath's R cast animation, start dodging. When you see Xerath's R cast animation, you can also engage on his position.
vs-xerath-ult.text: Xerath’s R Rite of the Arcane has a long cast animation, and he cannot move during it. As soon as you see the animation, start dodging or engage on his position; he cannot dodge on his own while R is active.

vs-xinzhao-e.basis: Audacious Charge is a targeted dash that cannot cross walls. Without a nearby minion or jungle monster, Xin Zhao cannot escape with Audacious Charge. To break off Xin Zhao’s pursuit, move into an empty area beyond a wall. When trying to catch Xin Zhao, force him into a position with no target behind him to dash to with Audacious Charge.
vs-xinzhao-e.text: E Audacious Charge is a targeted dash that cannot cross walls. Without a nearby minion or jungle monster, Xin Zhao cannot use it to escape. To break off his pursuit, move into an empty area beyond a wall; to catch him, force him somewhere with no target behind him to dash to.

vs-xinzhao-q.basis: Q's third empowered auto attack knocks the target airborne. If two Q-empowered auto attacks hit you, use a mobility ability or Flash to get out of range before the third. Much of Xin Zhao's damage and crowd control depends on Q's third hit.
vs-xinzhao-q.text: Q Three Talon Strike’s third empowered auto attack knocks its target airborne. If the first two hit you, use a mobility ability or Flash to get out of range before the third. Much of Xin Zhao’s damage and crowd control hinges on that hit, so avoiding it can change the fight.

vs-xinzhao-r-immunity.basis: When R is active, damage from champions outside his spear's range does not affect Xin Zhao. To deal damage during R, a marksman must move within his spear's range.
vs-xinzhao-r-immunity.text: While R Crescent Guard is active, damage from champions outside Xin Zhao’s spear range does not affect him. A marksman must either back away or move into that range to keep dealing damage; continuing to fire from outside it is the worst choice.

vs-xinzhao-r-knockback.basis: R knocks back only enemies who are not Challenged, splitting their formation. If you expect Xin Zhao to engage, space yourselves so the others can help even if one person is knocked back.
vs-xinzhao-r-knockback.text: R Crescent Guard knocks back only enemies who are not Challenged, pushing everyone except Xin Zhao’s target away and splitting the formation. If you expect him to engage, avoid standing too close together; leave enough space for the others to help if one person is knocked back.

vs-xinzhao-r-window.basis: Xin Zhao is very weak after R ends. When Xin Zhao engages, create distance to wait out R's immunity, then counterattack. In late-game teamfights, target Xin Zhao as soon as R ends.
vs-xinzhao-r-window.text: Xin Zhao is very weak after R Crescent Guard ends. When he engages, create distance and wait out its immunity before counterattacking instead of committing immediately. In late game teamfights, the moment R expires is your chance to take him down.

vs-xinzhao-w.basis: W is a slow skillshot, and its thrust deals most of its damage. Dodge W's thrust by moving sideways. Dodging W's thrust also avoids becoming Challenged and facing E's increased range.
vs-xinzhao-w.text: W Wind Becomes Lightning is a slow skillshot whose thrust deals most of its damage. Move sideways to dodge the thrust: if it misses, you avoid becoming Challenged and deny Xin Zhao an engage from E Audacious Charge’s increased range.

vs-yasuo-post-tornado.basis: Yasuo's Q stacks reset when he fires his tornado. Treat the moment right after Yasuo fires his tornado as his weakest window in a fight. Start a fight right after Yasuo fires his tornado.
vs-yasuo-post-tornado.text: Yasuo is weakest immediately after firing his tornado. His Q stacks reset, leaving him without a knock-up for a while, so engage then.

vs-yasuo-q-dodge.basis: Yasuo's Q has a very narrow hitbox. When Yasuo approaches, move sideways instead of backing away to get out of Q's straight path.
vs-yasuo-q-dodge.text: Yasuo's Q has a very narrow hitbox. When he approaches, move sideways instead of backing away: stepping out of its straight path will cause most casts to miss.

vs-yasuo-shield.basis: Yasuo's passive shield activates upon taking a single instance of damage. Yasuo's passive shield lasts briefly after activation. Use low-cost poke to strip Yasuo's passive shield first. Commit to a trade after Yasuo's passive shield disappears.
vs-yasuo-shield.text: Yasuo's passive shield activates when he takes damage and lasts only briefly. Strip it with low-cost poke, then commit to a trade once it disappears.

vs-yasuo-tornado.basis: After Yasuo lands Q twice in a row, his next Q becomes a tornado that knocks opponents airborne. Watch and listen for the effects that signal full Q stacks so you can prepare to dodge the tornado.
vs-yasuo-tornado.text: After Yasuo lands Q twice in a row, his next Q becomes a tornado that knocks opponents airborne. Watch and listen for the effects that signal full stacks so you can prepare to dodge.

vs-yasuo-wall.basis: Yasuo's W only blocks projectiles. Turret attacks pass through Yasuo's W. Beam abilities pass through Yasuo's W. If you play a projectile-based champion, reposition to attack around Yasuo's W. If you play a projectile-based champion, hold your key abilities until Yasuo's W disappears.
vs-yasuo-wall.text: Yasuo's W Wind Wall blocks projectiles, but turret attacks and beam abilities pass through it. If you play a projectile-based champion, reposition to attack around the wall or save your key abilities until it disappears.

vs-yasuo-wave.basis: Yasuo uses E through minions to close the gap. Keep a thin wave pushing toward your side to limit the minions Yasuo can use to approach with E.
vs-yasuo-wave.text: Yasuo closes gaps by using E through minions. Keep a thin wave pushing toward your side; with fewer minions to use as stepping stones, he has fewer ways to approach.

vs-yone-cc.basis: Yone cannot return to his body with E while under strong crowd control. Hold your immobilizing ability and use it when Yone enters in spirit form. Crowd control interrupts Yone's whirlwind Q.
vs-yone-cc.text: Strong crowd control prevents Yone from returning to his body with E (Soul Unbound), so hold your immobilizing ability until he dives in spirit form to stop his return and catch him. Crowd control can also interrupt whirlwind Q (Mortal Steel).

vs-yone-early.basis: Yone is weakest early, before he gains attack speed. Pressure Yone at levels 1–2 to deny him health and CS.
vs-yone-early.text: Yone is weakest early, before he gains attack speed, and his early deaths are noticeably high in the statistics. Pressure him at levels 1–2 to deny him health and CS, delaying the point when his items make him stronger.

vs-yone-echo.basis: Some of the damage Yone deals in spirit form is dealt again when he returns to his body. If Yone hits you in spirit form and you have about half your health left, heal or move out of his range before he returns.
vs-yone-echo.text: Some of the damage Yone deals in spirit form is dealt again when he returns to his body. If he has hit you in spirit form and you have about half your health left, heal or move out of range before he returns to avoid that additional damage.

vs-yone-q-stack.basis: Yone engages with whirlwind Q when its stacks are full. When Yone repeatedly hits minions with Q, his whirlwind becomes ready. When his whirlwind is ready, stay outside Yone's range until the stacks expire.
vs-yone-q-stack.text: Yone’s engage comes from whirlwind Q Mortal Steel at full stacks. Repeated Q hits on minions signal that his whirlwind is ready; stay out of range until the stacks expire.

vs-yone-r.basis: Yone moves behind the last champion in R's path. Yone's R pulls in every enemy it hits.
vs-yone-r.text: R Fate Sealed teleports Yone behind the last champion in its path and pulls in every enemy it hits. Standing second from the back prevents him from getting deeper, while standing alone at the rear lets him teleport to your position. Check whether you are the farthest back before a teamfight.

vs-yone-w-shield.basis: Yone's W grants a larger shield the more champions it hits at once. In teamfights, spread out instead of lining up in Yone's approach path.
vs-yone-w-shield.text: The more champions Yone hits at once with W (Spirit Cleave), the larger his shield becomes. In teamfights, spread out instead of lining up along his approach so W catches only one or two of you.

vs-yorick-e.basis: Yorick has no movement ability, so he struggles to close in if E misses. Dodge the arc of E's mist projectile to avoid the trade. Step forward to farm while E is on cooldown.
vs-yorick-e.text: Yorick has no mobility, so he cannot close in if E misses. Dodge the arc of its mist projectile to avoid being forced into a trade, then step forward and farm freely while E is on cooldown. As a ranged champion, repeating this pattern is enough to win the lane.

vs-yorick-ghouls.basis: Clear the Mist Walkers before fighting Yorick. Clearing the Mist Walkers noticeably reduces Yorick’s damage. A jungler with Smite can use it to clear Mist Walkers and the Maiden of the Mist immediately.
vs-yorick-ghouls.text: Clear the Mist Walkers before fighting Yorick to noticeably reduce his damage. A jungler with Smite can use it to clear the Mist Walkers and the Maiden of the Mist immediately.

vs-yorick-graves.basis: A grave forms each time two enemies die near Yorick. Yorick uses the accumulated graves as troops. Don’t start a fight where there are many graves. Keep pushing the lane so enemies die under Yorick’s turret.
vs-yorick-graves.text: A grave forms for every two enemies that die near Yorick, and those graves become his troops. Avoid starting fights where many have accumulated; keep pushing the lane so he cannot clear the wave on his side and the minions die under his turret.

vs-yorick-maiden.basis: A target marked by the Maiden's basic attack takes bonus damage based on maximum health from Yorick's basic attacks. When the Maiden starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick first. Target Yorick himself while the Maiden is alone in a side lane.
vs-yorick-maiden.text: The Maiden’s basic attacks mark targets to take bonus damage based on maximum health from Yorick’s basic attacks. If she starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick first. When she is alone in a side lane, Yorick fights more like an ordinary melee champion, making that your chance to target him.

vs-yorick-split.basis: If you have global mobility or can roam quickly, answer Yorick's side-lane push, then rejoin your team. If you can secure an objective elsewhere faster than Yorick can pressure a turret, that trade is not a loss.
vs-yorick-split.text: Counter Yorick’s side-lane pressure by moving across the map quickly. If your champion has global mobility or can roam fast, answer his push and then immediately rejoin your team to restore your numbers advantage. Trading his solo turret push for an objective elsewhere is worthwhile if you can secure it faster than he can take the turret.

vs-yorick-wall.basis: If trapped by W, attack and destroy the low-health wall before using a movement ability. If you have a dash or blink, cross the W wall. Yorick's W wall does not block his allies.
vs-yorick-wall.text: If W Dark Procession traps you, attack its low-health wall first: it breaks after a few hits, so there is no need to waste a movement ability in a panic. A dash or blink can get you across faster, and because Yorick’s wall does not block his allies, first look for a path toward an ally on the other side.

vs-yunara-early.basis: Yunara is weak at levels 1–2 because her Unleash is empty. At levels 1–2, push the lane and trade repeatedly to limit Yunara's chances to basic attack.
vs-yunara-early.text: Yunara is weak at levels 1–2, with low base attack damage and movement speed even among marksmen and no Unleash stacks built yet. Push the lane and trade repeatedly during this window to deny her opportunities to build Unleash with basic attacks.

vs-yunara-emanation.basis: Yunara's damage rises sharply when her Unleash stacks are full. Trade with Yunara while she's building Unleash without Q active.
vs-yunara-emanation.text: Yunara’s damage spikes only when her Unleash stacks are full. If she has been attacking only minions, they are likely still incomplete; if she has been harassing with basic attacks, Q may be ready soon. Trade while she is still building Unleash with Q inactive, rather than immediately after she backs away from landing a basic attack.

vs-yunara-q-window.basis: Spread out while Yunara's Q is active and wait out its duration. Engage Yunara right after her Q ends.
vs-yunara-q-window.text: While Yunara’s Q is active, she attacks faster and her basic attacks splash onto nearby targets, so even standing near her target can hurt you. Spread out and wait through its short duration, then engage as soon as it ends.

vs-yunara-w.basis: Yunara's W applies a strong slow, and its lingering damage finishes off low health enemies. If W hits you, leave its damage area immediately.
vs-yunara-w.text: Yunara’s W, Arc of Judgment, applies a slow that nearly stops movement, and its lingering damage can finish off low health targets. If it hits you, leave the damage area immediately; staying in it at low health can kill you without another basic attack.

vs-yuumi-detach.basis: Look for the moment Yuumi detaches to place a ward or reposition. Immobilizing Yuumi after she detaches prevents her from reattaching for a short time. Save targeted crowd control for the moment Yuumi detaches.
vs-yuumi-detach.text: Yuumi's brief moments while detached are your only opening. Save targeted crowd control for when she detaches to place a ward or reposition: immobilizing her then prevents her from reattaching for a short time.

vs-yuumi-laning.basis: Yuumi cannot farm CS on her own and has weak lane pressure. During the laning phase, pressure bot lane with your jungler to build a lead. The later the game goes, the more favorable it becomes for Yuumi.
vs-yuumi-laning.text: Yuumi cannot farm CS on her own and has weak lane pressure, with early-game statistics near the bottom across the board. Pressure bot lane with your jungler to build a lead during the laning phase; the longer the game goes, the more favorable it becomes for Yuumi.

vs-zaahen-e.basis: Getting hit by the edge of E’s cleave deals heavy damage and magic damage based on your maximum health. Move toward the end of Zaahen’s dash to stand inside E’s edge.
vs-zaahen-e.text: Only the edge of E’s cleave deals the heavier damage, including magic damage based on your maximum health. Move toward the end of Zaahen’s dash and stand inside that edge; even if E hits you, it will deal much less damage.

vs-zaahen-qw.basis: Zaahen’s Q knockup is applied by his next basic attack. When Zaahen prepares the knockup, move out of basic attack range. Avoid standing in a straight line between Zaahen and his allies so W cannot pull you toward them.
vs-zaahen-qw.text: Zaahen’s Q knockup comes from his next basic attack, so moving out of basic attack range makes a prepared knockup disappear. W thrusts in a straight line and pulls targets toward him; staying out of a straight line between Zaahen and his allies denies him an engage that would pull you toward them.

vs-zaahen-revive.basis: At full Determination, Zaahen revives with health shortly after dying. Force Zaahen to use his revive before starting objective fights or teamfights.
vs-zaahen-revive.text: At full Determination, Zaahen revives with health shortly after dying. A dive or teamfight that fails to account for this effectively starts a player down. His revive has a very long cooldown, so force it out before starting an objective fight or teamfight.

vs-zaahen-stacks.basis: Zaahen builds Determination stacks and gains attack damage by hitting enemy champions. Keep trades short and avoid even glancing hits from Zaahen. Do not duel Zaahen at full Determination stacks.
vs-zaahen-stacks.text: Zaahen gains attack damage from Determination stacks, which he builds by hitting enemy champions. Keep trades short and avoid even glancing hits to slow his stacking. At full stacks, his attack damage increase doubles, so do not accept a duel then.

vs-zac-blob.basis: Enemy champions can destroy Zac's blobs by stepping on them. Step on blobs during fights to prevent Zac from healing and reducing W's cooldown. Use immobilizing crowd control to keep Zac from collecting blobs.
vs-zac-blob.text: Enemy champions can destroy Zac’s blobs by stepping on them. Do so during fights to deny both his healing and W cooldown reduction, or immobilize him so he cannot reach them.

vs-zac-e-interrupt.basis: Zac's E charging animation is visible. If Zac charges E behind a wall, interrupt it with a silence, root, stun, or knockup.
vs-zac-e-interrupt.text: Zac’s E (Elastic Slingshot) has a visible charging animation. If you see him charging behind a wall, use a silence, root, stun, or knockup to interrupt it.

vs-zac-kite.basis: Zac needs to stay close to enemies to deal most of his damage. After weathering Zac’s engage, create distance as you fight to avoid his W damage.
vs-zac-kite.text: Zac needs to stay close to deal most of his damage. After weathering his engage, create distance as you fight to avoid most of his W area damage. If your team is weak in close combat, don’t start a fight from a position where you can’t judge Zac’s engage angle.

vs-zac-revive.basis: Zac's revive passive has a very long cooldown. Before committing to a 1v1 or an objective fight, check whether Zac's revive passive is ready.
vs-zac-revive.text: Zac’s revive passive has a very long cooldown. If it is used before a teamfight, he is just an ordinary frontliner for a while, so check whether it is ready before committing to a 1v1 or an objective fight.

vs-zac-revive-deny.basis: Ignite and Smite can hit the pieces Zac splits into after going down. If you have area damage, wait until the revival pieces are close together, then clear them all at once.
vs-zac-revive-deny.text: Ignite and Smite can hit the pieces Zac splits into after going down. If you have area damage, wait until the pieces are close together, then clear them all at once.

vs-zed-e.basis: E's slow only applies when a shadow lands the hit. To avoid the slow, check the shadow's position and move outside its E range.
vs-zed-e.text: E slows only when the shadow lands the hit. Watch its position and move outside its E range to escape without being slowed.

vs-zed-late.basis: Zed peaks in the mid game. Zed gets weaker as the game goes later. Avoid giving Zed an early lead. Move together with your allies to prevent Zed from killing isolated targets.
vs-zed-late.text: Zed peaks in the mid game and weakens as the game goes later. Avoid giving him an early lead, then move together with your allies so he has no isolated target to kill.

vs-zed-r-track.basis: After engaging with R, Zed must stick to his target and build up damage before the mark detonates. Use crowd control on Zed while the R mark is active to interrupt his combo and reduce the detonation damage.
vs-zed-r-track.text: After entering with R, Zed needs to stay on his target and deal damage before the mark detonates. Apply crowd control while the mark is active to interrupt his combo and reduce the detonation damage.

vs-zed-w.basis: Treat the moment just after Zed uses W as his most vulnerable window. Zed relies on his shadows for damage, slows, and movement. Approach after the W shadow disappears or Zed has already swapped positions.
vs-zed-w.text: Zed is most vulnerable just after using W because his damage, slow, and movement depend on the shadow. Move in after it disappears or after he has already swapped positions.

vs-zeri-e.basis: Zeri's E travels much farther when crossing terrain. When trying to catch Zeri, force her into open terrain away from walls.
vs-zeri-e.text: Zeri’s E travels much farther when crossing terrain. Pushing her toward a wall gives her an escape route, so force her into open terrain away from walls when trying to catch her.

vs-zeri-r.basis: Zeri gains movement speed as she hits enemies while R is active. If Zeri activates R, give up chasing her on foot or stop her immediately with an immobilizing effect. When Zeri's R is down, E is her only mobility tool.
vs-zeri-r.text: While R is active, each hit raises Zeri’s movement speed, making her impossible to catch on foot. If she activates R, give up the chase or stop her immediately with an immobilizing effect; when R is down, E is her only mobility tool.

vs-zeri-range.basis: Zeri's basic attack range is short even among marksmen. If you play a long-range champion, build a lead by poking Zeri before she gets her core items.
vs-zeri-range.text: Zeri’s basic attack range is short even among marksmen. A long-range champion can poke her without retaliation in lane, so build as large a lead as possible before she gets her core items.

vs-zeri-squishy.basis: Zeri has little kill pressure during the laning phase. Catch Zeri before she completes her core items. Once she has her core items, Zeri's mobility makes her harder to pick off.
vs-zeri-squishy.text: Zeri’s armor is among the lowest of all champions, and she has little kill pressure in lane. Catch her before she completes her core items; afterward, her mobility makes her much harder to pick off.

vs-zeri-w.basis: Zeri's W spreads when it hits terrain, greatly increasing its damage. When facing Zeri, don't stand with your back to a wall. Don't face Zeri head-on in a narrow passage. In open terrain, Zeri's W stops at the first target it hits.
vs-zeri-w.text: Zeri’s W spreads when it hits terrain and deals much more damage. Don’t stand with your back to a wall or face her head-on in a narrow passage; in open terrain, W stops at the first target it hits.

vs-ziggs-cooldown.basis: Look for an opening right after Ziggs uses a full rotation of abilities. Engage right after Ziggs uses W to poke or clear a wave. Without W, Ziggs has a hard time escaping on foot.
vs-ziggs-cooldown.text: Ziggs’s abilities have fairly long cooldowns, leaving him briefly vulnerable after a full rotation. The best time to engage is immediately after he spends W on poke or wave clear; without it, he cannot escape on foot.

vs-ziggs-e.basis: Go around the path covered by E, or wait for the mines to disappear. If E slows you, Ziggs’s other abilities become easier to land on you. Before engaging on Ziggs, identify an approach that E doesn’t cover.
vs-ziggs-e.text: Do not step into E: once it slows you, Ziggs’s other abilities become easier to land. Go around the mined path or wait for the mines to disappear, and before engaging, identify an approach that E does not cover.

vs-ziggs-mobility.basis: Ziggs has very low movement speed, and W is his only mobility tool. Engage when Ziggs has used W or is somewhere he can’t cross a wall. If Ziggs still has W, check vision and your chase route on the other side of the wall before engaging.
vs-ziggs-mobility.text: Ziggs has one of the lowest movement speeds, and W is his only mobility tool. If W is down or he is somewhere he cannot cross a wall, engage; a single crowd control effect is enough to finish him. If W is available, check your vision and chase route on the far side of the wall before going in.

vs-ziggs-r.basis: The center of R’s explosion deals the most damage; the edge deals much less. When R’s warning area appears, move away from the center even if you can’t escape it entirely. Near an objective, don’t group in one spot even if Ziggs isn’t visible.
vs-ziggs-r.text: R hurts most at the center of its explosion and much less at the edge. When its warning area appears, move away from the center even if you cannot leave the area entirely. Its range lets Ziggs reach fights from another lane, so avoid grouping in one spot near an objective even when he is out of sight.

vs-ziggs-turret.basis: Ziggs’s W instantly demolishes turrets below a certain health threshold. Turrets don’t recover health on their own. If a turret has lost a lot of health, keep clearing waves in that lane so Ziggs can’t demolish it with W.
vs-ziggs-turret.text: Ziggs’s W instantly demolishes turrets below a certain health threshold, and turrets do not recover health on their own. Leaving a turret at middling health can let Ziggs open the lane with a single wave, so if it has taken heavy damage, keep clearing waves in that lane.

vs-zilean-bomb.basis: Zilean must attach two bombs to the same target to stun them. If the first bomb attaches to you, move away from your allies and out of its explosion radius. Standing next to an ally carrying a bomb can get you caught in its stun too.
vs-zilean-bomb.text: Zilean needs two bombs on the same target to stun. If the first attaches to you, move away so your allies are outside its explosion radius; standing next to an ally carrying a bomb can catch you in the stun too.

vs-zilean-e.basis: E slows or speeds up only one person at a time. When engaging, approach from multiple directions so one E cannot stop everyone. Engaging alone makes it easy for E to slow you and leave you open to the bomb combo.
vs-zilean-e.text: E can slow or speed up only one person at a time. Engage from multiple directions so a single cast cannot stop everyone; going in alone lets Zilean slow you and land the bomb combo.

vs-zilean-early.basis: At levels 1–2, Zilean has no W and cannot set up a bomb stun. At levels 1–2, get close to Zilean and pressure him. From level 3, Zilean can use the Q → W → Q combo. If you gained no early advantage, farm outside bomb range after level 3.
vs-zilean-early.text: At levels 1–2, Zilean has no W to set up a bomb stun, and his health and attack damage are among the lowest. Get close and pressure him during that window. From level 3 onward, he can use Q → W → Q, so if you gained no early advantage, switch to farming outside bomb range.

vs-zilean-r.basis: An ally with R revives where they die. The target cannot be targeted while reviving with R. If you can keep pace with Zilean, finish off the target after R expires. If you cannot wait for R to expire, prepare to attack the target again right after they revive.
vs-zilean-r.text: An ally carrying R revives where they die and cannot be targeted during the revival, so using abilities on them then is a waste. If you can keep pace with Zilean, wait for R to expire before finishing them off; otherwise, prepare to attack again immediately after they revive.

vs-zilean-target.basis: Zilean himself has no mobility ability. If R makes your allied damage dealer hard to kill, switch your target to Zilean. If you kill Zilean first, his team loses his protection and speed boosts.
vs-zilean-target.text: Zilean has no mobility ability and is very fragile. If R makes your allied damage dealer hard to kill, it is better to switch your target to Zilean himself; taking him out first deprives his team of both protection and speed boosts.

vs-zoe-dive.basis: Against Zoe, aim to get within range and stick to her. If you have an engage ability, go in right after Zoe uses E.
vs-zoe-dive.text: Zoe has some of the lowest defensive stats of any champion and no true escape. Against her, avoid fighting over angles and focus on getting within range: once you close the gap, you can stick to her and take her down. If your champion has an engage ability, use it right after Zoe uses E Sleepy Trouble Bubble.

vs-zoe-e.basis: Even if E's bubble hits you, sleep takes effect after a short delay. After E hits you, move behind a wall or an ally so you fall asleep outside Zoe's Q angle. If you have Cleanse or Quicksilver Sash, use it to remove E's sleep.
vs-zoe-e.text: E’s bubble puts you to sleep after a short delay. During that window, move behind a wall or an ally and out of Zoe’s range to avoid the doubled damage. Zoe is looking for one big hit as you sleep, so make sure the spot where you wake is outside her Q angle. If you have Cleanse or Quicksilver Sash, use it to remove the sleep.

vs-zoe-q.basis: Zoe has very little time to redirect Q. Stun or root Zoe as she fires Q and lines up its angle.
vs-zoe-q.text: Zoe has only a brief window to redirect Q Paddle Star! after firing it. Stun or root her as she throws it and lines up the angle; she will be unable to redirect the star, causing it to miss. Her throwing animation is your cue to use crowd control.

vs-zoe-r.basis: Zoe always returns to her starting point after using R. When Zoe uses R, aim at her starting point to counterattack. Zoe can't walk while displaced by R.
vs-zoe-r.text: Zoe always returns to her starting point after using R, so aim there to counterattack. She also cannot walk while displaced.

vs-zoe-trap.basis: A missed E bubble remains where it lands as a trap. Move carefully through narrow paths without vision, bush entrances, and areas in front of objectives. Before starting an objective, use a Control Ward to reveal the surrounding area.
vs-zoe-trap.text: A missed E bubble remains where it lands as a trap. Against Zoe, move carefully through narrow paths without vision, bush entrances, and areas in front of objectives. Before starting an objective, use a Control Ward to reveal the surrounding area so a trap does not ruin the teamfight from the outset.

vs-zoe-w.basis: Using a summoner spell or active item near Zoe drops a shard she can reuse. If Zoe is in sight, save spells you don't urgently need. Right after using Flash near Zoe, move as though she can use that Flash to follow you.
vs-zoe-w.text: Using a summoner spell or active item near Zoe drops a shard she can use herself. When she is in sight, save spells you do not urgently need. In particular, after using Flash near her, move as though she can use that same spell to follow you.

vs-zyra-e.basis: Zyra relies heavily on her E root in fights. E travels in a straight line. At the edge of its range, move sideways to bait out E, then engage while it is on cooldown.
vs-zyra-e.text: Zyra's plays start with her E root. It travels in a straight line, and she has no mobility skill, so move sideways at the edge of its range to bait it out, then engage while it is on cooldown. Once E misses, she has virtually no way to fight back.

vs-zyra-plants.basis: Fully grown plants can be removed with attacks and disappear on their own over time. In an area full of plants, back off briefly and wait for them to disappear. Zyra is weakest when there are no plants nearby.
vs-zyra-plants.text: Fully grown plants can be cleared by attacking them a set number of times, like wards, and disappear on their own over time. Rather than force a fight in an area full of plants, back off briefly and Zyra's damage will drop by half. She is weakest when there are no plants nearby.

vs-zyra-position.basis: Leave the area where Zyra has been set up for a while and fight around another objective in fresh terrain. If Zyra places her plants far from herself, move in on Zyra.
vs-zyra-position.text: Moving the fight makes the seeds Zyra has set up useless. Avoid fighting in an area she has occupied for a while; move to another objective and engage on fresh ground. If she has grown plants far from herself, it is safer to move in on Zyra herself.

vs-zyra-r.basis: R knocks enemies up when its summoned vines contract after a delay. When you see R's cast indicator, leave its area immediately and use a mobility skill then if you have one. Avoid fighting near groups of plants so Zyra has a harder time enraging them with R.
vs-zyra-r.text: R knocks enemies up after a delay, when its summoned vines contract. Leave the area as soon as you see the cast indicator, saving a mobility skill for that moment if you have one. Zyra wants to cast R over groups of plants to enrage them, so avoiding fights near those groups greatly reduces its value.

vs-zyra-seed.basis: Zyra's seeds disappear when stepped on. If you see a Zyra seed along your path, step on it to remove it.
vs-zyra-seed.text: Zyra’s seeds disappear when stepped on. Their distinct color and larger size make them easy to identify, so step on any you find along your path. If Zyra casts an ability to grow a seed as you approach it, though, walking in will put you directly in her combo; when you see the ability coming, back away at the last moment, then step on the seed.

vs-zyra-vision.basis: Zyra's seeds give her team vision. Assume Zyra's team has vision in areas where she has stayed for a while, and plan your approach accordingly. Check a brush where you suspect an ambush with a control ward or a skill before entering.
vs-zyra-vision.text: Zyra's seeds give her team vision. Assume her team can see areas where she has stayed for a while and plan your approach accordingly. Before entering a brush where you suspect an ambush, check it with a control ward or a skill.

warwick-combo-e-fear.basis: When E expires, it fears nearby enemies. Recast it to trigger the fear early. Recast E to fear the target immediately when they are about to use a mobility ability or an ally needs to land a skillshot. When you need to withstand an enemy's burst damage, let E run its full duration to make the most of its damage reduction.
warwick-combo-e-fear.text: E fears nearby enemies when its duration ends, and recasting it triggers the fear early. Recast when an enemy is about to use a mobility ability or an ally needs help landing a skillshot; if you need to withstand enemy burst damage, let E run its full duration for the damage reduction.

warwick-combo-gank.basis: Start a gank by marking the target with W and using the movement speed to close in. Before level 6, gank lanes where an ally can catch the target first, then close in with Q and use basic attacks. After level 6, suppress the target with R, then follow with basic attacks, Q, and E in that order.
warwick-combo-gank.text: Start a gank by pressing W to mark a target, then use the movement speed to close in. Before level 6, head for lanes where an ally can catch the target first: Warwick can only close in with Q, land basic attacks, and follow up on allied crowd control. From level 6 onward, use R for guaranteed suppression, then follow with basic attacks, Q, and E in that order.

warwick-combo-r-range.basis: R's leap distance scales with movement speed. W's passive increases movement speed. Use R while running toward the enemy.
warwick-combo-r-range.text: R’s leap distance scales with movement speed, so using it while W’s passive or a movement speed item or buff is active can reach an enemy from a distance they thought was safe. Cast R while running toward them, rather than from a standstill.

warwick-jungle-gank.basis: Gank when the enemy has pushed the lane away from their turret. Warwick has no guaranteed crowd control before level 6. Before level 6, if you cannot rely on an ally's immobilizing crowd control, turn toward a camp or objective on the other side.
warwick-jungle-gank.text: Gank when the enemy pushes the lane and moves away from their turret. Before level 6, Warwick has no guaranteed crowd control, so an ally must land immobilizing crowd control first; if that opening is unavailable, turn toward a camp or objective on the other side instead of forcing the gank.

warwick-jungle-path.basis: Choose the lane you want to gank first, then path so your clear ends nearby. Warwick gains more from ganks than from farming.
warwick-jungle-path.text: Plan your clear to finish near a lane with a gank opportunity. Warwick ranks high in kills at 14 minutes but low in CS, so his value comes from how often he intervenes rather than how much he farms. Choose the lane you want to gank first, then clear camps toward it instead of waiting until every camp is done to consider a gank.

warwick-objective.basis: During standoffs at Dragon or Baron, W's passive lets you see enemies who have lost health. During an objective standoff, engage as soon as a W mark appears. Use R's movement speed based range to find an angle from the far side of the objective pit.
warwick-objective.text: During standoffs at Dragon or Baron, W’s passive reveals enemies as their health drops; a mark appearing is the signal to engage. Because R’s leap distance scales with movement speed, it can reach across a wall, letting Warwick find an entry angle from the far side of the objective pit.

warwick-phase.basis: Warwick can start ganking at level 2, once he has Q and W. Warwick reaches his peak power when he gains R at level 6. Warwick clears the jungle slowly, making it hard to gain an advantage through farming. In late-game duels, Warwick loses to damage dealers who have scaled up. Warwick can still suppress one target with R in the late game.
warwick-phase.text: Warwick can gank from level 2, once he has Q and W, and reaches a power peak when he gains R at level 6. His jungle clear speed and 14 minute CS figures are among the lowest, so competing through farming yields little advantage. Scaled damage dealers beat him in late game duels, but he can still use R to take one target out of the fight.

warwick-situational-antiheal.basis: If enemy healing could turn a fight, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item. Warwick stays close to enemies and attacks for a long time, so he can easily keep Grievous Wounds applied.
warwick-situational-antiheal.text: If enemy healing could turn a fight, buy Executioner’s Calling after completing one core item. Warwick stays close and keeps attacking, so he can maintain Grievous Wounds easily.

warwick-skill-passive.basis: Warwick's passive heals him more when his health is low. Don't leave a fight just because Warwick is at half health. Draw the fight toward minions or jungle monsters so Warwick has targets to heal from with his passive.
warwick-skill-passive.text: Warwick’s passive heals him more as his health falls and is strongest when his health is very low. Retreating simply because he has reached half health gives up that advantage, but he needs something to hit to heal, so draw fights toward nearby minions or jungle monsters.

warwick-skill-q-charge.basis: Tap Q to bite the target, or hold it to move behind them while biting and change positions. Hold Q to move an enemy toward your allies or escape turret range during a dive. While Q is biting a target, Warwick follows them even if they flee.
warwick-skill-q-charge.text: Tap Q to leap in and bite, or hold it to move behind the target while biting and change positions. Use the held cast to move an enemy toward your allies or to escape turret range during a dive. Warwick follows the target throughout the bite, even if they try to flee.

warwick-skill-q-value.basis: Q deals damage based on the target's maximum health and heals Warwick for the damage dealt. Q's healing is key to sustaining through jungle clears and fights.
warwick-skill-q-value.text: Q deals damage based on the target’s maximum health and heals Warwick for the damage dealt, making it central to his sustain in both jungle clears and fights. It is also his only way to close the gap with a leap, so if you plan to gank, avoid using it up on a camp; check its cooldown before moving out.

warwick-skill-w.basis: W's passive reveals the location of enemy champions below half health even without vision. After a lane trade ends, use W's detection to choose your next gank target. Using W marks the nearest enemy regardless of health. If W detects no target, part of its cooldown is refunded.
warwick-skill-w.text: W’s passive reveals the location of enemy champions below half health even without vision, making its detection a useful guide to your next gank target after a lane trade. Activating W marks the nearest enemy regardless of health; if it detects no target, part of its cooldown is refunded, so using it to check nearby carries little cost.

warwick-teamfight.basis: In teamfights, suppress a key enemy damage dealer with R. Immediately after using R, Warwick is locked in place. Engage with R when the enemy damage dealer is within your allies' range or your allies are ready to engage with you.
warwick-teamfight.text: In teamfights, R can take a key enemy damage dealer out of the fight, but Warwick is locked in place immediately after using it. If allies cannot follow up from where they are, he will be the only one caught. Engage when the damage dealer enters your allies’ range or your allies are ready to go in with you.

wukong-combo-eq.basis: Buffer Q while dashing in with E. Q empowers your next basic attack. Activate Q during the dash to land the empowered attack faster than if you activate it after arriving.
wukong-combo-eq.text: Dash in with E (Nimbus Strike) and buffer Q (Crushing Blow) during the dash. Because Q empowers your next basic attack, activating it before you arrive lets the attack land immediately; waiting until you arrive delays it.

wukong-combo-r-flash.basis: You can move while casting R. To compensate for R's short range, Flash into the middle of the enemy team while casting it. To knock up multiple enemies with R, reach them before they spread out.
wukong-combo-r-flash.text: Wukong can move during R (Cyclone), so Flash into the middle of the enemy team while spinning to make up for its short range. Reach them before they spread out to knock up multiple enemies at once.

wukong-combo-rw.basis: Use W immediately after starting R. A W clone created immediately after R mimics Cyclone. Use W's invisibility to retreat and avoid the enemy's counterattack.
wukong-combo-rw.text: Use W Warrior Trickster immediately after starting R Cyclone. The clone will mimic Cyclone, while Wukong can retreat invisibly and avoid the enemy’s counterattack.

wukong-jungle-path.basis: To clear faster, move between camps without letting your P stacks expire. R deals heavy damage to jungle camps. R has a long cooldown, so save it for fights instead of using it to clear camps.
wukong-jungle-path.text: Move between jungle camps without letting your P (Stone Skin) stacks expire to clear faster. Although R (Cyclone) deals heavy damage to camps, its long cooldown means using it to clear can cost you the next fight, so save it for combat.

wukong-objective.basis: Decide whether to start an objective fight based on whether R is available. Without R, engaging and disengaging are difficult, so secure vision and retreat. Force an objective fight as soon as R becomes available again.
wukong-objective.text: Decide whether to start an objective fight based on whether R (Cyclone) is available. Without it, Wukong struggles to engage or disengage, so secure vision and retreat; once it is ready again, force the objective fight.

wukong-phase.basis: Wukong's early clear speed and damage per minute are average. Wukong is especially vulnerable to magic damage. Build an advantage through early ganks. Wukong is strongest when he gets R at level 6 and in the mid game when he completes his first core item.
wukong-phase.text: Wukong’s early clear speed and damage per minute are average, and he is especially vulnerable to magic damage. Build an advantage through early ganks; his strongest points come when he gains R Cyclone at level 6 and when he completes his first core item in the mid game.

wukong-skill-e.basis: E is a targeted dash that enemies cannot dodge. E has short range, so first find an opening to get close to the enemy. Do not use E first while the enemy still has their mobility ability available. Follow up with basic attacks immediately after E lands to use the increased attack speed.
wukong-skill-e.text: E (Nimbus Strike) is a targeted dash that enemies cannot dodge, but its short range means you must first find an opening to get close. As Wukong’s only way to engage, save it while the enemy’s mobility ability is available, then follow up immediately with basic attacks to use the attack speed gained on arrival.

wukong-skill-passive.basis: Gain P stacks whenever you attack champions or jungle monsters. P stacks increase your armor. P stacks increase your healing. Attack nearby jungle monsters just before a fight to build up P stacks. Clone attacks also build P stacks.
wukong-skill-passive.text: Each hit on a champion or jungle monster builds a stack of P (Stone Skin), increasing both armor and healing. Hit a nearby jungle monster a few times just before a fight to start with those stacks, and remember that clone attacks build them too.

wukong-skill-q.basis: Q is an empowered basic attack with increased range. Q's armor reduction also increases your allies' physical damage. Q's cooldown decreases whenever Wukong or his clone attacks an enemy. Save Q for champion fights instead of wasting it on a wave or camp beforehand.
wukong-skill-q.text: Q (Crushing Blow) is a longer-range empowered basic attack that reduces the target’s armor, increasing your allies’ physical damage too. Each attack by Wukong or his clone reduces Q’s cooldown, making it available more often in extended fights, so save it for champion fights instead of spending it on a wave or camp beforehand.

wukong-skill-r.basis: Your movement speed increases during R. Walk into grouped enemies while spinning with R. Use the first R as a signal for your team to engage. Use the second R to finish enemies off or hinder their escape. Stuns and roots interrupt R, so use it after the enemy's main crowd control has been used.
wukong-skill-r.text: R (Cyclone) increases your movement speed while spinning, so walk into grouped enemies instead of standing still. You can cast it again before it goes on cooldown: use the first cast to signal your team to engage and the second to finish enemies or hinder their escape. Stuns and roots interrupt it, so wait until the enemy’s main crowd control has been used.

wukong-skill-w.basis: W is a dash that briefly makes you invisible. W leaves a stationary clone where you cast it. Use your W clone to draw targeted enemy abilities away from you. Do not use W immediately after engaging, so you can disappear from enemy vision and disguise your movement direction. W's invisibility is revealed by turrets and true sight.
wukong-skill-w.text: W (Warrior Trickster) is a short dash that briefly makes you invisible and leaves a stationary clone where you cast it. Save it after engaging so you can draw targeted abilities toward the clone or disappear from sight and disguise your direction. Turrets and true sight reveal you while invisible.

wukong-teamfight.basis: In teamfights, wait for an opening to land R. When two or more enemies overlap, close in with E and use R. Time your engage so you do not go in late alone and get picked off. Coordinate the timing of your R casts with your team's crowd control.
wukong-teamfight.text: In teamfights, wait for an opening to land R (Cyclone). When two or more enemies overlap, close in with E (Nimbus Strike) and spin, timing your engage with your team’s crowd control so you do not arrive late and get picked off alone.

wukong-teamfight-clone.basis: Enemies have a hard time distinguishing the W clone from the real Wukong. While enemies attack your W clone, circle around the side and enter their backline. When close to death, use W as a last resort to escape and deceive enemies.
wukong-teamfight-clone.text: Enemies have a hard time distinguishing Wukong’s W (Warrior Trickster) clone from the real Wukong. Using it in a teamfight buys time while they attack the clone, letting you circle around the side and enter their backline. Near death, use W as a last resort to escape while deceiving them.

xayah-combo-passive-weave.basis: After using an ability, Xayah's passive applies to her auto attacks. During trades, weave in a passive auto attack between abilities. An auto attack after each of W and Q quickly adds feathers for E.
xayah-combo-passive-weave.text: Xayah’s passive applies to auto attacks after she uses an ability, so weave them into trades: W, auto attack, Q, auto attack. This places far more feathers in the same amount of time, increasing E’s damage and the chance of a root.

xayah-combo-root.basis: Set up at least three feathers to root with E. Place two feathers with Q, add one with a passive auto attack, then recall them with E. If you land only Q before using E, it deals damage without rooting.
xayah-combo-root.text: The key to rooting with E is to place at least three feathers first: lay down two in a line with Q, add another with a passive empowered auto attack, then recall them with E for a guaranteed root. If you rush E after landing only Q, you will deal damage but the opponent can walk away.

xayah-combo-ult.basis: Xayah is untargetable while leaping with R. R leaves a line of feathers when Xayah lands. Dodge an enemy engage or skillshot with R, then immediately root with E.
xayah-combo-ult.text: Xayah becomes untargetable while leaping with R and leaves a line of feathers when she lands. Use it to avoid an enemy engage or skillshot, then press E immediately to turn the dodge into a root. R → E is her strongest counterattack.

xayah-laning.basis: In lane, poke opponents through minions with Q and passive auto attacks. Start a trade when the opponent stands over three feathers. If there is no root angle, save E for farming or disengaging. Do not stay forward with the wave pushed deep toward the enemy turret.
xayah-laning.text: In lane, poke opponents through minions with Q and passive empowered auto attacks. An opponent standing over three feathers is your cue to trade; without that angle, save E for farming or disengaging. Xayah has almost no mobility, so do not stand far forward after pushing the wave deep toward the enemy turret.

xayah-laning-feather-trap.basis: Feathers remain on the ground briefly. Set up Q feathers at brush entrances or river approaches the enemy may use to prepare a root.
xayah-laning-feather-trap.text: Feathers remain on the ground briefly, so you can place them where a fight is likely to start. Send Q toward a brush entrance or river approach the enemy may use, and half the root requirement will already be met when they engage.

xayah-phase.basis: Xayah is weak in trades at levels 1–2, when she cannot gather feathers. Leveling E shortens the root's cooldown and opens up chances to fight. Learning R at level 6 gives Xayah a way to survive. Xayah peaks in the mid to late game as she builds core critical strike items. Xayah has low movement speed and no escape besides R, making positioning mistakes costly.
xayah-phase.text: Xayah is weak in trades at levels 1–2 because she cannot build up feathers. Opportunities open as she levels E and its root cooldown shortens, while R gives her a survival tool at level 6. Her power peaks in the mid to late game as critical strike core items make a single E an area finishing move. At every stage, her low movement speed and lack of an escape besides R mean a positioning mistake can get her killed.

xayah-skill-e.basis: E hits enemies along the feathers' path back to Xayah. Move sideways to change E's recall angle and bring scattered feathers onto one target. When multiple feathers hit the same enemy, later feathers deal reduced damage. When bringing feathers onto one target, aim for the root over damage.
xayah-skill-e.text: E hits enemies along each feather’s path back to Xayah, so moving sideways can change the recall angle and bring scattered feathers through one target. Later feathers deal reduced damage when they hit the same enemy, so line them up for the root rather than extra damage.

xayah-skill-e-crit.basis: E's damage increases with critical strike chance and critical strike damage. With core critical strike items in the late game, E can heavily damage the enemy backline even without a root angle.
xayah-skill-e-crit.text: E’s damage increases with critical strike chance and critical strike damage. As Xayah completes core items with those stats, each cast becomes more powerful; in the late game, E can heavily damage the enemy backline even without a root angle.

xayah-skill-passive.basis: Passive auto attacks pierce enemies in their path, reaching opponents behind minions. In lane, poke with piercing passive auto attacks.
xayah-skill-passive.text: Xayah’s passive auto attacks pierce every enemy in their path, reaching opponents behind minions; use them for most of your lane poke. Spending an empowered auto attack on a minion when you don’t need a feather leaves you with one fewer feather for a fight.

xayah-skill-q.basis: Q costs little mana and leaves two feathers in a line. Throw Q so its feathers pass through the opponent for a later E recall. Q feathers that miss to the side fall outside E's recall path.
xayah-skill-q.text: Q costs little mana and leaves two feathers in a line. Aim it along the line between Xayah and her opponent so the feathers pass through that target again when recalled with E; feathers thrown off to the side may deal damage initially but fall outside the recall path.

xayah-skill-r.basis: Do not use R first just to deal more damage. Use R to dodge enemy skillshot ultimates or engage abilities. Xayah ignores unit collision while leaping with R. If cornered against a wall and surrounded, escape with R.
xayah-skill-r.text: R is an escape tool before it is a damage ability, so do not use it early just to deal a little more damage. It can avoid skillshot ultimates and engage abilities, and Xayah ignores unit collision during the leap, letting her escape a surround even when cornered against a wall.

xayah-skill-w.basis: W increases attack speed and adds a second blade. Hitting a champion while W is active increases movement speed. W has a short duration, so activate it when you can keep auto attacking. W is effective for hitting objectives or taking down turrets.
xayah-skill-w.text: W increases attack speed and adds a second blade, while hitting a champion also grants movement speed. Its duration is short, so save it for moments when you can keep auto attacking instead of wasting it to push the lane. It is most efficient when you can continuously hit a stationary target, such as an objective or turret.

xayah-skill-w-rakan.basis: Nearby allied Rakan also gains W's effect. Rakan gains movement speed only when Xayah actually hits a target. When Rakan engages, activate W and immediately auto attack.
xayah-skill-w-rakan.text: Nearby allied Rakan also gains W’s effect, but his movement speed increases only when Xayah actually hits a target. Activate W as Rakan engages and follow it immediately with an auto attack.

xayah-teamfight.basis: In teamfights, build up feathers with auto attacks from the back, then root enemies with E when they engage. Do not use up E before an engage; keep it to stop melee champions who get on top of you. Use E when multiple enemies are grouped together to root them all.
xayah-teamfight.text: In teamfights, Xayah builds up feathers with auto attacks from the back, then uses E to root enemies as they engage. Keep E ready to stop melee champions who reach you rather than spending it before the engage begins; if several enemies are grouped together, it can root them all and turn the fight.

xerath-combo-poke.basis: When poking without a kill opportunity, slow them with W, then fire Q. Firing Q first prompts the opponent to dodge, making it harder to land.
xerath-combo-poke.text: When poking without a kill opportunity, place W first, then fire Q at the slowed opponent. Leading with Q gives them time to start dodging, making it harder to land.

xerath-combo-stun-first.basis: For a guaranteed combo, stun with E, land W in the center, then fire Q. If E misses, save mana instead of following up with W and Q.
xerath-combo-stun-first.text: For a guaranteed combo, stun with E Shocking Orb, land W Eye of Destruction in the center while the target is stunned, then use Q Arcanopulse. The central W hit and Q are guaranteed only if E connects, so if it misses, save your mana instead of continuing the combo.

xerath-combo-ult.basis: Xerath cannot move while using R. Before activating R, pin the opponent down with E or W. Fire the remaining R shots ahead of the opponent's straight escape path. Activate R only after finding a safe position.
xerath-combo-ult.text: Xerath cannot move during R Rite of the Arcane. Pin the opponent down with E or W before activating it, then aim the remaining shots ahead of their straight escape path. Find a safe position first or you will be caught.

xerath-laning-mana.basis: Excessive poke leaves too little mana for farming or self-defense. Fire Q only when the opponent is in a position where it will hit. If Q won't hit, cancel it to get your mana back. When safe, basic attack the opposing champion to restore more mana with your passive.
xerath-laning-mana.text: Excessive poke drains the mana Xerath needs for both farming and self-defense. Fire Q only when the opponent is positioned to be hit; otherwise, cancel it to recover mana. When it is safe, basic attack the opposing champion, since P Mana Surge restores more mana against champions.

xerath-laning-poke.basis: Poke with Q from behind minions, using your range advantage. Don't push the lane unnecessarily. Without a movement ability, Xerath is vulnerable to ganks when his lane is pushed. If you need to push the lane, establish river vision first.
xerath-laning-poke.text: Use your range advantage to poke with Q from behind minions, and avoid pushing the lane unnecessarily. Xerath has no movement ability and is vulnerable to ganks when his lane is pushed, so establish river vision first if you need to push.
