xerath-phase.basis: At levels 1–2, Xerath's high mana costs limit how often he can poke. Xerath is very fragile at levels 1–2. After learning R at level 6, Xerath can pressure beyond his lane. Xerath is strongest in the mid game when he has both ability power and mana. In the late game, poor positioning can get Xerath killed instantly when an opponent engages.
xerath-phase.text: At levels 1–2, high mana costs limit Xerath’s poke, and he is very fragile. From level 6, R lets him pressure beyond his lane; he peaks in the mid game when he has both ability power and mana. Late in the game, opponents have ways to engage, so a single positioning mistake can get him killed instantly.

xerath-situational-zhonya.basis: If the opposing team has an assassin who can dive in, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. Zhonya's Hourglass can keep you alive if an opponent engages while you are casting R. Zhonya's Hourglass is a safeguard if you get caught while E is unavailable.
xerath-situational-zhonya.text: If the opposing team has an assassin who can dive in, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier. It is your only way to survive an engage during R and a safeguard if you are caught while E is unavailable.

xerath-skill-e.basis: E's stun lasts longer the farther its orb travels. Minions can block E's orb. When firing E, choose an angle clear of minions. Save E to interrupt an opponent's dash as self-defense.
xerath-skill-e.text: E stuns longer the farther its orb travels, so landing it from a distance is more rewarding. Minions can block it, so choose an angle with a clear path. As Xerath’s only means of self-defense, it is best saved to interrupt an opponent diving in.

xerath-skill-q-aim.basis: Q is easier to land when the opponent moves toward or away from Xerath than when they move side to side. Look for a Q when the opponent steps forward to last-hit a minion. Look for a Q when the opponent retreats to recall.
xerath-skill-q-aim.text: Q is much easier to land when an opponent moves toward or away from you than when they move side to side. Look for the moment they step forward to last-hit a minion or retreat to a spot where they can recall.

xerath-skill-q-charge.basis: Q gains range the longer it charges. Xerath is slowed while charging Q. Fully charge Q only from a completely safe distance. If a melee opponent is close, charge Q briefly before firing.
xerath-skill-q-charge.text: Q gains range as you charge it, but Xerath is slowed during the charge. Fully charge it only from a completely safe distance; if a melee opponent is close, fire after a short charge. Cancel if the shot no longer lines up: firing nothing refunds half the mana spent.

xerath-skill-r-cancel.basis: If R ends without firing a shot, its cooldown is halved. If the opponent disappears from vision right after activating R, end it without firing.
xerath-skill-r-cancel.text: If R ends without firing a shot, its cooldown is halved. If the opponent disappears from vision right after you activate it, end it without forcing a shot so R is available again for the next fight.

xerath-skill-w-center.basis: Land W in the center for its full damage and slow. Aim W ahead of the opponent's movement. After landing W in the center, follow up with Q.
xerath-skill-w-center.text: W Eye of Destruction needs to hit in the center to deal its full damage and slow. Catching the opponent with only the outer edge greatly reduces its value as poke, so aim ahead of their movement and follow up with Q Arcanopulse after landing the center hit.

xerath-teamfight.basis: Start teamfights from the very back. After your allies engage and pin down the opponents, deal heavy damage with W and R. Save E to stop assassins who reach Xerath.
xerath-teamfight.text: Start teamfights from the very back. Once your allies engage and lock down the opponents, pour on damage with W Eye of Destruction and R Rite of the Arcane, while saving E Shocking Orb to stop assassins who get onto you. If you use all your abilities first and stand there, you will have nothing to respond with when they engage on you.

xerath-teamfight-siege.basis: Xerath is strongest during sieges and standoffs around objectives. Keep pressuring opponents with Q from a safe position beyond a wall or behind a turret. Once the opponents back off, have your team start the objective.
xerath-teamfight-siege.text: Xerath is strongest during sieges and standoffs around objectives. Keep hitting opponents with Q from a safe position beyond a wall or behind a turret so they cannot settle into position; once they back off, have your team start the objective.

xinzhao-combo-challenge.basis: Champions hit by the thrust of Wind Becomes Lightning become Challenged. Audacious Charge has increased range against Challenged targets. Hit a distant target with Wind Becomes Lightning first, then follow up with Audacious Charge. Crescent Guard knocks back only enemies who are not Challenged. Challenge the target you want to leave in place before using Crescent Guard.
xinzhao-combo-challenge.text: Mark your target first: a champion hit by W Wind Becomes Lightning’s thrust becomes Challenged, extending E Audacious Charge’s range against them. Against a distant target, land W before following with E. R Crescent Guard knocks back only enemies who are not Challenged, so your mark determines who stays and who gets pushed away.

xinzhao-combo-gank.basis: For ganks, close in with E, activate Q, then knock the target up with an auto attack, W, an auto attack, and a third auto attack. Only auto attacks consume Q's empowered attacks, so using W between them does not reduce the count. W adds one hit toward Determination.
xinzhao-combo-gank.text: For a basic gank, close in with E Audacious Charge, activate Q Three Talon Strike, then auto attack, use W Wind Becomes Lightning, and land two more auto attacks to knock the target up on the third. Only auto attacks consume Q’s empowered attacks, so weaving in W costs nothing and adds a hit toward P Determination.

xinzhao-combo-r-timing.basis: Activate R after engaging to survive. Activate R when you enter the enemy team and become surrounded. While R is active, you take no damage from champions outside your spear's range. Activating R just before engaging spends its immunity time on movement, so activate it after closing in.
xinzhao-combo-r-timing.text: Use R Crescent Guard to survive after engaging: activate it once you have entered the middle of the enemy team and are surrounded. It prevents damage from champions outside your spear’s range, making it especially valuable against teams with many ranged damage dealers. If you activate it just before engaging, you waste its immunity time moving in, so wait until you have closed the gap.

xinzhao-jungle-counter.basis: His base movement speed and dueling strength make counterjungling valuable. When you confirm that the enemy jungler is clearing camps on the other side, take camps on the opposite side and leave. If you encounter the enemy jungler with your abilities ready, take the fight.
xinzhao-jungle-counter.text: Xin Zhao’s base movement speed ranks among the highest of all champions, and his strong dueling makes counterjungling valuable. When you confirm the enemy jungler is clearing camps on one side, take camps on the opposite side and leave; if you meet them with your abilities ready, take the fight. Always check whether an enemy laner can join it.

xinzhao-jungle-gank.basis: If the enemy is pushed up in lane and an ally has crowd control, gank with E and Q. If the enemy has vision in the river, land W to make them Challenged, then engage from E's increased range.
xinzhao-jungle-gank.text: The Challenge mechanic is key to successful ganks. If an enemy is pushed up in lane and an ally has crowd control, E Audacious Charge and Q Three Talon Strike can secure a guaranteed kill. If the enemy has vision in the river, land W Wind Becomes Lightning first to Challenge them, then jump in from E’s increased range instead of approaching head-on.

xinzhao-phase.basis: Your dueling and ganking become strong from level 3, when you have all three basic abilities. His kills at 14 minutes and damage per minute are below the jungler average, so he is not a champion who snowballs through early ganks alone. Clear camps while looking for skirmishes around objectives. In the late game, you can die easily once R ends, so avoid engaging alone.
xinzhao-phase.text: Xin Zhao’s dueling and ganking grow strong at level 3, once he has all three basic abilities, but his kills at 14 minutes and damage per minute are below the jungler average, so early ganks alone are not his route to snowballing. Keep clearing camps while looking for skirmishes around objectives. In the late game, he can be killed quickly when R ends, so avoid engaging alone.

xinzhao-situational-antiheal.basis: A target who is healing may survive R's damage based on current health. If the target you need to kill is healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
xinzhao-situational-antiheal.text: A healing target may survive R Crescent Guard’s damage based on current health. If the target you need to kill can heal, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.

xinzhao-skill-e.basis: Audacious Charge is a targeted dash. To escape with Audacious Charge, you need a minion or jungle monster in the direction you want to flee. When choosing where to fight, first check whether there is a target behind you to dash to with Audacious Charge. How far you can engage with Audacious Charge depends on whether Wind Becomes Lightning hits.
xinzhao-skill-e.text: E Audacious Charge is a targeted dash, so escaping with it requires a minion or jungle monster in the direction you want to flee. Before choosing where to fight, check for a target behind you. E also gains range against Challenged targets, making a W Wind Becomes Lightning hit decisive for how far away you can engage.

xinzhao-skill-passive.basis: Determination deals bonus damage and heals you on every third hit. W also counts toward Determination's hit count. During jungle clears and extended fights, use W consistently to benefit from Determination's healing. Determination's healing scales with maximum health, so health items also improve your sustain.
xinzhao-skill-passive.text: P Determination deals bonus damage and heals you on every third hit. W Wind Becomes Lightning counts toward those hits, so using it consistently during jungle clears and extended fights helps preserve your health. The healing scales with maximum health, making health items improve your sustain as well.

xinzhao-skill-q.basis: Q empowers three auto attacks and knocks up the enemy on the third. Q's empowered auto attacks also reduce the cooldowns of your other abilities. Use Q freely on jungle camps, too. When going for a kill, time your auto attacks so the third lands as the enemy tries to Flash.
xinzhao-skill-q.text: Q Three Talon Strike empowers three auto attacks, with the third knocking the target airborne. Those attacks also reduce your other abilities’ cooldowns, so keep using Q on jungle camps. When going for a kill, pace your auto attacks so the third lands as the enemy tries to Flash.

xinzhao-skill-r.basis: R deals damage based on current health, knocks enemies back, and grants immunity to damage from outside your spear's range. The more of the enemy team's damage comes from marksmen and mages, the more valuable R's immunity becomes. Even with R active, you still take damage from nearby melee champions. Before engaging, check where the enemy team's main damage comes from to judge the value of R.
xinzhao-skill-r.text: R Crescent Guard deals damage based on current health, knocks enemies back, and blocks damage from champions outside your spear’s range. Its immunity is more valuable when much of the enemy team’s damage comes from marksmen and mages, while nearby melee champions can still damage you. Check where the enemy team’s damage will come from before engaging to judge R’s value.

xinzhao-skill-w.basis: W has a slash and a thrust; the thrust deals most of its damage. Aim W when the enemy has trouble changing direction. Champions and large monsters hit by W's thrust are revealed. Use W's thrust to find enemies who flee into brush.
xinzhao-skill-w.text: W Wind Becomes Lightning has a slash followed by a thrust that deals most of its damage. Its slow cast lets enemies sidestep it, so aim for a moment when the target has trouble changing direction. The thrust reveals champions and large monsters it hits, which also makes it useful for finding enemies who flee into brush.

xinzhao-teamfight-entry.basis: Engage after the enemy has used their key crowd control. R's damage immunity applies only against champions outside your spear's range. Even with R active, you are vulnerable to nearby melee champions and crowd control. If an enemy melee diver is still alive, do not engage relying on R alone.
xinzhao-teamfight-entry.text: Engage after the enemy has used its key crowd control. R Crescent Guard blocks damage only from champions outside your spear’s range, so nearby melee champions can still hurt you and crowd control can still affect you. If an enemy melee diver is still alive, relying on R alone can get you killed even while its immunity is active.

xinzhao-teamfight-role.basis: In teamfights, use R's knockback to clear space in front of your carries. Jump in just after an enemy diver reaches your carry and knock them away with R.
xinzhao-teamfight-role.text: In teamfights, Xin Zhao is often more valuable for clearing space in front of his carries with R Crescent Guard’s knockback than for picking off the enemy backline. Jump in just after an enemy diver reaches your carry and knock them away with R; even without a pick, this can turn the fight.

yasuo-combo-e-chain.basis: Chain E through different minions to close the gap on your opponent. When chasing, dash through minions and save E on your opponent. If you plan to retreat, use E directly on your opponent so you can use minions to escape.
yasuo-combo-e-chain.text: Chain E through different minions to close a large gap. When chasing, dash through minions and save E for your opponent; when retreating, use E on your opponent first so the minions remain available as an escape route.

yasuo-combo-eq.basis: Start a trade by using E through a minion to dash past your opponent. Use Q during your E dash. Q used during E hits in a circle around you, giving it a more forgiving hitbox than the forward thrust. Use Q during E, then follow up with a basic attack immediately after landing.
yasuo-combo-eq.text: For a basic trade, use E through a minion to dash past your opponent, then press Q during the dash. It strikes in a circle instead of thrusting forward, giving it a more forgiving hitbox; follow with a basic attack as soon as you land.

yasuo-combo-tornado.basis: After landing Q twice, your third Q becomes a tornado that knocks opponents airborne. Use R immediately after knocking your opponent airborne with your Q tornado. To save your tornado, hit minions with Q to maintain your stacks.
yasuo-combo-tornado.text: After landing Q twice, your third Q becomes a tornado that knocks your opponent airborne. Press R as soon as it connects for the standard finish, or hit minions with Q to maintain your stacks while saving the tornado.

yasuo-laning.basis: Be careful not to push the wave carelessly with Q. Yasuo uses minions to approach or escape with E in lane. Only start a trade when you have two Q stacks and can use your tornado immediately. Start trading when your passive shield is available.
yasuo-laning.text: Avoid pushing the wave carelessly with Q. Minions give Yasuo routes to engage and escape with E, and clearing the wave removes both. Start a trade only when you have two Q stacks, can launch a tornado immediately, and still have your passive shield.

yasuo-phase.basis: Yasuo stacks Q slowly at levels 1–2 and tends to lose trades. Look for kill opportunities once you have invested skill points in Q and learned R at level 6. Prioritize surviving in the early game. Yasuo excels in the mid to late game with two or more critical strike items.
yasuo-phase.text: At levels 1–2, Yasuo has relatively low health and stacks Q slowly, making trades unfavorable. Investing skill points in Q and learning R at level 6 opens up kill opportunities, but his early damage per minute and death statistics are poor, so focus on surviving that stretch. His real power comes in the mid to late game with two or more critical strike items.

yasuo-situational-antiheal.basis: If your opponent relies on healing to sustain, get Executioner's Calling for healing reduction. Yasuo tends to draw out duels. Yasuo struggles to secure kills in long duels if his opponent keeps healing.
yasuo-situational-antiheal.text: If your opponent relies on healing to sustain, buy Executioner's Calling for healing reduction. Yasuo's duels tend to run long, and continued healing can keep an opponent alive no matter how much damage you deal.

yasuo-situational-mercurial.basis: If the enemy team initiates fights with crowd control that locks you down, buy Quicksilver Sash between core items. Yasuo loses damage while locked down because crowd control interrupts his Q.
yasuo-situational-mercurial.text: If the enemy team opens fights with crowd control that locks you down, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items. Crowd control interrupts Yasuo's Q, so every moment spent locked down costs you damage.

yasuo-skill-e.basis: E dashes through the selected target. You cannot use E again on the same target for a short time. Identify minions positioned to let you dash over walls with E in advance to secure an escape route. Before using E directly on an enemy champion, consider that you cannot use E on them again to close the gap for a while.
yasuo-skill-e.text: E dashes through a selected target, which you cannot target with E again for a short time. Identify minions positioned for a dash over a wall to give yourself an escape route, and remember that using E directly on an enemy champion during a trade leaves you unable to close the gap on them with E again for a while.

yasuo-skill-passive.basis: The passive shield charges as you move. Keep moving in lane to charge your passive shield. When Flow is full, taking damage from a champion or monster triggers the passive shield, which lasts briefly. You're most vulnerable right after an enemy poke strips your passive shield.
yasuo-skill-passive.text: Your passive shield charges through movement, so keep moving in lane to fill it. When Flow is full, damage from a champion or monster triggers the shield, which lasts only briefly; you are most vulnerable just after enemy poke removes it.

yasuo-skill-q.basis: Q counts as a basic attack. Q can critically strike. Q applies life steal. Q applies on-hit effects. Increasing attack speed reduces Q's cooldown. Q has a narrow hitbox. Crowd control interrupts Q's cast. Predict when your opponent will move sideways and use Q.
yasuo-skill-q.text: Q counts as a basic attack: it can critically strike and applies life steal and on-hit effects, while attack speed reduces its cooldown. Its hitbox is narrow and crowd control can interrupt it, so anticipate sideways movement before casting or use it for a circular strike during an E dash.

yasuo-skill-w.basis: W only blocks projectiles. Turret attacks pass through W. Beam abilities pass through W. W cannot block projectiles that have already arrived before the wall forms. W has a long cooldown, so save it to block grab abilities or your opponent's key ranged abilities.
yasuo-skill-w.text: W Wind Wall blocks projectiles, but turret attacks and beam abilities pass through it, and it cannot stop a projectile that arrives before the wall forms. Its cooldown is long, so save it for a grab ability or a key ranged ability.

yasuo-teamfight.basis: Avoid being the one to initiate teamfights. Engage with R after allied crowd control or your own Q tornado knocks an enemy airborne. Before engaging with R, use minions and allies from the flank to set up an angle of approach. You gain armor penetration after using R. After using R, focus on killing the enemy backline.
yasuo-teamfight.text: Yasuo should not initiate teamfights. Before entering, work from the flank, using minions and allies to find an angle; only go in with R after allied crowd control or your own Q tornado knocks an enemy airborne. R grants armor penetration, so focus on eliminating the enemy backline afterward.

yone-combo-allin.basis: For an all-in, use E, whirlwind Q, a basic attack, W, R, a basic attack, then recast E. If you activate E late, damage dealt beforehand does not count toward its bonus damage on return. After activating E, deal enough damage before returning.
yone-combo-allin.text: For an all-in, activate E (Soul Unbound) first, engage with whirlwind Q (Mortal Steel), then use a basic attack, W (Spirit Cleave), R (Fate Sealed), and another basic attack before recasting E to return. Damage dealt before E does not count toward its damage on return, while returning immediately after activating it wastes the engage.

yone-combo-r-followup.basis: When following up on an ally's immobilization, use R to pull and knock the target up, then use whirlwind Q. As an enemy hit by R lands, knock them up again with whirlwind Q.
yone-combo-r-followup.text: When following up on an ally’s immobilization, use R (Fate Sealed) first to pull and knock the target up, then save whirlwind Q (Mortal Steel) to knock them up again as they land. This leaves them virtually no time to use an escape or cleanse.

yone-combo-trade.basis: Stack Q on minions, knock the opponent up with whirlwind Q, then trade with two basic attacks, W, and one more basic attack. After knocking the opponent up with whirlwind Q, land the planned number of basic attacks and back off.
yone-combo-trade.text: For a lane trade, stack Q (Mortal Steel) on minions, then close in and knock the opponent up with whirlwind Q before landing two basic attacks, W (Spirit Cleave), and one more basic attack. The clock starts as soon as whirlwind Q connects: plan how many attacks to land after the knockup, then back off.

yone-laning.basis: Using Q repeatedly pushes the minion wave. When you do not know where the enemy jungler is, use Q less to farm, let the lane push toward you, and hold E. When the opponent has pushed the lane, close in with whirlwind Q and trade damage.
yone-laning.text: Because Yone uses no resources, it is easy to keep using Q and push the wave unintentionally. If the lane is pushed out and E is unavailable, a gank can catch him, so when the enemy jungler’s location is unknown, farm less with Q, let the wave come toward you, and hold E. When your opponent has pushed the lane instead, look to close in with whirlwind Q and trade only then.

yone-phase-early.basis: Yone is weakest at levels 1–2, when his attack speed is low and he has no whirlwind Q. At levels 1–2, avoid forcing an engage; use Q to last-hit and manage your stacks.
yone-phase-early.text: Yone is weakest at levels 1–2: his low attack speed makes W slow, and he has no whirlwind Q yet. By the 14-minute mark, his deaths rank among the highest while his kills are low, reflecting how often overly aggressive early engages get him killed. During this period, use Q to last-hit and manage its stacks.

yone-phase-spike.basis: Yone's power rises sharply as he gains attack speed and critical strike chance. Attack speed reduces W's cooldown and cast time. Start fighting proactively once you complete your first core item.
yone-phase-spike.text: Yone’s power rises sharply once he gains attack speed and critical strike chance. Attack speed shortens both W’s cooldown and cast time, improving its defense and damage, while excess critical strike chance converts to attack damage, so overlapping items are not wasted. Start looking for fights proactively once your first core item is complete.

yone-situational-antiheal.basis: If the opponent's healing could turn a duel, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Yone can stay close and keep landing basic attacks to maintain Grievous Wounds.
yone-situational-antiheal.text: If an opponent’s healing could turn a duel, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Yone stays close and lands repeated basic attacks, letting him maintain Grievous Wounds.

yone-situational-mercurial.basis: Buy Quicksilver Sash early if the enemy has many ways to lock Yone down. Yone cannot return to his body with E while under strong crowd control.
yone-situational-mercurial.text: Buy Quicksilver Sash earlier against a team with ways to lock Yone down. He cannot return to his body with E Soul Unbound while under strong crowd control, so a single immobilizing effect can take away his escape.

yone-skill-e.basis: Use E so you can return to your original position after engaging. Some of the damage dealt to champions in spirit form is dealt again when Yone returns to his body. Activate E before dealing damage so that damage counts toward the damage dealt on return. Yone cannot return to his body with E while under strong crowd control. Do not dive with E where the opponent still has an immobilizing ability ready.
yone-skill-e.text: E (Soul Unbound) is your way back after engaging. Activate it before dealing damage, since part of the damage Yone deals to champions in spirit form is dealt again when he returns to his body, and earlier damage does not count. Strong crowd control prevents that return, so do not dive with E while an opponent’s immobilizing ability is ready.

yone-skill-passive.basis: His passive makes every second basic attack deal bonus magic damage. Yone gains greatly increased critical strike chance, but his critical strikes deal less damage. When poking, trade in sets of two basic attacks. Critical strike chance beyond the cap converts to attack damage.
yone-skill-passive.text: Thanks to Way of the Hunter, every second basic attack deals bonus magic damage. Yone also gains greatly increased critical strike chance, though his critical strikes deal less damage, so trading in pairs of attacks is more effective than landing one hit and backing off. Critical strike chance beyond the cap converts to attack damage, so overlapping critical strike items do not go to waste.

yone-skill-q-basic-attack.basis: Q counts as a basic attack and can critically strike. The first target hit by Q receives on-hit effects and lifesteal. Crowd control interrupts Q's cast. If the opponent still has an immobilizing ability, do not engage with whirlwind Q first.
yone-skill-q-basic-attack.text: Q (Mortal Steel) counts as a basic attack and can critically strike; its first target also receives on-hit effects and lifesteal, making it both a poke tool and an attack that applies item effects. Crowd control interrupts its cast, so do not open with whirlwind Q while the opponent has an immobilizing ability ready.

yone-skill-q-stack.basis: Each Q hit grants a stack. At full stacks, the next Q becomes a dashing whirlwind that knocks enemies up. Q stacks disappear after a while. Hit a minion with Q just before a fight to prepare the whirlwind. Yone spends no resources to cast abilities.
yone-skill-q-stack.text: Each hit with Q (Mortal Steel) grants a stack, and at full stacks the next Q becomes a dashing whirlwind that knocks enemies up. Since stacks expire, hit a minion with Q just before a fight to prepare the whirlwind for a trade. Yone’s abilities cost no resources, so there is no need to conserve Q.

yone-skill-r.basis: R moves Yone behind the last champion in its path. Avoid R angles that pass through every grouped enemy and leave you deep in their ranks. Before using R, check that it will pull enemies toward your team. If no champion is in R's path, Yone moves forward. Use R with no champion in its path to escape.
yone-skill-r.text: R Fate Sealed teleports Yone behind the last champion in its straight-line path. Passing through a grouped team can leave him deep in enemy ranks, so an angle that crosses the whole group is usually suicidal. Check first whether R will pull enemies toward your team; if no champion is in its path, Yone simply moves forward, which can also be used to escape.

yone-skill-w.basis: W grants a larger shield for each champion it hits. Attack speed reduces W's cooldown and cast time. Early on, when attack speed is low, use W to block the opponent's key ability as it comes in.
yone-skill-w.text: W (Spirit Cleave) is chiefly a shield: it grows with each champion hit, while attack speed reduces both its cooldown and cast time. Early on, when attack speed is low, save W for the moment an opponent’s key ability comes in instead of using it in every trade.

yone-skill-w-vs-tank.basis: W deals physical and magic damage based on the target's maximum health. Count W as a damage option against high-health frontliners.
yone-skill-w-vs-tank.text: W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on the target’s maximum health, split between physical and magic damage. Against a frontliner who has stacked health, building only armor or only magic resistance will not fully stop it, so count W as a damage tool as well as a shield.

yone-teamfight.basis: In teamfights, only go deep into enemy ranks while E is active. Use W to hit several enemies and increase your shield. Save R if its angle would carry you through enemies and leave you too deep.
yone-teamfight.text: In teamfights, disrupt the enemy backline while making it back alive. Go deep only while E Soul Unbound is active, and aim W toward a group to graze several enemies at once and increase your shield. Cast R Fate Sealed in a direction that pulls enemies toward your team; if its path would carry you through them and leave you too deep, save it.

yorick-combo-basic.basis: For a basic trade, mark the target with E, approach, then land a Q empowered attack and follow-up attacks. E's slow and movement speed boost let Yorick land a Q attack despite his short range. If E misses, do not close in on the enemy.
yorick-combo-basic.text: For a basic trade, mark the enemy with E (Mourning Mist), close in while they are slowed, land a Q (Last Rites) empowered attack, then follow with basic attacks. Yorick needs E’s slow and movement speed boost to land Q reliably despite his short range, so do not close in if E misses.

yorick-combo-ghoul.basis: After using the Q empowered attack, press Q again to raise Mist Walkers if enough graves are nearby. Pressing Q again opens nearby graves at once and raises Mist Walkers. Even if you save the Mist Walker summon, use the Q empowered attack when it comes off cooldown.
yorick-combo-ghoul.text: Q (Last Rites) has two uses: after consuming its empowered attack, press Q again when enough graves are nearby to open them at once and raise Mist Walkers. The empowered attack becomes available again when its cooldown ends even if you save the summon, so there is no reason to hold Q just to preserve the graves.

yorick-combo-wall.basis: For a guaranteed kill, block the escape route with W, apply E’s mark and slow, then land a Q auto attack. Allies can pass through W’s wall; it only blocks enemies. Read which way the opponent will retreat and place W’s wall behind them to cut off their escape.
yorick-combo-wall.text: For a guaranteed kill, place W (Dark Procession) behind the enemy to cut off their retreat, apply E (Mourning Mist) for its mark and slow, then land a Q (Last Rites) attack. Allies can pass through W, but enemies cannot, so anticipate where the opponent will retreat and place the wall ahead of time.

yorick-laning.basis: In lane, manage your health with Q's healing while securing CS. Instead of forcing kills, clear waves on Yorick's side of the lane to build up graves. If the enemy pushes the lane and roams, attack the turret.
yorick-laning.text: Yorick’s lane phase centers on farming and turret pressure. Use Q (Last Rites) to manage your health while securing CS, and clear waves on your side of the lane to build graves instead of forcing kills. If your opponent pushes the wave and roams, attack the turret to turn their absence into an advantage.

yorick-laning-trade.basis: Yorick has virtually no movement abilities, so trade when the enemy steps forward. When the enemy steps forward for a last hit, slow them with E, then approach. Stand behind minions while E is on cooldown.
yorick-laning-trade.text: With virtually no mobility, Yorick should trade only when the enemy steps forward. If they walk up for a last hit, lead with E to slow them, then close in; while E is on cooldown, stay behind your minions instead. Follow this rule even more strictly against ranged opponents to avoid losing health.

yorick-phase.basis: Yorick is weak at levels 1–2 because Q is his only trading tool. Once Yorick learns E, he can poke and approach, making his lane more stable. Getting the Maiden at level 6 strengthens Yorick's 1v1 and turret pressure. Yorick peaks in the mid to late game with items, when he can take down a side lane alone. Yorick has less impact in a standoff when all five enemies are grouped.
yorick-phase.text: Yorick is weak at levels 1–2 because Q (Last Rites) is his only trading tool. Learning E (Mourning Mist) lets him poke and close in, stabilizing the lane, while gaining the Maiden at level 6 boosts both his 1v1 strength and turret pressure. He peaks in the mid to late game once he has items and can take down a side lane alone, but has less impact in a standoff against five grouped enemies.

yorick-situational-antiheal.basis: If the enemy has a champion with strong healing, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item. Yorick can easily maintain Grievous Wounds by attacking continuously with basic attacks and Mist Walkers.
yorick-situational-antiheal.text: If an enemy champion has strong healing, buy Executioner’s Calling after completing one core item. Yorick’s continuous basic attacks and Mist Walker attacks make Grievous Wounds easy to maintain.

yorick-situational-armor.basis: If the enemy laner deals mostly physical damage, buy Cloth Armor early and get Plated Steelcaps sooner. Buy an item that helps you withstand poke before a damage item so you can stay in lane long enough to build up graves.
yorick-situational-armor.text: If your lane opponent deals mostly physical damage, buy Cloth Armor early and get Plated Steelcaps sooner. Yorick needs to stay in lane to build graves, so invest in surviving poke before buying damage.

yorick-skill-e.basis: If an E-marked target is near graves, Mist Walkers keep rising and rushing at them. Yorick and his Mist Walkers gain movement speed when moving toward an E-marked target. E lowers the target's armor and slows them. Save E for gank follow-up or trades.
yorick-skill-e.text: E is Yorick’s main trigger for summoning Mist Walkers: when a marked enemy is near graves, the walkers keep rising and rushing at them, while Yorick and his walkers gain movement speed toward the target. The mark also reduces armor and slows, so landing E can decide a fight. Its long range makes it tempting to use for wave clear, but spending it there leaves you without the tool you need to close in for a trade or follow up on a gank.

yorick-skill-passive.basis: Enemies dying near Yorick leave graves. Champions and large monsters always leave a grave when they die. Mist Walkers rise by consuming graves, and there is a limit to how many can be active at once. Before a fight, clear the wave near Yorick to set up graves.
yorick-skill-passive.text: Graves from P (Shepherd of Souls) form when enemies die near Yorick, and champions and large monsters always leave one when they die. Mist Walkers consume graves to rise, and only a limited number can remain active at once, so clear a wave near Yorick before a fight to prepare your forces. Without graves nearby, he starts the fight as just another melee champion.

yorick-skill-q.basis: The Q empowered attack deals damage and restores Yorick's health. Q's healing scales with missing health and is reduced against non-champions. Hit a champion with Q during trades to heal and secure a grave. Hitting a champion or large monster with Q leaves a grave there.
yorick-skill-q.text: Q (Last Rites) is an empowered attack that deals damage and heals Yorick. Its healing scales with missing health and is reduced against non-champions, so landing it on a champion during a trade is more valuable than repeatedly using it on minions to sustain in lane: you gain healing and a grave. Hitting a champion or large monster with Q leaves a grave at that spot.

yorick-skill-r.basis: The Maiden of the Mist accounts for a large part of Yorick's fighting power. When Yorick hits a target marked by the Maiden's basic attack, he deals bonus damage based on the target's maximum health. In teamfights, attack the target the Maiden is attacking. After some time, press R again to send the Maiden down the nearest lane to pressure it. Send the Maiden when you want to draw one enemy to a side lane and gain a numbers advantage. If the enemy can cross the map quickly, keep the Maiden with you while fighting.
yorick-skill-r.text: The Maiden of the Mist summoned by R (Eulogy of the Isles) provides much of Yorick’s fighting power. Her basic attacks mark a target, and Yorick deals bonus damage based on that target’s maximum health when he hits them, so attack whoever she is attacking in teamfights. After some time, pressing R again sends her down the nearest lane to apply pressure, but Yorick’s own fighting power drops sharply. Send her only when you want to draw an enemy to a side lane for a numbers advantage; if an enemy champion can cross the map quickly and clear that pressure, keep her with you for fights.

yorick-skill-w.basis: W creates terrain and deals no damage. The W wall has health, so attacks can destroy it, and movement abilities can cross it. W is strong for trapping enemies without movement abilities, but only buys a little time against enemies who still have a dash. If you suspect the enemy jungler is nearby, save W to cut off the jungler from the laner during a gank.
yorick-skill-w.text: W (Dark Procession) creates a wall that deals no damage. Enemies can destroy it with attacks or cross it with a movement ability, making it strongest against targets without one; against someone who still has a dash, it buys only a little time. W can also separate a jungler from a laner during a gank, so save it when you suspect the enemy jungler is nearby instead of using it on every lane trade.

yorick-teamfight.basis: In teamfights, do not dive deep into the backline. Raise Mist Walkers just before a fight. Use W to block narrow passages, split the enemy formation, or protect your allies from behind. Engage after the enemy uses its crowd control on your allies. Hit a key enemy damage dealer with E so the Mist Walkers stick to them.
yorick-teamfight.text: In teamfights, Yorick should raise Mist Walkers just before combat and use W (Dark Procession) to block a narrow passage, split the enemy formation, or protect allies from behind. Move in after the enemy has used its crowd control on your allies, then land E (Mourning Mist) on a key damage dealer so the Mist Walkers swarm them; do not dive deep into the backline.

yunara-combo-trade.basis: Fill Unleash, activate Q, and land basic attacks. Use W if the enemy closes in or runs away. Use W to continue a trade that's already started.
yunara-combo-trade.text: For lane trades, build Unleash with basic attacks, activate Q, then keep attacking. Use W, Arc of Judgment, if the opponent closes in or runs away: casting it first gives them time to create distance, so use its slow to sustain a trade already underway rather than to start one.

yunara-combo-ult.basis: In a fight, use R to activate Q and land splash basic attacks, pierce grouped enemies with W, then adjust your angle with E. Activate Q just before R so you don't waste the discharge.
yunara-combo-ult.text: In a fight, activate R to turn on Q immediately, land splash basic attacks, pierce grouped enemies with Arc of Ruin (W), then adjust your angle with Untouchable Shadow (E). Do not activate Q just before R, since R activates it for free and doing so would waste Unleash.

yunara-laning-poke.basis: One basic attack against an enemy champion builds as much Unleash as two against minions. Land one or two basic attacks on an enemy who comes into range, then back off to build Unleash. Don't use W on minions if the enemy still has an engage ability available.
yunara-laning-poke.text: One basic attack against an enemy champion builds as much Unleash as two against minions. When an enemy enters range, land one or two attacks and back off to prepare for the next fight. If they engage while Unleash is empty, W is Yunara's only way to respond, so do not spend it on minions while the enemy's engage ability is available.

yunara-laning-wave.basis: Activating Q makes splash attacks hit low health minions hard, pushing the wave. Activate Q to gain lane priority or set up a recall. Save Q when pulling the lane to set up a jungle gank, even if Unleash is full.
yunara-laning-wave.text: Q's splash attacks deal much more damage to low health minions, so activating it quickly pushes the whole wave. Use it when you want lane priority, to keep the enemy in lane, or to set up a recall; if you are pulling the wave to invite a jungle gank, hold Q even with full Unleash.

yunara-phase-early.basis: Yunara is weakest at levels 1–2. At levels 1–2, farm safely while building Unleash. Start trading from level 3, when Q's attack speed boost grows stronger.
yunara-phase-early.text: Yunara is weakest at levels 1–2: her base attack damage and movement speed are low even among marksmen, and her Unleash cycle has not started, leaving little damage for a single trade. Farm safely and build Unleash during this window, then start trading from level 3 onward as Q’s attack speed boost grows.

yunara-phase-late.basis: Getting R at level 6 gives Yunara her first power spike. From level 6, use R's dash and piercing beam to start 2v2 fights. Late in the game, after building critical strike items, the passive's bonus magic damage also applies to Q's splash attacks, greatly increasing area damage.
yunara-phase-late.text: R gives Yunara her first power spike at level 6, when she gains both a dash and a piercing beam and can force 2v2 fights. Her strongest point comes after she builds critical strike items: Vow of the First Lands adds magic damage to each critical strike, including those from Q’s splash attacks, sharply increasing her area damage in late game teamfights.

yunara-situational-antiheal.basis: If the enemy team's healing is a problem, reduce it with Mortal Reminder. Q's splash attacks also apply some on-hit effects, letting you apply healing reduction to multiple enemies.
yunara-situational-antiheal.text: If the enemy team's healing becomes a problem, cut it with Mortal Reminder. Q's splash attacks apply some on-hit effects, allowing the healing reduction to reach multiple enemies at once.

yunara-situational-cc.basis: If the enemy team has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, buy Quicksilver Sash early. Without R, Yunara has trouble escaping when caught by immobilizing crowd control.
yunara-situational-cc.text: Buy Quicksilver Sash earlier if the enemy team has a lot of immobilizing crowd control. Yunara's only dash comes from R, so if she is caught without it, she has no way to dash out.

yunara-skill-e.basis: Base E grants ghosting and increased movement speed. E grants a larger movement speed boost when approaching an enemy champion. Use E's ghosting to move through minions. Yunara can dash only while transformed by R.
yunara-skill-e.text: E, Kanmei's Steps, grants ghosting and movement speed rather than a dash. The speed boost is larger when approaching an enemy champion, making E better for pursuit than escape, while ghosting lets Yunara pass through minions. She gains an actual dash only during R’s transformed state, so position as though she has no dash whenever R is unavailable.

yunara-skill-passive-cycle.basis: Stack Unleash with basic attacks, then activate Q. Basic attacks against champions build Unleash twice as fast. Fill your Unleash before a fight.
yunara-skill-passive-cycle.text: Yunara’s damage follows a cycle of basic attacks, Unleash stacks, and Q activation. Each basic attack builds Unleash, with hits on champions granting twice as much as hits on minions, so short bursts of champion harassment ready Q much faster than farming alone. Starting a fight before Unleash is full means giving up much of her damage.

yunara-skill-w.basis: W heavily slows enemies and leaves an area that deals damage over time. After landing W, follow up before the slow ends. Place W's damage area in a low health enemy's escape path to finish them off. Early on, use W after the enemy is caught.
yunara-skill-w.text: W, Arc of Judgment, throws an orb that applies a heavy slow and leaves a lingering damage area. The slow fades over time, so follow up as soon as it lands; placing the area in a fleeing, low health enemy’s path can finish them off with its damage over time. Its cast time gets shorter with permanent attack speed, so early on, when the cast feels slow, use W after the enemy is already caught.

yunara-teamfight.basis: In teamfights, stay behind your frontline and hit multiple enemies with Q's splash basic attacks. Save W to stop enemies diving your backline. Before a teamfight, decide whether to use R for area damage or to escape.
yunara-teamfight.text: Yunara's low movement speed and R dependent dash make her usual teamfight role attacking several enemies with Q's splash attacks from behind her frontline. Save W to stop enemies diving your backline, and decide in advance whether to use R for area damage or escape.

yuumi-combo-poke.basis: Attach to an ally and land Q from long range, then follow up their attack by shielding them with E. While attached to her Best Friend, Q's empowered slow always applies. While attached to her Best Friend, their hit after Q deals bonus damage. Time Q's hit with your ally's follow-up attack.
yuumi-combo-poke.text: For a poke combo, stay attached and land Q from long range, have your ally follow up with attacks and abilities against the slowed target, then shield them with E. While attached to her Best Friend, Q's empowered slow always applies and their follow-up hit deals bonus damage, so time Q's impact with your ally's damage.

yuumi-laning.basis: Yuumi can use Q and E while attached. Detaching makes Yuumi a target for targeted abilities. Detach briefly only to establish vision or buy items. Leave all CS to the ADC. Leave decisions about lane priority to your ally.
yuumi-laning.text: Yuumi can use both Q and E while attached, so there is little reason to detach in lane. Doing so exposes her to targeted abilities; detach briefly only to establish vision or buy items, leave all CS to the ADC, and let your ally decide when to contest lane priority.

yuumi-phase.basis: Yuumi is weak early and strong in the mid to late game once her allies have items. Yuumi has a hard time surviving if caught while unattached. In lane, aim to avoid losing rather than to win.
yuumi-phase.text: Yuumi’s level-one health and resistances are among the lowest in the game, so getting caught while unattached means death. Aim to avoid losing lane rather than win it; her strength comes in the mid to late game, once her allies have items. Her early-game stats are near the bottom across the board, while her death count is the lowest of all, and breaking that balance costs her value.

yuumi-skill-e.basis: E gives the attached ally a shield and attack speed. E also restores the attached ally's mana. The ally gains movement speed while E's shield lasts. Use E for chases and escapes as well as trades. Use E when an ally is low on mana to help them stay in lane.
yuumi-skill-e.text: E gives the attached ally a shield, attack speed, and mana. They also gain movement speed while the shield lasts, making E useful for chases and escapes as well as trades; using it when an ally is low on mana noticeably improves their ability to stay in lane.

yuumi-skill-passive.basis: Yuumi's Best Friend is determined by friendship gained from takedowns while attached to an ally. While attached to her Best Friend, Q's slow is always empowered. Yuumi can steer R with her mouse only while attached to her Best Friend.
yuumi-skill-passive.text: Yuumi's passive determines her Best Friend through friendship gained whenever an ally she is attached to participates in a takedown. Only while attached to her Best Friend is Q's slow always empowered and R steerable with the mouse, so choose an ally to carry early and spend most of your time attached to them to help them grow.

yuumi-skill-q.basis: Q must travel for a certain amount of time before its damage and slow are empowered. Start Q poke from as far away as possible so it becomes empowered. Yuumi can initially steer Q with her mouse after firing it while attached, but it locks into a straight path as it speeds up. Decide whether to steer Q right after firing it.
yuumi-skill-q.text: Q must travel for a certain amount of time before its damage and slow are empowered, so poke from as far away as possible; firing from too close yields only the weaker effect. While attached, Yuumi can steer Q with her mouse just after firing, but it locks into a straight path as it speeds up, so decide where to turn it immediately.

yuumi-skill-r.basis: While channeling R, Yuumi can still move, switch attached allies, or use E. R's waves slow enemies and heal allies. Excess healing from R remains as a shield. Use R after both teams have grouped in one place.
yuumi-skill-r.text: While channeling R, Yuumi can still move, switch attached allies, and use E. Its waves slow enemies and heal allies, with excess healing remaining as a shield, so use it once both teams have grouped in one place rather than as soon as the fight begins.

yuumi-skill-w-attach.basis: When Yuumi attaches to an ally with W, units other than turrets cannot target her. Yuumi's survival depends on staying attached. Keep her attachment from breaking when her ally dies or Yuumi is immobilized.
yuumi-skill-w-attach.text: When Yuumi attaches to an ally with W, units other than turrets cannot target her. Her survival depends on staying attached, so above all, avoid losing that attachment when her ally dies or Yuumi is immobilized.

yuumi-skill-w-danger.basis: If the ally Yuumi is attached to dies, she drops at their location. If the attached ally's health gets dangerously low, switch to another ally before they die. When an ally dives in too far, decide first whether to go with them or attach to an ally who stayed back.
yuumi-skill-w-danger.text: If the ally Yuumi is attached to dies, she drops at their location. Switch to another ally before an attached ally with dangerously low health dies, and when an ally dives too far in, decide in advance whether to follow them or attach to an ally who stayed back.

yuumi-skill-w-switch.basis: Recast W to switch attached allies at any time. If Yuumi is immobilized, she cannot reattach for a short time. When allies are spread out in a teamfight, check that the next ally is in range before attaching.
yuumi-skill-w-switch.text: Recast W to switch attached allies at any time, but if Yuumi is immobilized, she cannot reattach for a short time. In a teamfight where allies are spread out, she can be left isolated with no one to switch to, so check that the next ally is in range before attaching.

yuumi-teamfight.basis: Yuumi's impact in teamfights depends heavily on which ally she attaches to. Attaching to the frontline makes survival easier but makes it harder to reach allies who need help. Attaching to the backline exposes Yuumi to enemy dives alongside her ally. Once the enemy's engage tools are used, attach to the carry and focus E and R on them.
yuumi-teamfight.text: Yuumi's impact in a teamfight depends on whom she attaches to. The frontline is easier to survive with but may keep her support from allies who need it, while the backline exposes her to enemy dives alongside her ally. Once the enemy has used its engage tools, the safest and most valuable choice is to attach to the carry and focus E and R on them.

yuumi-vision.basis: Yuumi cannot move on her own while attached, making solo roams and vision control virtually impossible. When your ally is in a safe position, detach briefly to place a Control Ward, then reattach immediately. Move with an ally into areas where vision is needed.
yuumi-vision.text: Yuumi cannot move on her own while attached, making solo roams and vision control virtually impossible. Detach briefly to place a Control Ward only when your ally is in a safe position, then reattach immediately; move together with an ally into areas where vision is needed.

zaahen-combo-engage.basis: Use E to dash past the enemy and hit them with its edge, pull them in with W, then land both stages of Q through basic attacks. Aim E beyond the enemy, rather than at a spot that overlaps them.
zaahen-combo-engage.text: For an engage, dash past the enemy with E so its edge hits, pull them in with W, then land both stages of Q through basic attacks. Always aim E beyond the enemy: stopping on top of them misses the edge hit and greatly reduces your damage.

zaahen-combo-q.basis: After using Q, heal with two basic attacks, then recast Q and knock the enemy up with a basic attack. Q’s second knockup is applied by your next basic attack. Use Q’s knockup before the enemy leaves basic attack range.
zaahen-combo-q.text: Q is a two-stage ability: use it, land two basic attacks to heal, then recast it to knock the enemy up with your next basic attack. Because the knockup rides on that attack, it disappears if the enemy leaves basic attack range; recast while you are still close enough to land it.

zaahen-combo-r.basis: Time R to the enemy’s burst ability or targeted ability cast. You take reduced damage while airborne during R. When you have little health left, using R makes the healing from its landing damage more valuable.
zaahen-combo-r.text: R is both a finisher and a way to evade damage. Time it with an enemy burst ability or targeted ability cast: Zaahen takes reduced damage while airborne, then deals damage on landing and heals for part of that damage. The heal is most valuable when his health is low.

zaahen-laning.basis: Zaahen can hold his own in early trades, but his CS and kill stats are low among top champions. In lane, build Determination stacks through short trades while pressuring the turret. Do not spend all your abilities farming; save mana for trades.
zaahen-laning.text: Zaahen’s high health and armor let him hold his own in early trades, though his CS and kill stats rank low among top champions. His statistical path to victory is closer to building Determination through short trades and pressuring the turret than trying to end lane with a kill. He uses mana, so spending every ability on farming leaves him weaker in trades.

zaahen-laning-trade.basis: Clip the enemy with E’s edge, land both stages of Q through basic attacks, then back off. Save W for when the enemy flees or needs to be pulled under the turret.
zaahen-laning-trade.text: In lane, clip the enemy with the edge of E, land both stages of Q through basic attacks, then back off. Using W first pulls them toward you but leaves no way to close the gap, so save it for when they flee or need to be pulled under your turret.

zaahen-phase.basis: Zaahen can hold his own in trades from levels 1–2. Zaahen’s power spikes sharply when full Determination stacks coincide with reaching level 6 and learning R. Judge Zaahen’s power windows by Determination stacks and the revive cooldown more than by level.
zaahen-phase.text: Zaahen’s high health and armor let him hold his own in trades from levels 1–2, and his power jumps when full Determination stacks coincide with learning R at level 6. His real peak comes while the revive is available, so judge his power windows more by his stacks and revive cooldown than by level.

zaahen-situational-antiheal.basis: If the enemy team relies on its own healing to survive, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Zaahen stays on enemies and deals damage over time, so he can maintain Grievous Wounds for a long time.
zaahen-situational-antiheal.text: If the enemy team relies on its own healing to survive, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Zaahen stays in range and deals damage over time, letting him maintain Grievous Wounds for a long time and get more value from it.

zaahen-skill-e.basis: E is Zaahen’s only mobility ability and his biggest source of damage. Only enemies hit by the edge of E’s cleave take increased physical damage and magic damage based on their maximum health. Keep E available to escape when a gank is possible.
zaahen-skill-e.text: E is Zaahen’s only mobility ability and his biggest source of damage. Only enemies caught by the edge of its cleave take increased physical damage plus magic damage based on their maximum health, so dashing directly on top of an enemy cuts your own damage. Using E to engage also leaves you without an escape; keep it available when a gank is possible.

zaahen-skill-passive-revive.basis: At full Determination, lethal damage briefly leaves you motionless before you revive with health. The revive cooldown is very long, leaving only a few chances to use it per game. Start objective fights and teamfights while your revive is ready. Play cautiously after using your revive.
zaahen-skill-passive-revive.text: At full Determination, lethal damage briefly leaves Zaahen motionless before he revives with health. The revive has a very long cooldown, so you get only a few chances to use it per game: force objective fights and teamfights while it is ready, then play cautiously like an ordinary fighter after it is spent. Creating those windows of strength is central to playing Zaahen.

zaahen-skill-passive-stack.basis: Determination stacks build only when basic attacks or abilities hit enemy champions. In lane, build Determination stacks through short trades that briefly hit the enemy. At full Determination stacks, the attack damage increase from the stacks doubles.
zaahen-skill-passive-stack.text: Determination stacks build only when basic attacks or abilities hit enemy champions; hitting minions builds none. In lane, frequent short trades that clip your opponent help you scale. Each stack increases attack damage, and at full stacks that increase doubles.

zaahen-skill-q.basis: Q’s healing scales with maximum health and is halved against non-champions. Use Q healing from minions as a backup when needed. Use Q’s bonus damage to monsters to clear jungle camps and objectives.
zaahen-skill-q.text: Q’s healing scales with maximum health but is halved against non-champions. Healing off minions is a backup when you urgently need it; your real sustain comes from hitting enemy champions. Q also deals substantial bonus damage to monsters, so use it freely on jungle camps and objectives.

zaahen-skill-r-passive.basis: Learning R increases armor penetration. Trades against enemies building armor become stronger after you learn R.
zaahen-skill-r-passive.text: Learning R increases Zaahen’s armor penetration immediately, even if he saves the ability. His basic attacks and physical abilities deal more damage from that point, making trades against enemies building armor noticeably stronger.

zaahen-skill-w.basis: W pulls enemies hit in a straight line toward Zaahen. Position yourself where you want to pull the enemy before using W. Position with allied crowd control or a turret behind you, then use W to pull the enemy into it.
zaahen-skill-w.text: W thrusts in a straight line and pulls enemies it hits toward Zaahen. Since the pull direction is fixed, where you stand before casting determines where the enemy ends up. Cast with allied crowd control or a turret behind you to pull them into it.

zaahen-teamfight.basis: Zaahen takes the frontline role in teamfights. At full Determination, engage first with E and pull a backline enemy toward your team with W. If the revive is on cooldown, follow after your allies engage.
zaahen-teamfight.text: Zaahen plays the frontline in teamfights. At full Determination, engaging first carries less risk: go in with E to disrupt the enemy formation, then use W to pull a backline enemy toward your team. If the revive is on cooldown, follow your allies’ engage instead of making the same first move.

zac-combo-engage.basis: Land E on the enemy backline to knock them up, then use R immediately. Chain E into R to scatter the enemy formation and give your team a favorable position to start the teamfight.
zac-combo-engage.text: Start the fight by landing E (Elastic Slingshot) on the enemy backline to knock them up, then immediately use R (Let's Bounce!) to scatter their formation and give your team a favorable position for the teamfight.

zac-combo-q-escape.basis: Casting Q does not stop Zac from moving. When disengaging, throw Q behind you to slow pursuers.
zac-combo-q-escape.text: Casting Q doesn’t interrupt Zac’s movement, so throw it behind you while retreating to slow pursuers. Use it during disengages, not just to engage.

zac-combo-q-sling.basis: After Q grabs the first enemy, your follow-up basic attack gains range. Basic attack a different enemy while holding one with Q to throw them into each other and knock them up. You need at least two enemies to collide them with Q. If there is only one enemy, use Q to slow them and do not hold back your basic attacks.
zac-combo-q-sling.text: Q (Stretching Strikes) grabs the first enemy it hits and increases the range of your next basic attack. Hit a different enemy with that attack to throw the two together and knock them up. This requires at least two enemies; against just one, use Q for the slow and keep using your basic attacks.

zac-combo-r-w.basis: You can use W while bouncing with R. After activating R, keep using W between bounces to deal more damage. During R, you become ghosted and can move through enemies. Aim your R bounces toward the enemy backline.
zac-combo-r-w.text: You can use W (Unstable Matter) while bouncing with R (Let's Bounce!), so keep pressing it between bounces for much of Zac’s damage. R also lets you pass through enemies; aim your path toward their backline.

zac-laning-gank.basis: When ganking, choose a spot behind a wall and out of enemy vision to charge E. Fire E after your laner draws the enemy forward by trading damage.
zac-laning-gank.text: For a gank, first find a spot behind a wall and out of enemy vision where you can charge E. Because it takes time to charge, aim where the enemy is about to be, rather than where they are now; the most reliable play is to fire after your laner trades damage and draws them forward.

zac-phase.basis: Zac has relatively low kill pressure and damage early on. Early on, clear camps safely and keep up in levels. After level 6, with E and R available, you can force fights over objectives. Once you have built up items, W damage and healing from blobs give you strong staying power in teamfights.
zac-phase.text: Zac has relatively low kill pressure and damage early on, with low early kill and damage per minute numbers, but he also dies less often. Clear camps safely and keep up in levels until level 6, when E (Elastic Slingshot) and R (Let's Bounce!) let you force objective fights. As you build items, W’s area damage and healing from blobs steadily improve your staying power in teamfights.

zac-situational-mr.basis: If the enemy has strong magic damage, build Spirit Visage early. Spirit Visage increases both magic resistance and healing from blobs.
zac-situational-mr.text: If the enemy deals heavy magic damage, build Spirit Visage early. Along with magic resistance, it increases healing from Zac’s blobs, strengthening his sustain.

zac-skill-e-charge.basis: The longer you charge E, the farther you fly. Moving while charging E cancels the cast and refunds half its cooldown and cost. If the enemy notices you charging E and backs away, cancel the cast to reduce the loss. Silences, roots, stuns, and knockups interrupt E's charge.
zac-skill-e-charge.text: The longer you charge E (Elastic Slingshot), the farther Zac flies. Moving during the charge cancels it and refunds half its cooldown and cost, so if the enemy spots you and backs away, cancel instead of forcing the cast. A silence, root, stun, or knockup also interrupts the charge.

zac-skill-e-range.basis: E can fly in from far away and gank while barely passing through warded areas. For a gank, first choose a spot behind a wall and out of vision to charge E.
zac-skill-e-range.text: E (Elastic Slingshot) can carry Zac into a gank from far away while barely crossing warded ground. Choose a charging spot behind a wall and out of vision before planning your route in.

zac-skill-passive-blob.basis: Hitting an enemy with an ability drops a blob. Picking it up restores health and reduces W's cooldown. During fights, path over your blobs to pick them up. Enemy champions can destroy blobs by stepping on them, so collect them before it is too late.
zac-skill-passive-blob.text: Hitting an enemy with an ability drops a blob that restores health and reduces W’s cooldown when Zac picks it up. In fights, path over your blobs to sustain yourself instead of simply staying close to the enemy. Enemy champions can destroy the blobs by stepping on them, so collect them promptly.

zac-skill-passive-revive.basis: Zac's revive passive has a very long cooldown. Attempt dives or risky engages when the revive passive is ready. When the revive passive is on cooldown, play like a regular frontline champion. Use the revive passive in close fights, but do not count on it in fights you are certain to lose.
zac-skill-passive-revive.text: Zac’s revive passive has a very long cooldown. Dives and risky engages are viable when it is ready; while it is on cooldown, play like a regular frontline champion. Save that safety net for close fights rather than entering a fight you are certain to lose.

zac-skill-w.basis: W has a short cooldown and deals damage based on the target's maximum health. In teamfights, use W whenever it is ready, even against the frontline. W's health-based damage is capped against minions and jungle monsters. When clearing the jungle, do not rely on W as your main clearing tool.
zac-skill-w.text: W (Unstable Matter) has a short cooldown and deals damage based on the target’s maximum health, so use it whenever it is ready in teamfights, including against the frontline. Its health based damage is capped against minions and jungle monsters, though, so do not rely on it as your main jungle clearing tool.

zac-teamfight-role.basis: If the enemy ignores Zac, W damage keeps adding up. If the enemy attacks Zac, your team's damage dealers are free to act. After engaging, stay alive by picking up blobs.
zac-teamfight-role.text: Zac’s job is to absorb damage: if enemies ignore him, his W area damage keeps adding up, and if they focus him, your damage dealers are free to act. Either way your team benefits, so after engaging, stay in the fight and keep picking up blobs to survive.

zac-teamfight-target.basis: When engaging with E, land toward the enemy backline. If you land on the enemy frontline, Zac has very little he can do. After landing, look for an angle to throw an enemy damage dealer toward your team with Q.
zac-teamfight-target.text: When engaging with E (Elastic Slingshot), land toward the enemy backline; landing on the frontline leaves Zac with very little to do. Then look for an angle to throw an enemy damage dealer toward your team with Q (Stretching Strikes), rather than toward their frontline.

zed-combo-basic.basis: Place your W shadow behind or beside the enemy. Use W → Q → E for a basic trade. Hitting the same target with the same ability from both Zed and his shadow restores energy.
zed-combo-basic.text: For a basic trade, send your W shadow behind or beside the enemy, then use Q → E. When Zed and his shadow hit the same target with the same ability, he restores energy, so positioning the shadow to land its hit is part of managing that resource.

zed-combo-ult.basis: Make sure you have enough energy before an R combo. Start your R combo with all abilities off cooldown. In an R combo, use Q and E so both Zed and his shadow hit the target. The R mark's detonation damage scales with the damage Zed deals while the mark is active.
zed-combo-ult.text: Start an R combo with full energy and all abilities off cooldown. After using R to reach the target, place your W shadow, then land Q and E with both Zed and the shadow before the mark detonates. The detonation scales with the damage Zed deals while the mark is active, so use R before the rest of the combo.

zed-combo-w-safe.basis: Before using R, place your W shadow in a safe spot behind you. Return to your pre-placed W shadow immediately after the R mark detonates. Use W and R shadows together to secure entry and escape routes.
zed-combo-w-safe.text: Before using R, place your W shadow in a safe spot behind you. Returning to it immediately after the mark detonates lets you escape from the middle of the enemy team; using it alongside the shadow left by R gives you routes both in and out.

zed-laning.basis: Zed relies heavily on energy management in lane. Hitting the same target with the same ability from both Zed and his shadow restores energy. Place the shadow before poking in lane. Avoid spending Q solely on clearing minions so you have energy left for trades and escapes.
zed-laning.text: Energy management is central to Zed’s lane. When he and his shadow hit the same target with the same ability, he restores energy, so place the shadow even when poking. Spending Q only to clear minions can leave you without the energy to trade or escape.

zed-phase.basis: Zed is strong at trading at levels 1–2. Zed can start looking for solo kills after learning R at level 6. Zed peaks in the mid game with a couple of items. Zed's strength drops sharply in the late game as enemies build armor and group up. Build a game-ending lead during your mid-game peak.
zed-phase.text: Zed trades well at levels 1–2 because he has high health and uses energy instead of mana. Solo kills become possible once he gets R at level 6, and he peaks in the mid game with a couple of items. His strength falls sharply late as enemies build armor and group up, so use that peak to build a lead that can end the game.

zed-skill-e-cdr.basis: Each enemy champion hit by Zed's own E reduces W's cooldown by 3 seconds. An E used by a shadow does not reduce W's cooldown. To use W again during a fight, use E from a position where Zed himself can hit multiple enemies.
zed-skill-e-cdr.text: Each enemy champion hit by Zed’s own E reduces W’s cooldown by 3 seconds; a shadow’s E does not. If you want to use W again during a fight, position Zed to hit multiple enemies himself before pressing E.

zed-skill-passive.basis: P adds damage based on the target's maximum health when you basic attack an enemy below half health. P cannot trigger again on the same champion for a while. Use at least one basic attack during the combo. Avoid staying in a fight just to trigger P again on the same champion.
zed-skill-passive.text: P adds damage based on maximum health when you basic attack an enemy below half health. It cannot trigger again on the same champion for a while, so weave at least one basic attack into your combo without lingering to try for a second proc.

zed-skill-q.basis: Using Q makes both Zed and his shadows throw shurikens. Q shurikens pass through targets. Q shurikens deal reduced damage to enemies beyond the first target. Make the enemy champion the first target hit by Q.
zed-skill-q.text: Both Zed and his shadow throw a shuriken with Q. Place the shadow beside or behind the enemy so the two shurikens converge from different directions and both hit with one cast. They pass through targets but deal less damage beyond the first, so make the enemy champion the first target hit.

zed-skill-w-cost.basis: Treat the moment just after Zed uses W as his weakest window. Zed relies on his shadows for damage, slows, and movement. Avoid wasting W on poke when the enemy jungler is missing.
zed-skill-w-cost.text: Zed is weakest just after using W. His damage, slow, and movement all depend on the shadow, so don’t waste W on poke when the enemy jungler is out of sight.

zed-skill-w-double.basis: Quickly press W twice to immediately move to where the shadow lands. Practice quickly pressing W twice for emergency escapes.
zed-skill-w-double.text: Press W twice quickly to move immediately to where the shadow lands. Practice the input so you can use it for an emergency escape.

zed-teamfight.basis: Avoid engaging head-on in teamfights. Flank from the side or rear and focus on one enemy damage dealer. Use R after the enemy has spent their protective abilities and crowd control on your allies. Aim to survive until the R mark detonates. Always keep a spot available to return to with W.
zed-teamfight.text: Avoid engaging head-on in teamfights. Flank from the side or rear, focus on a single enemy damage dealer, and use R after the enemy has spent their protective abilities and crowd control on your allies. You need to survive until the mark detonates, so always keep a position you can return to with W.

zeri-combo-allin.basis: When engaging, slow with W, approach with E, then fire Q repeatedly and activate R. When disengaging, gain movement speed with R, then cross a wall with E. Crossing a wall with E while R is active lets you shake off most pursuers.
zeri-combo-allin.text: To engage, slow with W, use E to close the gap and prepare a piercing Q, fire Q repeatedly, then activate R. To disengage, activate R first for movement speed, then use E to cross a wall; doing so while R is active lets you escape most pursuers.

zeri-laning.basis: Zeri's basic attack range is short even among marksmen. Avoid standing too far forward in lane. Move to avoid enemy poke while charging your passive and farming. Clear waves with Q. Fire W only from positions where you can angle it into a wall.
zeri-laning.text: Zeri’s basic attack range is short even among marksmen, so avoid standing too far forward. Keep moving to dodge poke and charge your passive while farming without falling behind, and clear waves with Q. Fire W only when you can angle it into a wall; save it otherwise.

zeri-phase.basis: In lane, use W that hits a wall and charged basic attacks to hold your ground while farming CS. Zeri is strong at farming during the laning phase. She becomes much stronger once she has two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike chance.
zeri-phase.text: Laning is a time to hold your ground and farm CS with wall-spread W and basic attacks charged by moving, rather than to seek kills yourself. Statistically, Zeri’s laning CS ranks among the highest of all marksmen, and she grows much stronger after two or three core items give her attack speed and critical strike chance.

zeri-situational-antiheal.basis: If the enemy has healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Zeri wears enemies down with sustained damage, making her vulnerable to their healing.
zeri-situational-antiheal.text: If the enemy has healing, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Zeri wears enemies down with sustained damage, so an enemy who keeps healing can survive no matter how long she attacks.

zeri-situational-qss.basis: If the enemy starts fights with targeted crowd control, buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar between core items. Zeri deals sustained damage while moving with E and R, so being locked down takes away her strengths.
zeri-situational-qss.text: If the enemy team starts fights by locking Zeri down with targeted crowd control, buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar between core items. She deals sustained damage while moving with E and R, so being locked down takes away both her movement speed and sustained damage.

zeri-skill-e.basis: E travels much farther when crossing terrain. Use E to cross a wall when escaping. Basic attack hits and critical strikes reduce E's cooldown. Keep attacking during fights to get your next E sooner.
zeri-skill-e.text: E is a short dash that travels much farther across terrain, so aim it over a wall when escaping. Basic attack hits and critical strikes reduce its cooldown; keep attacking during fights to get the next E back much sooner.

zeri-skill-e-pierce.basis: After using E, your next Q pierces enemies. Against an opponent behind minions or several enemies lined up, use E before attacking with Q.
zeri-skill-e-pierce.text: Using E makes your next Q pierce enemies. Against an opponent standing behind minions or several enemies lined up, use E first so the same Q deals much more damage; treating E purely as a mobility tool wastes that opportunity.

zeri-skill-passive.basis: Moving or using Q charges your passive. A fully charged basic attack deals magic damage based on the target's maximum health. Keep moving in lane to charge your passive. A fully charged basic attack deals especially high damage to high-health opponents.
zeri-skill-passive.text: Moving or using Q charges Zeri’s passive Spark Pack, and a fully charged basic attack deals magic damage based on the target’s maximum health. Keep moving in lane to gain a way to poke, especially against high-health opponents, who take more damage from it.

zeri-skill-q.basis: Zeri's real basic attack is Q. Q counts as a basic attack and can critically strike. As attack speed increases, Q's cast time and cooldown decrease. Attack speed above the cap is converted into attack damage.
zeri-skill-q.text: Zeri’s real basic attack is Q. It counts as a basic attack and can critically strike; as attack speed rises, its cast time and cooldown both fall. Attack speed above the cap converts to attack damage, so none goes to waste.

zeri-skill-r.basis: After activating R, each hit on an enemy champion adds a stack and increases your movement speed. After activating R, each hit on an enemy champion extends its duration. Activating R turns Q into rapid fire with chain lightning. Activate R when you can keep attacking, rather than when the fight will end after one takedown.
zeri-skill-r.text: Keeping R active matters more than the moment you cast it. Each hit on an enemy champion adds a stack, raises your movement speed, and extends its duration, while Q becomes rapid fire with chain lightning. Activate R when you can keep attacking, rather than when the fight will end after one takedown.

zeri-skill-w-slow.basis: W is Zeri's only slow. If an enemy engage champion is still alive, decide whether you'll need W's slow before using it to poke.
zeri-skill-w-slow.text: W is Zeri’s only slow, so using it all to poke leaves you with no way to push an enemy away if they close in. When an enemy engage champion is still alive, first decide whether to save one use.

zeri-skill-w-wall.basis: W spreads into a long laser when it hits terrain. A W that spreads after hitting terrain critically strikes champions and monsters. Aim W at opponents with a wall behind them or at the walls of narrow passages.
zeri-skill-w-wall.text: W spreads into a long laser when it hits terrain and critically strikes champions and monsters. Aim it at an opponent with a wall behind them, a narrow passage, or a Rift wall to deal several times more poke damage; don’t throw it into open space.
