zeri-teamfight.basis: In teamfights, keep landing Q from the side. In teamfights, position beside a wall that gives you both an angle for W to spread and an escape route with E. E and R's mobility make it easier to evade enemies who engage on you. Position with the risk of dying if caught in mind.
zeri-teamfight.text: In teamfights, keep landing Q from the side instead of facing enemies head-on. E and R make it easier to evade enemies who engage on you, and positioning beside a wall gives you both an angle to spread W and an escape route with E. Zeri has low armor and can die as soon as she is caught, so position accordingly.

ziggs-combo-basic.basis: Place E under the enemy or on their escape route, then throw Q when they’re slowed. E’s slow makes the delayed Q easier to land.
ziggs-combo-basic.text: For basic poke, place E under the enemy or along their retreat path, then follow with Q when the slow takes hold. All of Ziggs’s abilities take time to land and often miss when thrown at an unslowed target, so applying the slow first is the only way to improve your hit rate.

ziggs-combo-passive-turret.basis: The passive’s empowered basic attack deals more damage to structures. Using an ability reduces the passive’s cooldown. At a turret, clear waves with abilities to bring up the passive sooner, then use the empowered basic attack on the turret. Save W for when the turret’s health falls below its demolition threshold.
ziggs-combo-passive-turret.text: Short Fuse’s empowered basic attack deals much more damage to structures, and each ability cast reduces its cooldown. At a turret, use abilities on the wave to ready the passive sooner, then hit the turret with the empowered attack. Once the turret falls below W’s demolition threshold, save W to finish it instead of relying on one last basic attack.

ziggs-combo-satchel.basis: Place W behind the enemy and detonate it to knock them toward Ziggs. Place W, throw Q, then knock the enemy into Q’s landing spot. Place W between Ziggs and the enemy and detonate it to retreat.
ziggs-combo-satchel.text: Place W behind the enemy and detonate it to knock them toward Ziggs. Throw Q immediately after placing W, then knock the enemy into Q’s landing spot to force them somewhere they cannot dodge. To escape instead, place W between Ziggs and the enemy and detonate it to knock yourself backward.

ziggs-laning.basis: In bot lane, use Q’s range instead of trading basic attacks. Keep poking with Q from outside the enemy marksman’s basic attack range. If the enemy moves forward, block their escape route with E. If the enemy support has an engage ability, stand behind your support.
ziggs-laning.text: In bot lane, Ziggs fills the marksman position but fights at Q range rather than trading basic attacks. Keep poking from beyond the enemy marksman’s basic attack range, and if they step forward, place E behind them to cut off their retreat. Against a support with an engage ability, stand behind your own support instead of behind the minions so you do not give them an opening.

ziggs-laning-wave.basis: You can clear a group of minions with one Q to push the lane when you want. Push the wave to the enemy turret and attack it with the passive’s empowered basic attack. Before pushing the lane, check that W is available and you have vision.
ziggs-laning-wave.text: One Q can clear a group of minions, letting you push the lane whenever you want. Ziggs wins by pushing lanes and destroying turrets, so keep the wave at the enemy turret to create chances to chip away at it with Short Fuse (P) empowered basic attacks. Pushing leaves you open to ganks, so check that W is available and you have vision before doing so.

ziggs-phase.basis: At levels 1–2, Q’s long cooldown and limited mana make it slow to poke repeatedly. Lane pressure grows stronger as you put more ranks into Q and get a mana item. Learning R at level 6 lets you influence other lanes. Late game, when you’ve built up ability power, is Ziggs’s strongest phase. In late game, stand farther back because Ziggs is fragile.
ziggs-phase.text: At levels 1–2, Q’s long cooldown and limited mana make repeated poke slow. Lane pressure grows as you put more ranks into Q and get a mana item, while learning R at level 6 lets you influence other lanes. Ziggs is strongest late, once he has built up ability power, but he remains fragile, so position even farther back as his damage grows.

ziggs-situational-antiheal.basis: If the enemy has a champion with strong healing, buy Morellonomicon after completing your first core item. Ziggs can land abilities often to apply healing reduction over a wide area.
ziggs-situational-antiheal.text: If the enemy has a champion with strong healing, buy Morellonomicon after completing your first core item. Ziggs lands abilities often enough to apply healing reduction across a wide area.

ziggs-situational-zhonya.basis: If the enemy has an assassin who dives in, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier. Ziggs has no mobility tool besides W, so it’s hard for him to escape on foot if an enemy catches him.
ziggs-situational-zhonya.text: If the enemy has an assassin who dives in, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier. Ziggs has one of the lowest movement speeds and W is his only mobility tool, so once caught, he cannot escape on foot. Having a way to survive the engage determines how much damage he can deal later in the game.

ziggs-skill-e.basis: Use E to block the enemy’s path. If the same target steps on multiple mines in succession, subsequent damage is greatly reduced. Place E in narrow passages, at brush entrances, and on approach routes leading behind your allies. When retreating, place E beneath you to stop the enemy from engaging.
ziggs-skill-e.text: Use E to control space rather than deal damage: when the same target steps on several mines in succession, later hits deal much less damage. Place it in narrow passages, at brush entrances, on routes that lead behind your allies, or beneath you as you retreat to cut off the enemy’s approach and make them abandon the engage.

ziggs-skill-q.basis: Q is your main poke and wave clear tool, and has the shortest cooldown. Keep using Q as long as you have the mana. Aim Q where the enemy is going, not where they’re standing. Throw Q when the enemy stops to last-hit behind minions or use an ability.
ziggs-skill-q.text: Q is Ziggs’s main poke and wave clear tool, with his shortest cooldown, so keep using it as mana allows. Because it takes time to land, aim where the enemy is headed rather than where they stand; the best moments are when they stop behind minions to last-hit or pause to use an ability.

ziggs-skill-r.basis: R’s long range lets it reach fights in other lanes and near objectives. Hit with the center of R’s explosion to deal its full damage. Aim R at grouped enemies or narrow terrain where they’ll struggle to escape. When supporting another lane with R, wait until an ally pins the enemy down. If there’s no chance to support from range, use R to clear waves or pressure a turret.
ziggs-skill-r.text: R’s enormous range lets you affect fights in other lanes or near objectives. Its center deals full damage, so aim for the middle of a group or narrow terrain where enemies cannot escape. Supporting another lane from afar is worthwhile when an ally has already pinned the enemy down; otherwise, use R to clear a wave or pressure a turret rather than leave it unused through a long stretch of laning.

ziggs-skill-w.basis: W is Ziggs’s only mobility tool. When chasing or escaping, detonate W beneath you to cross a wall. If you need W to escape, don’t use it to poke. If you see a chance to push a turret, save W to demolish it as soon as its health is low enough.
ziggs-skill-w.text: W is Ziggs’s only mobility tool: detonating it beneath you can carry you over a wall while chasing or escaping. If you need it to escape, don’t spend it on poke; Ziggs has one of the lowest movement speeds, and he is vulnerable while W is on cooldown. Save it for a turret push, too, so you can demolish a weakened turret as soon as it falls below the threshold.

ziggs-teamfight.basis: Start teamfights behind your allies; don’t move forward to look for an angle. Place E on the enemy’s approach route before the fight starts. Once the fight starts, use Q repeatedly. During the fight, aim R at grouped enemies.
ziggs-teamfight.text: Start teamfights at the very back, behind your allies, and give up the habit of stepping forward to find an angle; W is your only way to protect yourself. Place E on the enemy’s approach before the fight begins, then cast Q repeatedly once it starts and aim R at grouped enemies.

zilean-combo-doublebomb.basis: Use Q → W → Q to stun with the bombs. Placing a second bomb on a target carrying one makes the first explode immediately, stunning nearby enemies. W reduces Q's cooldown so you can cast Q again right away. Start the bomb combo when the enemy is standing still or held in place. If the enemy leaves the bomb radius between casts, the combo will deal no damage or stun them.
zilean-combo-doublebomb.text: Zilean’s core combo is Q → W → Q: placing a second Time Bomb on a target already carrying one detonates the first immediately and stuns nearby enemies. Rewind cuts Q’s cooldown so you can cast it again right away. Start when the enemy is standing still or held in place; if they leave the bomb radius between casts, the combo deals no damage and lands no stun.

zilean-combo-engage.basis: Slow an enemy with E, then stun them with Q → W → Q. E's strong slow makes it hard for the enemy to walk out of the bomb radius. To help an ally engage, speed them up with E before using the bomb combo. Before casting E, decide whether to slow an enemy or speed up an ally.
zilean-combo-engage.text: Slow an enemy with E, then use Q → W → Q to stun them; Time Warp’s strong slow makes it difficult to walk out of the bomb radius. To help an ally engage, use E to speed them up before the bomb combo. Decide who needs E before casting it.

zilean-laning-poke.basis: Throw a bomb ahead of time as the enemy steps forward to last-hit. If the enemy stands behind minions, throw a bomb at their position ahead of time. If the enemy dodges the bomb, it may attach to a minion and push the wave. Q costs a lot of mana, so casting it carelessly will drain your mana quickly. Throw Q when the enemy will have trouble leaving the bomb's landing spot. Stand behind or beside your allied marksman when throwing bombs.
zilean-laning-poke.text: In lane, throw a bomb ahead of time when an enemy steps forward to last-hit or stands behind minions. If they retreat, the bomb may attach to a minion and push the wave. Q costs a lot of mana, so save it for spots the enemy will struggle to leave. Stand behind or beside your allied marksman and send the bombs forward.

zilean-laning-wave.basis: If a bomb attaches to a minion, it pushes the wave. Save Q when your ally wants to keep the wave near your side. When pushing toward the enemy turret to roam, use bombs to push the wave. Right after pushing the wave, speed up an ally with E and head to mid or the jungle.
zilean-laning-wave.text: A bomb attached to a minion pushes the wave, so save Q when your ally wants to keep the wave near your side. When you want to push toward the enemy turret and roam, use bombs to clear the wave, then speed up an ally with E and head to mid or the jungle.

zilean-phase.basis: Levels 1–2 are Zilean's weakest point because he has no W to set up a bomb stun. Start trading at level 3, when learning W lets you use Q → W → Q. After learning R at level 6, Zilean becomes stronger in fights because he can save an ally. Zilean's own damage becomes relatively low in the late game. In the late game, focus on protecting allies with R and E rather than poking.
zilean-phase.text: Levels 1–2 are Zilean’s weakest point: without W, he has only one bomb’s damage and cannot stun. Start trading at level 3, when Rewind enables Q → W → Q. Once he learns R at level 6, he can save an ally and becomes much stronger in fights. His own damage matters less in the late game, so shift from poking to protecting allies with R and E.

zilean-situational-antiheal.basis: Build Morellonomicon if enemy healing is strong enough to turn a fight. Area bombs can apply healing reduction to multiple enemies at once.
zilean-situational-antiheal.text: Build Morellonomicon if enemy healing is strong enough to turn a fight. Area bombs can apply healing reduction to multiple enemies at once.

zilean-situational-mikael.basis: If the enemy team has a lot of crowd control that can lock down your team's main damage dealer, build Mikael's Blessing between core items. Mikael's Blessing frees an ally the moment they get caught. R only activates when the target is in danger of dying.
zilean-situational-mikael.text: If the enemy team has enough crowd control to lock down your main damage dealer, build Mikael’s Blessing between core items. R only activates when its target is in danger of dying, while Mikael’s Blessing frees an ally the moment they are caught, so each covers a different point in the fight.

zilean-skill-e.basis: E greatly slows one enemy or speeds up one ally. Use E on an enemy engager as they jump onto an ally. Use E on an ally when they try to finish off an enemy. When the enemy jungler is missing, keep E available for survival.
zilean-skill-e.text: E greatly slows one enemy or speeds up one ally. Use it on an enemy engager as they jump onto an ally, or on an ally trying to finish off an enemy. Keep it available for survival when the enemy jungler is missing.

zilean-skill-passive.basis: You can give an ally the experience stored by P to level them up. When P gives an ally experience, Zilean gains the same amount. Use P when it will change an ally's level. Use P when an ally can get their level 6 ultimate early or level up just before a fight. During lane phase, use P on a bot lane ally. From mid game onward, use P on the ally initiating fights at that point.
zilean-skill-passive.text: P lets you give an ally stored experience to level them up, and Zilean gains the same amount. Use Time In A Bottle when it will change their level: give them their level 6 ultimate early or create a level advantage just before a fight. During lane phase, use it on a bot lane ally; from mid game onward, use it on whoever is initiating fights.

zilean-skill-q-attach.basis: Q lands at the chosen spot and attaches to the first unit that comes close. Q prioritizes champions and units already carrying a bomb. If the enemy champion is outside the bomb radius, a minion may pick it up first. Throw Q where the enemy is about to walk, rather than where they are now.
zilean-skill-q-attach.text: Q lands at the chosen spot and attaches to the first unit that comes close, prioritizing champions and units already carrying a bomb. Even among crowded minions, it will attach to an enemy champion within its radius; if the champion is outside it, a minion may take the bomb first. Aim where the enemy is about to walk rather than where they are now.

zilean-skill-r-bluff.basis: R on an ally can make enemies hesitate to attack them. You can cast R on your main damage dealer early to deter an engage near an objective or in a narrow passage.
zilean-skill-r-bluff.text: R can make enemies hesitate to attack the ally carrying it. Cast it early on your main damage dealer to deter an engage near an objective or in a narrow passage, even if the revive never triggers.

zilean-skill-r-timing.basis: For R's revive to trigger, the targeted ally must die while it is active. If you cast R too early, the enemy may switch to another ally. If you cast R too late, the ally may die before you can cast it. Cast R after you see a key targeted enemy ability hit an ally. An ally is untargetable while reviving with R. Time your counterattack around the ally's revival.
zilean-skill-r-timing.text: For R’s revive to trigger, the targeted ally must die while Chronoshift is active. Cast it too early and the enemy may switch targets; cast it too late and your ally may die first. The most reliable moment is after a key targeted enemy ability has hit an ally. They are untargetable while reviving, so time your team’s counterattack around the revival.

zilean-skill-w.basis: W deals no damage on its own. W reduces E's cooldown as well as Q's. When escaping, speed yourself up with E and use W to get E back. If the fight may drag on, save one W for a second stun or another E.
zilean-skill-w.text: W deals no damage on its own, but Rewind cuts E’s cooldown as well as Q’s. When escaping, speed yourself up with E and use W to get E back. If the fight may last, save a W for a second stun or another E.

zilean-teamfight.basis: In teamfights, stay back and protect your allies. If an enemy dives your backline, slow them with E and stun them with Q → W → Q. Cast R just before your main damage dealer comes under focused attack. A bomb stun can hit multiple enemies within its radius. Look for a bomb stun when enemies group up in a narrow passage.
zilean-teamfight.text: In teamfights, stay back and protect your allies. When an enemy dives your backline, slow them with E and follow with a Q → W → Q stun; cast R just before your main damage dealer comes under focused attack. The bomb stun can hit several enemies in its radius, making it especially valuable when they group up in a narrow passage.

zoe-combo-q.basis: You can redirect Q once after firing it. Q's damage increases with the total distance the star travels. Send Q far to the side or behind you, then redirect it toward the target. Fire Q from a safe spot where you won't be interrupted between casting and redirecting it.
zoe-combo-q.text: After firing Q, Paddle Star!, you can redirect it once, and its damage increases with the total distance the star travels. Send it far to the side or behind you before turning it toward the target; this avoids the minion wave and maximizes damage. The window to redirect is short, so cast from a safe spot where you will not be interrupted.

zoe-combo-re.basis: Throw E first and let the bubble grow, then use R to follow it. Use R to briefly cross a wall and throw E, then return to your starting point. When combining skills with R, always account for where you'll return.
zoe-combo-re.text: Throw E first and let the bubble grow, then use R to jump in its direction and follow it far enough to land the enlarged bubble. You can also briefly cross a wall with R, throw E, and return. Either way, account for the fact that R always brings you back to where you started.

zoe-laning.basis: In lane, use Q to last-hit and poke while looking for an angle to land E. Use your abilities when the enemy steps forward. Spamming Q leaves you short on mana and makes farming difficult. Use Q from a position where it can hit multiple targets.
zoe-laning.text: Zoe’s armor and magic resistance are both low, so avoid direct damage trades. In lane, use Q to last-hit and poke while looking for an angle for E, and spend your abilities only when the enemy steps forward. Q costs enough mana that spamming it can leave you unable to farm; cast it from a position where it can pass through minions and hit multiple targets.

zoe-phase.basis: At levels 1–2, E has a long cooldown and mana is scarce, so mistakes are costly. Once you've learned E and completed one item, landing E enables a combo that can kill one enemy. Zoe's burst remains strong in the late game. In the late game, once enemies have their engage abilities available, first position yourself where you can survive.
zoe-phase.text: At levels 1–2, E has a long cooldown and mana is scarce, making mistakes costly. Once you have learned E and completed an item, landing it enables a combo that can kill one enemy. Zoe keeps her burst damage into the late game, but gains little durability; when enemies have their engage abilities available, finding a position where you can survive matters more than looking for an attack angle.

zoe-skill-e-timing.basis: A target hit by E falls asleep after a short delay. Land E while the target is held in place. Follow up allied crowd control with E. Throw E through narrow passages. Hitting a champion with E greatly reduces Zoe's ability cooldowns.
zoe-skill-e-timing.text: E puts its target to sleep after a short delay, giving them time to walk away. Aim for a spot where they will be held in place, such as during an ally’s crowd control or in a narrow passage. Hitting a champion greatly reduces Zoe’s ability cooldowns, bringing her next fight around much sooner.

zoe-skill-e-wall.basis: Throwing E over a wall extends its range. Hide in a bush or behind a wall and throw E from an angle the enemy can't see. If E hits no one, the bubble remains where it lands as a trap. Place E traps ahead of time in front of the first turret or at dragon and Herald entrances to block the path.
zoe-skill-e-wall.text: Throwing E over a wall extends its range. It is most reliable when you hide in a bush or behind a wall and cast from an angle the enemy cannot see. If the bubble hits no one, it remains where it lands as a trap, so you can place one in advance at a choke point such as in front of the first turret or at a dragon or Herald entrance to block the path.

zoe-skill-passive.basis: Your first basic attack after using an ability is empowered by your passive. Early on, use empowered passive attacks to poke or finish off targets; don't waste them on minion last hits. Both casting and recasting Q trigger your passive.
zoe-skill-passive.text: Your first basic attack after using an ability is empowered by More Sparkles!. Early on, save it for poke or finishing off a target instead of spending it carelessly on minion last hits. Both the initial cast and the recast of Q trigger the passive, letting you get two empowered attacks from one Q.

zoe-skill-r.basis: After moving briefly with R, Zoe always returns to her original position. While displaced by R, Zoe can use abilities and basic attacks, but she can't walk. Use R to extend your ability range or gain vision over a wall. After a delayed targeted dash is cast, use R to stay briefly beyond a wall and leave the enemy there.
zoe-skill-r.text: R, Portal Jump, briefly moves Zoe nearby before always returning her to her starting point. She can use abilities and basic attacks during the jump but cannot walk, so use it to extend her range or gain vision over a wall. Against a delayed targeted dash, you can cast R after the dash begins, stand briefly beyond a wall, and return to leave the enemy there.

zoe-skill-w-move.basis: Using W or a summoner spell increases your movement speed. W missiles fly toward the target you last hit with a basic attack. Use W shards when you need movement speed, such as to find an angle to engage or escape a gank.
zoe-skill-w-move.text: Using W or a summoner spell grants movement speed and sends missiles toward the last target you hit with a basic attack. A shard is therefore a movement speed tool as well as its own effect. Save it for when you need that speed, such as moving in to find an angle or escaping a gank.

zoe-skill-w-shard.basis: W shards drop from enemy summoner spells, active items, and certain minions. Keep track of the enemy's used spells and tell your team. Pick up W shards that drop in lane. In teamfights, use defensive or utility shards that can save allies.
zoe-skill-w-shard.text: W, Spell Thief, gets shards from enemy summoner spells, active items, and certain minions. Keep count of the spells enemies use, tell your team, and collect shards that fall in lane. In teamfights, defensive or utility shards can often save allies and turn the fight around more effectively than offensive ones.

zoe-teamfight.basis: Start teamfights from the very back. Follow up an ally's immobilizing crowd control with E or Q. Move forward after confirming the enemy has used their engage abilities. While the enemy still has engage abilities, hold your position with E traps and movement speed from W shards.
zoe-teamfight.text: Start teamfights from the very back and follow an ally’s immobilizing crowd control with E or Q instead of moving out first to look for an angle. Step forward only after confirming the enemy has used their engage abilities; until then, hold your position with E traps and movement speed from W shards.

zyra-combo-basic.basis: Place a W seed where E roots the target, then use Q. If both E and Q hit one seed, both types of plants grow. Start with E because using Q first lets the target walk away and avoid the plant damage.
zyra-combo-basic.text: The basic guaranteed combo is E to root the target, W on the rooted spot, then Q. The target cannot move off the seed, so Q lands; if both E and Q hit the same seed, a Thorn Spitter and a Vine Lasher grow together. Starting with Q lets the target walk away and avoid the plant damage.

zyra-combo-seed-after.basis: Use Q or E first, then throw a W seed into the skill's path. W has virtually no cast time, so you can place a seed while Q or E is traveling. Place seeds in advance only when you are sure where the target will move.
zyra-combo-seed-after.text: Cast Q or E first, then place a W seed in its path. W has virtually no cast time, so the seed can land while Q or E is traveling, leaving the target no time to dodge it or step on it first. Plant seeds in advance only when you are sure where the target will move.

zyra-combo-ult.basis: Place a seed, grow plants with Q and E, then cast R over them. Plants inside R become enraged, have their duration refreshed, and deal more damage. Save E until R knocks the target up, then root them right after they land.
zyra-combo-ult.text: For a teamfight combo, place seeds, grow plants with Q and E, then cast R over them. Plants inside R become enraged, have their duration refreshed, and hit harder, so casting it over plants produces a very different result from casting it on empty ground. R deals damage immediately, then knocks enemies up when the vines contract; if you save E for the knockup, you can root the target as soon as they land.

zyra-laning.basis: When the enemy support steps forward to protect their ADC or place a ward, root them with E and add a seed. If Zyra misses E, she has few ways to withstand a counterattack. When E is on cooldown, fall back and build up seeds.
zyra-laning.text: In lane, look to trade when the enemy support steps forward to protect their ADC or place a ward: root them with E, then add a seed. Zyra has low health and resistances, leaving her little way to withstand a counterattack if E misses. While E is on cooldown, fall back and build up seeds.

zyra-laning-brush.basis: Zyra is strong at ambushing enemies in areas where she has prepared seeds. Place seeds near a brush by a passage, then lead with E when the enemy enters.
zyra-laning-brush.text: Zyra is especially strong at ambushing. Prepare seeds near brush along a passage by the river or lane, draw the enemy toward them, then lead with E the moment they enter the seeded area. Having the seeds in place saves casting time and lets the same combo deal nearly lethal damage.

zyra-phase.basis: Zyra is weakest at levels 1–2, when seeds spawn slowly and she has few skills. From level 3, after learning E and Q and building up seeds, Zyra can trade damage. Zyra's power peaks at level 6 when she learns R and in the mid game when she gains ability power.
zyra-phase.text: Zyra is weakest at levels 1–2, when seeds spawn slowly and she has only one or two abilities. She can start trading damage from level 3, once she has learned both E and Q and built up seeds; her power peaks at level 6 when she learns R and in the mid game as she gains ability power. Later, enemies have mobility and ways to cleanse crowd control, making fights decided by a single E less likely, so secure advantages through vision and objectives before then.

zyra-situational-antiheal.basis: If the enemy has strong healing, finish one core item, then use Morellonomicon to reduce healing. Zyra lands many hits, including with her plants, making it easy to apply healing reduction.
zyra-situational-antiheal.text: If the enemy has a champion with strong healing, build Morellonomicon after finishing one core item to reduce it. Zyra lands many hits, including from her plants, so she can apply healing reduction easily.

zyra-situational-zhonya.basis: If the enemy has an assassin who dives in, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. Zyra has no mobility skill, so she has no way out once caught.
zyra-situational-zhonya.text: If the enemy has an assassin who dives in, build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. Zyra has no mobility skill and no way out once caught, so surviving the engage is essential to keeping her plants active.

zyra-skill-e.basis: E is Zyra's only guaranteed crowd control and the start of her combo. Do not waste E on wave clear. Vine Lashers grown from seeds in E's path are short range melee plants. If the enemy only pokes from afar, use your seeds with Q.
zyra-skill-e.text: E is Zyra’s only guaranteed crowd control and starts her combo, so do not waste it on wave clear. Vine Lashers grown from seeds in E’s path are very short range melee plants and are useful only when an enemy is close. If the enemy is poking from afar, seeds placed along E will accomplish nothing; use them with Q instead.

zyra-skill-passive.basis: P seeds spawn faster as you level up. P seeds stop spawning while you are hidden in a brush. When waiting in a brush, plant seeds before entering it. If an enemy champion steps on a seed, it disappears and briefly reveals their location.
zyra-skill-passive.text: P seeds are a resource that spawns automatically and more quickly as Zyra levels up. They stop spawning while she is hidden in a brush, so plant seeds before entering if you plan to wait there. An enemy champion who steps on a seed destroys it and briefly reveals their location.

zyra-skill-q.basis: Use plants grown by Q to clear waves and pressure towers. Q has a delayed detonation, so it often misses moving targets. When targeting a champion, time Q with a root or an ally's crowd control. If you spend mana to push the lane, gain an advantage by setting up vision or roaming.
zyra-skill-q.text: The ranged plants grown by Q keep firing, making them Zyra’s main tool for clearing waves and pressuring towers and a reason she can push faster than many supports. Q itself detonates after a delay and often misses moving enemies, so use it alone to clear minions and pair it with a root or an ally’s crowd control when targeting a champion. Because pushing costs a lot of mana, use the time it creates to set up vision or roam.

zyra-skill-r.basis: R has a delay between its cast and knockup, so targets with mobility skills can leave its area. To land R's knockup, cast it on enemies immobilized by an ally or in a narrow passage. Cast R ahead of an advancing enemy to block their path.
zyra-skill-r.text: R takes time to knock enemies up after it is cast, giving mobile targets a chance to leave its area. Starting with R alone often fails, so cast it on an enemy immobilized by an ally or one pressed against a wall or caught in a narrow passage to secure the knockup. You can also place it ahead of an advancing enemy, using the delay to block their path and discourage the engage.

zyra-skill-w.basis: W stores charges, and killing minions or monsters speeds up its recharge. Before a fight, keep at least one W charge for your combo. If W is fully charged, plant seeds along paths to use for vision.
zyra-skill-w.text: W uses charges rather than a standard cooldown, and killing minions or monsters speeds up its recharge. Farming naturally restores charges, but keep at least one for your combo before a fight. Sitting at full charges wastes the resource, so plant seeds along your route to provide vision.

zyra-teamfight.basis: Start teamfights behind your allies at the edge of your range. Before a fight, scatter seeds where your allies will stand and along the enemy's approach. As the enemy engages, cut off their path with E and R.
zyra-teamfight.text: In teamfights, Zyra controls an area from behind her allies. Before the fight, scatter seeds where they will stand and along the enemy's approach, then cut off the path with E and R as the enemy engages. Start at the edge of your range: if Zyra is caught first, neither her plants nor her seeds will matter.
